zlu ma (tshag ba 'a kho ra smo yi ( 10) khyu/ krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis dpe bsdur zhus//nyi sa// ///riX krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang / khyi)/ li ) rdzohū 447 chu sgo sprezhu dzekhrozhutsho/

'dulab/ tshomirtsi (10)0006 'dul ba phran tshegs kyi gzhi/ daphra mo'i rgo dang po/ so phag gi n+de tshan/ 3so phag sogs bshad pa/ 3sen mo bcos pa sogs bshad pa/ 18lhung bzed sogs bshad pa/ 74me long skyes sogs bshad pa/ 78yan lag sogs bshad pa/ 95lam phran sogs bshad pa/ 114chu tshags sogs bshad pa/ 121mon sran sde'u sogs bshad pa/ 137rkang pa bkru ba sogs bshad pa/ 148gos mdud pa sogs bshad pa/ 152phra mo'i sgo gnyis pa/ chan pa'i the tshan/ 162chan pas 'dreg sogs bshad pa/ 1621

gdugs sogs bshad pa/ 169be'u ras sogs bshad pa/ 183rgyan spel ma sogs bshad pa/ 185len pa sogs bshad pa/ 250tshogs dang khrus la sogs pa bshad pa/ 26 gcin la sogs pa bshad pa/ 271sgo 'phar bshad pa/ 291gsor la sogs pa bshad pa/ 292ste'u sogs bshad pa/ 298phra mo'i sgo gsum pa/ chos gos kyi n+de tshan/ 397chos gos kyi gdang sogs bshad pa/ 397nang dang phyi rol sogs bshad pa / 40 bskrad pa sogs bshad pa/ 407khang bzangs sogs bshad pa/ 426lan tshwa sogs bshad pa/ 452gdong phyis sogs bshad pa/ 456phyi ba sogs bshad pa/ 466mkhar len sogs bshad pa/ ci 476stan sogs bshad pa/ 484spu gri sogs bshad pa/ 495phra mo'i sgo bzhi ba/ gnas brtan gyi the tshan/ dzinaganas brtan sogs bshad pa/ dzinar ba sogs bshad pa/ 502lhan pa sogs bshad pa/ 516nad pa sogs bshad pa/ 5262

rigs ngan sogs bshad pa/ 544phag sogs bshad pa/ 544ri mo sogs bshad pa/ 554lhung bzed med pa sogs bshad pa/ 560gnas bca' ba sogs bshad pa/ 569shing bskyed pa sogs bshad pa/ 576za mo'i sgo lnga ba/ lus kyi ge tshan/ 582ro bsreg par bya ba sogs bshad pa/ 582gleng ba sogs bshad pa/ 607sangs rgyas mtshan nas smos pa sogs bshad pa/ 608spang ba sogs bshad pa/ 614nga 'das nas 'di la byin cig sogs bshad pa/ 621mtshams kyi phyi rol sogs bshad pa/ 627dge slong bgrang bar bya ba sogs bshad pa/ 630dge tshul gyi khri'u sogs bshad pa/ 6 8 tshul shing brims pa sogs bshad pa/ 642rung ba mi yin pa lnga sogs bshad pa/ 647phra mo'i sgo drug pa/ rgyus pa'i the tshan/ 650rgyus pa sogs bshad pa/ 650rab snang sogs bshad pa/ 651'tsho byed sogs bshad pa/ 676zhi ba sogs bshad pa/ 710ba lang skyong sogs bshad pa/ 789bsdur mchan/(759) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(897)3

la na ga sto 9rngo —— da ci ske ri dro ci r+sha44 cho gci tsho —— — 1 ci ci ci — ri ri / ci wa ༷༷nga — ri mi cipho mi pa — ci ga ༷ ———— — — — rdo ci 4) na tāchi da ༷ ci cho 1cho ༷rjo—— —ded nga4rda 4te ri 44 4 lo go dz+wa —rtoge do wa( rdo r+sā4 ci dzi ci (da mu nyi ༵ ༷༷nga kyidzha rngo byes sme ci mcho ༷ / rto44 ci 'bye ra dhetho — — rgyu su ru ༷ — — 4 ri sa la/sna ci 〉rto shi / ca ris/— ne / ri (4 /zlu wa ci ci / — cho ci /tshas k+ṣe ༷ ༷ ṣ+ṭa sa/ zi trerdo zhe ci ) lja nga ji / —4 tsho nga rdo liṅge/ ji na rtso / / —rtsa ji ci go zhadarjo cici / chos —6meḥzhes/ bye —sna —— —— /lta rī ciX ————— ci ) ca ci no 3 rngo rin ci ga / pa durdo ciri/ — — 4 ci ci nga ༷ /wa zang bye tre —1 7 /nga rtsa ༷ sgo cig ci tshi shāX mi rnga ༷ ci sna /bye su la 4 da nga pa ci ༄/ /rgyal po mes sbyin gyis mchod pa'i/ /bstan skyong chos kyi tshong dpon zhabs/ /

༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ bi na ya k+ṣa dra ka ②bstu/ bod skad du/'dul ba phran tshegs kyi gzhi/ bam po dang po/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phran tshegs kyi gzhi'i sdom ni/ so phag chan pa ②chos gos dang / /shing tshad dudang ni gnas brtan lus/ /rgyus pa 'gyod pa dbyung ⑤ba nyid/ /phran tshegs gzhir ni yang dag bshad/ /bsdus pa'i sdom ni/ so phag sen mo bcos pa dang / /lhung bzed yan lag me long skyes/ /lam phran chu tshags mon dusran sde'u/ /rkang pa bkru ⑦dang gos mdud do/ /sdom ni/ so phag dang ni sa dkar dudang / /nya phyis dri yi lag ris dang / /ka ba dang ni skud pa gnyis/ /lag rgyan dang ni sor gdub rgya/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yangs pa can na spre'u rdzing gi 'gram khang pa brtsegs pa ⑨⑩na bzhugs so/ /drug sde ⑩rnams snga dro sham thabs tsodang chos gos bgos8/ lhung bzed thogs 10—3

te yangs pa can du bsod snyoms kyi phyir zhugs pa dang / yangs pa can gyi bar dang / khang pa brtsegs pa'i bar gyi bar skabs de na yangs pa can gyi lits+tsha bī ①rnams kyi skyed ②mos tshal me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / chu phun sum tshogs pa / bya sna tshogs skad 'byin pa dga' ba'i tshal dang 'dra ba de dag na ①de dag gi rtse ba rjodang / gar dang / glu dang / rol mo'i sgra'i cha byad rjosna tshogs dag dang / khrus kyi yo byad sna tshogs dag kyang bzhag pa dang / drug sde rnams kyis ༅smras pa/ dga' bo nye dga' bo/ yangs pa can gyi lits+tsha bī 'di dag dang / skyed mos tshal gyi dga' ba ni bcom ldan 'das kyis sum bcu ⑦ma gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi ⑧dper mdzad na/ re zhig ⑨de dag gi skyed mos tshal ci 'dra ba blta'o zhes de rnams glod tshunas de dag gi skyed mos tshal du zhugs 7so//de dag gis de na brtsal 6)ba'i yo byad mda' bo che dang / drang ba dang /'phang rdo sna tshogs dang / gar dang / glu dang / rol mo'i sgra'i cha byad tsosna tshogs dang / pi bang byadang / gling bu dang / rdza rnga dang / khar byang dang /skad snyan la sogs pa sna tshogs dang / khrus kyi yo byad so phag dang / bkru ba'i phye ma dang / mgo bkru ba skyu ru ra sna tshogs mthong ba dang / de rnams kyis phan tshun smras pa/ dga' bo 8nye dga' bo yo byad phun 0sum tshogs pa rnam pa du ma 'di dag yod tson/ ci re zhig rtsal yibya'am/ 'on te gar bya'am/ glu blang ngam/ rol mo'i sgra bya ()'am/ khrus bya/ kha cig gis smras pa/bdag cag bkrus nas ring zhig lon gyis/ je 0khrus bya'o zhes de dag glod phy-inas so phag dag gis drud cing drud nas khrus bya bar brtsams pa dang / bzo'i gnas dang / las kyi gnas de dag la mkhas pas khrus la zhugs pa de rnams kyi 10—4

sgra yid du 'ong ba 'di lta ste/ sil snyan yan lag lnga pa skyes bu mkhas pas legs par dkrol ①ba'i ②lta bu byung ngo / /skye bo'i tshogs phal po che lam de nas 'gro bas sgra de thos pa dang / de rnams rna 0byo ste/ yud tsam bsdad nas smras pa / shes ldan dag yangs pa can gyi lits+tsha bī rnams kyi skyed mos tshal na gar mkhan rnams gar byed pa ltar du'adong ngam/ de ltar bya'o zhes ltad mo la yid 'dun pa de dag myur bar chas te skyed mos tshal du dong nas de dag nang du zhugs pa dang / drug sde rnams kyang phyir byung ngo / /de dag gis de rnams la smras pa/ 'phags pa dag phyogs gang na gar mkhan rnams gar dubagyidaX/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ bkren pa khyod ⑦kyis bye brag ⑧mi phyed de/ gar mkhan gar byed pa la sgra 'di lta bu 'byung ngam/ 'phags pa dag 'o na 'di su'i sgra lags / shes ldan dag kho bo cag lus drud nas khrus byas pa yin no/ /'phags pa dag ci dge sbyong khyed 'dod pa'i yon tan gyis gzir tam/ bkren pa khyed kyi mgrin pa rdog pas mnan la dge sbyong kho bo cag 'dod pa'i yon tan gyis gzir to/ /khyed kho bo cag gi rjes su ston pa yin nam ci/ ma smra bar deng ⑨/ khyed la gnod pa byas sa re zhes de rnams kyis de dag bsdigs pa dang /spa gong nas dong ste/ yangs pa can du zhugs nas lam po che dang / srang dang / bzhi ⑩mdo yidang / sum mdo dag tu 'phya bar brtsams so/ /dge slong rnams kyis skabs 8de thos nas bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa'/ nyes byadamigs gang cung zad byung ba ni dge slong rnams so phag dag gis (nyelus drud de khrus byed pa las gyur gyis0/de lta bas na chadage slong gis tsoso phag gis lus drud de khrus mi bya'o/ /'drud na 10—5

'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gis so ①phag gis lus drud ②de khrus mi bya'o zhes boka' stsal pa dang / dge slong dag rkang pa ser ga byung zhing dri ma dang bcas bzhin bsod snyoms la 'jug pa de dag bram ze dang / khyim bdag rnams kyis mthong nas smras pa/ 'phags pa dag khyed zhabs ser ga byung zhing ②dri ma dang bcas na/ ci ste dri ma sbyang bar mi bgyi/de rnams kyis smras pa/ bzhin bzangs rjorjodag bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang ngo / /ci 'phags pa khyed dri ma'i 'dam bcangs pas dag par 'gyur ram/de rnams cang mi smra bar 'dug ste/ bsod snyoms la brgyus dunas gtsug lag khang du dong ba dang / skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la rgyas par gsol tol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis r+shaka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ⑧de ltar na snga ma ni bcas pa'o/ /'di ni gnang ba yin te/ de lta bas na dge slong gis rkang pa so phag gis drud par gnang ngo / /lus gzhan ni ma yin te/'drud lan 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro//bcom ldan 'das yangs pa can na spre'u rdzing gi 'gram khang pa brtsegs pa na bzhugs 0so/ /dge slong rnams snga dro sham thabs dang chos gos bgos/lhung bzed thogs te yangs pa can du bsod snyoms kyi phyir zhugs pa dang / de rnams kyis bram ze zhig sa dkar gyis sor 7ris gsum byugs nas slong tsomo la rgyu zhing de'i bslangs pa yang mang du rnyed par mthong ngo ⑫/ /drug sde rnams kyis smras pa/ dga' bo nye dga' bo thabs 'di ni bzang po zhig ste/ bdag cag kyang de ltar bya'o zhes de rnams phyi de nyin sa dkar gyis sor 8ris gsum byugs nas bsod snyoms la zhugs pa ma dad pa rnams kyis mthong nas 'phya zhing gus 18—6

par smra'o/ /gus par smra'o zhes smras pa dang / drug sde rnams kyis smras pa/bkren pa khyed kyis gus par smra bar ①bya ba gang dag yin pa dang / phyag bya ②ba gang dag yin pa 'di yang mi shes sam/ de dag gis smras pa/ 'di la ci zhig 'tshal bar bgyi/ bram ze rgan pa rgan ①pa rnams ni gus par smra bar bya ba yin la/ dge slong rnams ni phyag bya ba yin na/ de ci'i phyir khyed dge slong rnams la gus par smra ba byed kyi phyag ma yin/ 'phags pa dag 0bdag cag gis khyed bram ze lags par 'tshal gyi dge slong du ni ma lags so/ /de lta lags pas bdag cag gis ma 'tshal gyis dubazod par gsol lo zhes byas pa dang /de dag cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis thos nas bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis ༷dgongs pa/nyes dmigs gang cung zad ci byung ba ni dge slong rnams sor ①ris gsum 'dri ba las gyur gyisani/ de lta bas na dge slong gis sor ⑨ris gsum bri bar ⑩mi bya'o / /dge slong sor yiris gsum 'dri na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gis sor 8ris gsum mi byug tsogo zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong dag sman pas bsgo yang lus sas mi ④skud pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de ltar na snga ma ni bcas pa'o/ /'di ni gnang ba yin te/ de lta bas na sman pas bsgo ba ni ma gtogs so//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /drug sde rnams snga dro sham thabs dang chos gos bgos/ lhung bzed thogs te mnyan yod du bsod 10—7

snyoms kyi phyir zhugs pa na/ de rnams kyis bram ze gi'u nyuwang gi thig ②le byas pa zhig skye bo phal po che'i tshogs kyis bskor zhing ②ston mo'i bsngags pa brjod pa mthong ba dang / de rnams kyis smras pa/ dga' bo nye dga' bo thabs 'di ni bzang po zhig ste/ bdag cag kyang 'di ltar bya'o/ /legs kyis rjode ltar bya'o zhes de rnams phyi de nyin gi'u duwang gi thig le dag gis bdag nyid brgyan pa rjobyas nas bsod snyoms la zhugs pa dang / bram ze dang khyim bdag dag gis ⑦mthong nas 'phya zhing gus par smra'o gus par smra'o zhes smras pa dang / drug sde rnams kyis smras pa/ bkren pa khyod nikyis gus par smra bar bya ba gang dag yin pa dang / phyag bya ba gang dag yin pa 'di yang mi shes sam/ de dag gis smras pa/ 'di la ci zhig 'tshal bar bgyi/ bram ze rgan pa rgan pa rnams ni gus par smra bar bya ba yin la/ dge slong rnams ni phyag bya ba yin na/ de ci'i phyir ⑨khyed dge slong rnams la gus par smra ba byed kyi phyag ma yin/ 'phags pa dag bdag cag gis khyed bram ze lags par 'tshal gyi dge slong du ni ma lags so / /de'i slad du bdag cag gis ma ⑩'tshal gyisayi/ bzod par gsol lo zhes byas pa dang / de dag cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ nyes 8dmigs gang cung zad ci 'byung ba ni dge slong dag gi'u rkyiwang gi thig ledag gis bdag nyid brgyan pa las gyur gyisaX/ de lta bas na dge slong gis gi'u 0wang gi thig le dag gis brgyan par mi bya'o/ /brgyan na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gis gi'u ⑩wang gi thig le dag gis bdag nyid brgyan par mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang /18—8

dge slong zhig 'phral ①bar rma byung ba de sman pa'i drung du song nas bzhin bzangs bdag la sman ston cig /'phags pa rma'i than ②kor gi'u chawang gis skus ༷shig dang khyod 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /des smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang ngo / /'phags pa khyod kyi ston pa ni thugs rje can yin pas gnang bar 'gyur ro/ /skabs dude dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na dge slong dag sman pas bsgo ba ni ma gtogs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rjogis so phag gis lus drud par mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong rnams nya phyis kyis 'drud par byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/nya phyis kyis drud ⑦par mi bya'o/ /'drud na 'gal ②tshabs can du 'gyur ro//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /drug sde rnams dris byugs te gzhon nu rnams kyi ⑨nang du dong nas smras pa/ gzhon nu dag nged kyi dri ji lta snoms shig /de dag gis smras pa/ gnas brtarno ci khyed dris byugs sam/ byugs so0/ /gnas brtan khyed dris byug tu rung ngam/ rung yang yirung mi rung yang rung ste/ ⑫ nged kyis ⑩ni byugs so/ /de dag 'phya smod kha zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ nyes dmigs gang cung zad 'byung ba ni dris nyug pa las gyur gyis 8de lta bas na dge slong rnams kyis dris byug par mi bya'o / /nyug na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams kyis dris 8byug par mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge 10—9

slong nad pa zhigo sman pa'i drung du song ste/ bzhin bzangs bdag la sman ston cig① /des smras pa/ 'phags pa dris byugs na khyod 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /bzhin bzangs ci kho bo 'dod pa spyod dam/ 'phags pa khyod kyi sman ni 'di yin te/ gzhan gyis ni ②'tsho bar mi nus so/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/de lta bas na gnang gis ②sman pa'i lung gis dri bcang bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag dris byugs nas dge 'dun gyi nang na 'dug cing bram ze dang khyim bdag 'ongs shing lhags pa rnams la chos ston par byed/ bram ze dang khyim bdag gi khyim rnams su yang 'gro bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ngas dge slong dri 'chang ba'i kun du spyad pa'i chos bca' bar bya ste/ dge slong dri 'chang bas dris byugs nas dge 'dun gyi nang du 'dug par mi bya/ bram ze dang khyim bdag 'ongs shing lhags pa rnams la chos bstan 0par mi bya/ bram ze dang khyim bdag gi khyim rnams su 'gro bar mi bya'i/ nam sos par gyur pa de'i tshe khrus byas nas dri dumed par gyur pa dang dge 'dun gyi nang du 'dug par bya / bram ze dang khyim bdag 'ongs shing lhags pa rnams la chos bstan par bya/bram ze dang khyim bdag gi dukhyim rnams su 'gro bar bya'o/ /dge slong dri 'chang bas kun du spyad pa'i chos ji ltar bcas pa bzhin yang dag par blangs te mi 'dug na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag dge slong rnams la dri 'bul ba na/ dge slong rnams 'gyod nas mi len pa dang / de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag gang gi tshe sangs rgyas 18—10

bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du byung bar ma gyur pa de'i tshe ni ①nu stegs can rnams yon gnas lags/ da ni bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du byung bas da ltar khyed yon gnas lags na/ gal te khyed ②kyis ma bzhes rgyan ci bdag cag 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol du dge ba'i lam rgyags ma mchis par mchi'amadu / bdag cag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du bzhes shig /de dag gis smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das la zhu'o/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das dul gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das ⑥kyis bka' stsal pa/blang bar bya'o/ /dge slong rnams kyis blangs nas de dag nyid kyi mdun du bor ba dang / de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag bdag cag gis ①rin thang bzhin du nyo nyo na khyed nikyis blangs te dor ram/ skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/blangs nas dor bar 0mi bya'i/ 'on kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la dri'i lag ris byug par bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis blangs nas dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten dag la dri'i lag ris zhug go/ /de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag ci bdag cag gis mchod rten ma mthong ngam/bdag cag gis ni khyed kho na la phul te⑩/ dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten dag la ni sngar phul lags so/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ blangs nas gnas khang la byug par bya'o/ /de rnams kyis gnas khang gi sgo la byugs pa dang / de dag dri gtsang khang yin no snyam nas phyag 'tshal bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom 10—11

ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nang du byug par bya'o/ /dge ①slong rnams kyis drang thad ②du byugs pa dang / nyes dmigs de nyid du gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sngas dang nye ba'am rkang pa dang nye bar byug par bya zhing ②dri zhim po ༷thams cad mig la phan pas dus dus su bsnam rjopar bya ste/ 'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chu srin byis pa gsod ⑥kyi ri la 'jigs 'jigs lta'i tshal ri dgas ⑦kyi nags na bzhugs so/ /ji tsam na rgyal bu gzhon nu rtogs byed kyi nikhang bzangs pad ma ris byed du bcug ⑨nas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa gdugs tshod la spyan drangs te⑩/bcom ldan 'das khang bzangs pad ma'i ris su dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams byapa la bzhugs tsoso/ /nye dga' bo 8zan za ba'i tshe lag pas ka ba la bsnun pa dang / khang bzangs pad ma ris g.yos par gyur to/ /'dri thostemakhan rnams kyis smras pa/ 'phags pa rgyal bu rtogs byed kyis khang bzangs pad ma ris tshon brgya rtsa tshugacig gis bkra bar byas pa khyed kyis gzhig gam ci/ nye dga' bos (9smras pa/ bkren pa rtogs byed 'di la lhag par chags pas dus byas nas gar skye gtol med do/ /khyed kyang 'di la lhag par chags pas dus byas nas yi dgas lba ba can rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag kha zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑩dgongs pa nyes dmigs gang cung zad byung ba ni dge slong dag ka ba la lag pas bsnun pa las gyur gyisaX/ de lta bas na dge slong gis 6)lag pas ka ba la bsnun par mi bya'o/ /bsnun ⑥ na 'gal 10—12

tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gis ka ba la lag pas bsnun par mi bya zhes bka' stsal pa dang / drug sde rnams khu tshur dang gru mo dang / phrag pa dang / mgo dang / rtsib logs dang / rgyab dang / rked pa dang / brla dang / pus mo dang / byin pa dang / rkang pa dang /dbyug pa dang / bong ba dang / gzhan gyis snun ①par byed pas ②nyes dmigs de nyid du gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang gis kyang bsnun par mi bya'o/ /drug sde rnams rtsig pa dang sa dang / gzhan la snun ②par byed pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gzhan la yang gang ⑤gis kyang ⑤bsnun par mi bya'o/ /bsnun yin 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan ⑦yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal ⑧mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ⑨ba na bzhugs so/ /drug sde rnams snga dro mnyan yod du bsod snyoms kyi phyir zhugs pa dang / de rnams kyis bram ze zhig tshangs pa'i skud pa thogs te slong ⑨ mo la rgyu zhing des bza' ba ⑩dang bca' ba yang mang du rnyed 8pa mthong nas drug sde rnams kyis smras pa/ dga' bo nye dga' bo thabs 'di ni bzang po zhig ste/ bdag cag kyang de lta bu bya'o zhes de dag phyi de nyin tshangs pa'i skud pa thogs te/ bsod snyoms la zhugs pa ma dad pa rnams kyis mthong nas/ 'phya zhing gus par smra'o/ /gus par smra'o zhes smras pa dang / drug sde rnams kyis smras pa/ bkren pa khyed kyis gus par smra bar bya ba gang dag yin pa dang / phyag bya ba gang dag yin pa 'di yang mi shes sam / de dag gis smras pa/ 'di tsol ci zhig 'tshal bar bgyi/ bram ze rgan pa rgan pa rnams ni gus par smra bar bya ba yin la/ dge slong rnams ni 10—13

phyag bya ba yin na/ de ci'i phyir khyed dge slong rnams la gus par smra bar byed kyi ①phyag ma yin/ 'phags pa dag bdag cag gis khyed bram ze lags par 'tshal gyi dge slong du ni ma lags so/ /de lta lags pas bdag cag gis ma 'tshal gyis ②bzod par gsol ②lo zhes byas pa dang / de dag cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis ④thos nas bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ nyes dmigs gang cung zad ci byung ⑤ba ni dge slong rnams tshangs pa'i skud pa thogs pa las gyur gyis⑥/de lta bas na dge slong gis tshangs pa'i skud pa gdags par mi bya'o/ /'dogs na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /drug sde rnams snga dro sham thabs dang chos gos bgos/ lhung bzed thogs te mnyan yod ⑦du bsod snyoms kyi phyir zhugs pa na/ de dag gis bram ze dri dang me tog gis brgyan pa tshon sna lnga pa'i ③skud pas lag pa bcings pa zhig dus ston zos nas dbang po tshim ste/ khyim nas byung ba mthong ba dang / de dag gis smras pa/ dga' bo nye dga' bo thabs 'di ni bzang 0po zhig ste/ bdag cag kyang 'di bzhin bya'o zhes de dag phyi de nyin tshon sna lnga pa'i skud pas lag pa bcings nas bsod snyoms la zhugs pa/ bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis mthong nas 'phya zhing gus par smra'o/ /gus par smra'o zhes smras pa dang / drug sde ⑩rnams kyis ⑩smras pa/ bkren pa khyed kyis gus par smra bar bya ba gang dag yin pa dang /phyag bya ba gang dag yin pa 'di yang mi shes sam/ de dag gis smras pa/18—14

'di la ci zhig 'tshal bar bgyi/ bram ze rgan pa rgan pa rnams ni gus par smra bar bya ba yin ①la dge slong rnams ni phyag bya ②ba yin no②/ /de ci'i phyir khyed dge slong rnams la gus par smra bar ༷byed kyi phyag ma yin/ 'phags pa dag bdag cag gis khyed bram ze lags par 'tshal gyi/ dge slong du ni ma lags so//de lta lags pas bdag cag gis ma 'tshal gyis dubazod par gsol lo zhes byas pa dang / de dag cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis thos nas bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis rjidagongs pa/ nyes dmigs gang cung zad ci byung ba ni dge slong rnams tshon sna lnga pa'i skud pas lag pa 'ching ba las gyur gyisal/ de lta bas na dge slong gis tshon sna lnga pa'i skud pas lag pa bcing bar mi bya'o/ / 'ching na ⑧'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong tshon sna lnga pa'i ②skud pas lag pa bcing bar mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong nad pa gzhan zhig sman pa'i drung du song ste/ bzhin ⑩bzangs kho bo la nad 'di lta bu byung na sman ston cig ces byas pa dang / des smras pa/ 'phags pa skud ⑩pa la gsang sngags dag gis bzlas brjod byas te/ lag pa la bcings na khyod 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /des smras pa/ bzhin bzangs bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang ngo / /'phags pa khyod kyi ston pa ni thugs rje can yin pas gnang bar 'gyur 8ro/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na gnang gis (spresman pa'i lung gis skud pa bcang ④bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis sman pa'i lung gis skud pa bcang bar 8bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong 10—15

rnams lag pa g.yas pa'i rtse mo la 'ching ste/ nyes dmigs de nyid du gyur nas / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag lag pa g.yas pa'i rtse mo la bcing bar mi bya'o/ /de rnams lag pa g.yas pa'i dpung pa la 'ching ste/ nyes dmigs de nyid du gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lag pa g.yas pa'i dpung pa la bcing bar mi bya'o/ /de rnams lag pa g.yon pa'i rtse mo la 'ching ste/ nyes dmigs de nyid du gyur nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lag pa g.yon pa'i rtse mo la bcing bar mi bya'i/ 'on kyang lag pa g.yon pa'i dpung pa la bcing bar bya'o/ /dge slong rnams nad sos par gyur nas skud pa bab bab tu 'dor bas ①mi ma yin pa rnams 'phya ste/ 'phags pa dag nged kyis sos par byas na ②da ma gus par byed pa lta/ skabs de dge slong rnams ②kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bab bab tu dor bar mi bya ste/gal te nad ma byang na chos gos kyi mtha' 'am/ rgya cang la bcing bar bya'o/ /'on te thams cad kyi thams cad du sos par gyur na ④ka ba'i ser ga'am/ rtsig pa'i gseb tu gzhug par bya'o// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /drug sde rnams snga dro sham thabs dang chos gos bgos/ lhung bzed thogs te mnyan yod du bsod snyoms kyi phyir zhugs pa na/ bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis durgyan slo duma'i nang du bzhag ⑦pa drug sde rnams kyis rkang ⑧rgyan dang lag rgyan dag thogs nas smras pa/ dga' bo nye dga' bo ji lta ⑨mdzes sam/ bram ze dang khyim bdag dag ⑩10—16

gis smras pa/ 'phags pa khyed mgo ni byi/ mchan ②khung ni spun ②na 'di la lus mdzes pa ci zhig yod gdon mi za bar dge sbyong khyed ②'dod pa'i yon tan dag gis gzir dubar gyur to zhes byas pa dang / de rnams cang ⑤mi smra bar 'dug go//skabs de dge slong rnams kyis thos nas bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ nyes dmigs gang cung zad ⑥byung ba ni ⑦dge slong rnams lag rgyan ⑧dang rkang rgyan dag gis bdag nyid brgyan pa ⑨las gyur gyis0/ de lta bas na dge slong gis lag rgyan yidang rkang rgyan 8gyis bdag nyid brgyan par mi bya'o/ /brgyan na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /gtsug lag khang du ma byin par len pa rnams kyis dge 'dun gyi mdzod dang / gang zag gi tsoganas khang dag nas brkus tho)so/ /dge slong gzhan dag gcig tunyegi yang stor na/bdag cag gi stor nas ji tsam lon pa ma tshor ro/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/de lta bas na gnang gis tu)rgya bcang bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis rgya bcang bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / drug sde rnams kyis gser dang /dngul dang / be+e ḍūr+ya ⑩dang shel las byas pa dang / sor gdub rgya 8rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa dag bcangs so/ /de nas bram ze dang khyim bdag dag gis ⑩mthong nas lag pa brgyang ① ste smras pa/ bzhin bzangs nad med cig nad med cig /de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa 'di ci lags/ bzhin ⑥bzangs bcom ldan 'das kyis rgya gnang ngo de dag 'phya smod kha zer zhing dge 10—17

sbyong shākya'i bu rnams kyis ①dge sbyong gi tshul nyams shing tshangs pa'i tshul nyams te/'di na da ②ltar rgya la tha snyad 'dogs shing rgyan ③rnams kyis bdag nyid brgyan par byed do/ /skabs de rjodage slong rnams kyis thos nas bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong gis gser dang / dngul dang / be+e ḍūr+ya rjodang / shel las byas pa'i rgya bcang rjobar mi bya/ sor gdub ⑦rgya yang bcang bar mi bya'i 'on kyang rgya lnga po ra gan dang / zangs las byas pa dang / khar ⑧ba las byas pa dang / ba so las byas pa dang / rwa las byas pa bcang bar bya'o/ /drug sde rnams kyis rgya la skyes pa dang / bud med nyal po byed pa bris pa dang / bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis smras pa/ 'phags pa ci dge sbyong khyod ⑨'dod pa'i yon tan dag gis gzir tam/ gnas skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' ⑨ stsal pa/ rgya ni gnyis te/ dge 'dun gyi dang yigang zag gi'o/ /de la dge 'dun gyi ni dbus su 'khor lo bris la/glo gnyis su ri dgas 'og tu gtsug lag khang gi bdag po'i ming bri bar bya'o/ /gang zag gi ni rus pa'i keng rus sam/ mgo'i thod pa bri bar bya'o// //sdom ni/ sen mo 'breg tsodang byi dor dang / /a mra tsodang ni skyu ru ra/ /lhung bzed brgyad po bkag pa dang / /rjes su gnang ba gnyis yin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' byar ba na bzhugs so/ /gang gi tshe khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis tsosangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge ⑩'dun la rgyal bu rgyal 10—18

byed kyi tshal phul ba de'i tshe/ des 'breg ①mkhan gyi mi la smras pa/ kye skyes bu rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du song la 'phags pa rnams kyi ②skra dang kha spu bregs ①shig /de rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du song ba dang / drug sde rnams kyi kun du spyod pa ni drug sde gang yang rung ba zhig gis rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi sgo mi stong 0pa yin te/ tshe dang ldan pa nye dga' bo rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal na 'chag cing 'dug pa des de rgyang ring po nas mthong nas smras pa/ bzhin ⑤bzangs 'ongs pa legs so/ /'ongs pa legs so/ /khyod zla ba lta bur gnas na ring mo zhig lon te/ gang nas 'ongs/ des smras pa/ 'phags pa khyim bdag gis 'phags pa rnams kyi skra dang kha spu breg ༷pa'i slad du 'dir btang ngo //des smras pa/ sen mo legs par 'breg shes sam/ 'phags pa 'di ④nyid bdag gi bzo lags so/ /bltas latshur de 0nye bar 'ongs pa dang / nye dga' bos lag pa brkyang ngo / /'breg ⑩mkhan gyis smras pa/ 'phags pa ci 'dra bar breg /bzhin bzangs 'bru'i rtse mo ltar bregs 0shig /des 'bru'i rtse mo ltar bregs pa dang / des smras pa/ da 8ni ra ba'i cog 0lta bu dang /spu gri'i 8so dang / ste'u ka dang / zla ba tshes pa ltar gyis shig /des de ⑫ji lta/ ji ltar sgo ⑩ba de lta tsobur byas pa dang / mjug tu smras pa/ bkren pa khyod ko cung zad kyang mi shes pa zhig /'di kho na ltar mnyam 8par gyis la song shig ces des de nyi ma nub kyi bar du ma btang 0ngo / /de nyi ma nub nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi drung du song ba dang / mgon med zas sbyin ⑥gyis smras pa/ kye skyes bu khyod kyis 'phags pa mang po ji snyed cig gi mgo dang kha spu bregs/ bdag gis 'phags pa rnams kyi skra dang kha spu ga la bregs/10—19

dge sbyong ①gzu lums can nye dga' bos bdag bsgor ②nas/ sen mo 'bru'i rtse mo dang / ra ba'i cog ③dang / spu gri'i so dang / ste'u ka dang / zla ba tshes pa lta bur gyis shig ces pa'i rnam pa thams cad bdag gis bgyis pa dang /de nas 'di skad cesadu/ bkren pa khyod rjoko cung zad kyang mi shes pa zhig /'di kho na ltar mnyam par gyis la song shig ces mchi dunas da gzod 0kho na shor na ci zhig bgyi/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la nirab tu byung ba rnams la nye bar zhi ba med pa lta zhes 'phya ba la zhugs so/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis ①thos nas bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ nyes dmigs gang cung zad 'byung ba ni dge slong rnams sen mo 'breg pa las gyur gyisayi/ de lta bas na dge slong gis sen mo breg par mi bya'o/ /'breg na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gis sen mo breg par mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong rnams sen mo ring po 8ring por 'dug pa bram ze dang khyim bdag de tsodag gis mthong nas ⑩smras pa/ 'phags pa dag ci ste sen mo ring po ring por 'jog /bzhin bzangs bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang ngo / /'phags pa ci khyod 8sen mo bcangs pas 'dag ⑩par 'gyur ram/skabs de dge slong rnams kyis thos nas bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ snga ma ⑩ni bcas pa'o/ /'di ni gnang ba yin te de lta bas na gnang gis phyesen mo rnam pa gnyis po spu gri'i yiso dang / ste'u ka lta bur breg par bya'o//bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas 10—20

sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /gang gi tshe khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis ①sangs rgyas la sogs ②pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la zhes bya ba thams cad de kho na bzhin no/ /khyod sen mo 'chos shes sam/ 'phags pa ji lta bur bgyi/ ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang / gser gyi kha dog lta bur gyis shig ces pa'i rnam pa thams cad bdag gis bgyis pa dang ②/de nas 'di skad ces bkren pa khyed ko ༷cung zad kyang mi shes pa zhig /'di kho na ltar mnyam par gyis la song shig ces mchi nas da gzod 0kho na shor na ci zhig bgyi/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin ༅legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba rnams la nye bar zhi ba med pa lta zhes 'phya ba la zhugs sol/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis thos nas bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs ⑦pa/ nyes dmigs gang cung zad ⑧byung ba ni dge slong rnams sen mo dag byi dor byed pa las gyur gyisal/ de lta ⑩bas na dge slong gis sen mo dag byi dor mi bya'o/ /byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gis sen mo dag byi dor mi bya'o//zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong tshon rtsi'i las dang / lhung bzed kyi las byed pa rnams kyi sen mo dri ma chags la mdog mi sdug par gyur cing ⑪/ de rnams sen mo de 'dra ⑩ba kho nar bsod snyoms la 'jug go/ /bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis mthong nas smras pa/ 'phags pa dag khyed ci'i phyir sen mo de lta bur 8dri ma chags shing mdog ④mi sdug /de dag gis bsnyad 8pa dang / de rnams kyis smras pa/ 'phags pa ci'i phyir dri ma mi dbyiX/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang ngo / /'phags pa khyed ci dri ma'i 'dam ⑩bcangs pas 'dag ⑫18—21

par 'gyur ram/ skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dri ma dbyi ba'i ①phyir sen mo bzhar bar bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na 'od ma'i tsal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa na bzhugs so/ /rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i kun du spyod pa ni dus kyi ②gsar thog 'bru sar ③pa'am 'bras bu sar pa gang ci yang rung ba dude dag dang por dge 'dun la 'bul lo/ /de'i du'og tu bdag nyid za'o/ /de'i blon po rnams kyis a mra'i shing thog dag phul ba dang / des smras pa/song la 'phags pa rnams la phul cig /de dag gis bgad pa rjodang / des smras pa/ shes ldan dag ci la dgodal/ de dag gis smras pa/ lha ci khyod ⑧da ni 'phags pa rnams la dang por 'bul snyam dgongs kyi/ bdag cag gis ches sngar 'phags pa rnams la phul bar ni ma lags sam/ des smras pa/gal te de lta na ngas 'phags pa rnams la stong gi kun dga' ⑨ra ba nyid phul lo/ /lha legs te rjes su yi rang ngo / /des phyogs bzhi'i dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi phyir stong gi kun dga' ra ba phul nas der dus ston kyang btsugs 0so/ /de ji ltar yul ma ga dhā yin gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs dus ston la lta bar 'ongs pa a mra'i shing thog smin pa rnams kyis tshim par gyur pa de ltar shing thog rgyas par gyur to / /de dge 'dun la phul zhes byadage slong rnams kyis a mra'i 'bras bu dag ma smin pa nyid du zos so/ /ji tsam na mtshams kyi rgyal po zhig la a mra dag dgos par gyur nas/ des rgyal po gzugs can snying po la pho nya btang ⑩ste/grogs po bdag la a mra dag dgos kyis byabaskur ba'i rigs so zhes byas pa dang /10—22

des pho nya de la smras pa①/ kye skyes bu ngas stong gi kun dga' ra ba de 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la phul gyis ②song la 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la slongs shig /de 'od ma'i tshal du song ba dang / drug sde rnams kyis ①kun tu spyod pa ni rtag tu kun dga' ra ba'i sgo mi stong ༷par byed pa yinadu/ tshe dang ldan pa nye dga' bo 'od ma'i tshal gyi sgo na 'chag cing 'dug go/ /de de'i drung du song nas phyag 'tshal te des smras pa/ rgyal po che ge mo zhig gis a mra'i ched du khyed kyi thad du btang na 0de'i slad du a mra ⑦dag stsal ba'i rigs so/ /des smras pa/ kye skyes bu song la a mra byaji tsam dgos pa de tsam long 0shig /de rkyisong nas a mra'i shing rnams kyi ⑩drung du bltas na mi snang stem/ de slar log nas smras pa/ 'phags pa ma mchis so/ /nye tsodaga' bos de khrid nas kun dga' tsor bar zhugs te/ kun dga'i sker ba thams cad bskor nas smras pa/kye skyes bu shing 'di la 'dzegs shig /des 'dzegs nas ⑩ma mthong ba dang /nye ⑩dga' bos smras pa/ kye skyes bu dag tsoshar gyi yal gar song lho dang nub kyi yal gar song / de thams cad du song nas skyo chabar gyur te babs nas smras pa / 'phags pa ci kun dga'i dur ba 'di 0lo 'di la 'bras bu ma chags sam/bzhin bzangs ji ltar lo re zhing dulo re zhing shing thog yod pa de ltar 'di 'bras bu chags so/ /'phags pa ci rlung dang char pas blags sam/ bzhin bzangs rlung dang char pas dum blags kyiphyo/ 'on kyang kho bo cag gis a mra'i 'bras bu dag ma smin pa nyid du 'chos so/ /de slar log nas rgyal po gzugs can snying po la gsol pa/ lha 'phags pa rnams kyi duzhal nas kho bo cag gis a mra'i 'bras bu dag ma smin pa nyid du 'chos so zhes gsung 0ngo / /des smras pa/10—23

legs te nga la longs spyad ①pa nyid dgos so zhes byas pa dang / mi de slar song ngo / /ji tsam na dus ston la bab pa'i tshe yul ma ga dhā ②na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs 'dus nas/ de dag gis ②smras pa/ 'phags pa dag ci stong gi kun dga' ra ba 'di lo 'di la ④'bras bu ma chags sam/ bzhin bzangs dag ji ltar lo re lo re zhing shing thog yod pa de ⑤ltar 'di 'bras bu chags mod kyi/'on kyang kho bo cag gis a mra'i 'bras bu dag ma smin pa nyid du 'chos ⑥so /'phags pa dag gang ⑦yul ma ga dhā ⑧na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs thams cad a mra ༅smin pa dag gis tshim par 'gyur ba de khyed ⑩kyis 'bras bu ma 0smin pa kho nar 'chos te/ gang kho bo cag la gnod pa byas pa ni ma legs pa zhig byas so//des smras pa/ 'di rgyal pos yul tsom ga dhā tson gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs la byin pa ma yin gyi/ 'on kyang dge slong gi dge 'dun la phul te/ de lta bas na kho bo cag gis ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin zos so/ /khyed ci ④gtogs zhes byas pa tsodang / de dag 'phya smod kha zer bar byed do/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis thos nas bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs ⑩pa/ nyes dmigs gang cung zad ci byung ba ni dge slong rnams a mra dag za ba las gyur gyisatshu/ de lta bas na dge slong gis a mra dag bza' bar mi bya'o/ /dge slong a mra dag za na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gis a mra dag bza' bar mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag dge slong rnams la shing sa ha ka tsora'i shing tog dag 'bul ba na/ dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang ngo / /de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag 10—24

gang gi tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du byung bar ma gyur pa zhes bya ba nas/ 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol du 'gro'am/ bzhes shig ces bya ba'i bar snga ma ①bzhin no/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis thos nas bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/de lta bas na gnang gis ②mtshan nyid grub pa yin no zhes byas nas bza' bar bya ste / 'di la ③'gyod par mi bya'o/ /de la mtshan nyid grub pa ni 'di dag yin te/ tshig gu ༷chags pa rnams so/ /bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can gzhan dag cig /dge slong rnams la ༷a mra'i shing thog ⑥min pa dag 'bul ba na zhes bya ba nas/ de bzhin du 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol du mchi'am / bzhes shig ces bya ba'i bar thams cad snga ma bzhin no/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na gnang gis ⑦mtshan nyid bye brag phyed do zhes byas te bza' bar bya'o/ /de la mtshan nyid bye brag phyed pa ni 'di dag yin te/ sha zhugs pa rnams so//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /mnyan yod na dge slong nad pa zhig sman pa'i drung du song ste/ bzhin bzangs bdag 'di 'dra ba'i nad kyis thebs na ②sman ston cig /des smras pa/ 'phags pa je mar 'thung la snum ⑨par gyis shig dang bkru ⑦sman sbyin no/ /des mar 'thungs pa dang / skom tunyepas gnod par gyur to/ /sman pa 'ongs te dris pa/'phags pa bde bar 'dug gam/ des smras pa/ bzhin bzangs bdag skom ⑫18—25

pas gnod do/ /skyu ru ra chongs shig ces byas pa dang / des lag tu blangs te 'dug go/ /yang sman pas dris pa/ 'phags pa skom chopa dang bral lam/des smras pa/ bzhin bzangs ma bral lo/ /sman pas smras pa/ 'phags pa ②de'i tshe skyu ru ra ma bcangs sam/ bzhin bzangs yod de 'di yin ①rna/ /'phags pa khar chongs shing du/ /bzhin bzangs bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang ngo / /'phags pa khyod kyi duston pa ni thugs rje can yin pas gnang bar 'gyur ro/ /skabs de zhes bya ba nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/khar bcang bar bya'o ⑥zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /des khar bcug nas 'dug go//yang sman pa de 'ongs nas dris pa/ 'phags pa skom pa dang bral lam/ des smras pa/ bzhin bzangs da rung ⑦ma bral lo/ /sman pas smras pa/ 'phags pa de'i tshe skyu ru ra khar ma bcangs sam/ bzhin bzangs bcangs te 'dug pa 'di yin no/ /des smras pa/ 'phags pa mur cig /gzhan du na skom ⑧pa dang bral ⑨bar mi 'gyur ro/ /des smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang ngo / /'phags pa khyod kyi 7ston pa ni thugs rje can yin pas gnang bar 'gyur rol/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis thos nas bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mur bar bya'o/ /mur mur nas por gyi ⑩ma mid pa dang / skom ⑩pas je gnod par gyur to/ /yang sman pa 'ongs nas dris pa/ 'phags pa skom pa dang bral lam/ des smras pa/ bzhin ⑫bzangs shin tu gnod do/ /'phags pa de'i tshe skyu ru ra ma mur ram/ bzhin bzangs mur nas bor ro/ /'phags pa ci'i phyir ma mid8/ bzhin bzangs bcom ldan 'das kyis dus ma yin pa'i zas bkag go/ /'phags pa khyod ni 10—26

nad pa yin la/ khyod kyi ston pa ni thugs rje can yin pas gnang bar 'gyur rol/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na dge slong dag gnang gis ①'bras bu lnga dus su yang rung / dus ma yin par yang rung / nad pa yang rung / mi na bas kyang rung bza' bar bya ste/ 'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'bras bu lnga dus su yang rung / dus ma yin par yang rung / nad pa yang rung / mi na bas kyang rung ②ste/ bza' bar bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis 'bras bu lnga gang dag yin pa mi shes pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ skyu ru ra dang / a ru ra dang / ba ru ra dang / pi pi ling sridang / na le sham mo//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na 'od ma'i tshal bya rjoka lan da ka duganas pa na bzhugs so/ /rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer na khyim bdag shin tu bzang po zhes bya ba phyug cing nor mang ba longs spyod chen po zhig duganas pa de gcer bu pa ⑦rnams la rab tu dad do/ /des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas/ de de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed ⑧dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur 0spyod par 0byed do/ /de rtse bar byed dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las dus gzhan zhig na chung ma la sems can zhugs par gyur to//bcom ldan 'das kyang snga dro sham thabs dang chos gos mnabs 0lhung bzed bsnams 7te rgyal po'i khab tu bsod snyoms 8kyi phyir zhugs nas rgyal po'i khab na bsod snyoms la rgyu zhing khyim bdag shin tu bzang po'i khyim ga la ba de logs su gshegs pa dang / khyim bdag shin tu bzang pos bcom ldan 'das rgyang ma 10—27

nas mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang chung ma khrid nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gi ①mchis 'brang ②'di ②sems can zhugs par dugyur na ci zhig tu btsa' bar 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bu phor btsa' bar 'gyur zhing / rigs gsal bar byed par 'gyur/ lha dang mi'i dpal nyams su myong bar 'gyur/ nga'i bstan dupa la rab tu byung nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te/ dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byed par 'gyur ro/ /des bcom ldan 'das la bza' rjob dang bca' ba gtsang zhing bsod pas lhung bzed bkang ste phul ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis nad med cig ces gsungs nas bsod snyoms bzhes te gshegs so/ /de dang ha cang mi ring ba zhig na gcer bu pa zhig 'dug pa des bsams ⑦pa/ gang bdag cag la bslang ba'i khyim gcig pu zhig yod pa de yang dge sbyong gi duta mas kha drangs kyis 0song la dge sbyong gau ta mas ci tshulung bstan pa blta'o snyam mo/ /de der song ste smras pa/ khyim bdag dge sbyong gi ta ma skye'ongs par gyur tam/byon tsoto/ /des ci zhig lung bstan/ 'phags pa bdag gis de la 8chung ma ⑫bstan te/ ci zhig tu btsa' ⑤bar 'gyur zhes bgyis pa dang / de bu 'phor btsa' bar 'gyur zhing / rigs gsal bar byed par 'gyur/ lha dang mi'i dpal nyams su myong bar 'gyur/ nga'i bstan pa la rab tu byung nas nyon mongs ⑩pa thams cad spangs te/ dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byed par 'gyur ro zhes gsung 8ngo / /gcer bu pa de rtsis mkhas pa zhig ste/ rdo rgyus kha dog dkar po blangs nas brtsis pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis ji skad du lung 10—28

bstan pa de thams cad de kho na bzhin du mthong nas/ des bsams pa/gal te rjes su bsngags na ni khyim bdag 'di dge sbyong gau ta ma la je ①dad par 'ong bas de bas na ②'dir cung chazad cig ni bsngags par bya/ cung zad cig ni smad par bya'o snyam du bsams nas/ lag pa kyog dubazhin bsgyur ba dang / khyim bdag shin tu bzang pos smras pa/ 'phags pa ci ste lag pa kyog dubazhin bsgyuraX/ des smras pa/ khyim bdag 'di la cung zad cig ni bden/cung zad cig ni brdzun no⑦/ /'phags pa gang ni bden gang ni brdzunani/khyim bdag bu phor btsa' bar 'gyur ro zhes zer ba gang yin pa de ni bden no/ /rigs ⑨gsal bar byed par 'gyur ro zhes zer ⑩ba gang yin pa de ni bden nayi/gsal ba ni me'i ming yin pas sems can skal ba chung ngu de btsas ma thag kho nar khyim mes tshig par 'gyur ro/ /lha dang mi'i dpal nyams su myong bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes zer ba gang yin pa de ni brdzun 8te/ khyim bdag khyod kyis mir gyur pa la lha dang mi'i dpal nyams su myong bar gyur pa 0'ga' yod pa lta mthong ngam/ nga'i bstan pa la rab tu 'byung ngo zhes zer ba de bden te/gang gi tshe 'di bza' ba yang med/ bgo ba yang med pa de'i tshe gdon mi za bar dge sbyong gi ta ma'i thad du rab tu byung ④bar 'gyur ro/ /nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byed par 'gyur ro zhes zer ba gang yin pa 8de ni brdzun 0te/ re zhig dge sbyong gau ta ma la yang nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pa'i dgra bcom pa nyid med na/ de'i nyan thos la lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyim bdag shin tu bzang 0po mi dga' bar gyur nas smras pa/ 'phags pa 'di la bdag gis ji ltar bsgrub par bgyi/ gcer bu 10—29

pas smras ①pa/ khyim bdag bdag cag ni rab tu byung ba ste/ bslab pa blangs pa yin pas khyod nyid shes so zhes smras nas song ngo ②/ /shin tu bzang pos bsams pa 'di yang dor ③ro snyam nas sman ma yin pa sbyin par brtsams dupa dang / sems can de srid pa tha ma pa ⑤zhig pas sman ma yin pa 0de yang de la sman du gyur to/ /des de'i dku g.yon pa mnye bar brtsams pa dang /mngal na 'dug pa de dku g.yas par song ngo / /shin tu bzang rgyapos dku g.yas pa mnye bar brtsams ⑤pa dang / de dku g.yon par song ste/ srid pa tha ma pa'i sems can zag pa zad pa ma thob kyi bar du bar ma dor rgyun chad cing dus byed par 'gyur ba gang yin pa de ni gnas ma yin zhing 0go skabs med do/ /khyim bdag shin tu bzang po'i chung ma de dku mnyes pas 0ngu bar brtsams ⑩pa dang / khyim tshes dag gis thos nas rings pa rings par song ste dris pa/shes ldan khyim bdag gi chung ma 'di ci ste ngu / shin tu bzang pos smras pa/gdon mi za bar 'di bu btsa' chaba'i dus la bab po zhes byas pa dang / de de ⑫dag dong ngo / /shin tu bzang pos bsams ④pa/ bdag gis 8'di 'dir gsad ⑩mi nus kyis0/ dgon par bkri'o snyam nas/ des de dgon par khrid nas ci nas 'chi bar 'gyur ba de lta 8de ltar brtsal nas des de sbas te khyim du khyer nas mdza' bo dang / nye du dang / phu nu dang / khyim tshes rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag kho bo'i chung ma shi'o/ /de dag gis ngu bar brtsams nas de dag ngu zhing de gos sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po rnams kyis khyogs brgyan nas bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod du khyer ro/ /gcer bu pa yidag gis thos nas de dag dga' mgu durangs nas 10—30

gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dag bsgreng ste rgyal po'i ①khab kyi ②grong khyer ②gyi lam po che dang / sung dang bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo dag tu rgyu zhing smras pa/ shes ldan dag nyon cig /dge sbyong gi ta mas khyim bdag shin tu bzang ④po'i chung ma bu phor btsa' bar 'gyur zhing / rigs gsal bar byed par 'gyur/ lha dang mi'i dpal nyams su myong bar 'gyur/ nga'i bstan pa la rab tu byung nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byed par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa de ni shi nas bsil ba ⑤tshal gyi dur khrod du khyer ro/ /re zhig shing gang la rtsa ba nyid kyang med pa de la yal ga dang 'dab ⑥ma dang / lo ma 'byung bar lta ga la 'gyur/ skabs 'di lta bu la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams mi mkhyen pa'am/ mi gzigs pa'am / mi rig pa'am/ rnam par mi mkhyen pa cung zad kyang mi mnga' ste/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po 'jig rten la phan par zhugs pa/srung ba gcig pu/ gcig tu dpa' ba⑦/ zla med pa gnyis su mi gsung bdu/zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gis gnas pa/ bslab pa ⑨gsum la legs par bslabs ⑩pa/ 'dul ba'i gzhi gsum la mkhas pa/ chu bo bzhi las rgal ⑩ba/rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi'i zhabs kyi mthil la 8legs par gnas pa/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la yun ring po nas goms 8par mdzad pa/ mi 'jigs pa bzhis mi snyings ④pa/ yan lag lnga rnam par spangs pa/ 'gro ba lnga las yang dag par 'das pa/ yan lag drug dang ldan pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa/ drug la rtag tu gnas pa/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyi 4)me tog gis phyug pa/ lam yan lag brgyad pa ston pa/ mthar gyis 10—31

gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la mkhas pa/ stobs bcu'i stobs mnga' ba / grags pas phyogs bcur khyab pa/ stong la dbang sgyur ba ①bas khyad par du 'phags pa rnams ni chos nyid kyis nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis ②'jig rten la gzigs shing su ni nyams/ su ni dar/su ni nyam nga bar gyur③/ su ni skobs 0su chud par gyuraX/ su ni gnod par gyuraX/ su ni nyam ⑦nga ba dang / skobs nisu chud pa ⑨dang / gnod par gyur/ su ni ngan song la gzhol/ su ni ngan song la babaX / su ni ngan song la 'bab/(tre gang ni ngan song las drangs nas mtho ris dang /thar pa dang / 'bras bu la dgod/ gang zhig gis chadage ba'i rtsa ba ma bskyed pa ni ()bskyed par bya/ gang zhig gis bskyed (srepa ni yongs su smin par bya/gang zhig smin pa ni grol bar bya zhes ye shes gzigs pa 'jug go/ /yang smras pa/chu srin 8gnas kyi rgya mtsho ni/ /dus rlabs 'da' bar 'gyur srid kyi/ /gdul bar bya ba'i sras rnams la/ /sangs rgyas dus las mi 'da'o⑩/ /ji ltar ma ni sdug pa'i bu gcig la/ /lta zhing de yi srog kyang srung ba ltar/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gdul ba'i skye bo la/ /de bzhin gzigs shing de yi rmyargyud kyang srung / /thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu tsol gnas pa yi/ /thugs rje'i ba drus ba gshin be'u stor bzhin/ /srid pa bgrod dkar tso'akhyams par gyur pa yi/ /gdul ba'i sras rnams skyo mi mkhyen par tshol// // 'dul ba phran tshegs kyi gzhi/du bam po gnyis pa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis phyogs zhig 0tu 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /chos nyid kyis gang gi tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 'dzum pa mdzad pa de'i tshe zhal nas 'od 18—32

zer sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dag byung nas kha cig ni 'og tu 'gro/ kha cig ni steng du 'gro ste/ gang dag 'og tu 'gro ba de dag ni dmyal ba yang sos dang / thig nag dang / bsdus gzhom dang / ngu 'bod dang / ngu 'bod chen po dang / tsha ba dang / rab tu tsha ba dang / mnar med pa dang / chu bur can dang / chu bur rdol ba dang /so thams thams dang / kyi hud zer ba dang / a cu ༅zer ba dang / ut+pal ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa chen por song ste/ tsha ba'i dmyal ba gang dag yin pa de dag tu ni bsil bar gyur nas 'bab / grang ba'i ②dmyal ba gang dag yin pa de dag tu ni dro bar gyur nas 'bab po/ /des sems can de rnams kyi sdug bsngal gyi khyad par rgyun bcad pa dang / de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ shes ldan dag ①ci bdag cag ④'di nas shi 'phos sam/ 'on te gzhan du skyes zhes ⑤zor ro/ /de ⑥dag dad pa bskyed pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das sprul pa gtong ste/ de dag gis sprul pa de mthong nas 'di snyam du sems shing shes ldan dag bdag cag 'di nas shi 'phos pa yang ma yin gzhan ⑦du skyes pa yang ma yin gyis/ 'on kyang sems can 'di sngon ma mthong ba zhig ste/ 'di'i mthus bdag cag sdug bsngal gyi khyad par rgyun chad do zhes zer ro/ /de dag sprul pa ⑨la sems mngon par dang bas dmyal ba myong bar 'gyur ba'i las de zad par byas nas gang du sems can rnams snod du gyur pa ⑩lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du nying mtshams sbyor ba 'dzin to//gang dag steng du 'gro ba de dag ni rgyal chen bzhi'i lha dang / sum bcu rtsa gsum pa 7dang / 'thab bral dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang /18—33

gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang / tshangs ris dang / tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don dang / tshangs chen dang / 'od chung dang / tshad med 'od dang /'od gsal dang / dge chung dang / tshad med dge dang / dge rgyas dang /sprin med dang / bsod nams 'phel dang / 'bras bu che ba ①dang / mi che ba dang / mi gdung ba dang / shin tu mthong ba dang / gya rnam snang ba dang /② 'og ②min gyi ④lha rnams kyi nang du song nas mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / stong pa dang / bdag med pa zhes bya ba yang sgrogs socha/ /tshigs su yibacad pa tsoganyis kyang sgrogs te/ brtsam ⑧par bya zhing 'byung ⑨bar bya / /sangs rgyas bstan la 'bad ⑩par bya/ /'dam 0bu'i khyim la glang chen bzhin / /'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par bya/ /chos 'dul 'di la gang zhig ni//bag dang bcas par spyod byed pa/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs nas/ /sdug bsngal gyi ni mthar byed 'gyur/ /de nas 'od zer de dag stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams bskor nas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi phyi bzhin ⑫phyi bzhin 'brang 8zhing 'gro ste/ de gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis ④'das pa ⑫lung ston par bzhed tson ni bcom ldan 'das kyi snam logs su nub par 'gyur rol/ /ma 'ongs pa lung 0ston par bzhed na ni mdun du nub par 'gyur ro/ /dmyal bar skye bar yilung ston par bzhed yin ni zhabs kyi mthil du nub par 'gyur ro/ /dud 'gror skye bar 0lung ston par bzhed na ni long bur nub par 'gyur ro/ /yi dgas su skye bar 0lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthe bor nub par 'gyur ro/ /mir skye bar tsolung ston par bzhed na ni pus mor nub par 'gyur ro/ /stobs kyi tso'akhor los sgyur chuba'i rgyal srid tshulung ston par 10—34

bzhed na ni phyag g.yon gyi mthil du nub par 'gyur ro/ /'khor los sgyur ①ba'i rgyal srid lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yas kyi mthil du nub par 'gyur ro / /lhar skye ba ③lung ston par bzhed na ni lte bar nub par 'gyur ro/ /nyan thos kyi byang chub lung ston par bzhed na ni zhal du nub par 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub lung ston par bzhed na ni mdzod spur nub par 'gyur ro/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub lung ston par bzhed na ③ni gtsug tor rjodu nub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams bskor nas bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal du nub po/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos thal mo sbyar te bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/rnam pa sna tshogs tshon ni stong dag gis/ /bkra ba'i tshogs dag zhal gyi nang nas byung / /nyi ma shar bar gyur pa ji lta bar/ /de yis phyogs rnams kun tu snang bar bgyis/ /tshigs su bcad de yang gsol pa/ sangs rgyas rgod dubral zhum dang rgyags pa spangs/ /rgyal ba dgra thul 'gro mchog rgyur gyur pa/ /rgyu ma mchis par pad ma'i rtsa lag dang / /dung ltar dkar ba'i 'dzum pa ston mi mdzad / /de ltas ①nyid kyi brtan blos ⑦dus mkhyen nas/ /rgyal dbang nyan po nyan par 'tshal rnams kyi/ /the tshom skyes pa thub pa skyes mchog gi/ /gsung mchog bzang zhing brtan ⑧pas bsal ①du gsol/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ri rab ltar brtan pa/ /zung thub rnams ni glo bur 'dzum mi ston/ /mgon po ci slad ⑩'dzum pa mdzad pa de/ /skye bo'i tshogs 'di nyan par yang dag 'tshal/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de de 10—35

bzhin no de de bzhin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni rgyu med rkyen med par 'dzum pa mi mdzad do/ /kun dga' bo song la dge slong rnams la dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa dur khrod du rgyu zhing gshegs par bzhed kyis ①khyed las ②gang zhig de bzhin gshegs pa dang lhan cig dur khrod du rgyu zhing 'gro bar spro ba de chos gos dag so so nas long ②shig ces bsgo ④shig /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos btsun pa de ltar 'tshal lo ⑤zhes bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan nas/ dge slong dag gang na ba der song ste phyin nas dge slong rnams la dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa dur khrod du rgyu zhing gshegs par bzhed kyis⑥/ khyed las gang zhig de bzhin gshegs pa dang lhan cig dur khrod du rgyu zhing 'gro bar spro ba de chos gos dag so so nas long ④shig ces bsgo ba phyedang / dge slong thams cad 'dus nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar lhags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dul ba 'khor dul ba zhi ba 'khor zhi ba grol ba 'khor grol ba/ dbugs phyin pa 'khor dbugs phyin pa/ rnam par dul ba 'khor rnam par dul ba/ dgra bcom pa 'khor dgra bcom pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba 'khor 'dod chags dang bral ba / mdzes pa 'khor mdzes pa/ khyu mchog ba glang gi tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/0 glang po che glang po che'i phru gu'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ seng ge mche ba can gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ ngang pa'i rgyal po ngang pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ nam mkha' lding bya'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ bram ze bram ze'i khye'u'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/0 sman pa nad pa'i tshogs kyis ⑪bskor ba lta bu/ dpa' bo dmag mi'i tsotshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ sa 18—36

mkhan 'gron pa'i ①tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ ded dpon ②chong pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ tshong dpon 'khor gyi ①tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/khams kyi rgyal po blon po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ 'khor los sgyur ④ba bu stong gis bskor ba lta bu/ zla ba skar ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ nyi ma 'od zer stong gis bskor ba lta bu/ yul 'khor srung dri za'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ 'phags skyes po grul bum gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ mig mi bzang klu'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ rnam thos sras ⑤gnod sbyin gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ thags 0zangs ris ⑦lha ma yin gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ brgya byin sum bcu rtsa gsum pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ tshangs pa tshangs ris pa'i 2tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ rgya mtsho mi g.yo ba lta bu/sprin chu dang bcas pa lta bu/ glang po che'i rgyal po dregs ⑨pa med pa lta bu/dbang po shin tu dul bas spyod lam mi nyams par gshegs pa/ sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyis brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad bcus mdzes par byas pa/ sku 'od 'dom gang gis skyabargyan pa/ 'od nyi ma stong bas lhag pa/ rin po che'i ri 'gro ba lta bur kun nas bzang ba/ stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / ma 'dres pa'i yidran pa nye bar gzhag pa gsum tsodang / thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ nyan thos chen po kun shes kauṇ+ḍi 6)rgya dang / rta thul dang / rlangs pa dang / ming chen thostedang /bzang po dang / shā ri'i bu dang / mod gal ④gyi bu dang / 'od srung dang /grags pa dang / gang po la sogs pa dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun mang po gzhan dang / srog chags brgya stong phal mo tsoches bskor nas bsil ba'i 0tshal 10—37

gyi dur khrod du gshegs so/ /sangs rgyas gshegs pa la phan yon bcwa ①brgyad yod de/ ba'o ②brgyad gang zhe na/ me'i 'jigs pa med/ chu'i 'jigs pa med / seng ge'i 'jigs pa med/ stag gi 'jigs pa med/ gzig gi 'jigs pa med/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyi 'jigs pa med/ rkun ③po'i 'jigs pa med/ la gcan pa'i 'jigs pa med/ gru btsas kyi 'jigs pa med / sho gam gyi 'jigs pa med/ bsel byangan gyi 'jigs pa med/mi'i 'jigs pa medage/ mi ma yin pa'i 'jigs pa med/ dus dus su gzugs bzang po dag mthong bar 'gyur/ sgra snyan pa dag thos par 'gyur/'od chen po dag mthong bar 'gyur/ kun shes pa lung ston ⑥pa dag thos par 'gyur / chos kyi longs spyod dang / zang zing gi longs spyod dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas gshegs pa ni gnod pa chung ba yin pas lha dang /mi ⑦brgya stong du ma bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs du'abring du phyi bzhin 'brang ngo / /bsil ba'i 0tshal logs nas rlung dag kyang langs so/ /rgyal rigs kyi khye'u zhig dang / bram ze'i khye'u ⑩byis pa gnyis shig rgyal po'i khab nas phyi rol du byung ste rtse zhing 'khod do/ /de gnyis las rgyal rigs kyi khye'u ni dad pa dang ldan pa yin/ bram ze'i khye'u ni de lta hum yin no/ /bram ze'i khye'u des rgyal rigs kyi khye'u la smras pa/ grogs po bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag shin tu bzang po'i 8chung ma'i bu khye'ur ⑩skye bar 'gyur te/ rigs 'bar bar 'gyur zhing lha dang mi'i dpal yang myong bar 'gyur tsonas nga'i bstan pa la rab tu byung 8ste/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byed par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa ⑩de ni 'chi ba'i dus byas nas 10—38

bsil ba'i ②tshal gyi dur khrod du khyer na②/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / brdzun ②du ma gyur grang / rgyal rigs kyi khye'u des tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ zla ba skar ma'i tshogs bcas sa la lhung ④yang srid/ /sa 'di ri dang nags bcas mkha' la 'gro yang srid⑤/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i chu ni skam par 'gyur ⑥srid kyi/ /drang srong chen po brdzun ⑦gsung 'gyur ba srid pa min/ /bram ze'i khye'u des grogs po de ltar ⑧na bsil ba'i 0tshal gyi dur khrod lta ⑩zhing 'dong ngo zhes smras nas de gnyis dong ba dang bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab nas gshegs pa mthong ngo / /rgyal rigs kyi ⑩khye'us bcom ldan 'das thag ring po kho na tsonas mthong nas yang tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ thub pa the tshom ⑫bral zhing rgod pa mi mnga' ba/ /ri dgas rgyal po lta bu'i sgra skad mchog sgrogs shing / /the tshom 8med par pha rol smra bas mi rdzi tsob/ /'di ltar skye bo'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor cing ⑩gshegs/ /bsil tshal phyogs su kha ba'i tshogs lta bu'i/ /bsil ba'i ngad can rlung ni langs par gyur pa ni rmye/ /shākya thub pa'i rdzu 'phrul brtag pa'i don gyi phyir/ /lha tshogs mang po gnas nas 'ongs pa nyid du nges/ /rgyal po gzugs can snying pos bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag shin tu bzang po'i chung ma'i bu khye'ur 8skye bar 'gyur yite/ rigs 'bar bar 'gyur zhing lha dang mi'i dpal yang myong bar gyur nas nga'i bstan pa la rab tu byung ste nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum 0du byed par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan na 0de ni 'chi ba'i dus la bab nas bsil tshal gyi dur khrod du phyung zhing / bcom ldan 'das kyang nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang thabs cig 'atu bsil ba'i dutshal gyi dur khrod du gshegs so zhes thos 10—39

so / /thos nas kyang de 'di snyam du sems te/ bcom ldan 'das ni don med par bsil tshal gyi dur khrod du mi gshegs pas bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag shin tu bzang po'i chung ma la ①brten te gdul ba'i don chen po zhig mdzad par 'gyur gor ma chag gis ②ltar la'agro'o snyam nas de btsun mo dang /gzhon nu dang / blon po dang / pho brang 'khor ba rjodang / ljongs kyi 0mis yongs su bskor nas rgyal po'i khab nas 0song ba dang / rgyal rigs kyi ⑦khye'u des rgyal po bzo ②sbyangs gzugs can snying po thag ring po kho na ⑨nas mthong ⑩nas yang tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ ma ga dhā yi mnga' yibadag rgyal po'i gtso bo 'di/ /'di ltar 'khor bcas rgyal po'i khab nas byung ba las/ /skye bo'i tshogs kyi 8'byor pa phun sum tshogs par ni/ /bdag gi snying la nges pa'i blo dag skyes par ⑩gyur/ /skye bo'i tshogs rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das mthong nas gshegs shul phye ba dang / bcom ldan 'das zhal 'dzum pa mdzad cing skye bo rnams kyi gung la bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das zhal 'dzum pa mdzad pa gcer bu pa dag gis mthong nas bsams pa/ 'di ltar dge sbyong gi ta ma bzhin 'dzum pa byed cing skye bo mang po'i gung la 'dug pa las na sems can 'di ma shi bar nges so snyam nas/ des khyim bdag shin tu bzang po la smras pa/khyim bdag sems can skal ba chung ngu 'di ni ma shi'o/ /des smras pa/'phags pa de ltar gyur na skabs 'di la da ⑩ji ltar bsgrub par bya/ des smras pa / khyim bdag kho bo ni bslab pa'i gzhi 8yang dag par blangs pa yin gyisarkye/khyod nyid shes par gyis shig /des bud shing bcer ⑦te chung ma'i ro 8me'i phung po'i nang yidu bcug ste bsregs pa dang / de'i lus thams cad tshig na lto'i 10—40

nyen kor ①de bzhin du 'dug go/ /de nas lto'i nyen kor ②de rdol nas pad ma byung ste/ pad ma ③de'i snying po las gzhon nu gzugs bzang ba blta na sdug pa/mdzes pa zhig byung ngo / /de srog chags brgya stong dag gis mthong nas mchog tu ngo mtshar chen po skyes par gyur pa dang gcer bu pa dag gi ④rgyags ⑤pa dang /nga rgyal dang / khengs pa dag nyams soyi/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag shin tu bzang po la bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag gzhon nu long ༅shig /des gcer bu pa'i gdong du bltas pa dang / des smras pa/ khyim bdag me phung durab tu 'bar ba'i nang du zhugs ⑨na thams cad kyi thams cad du tshig ⑩ par mi 'gyur ram/ de skad 0smras pas 'des ma blangs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'tsho byed gzhon nus gsos la bka' stsal pa/ 'tsho byed gzhon nu long 8shig /des bsams pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gnas ma yin skabs ma yin par bdag mi bskos kyis 8blang ngo snyam nas de 8the tshom 8med par me phung gi nang du zhugs cite blangs so/ /rgyal ba'i bka' yis me yi phung por zhugs 'gyur te/ /de yis gzhon nu me yi nang nas blangs pa na/ /rgyal ba'i mthu yis me ni zhi ba nyid gyur cing / /kha ba'i tshogs ltar bsil ba'ang skad cig de la byung / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'tsho byed gzhon nu tsol bka' stsal pa/ 'tsho byed khyod nyams pa'ams/ gnod pa dag tu ma gyur tam/des gsol pa/ btsun pa bdag rgyal po'i pho brang du btsas zhing ⑥rgyal po'i pho brang du skyes par gyur kyang 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyezhugs kyi phung po tsan dan sa mchog 3lta bur bsil bar gyur pa 'di lta bu ni sngon chad ma myong lags so/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag shin tu 10—41

bzang po la bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag gzhon nu 'di long ①shig /de log par blta ②ba la phyogs pas re zhig len par mi byed cing / gcer bu pa de nyid kyi gdong du lta bar byed do/ /des smras pa/ khyim bdag mang du smra ci dgos / mes ni thams cad 'tshig pa yin na/ gzhon nu shin tu skal ba chung ba 'di ma tshig pa las na/ 'di khyod kyi lakhyim du khyer na khyod kyi khyim yang tshig cing khyod kyi srog gi bar chad du yang 'gyur bar nges so/ /des bdag las gces pa med do snyam nas de ma blangs pa dang / de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis ma ga ṅgā'i ④rgyal po bzo ⑤sbyangs gzugs can snying po la bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po gzhon nu long ⑥shig /des gus ⑦par bsgrims ⑧pa dang bcas pas lag pa brkyang ⑨ste/ de blangs nas kun du brtags te gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das khye'u 'di'i ming cir gdags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/—rgyal po chen po khye'u 'di ⑨ 'di ltar me'i nang nas skyes 0pas de'i phyir khye'u 'di'i ming me skyes zhes bya bar gdags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑫skye bo phal po che'i tshogs de dag gi ()bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang /khams dang / rang bzhin thugs su chud nas ci nas kyang sems can brgya phrag mang po de dag gis thos nas khyad par rnyed par 'gyur ba 8de lta bur chos bstan pa mdzad pas kha cig gis ⑩ni rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas/kha cig gis ni lan gcig 8phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu/ kha cig gis ni phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu/ kha cig gis ni rab tu byung ste/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas par gyur to/ /kha cig gis ni dro bar gyur pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang / kha cig gis ni rtse mo dang /10—42

kha cig gis ①ni bzod pa chung ngu dang 'bring ②bskyed par gyur to/ /kha cig gis ni nyan thos kyi byang chub dang / kha cig gis ni rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub dang / kha cig gis ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi sems bskyed par gyur to/ /kha cig gis ni skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi dag yang dag par blangs te 'khor de dag las phal cher sangs rgyas la gzhol ba dang / chos la 'bab ②pa dang / dge 'dun la bab 0par gyur to//de nas brgyal po gzugs can snying pos khye'u me skyes ma ma brgyad po pang na 'tsho rjoba'i ma ma gnyis dang / nu ma snun ⑦pa'i ma ma gnyis dang / dri ma 'phyi ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / rtsen ⑧grogs kyi ma ma gnyis la rjes su gtad do/ /de ma ma brgyad po dag gis 'o ma dang / zho dang / mar dang / zhun mar dang /mar gyi snying khu ⑨dang / gzhan yang yo byad kyi bye brag gtso bo gtso bo dag gis sring bar byed skyed ⑩par byed cing / rdzing na gnas pa'i pad ma bzhin du myur du skyed yipar byed do/ /de'i zhang po zong thogs te yul gzhan du song ba des ji ltar bdag gi sring mo la sems can zhugs par gyur pa de bcom ldan 'das kyis khye'ur skye bar 'gyur te/ rigs 'bar bar 'gyur zhing / lha dang mi'i dpal yang myong bar gyur nas/ nga'i tsobastan pa la rab tu byung ste nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas tsodagra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byed par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa thos nas des zong bsgyur 8te rin blangs nas rgyal po'i khab tu song ba dang / des 'di ltar bdag gi sring mo de 'chi ba'i dus la bab po zhes 8thos so/ /thos nas kyang bsams pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i bu khye'ur skye bar 'gyur te/ rigs 'bar bar 'gyur zhing / lha dang mi'i 18—43

dpal yang myong bar gyur nas nga'i rbestan pa la rab tu byung ste nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byed par 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de brdzun ①du ma gyur tam snyam nas des khyim tshes dag la dris pa/ bdag gi sring mo la sems can zhugs par gyur pa de bcom ldan 'das kyis ②khye'ur 'gyur te/ rigs 'bar bar 'gyur zhing / lha dang mi'i dpal yang myong bar gyur nas nga'i bstan pa la rab tu byung ste/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byed par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan par thos so/ /thos nas bdag kun tu dga' ba las de yang 'chi ③ba'i dus la bab po zhes thos na / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de brdzun dudu ma gyur tam/de dag gis tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ zla ba skar ma'i tshogs bcas sa la lhung ⑤yang srid/ /sa 'di ri dang nags bcas mkha' la 'gro yang srid/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i chu ni skam par ⑥'gyur srid kyi/ /drang srong chen po brdzun ⑦gsung 'gyur ba srid pa min/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa ni brdzun ⑧du mi 'gyur te 'di ltar khyim thab ⑨des de ji lta ji ltar 'chi bar 'gyur ba de lta de ltar byas pas 'chi ba'i dus la bab nas de'i ⑩khye'u dbang thang chen po can mer bsregs kyang ma tshig pa mthu bo che ⑩zhig da ltar rgyal po'i pho brang na gso zhing 'dug go zhes smras pa dang / de khyim bdag shin tu bzang po'i gan du song ste smras pa/ khyim bdag khyod kyis 8mi rigs pa zhig byas so/ /ci zhig byas/gcer bu pas bslus nas khyod kyis nga'i sring mo la sems can zhugs pa ji lta ji ltar 'chi bar 'gyur ba de lta de ltar byas pas 'chi ba'i dus la bab par tsobyas so//18—44

des ①khye'u dbang thang can mer bsregs kyang ma tshig pa mthu bo che zhig da ltar rgyal po'i pho brang na gso zhing ②'dug pa de la ②ni re zhig ci byar yang med de/'di ltar da ④yang gal te gzhon nu de blangs na de lta na legs/ 'on te mi len na ngas khyod gnyen du yang mi brtsi/ rabs yig kyang dor ⑤zhing lam po che dang / srang dang lam gyi sum mdo dang / bzhi 0mdo dag tu yang khyim bdag shin tu bzang pos bdag gi sring mo bsad deX/ chung ma gsod ⑧pa 'di la sus kyang gtam 'dre bar mi bya'o zhes mi snyan pa bsgrag cing rgyal po'i gnod pa yang byed du gzhug go zhes smras pa dang / des de thos nas skrag ste/ de skad smras pa ⑨dang sbyar na bdag la de ltar byed par nges so snyam nas/ de rgyal po'i gan du song ste rkang pa gnyis la phyag 'tshal nas smras pa/ lha bdag gi nye du po'i mchid nas da yang gal te gzhon nu de blangs na de lta na legs/ 'on te mi len na ngas khyod gnyen du yang mi brtsi/ rabs yig kyang dor ⑨ zhing /lam po che dang / srang dang lam gyi sum mdo dang / bzhi yimado dag tu yang khyim bdag shin tu bzang pos bdag 8gi sring mo bsad de 'chung ma gsod ④pa 'di la sus kyang gtam 'dre bar mi bya'o zhes mi snyan 8pa bsgrag ⑩cing rgyal po'i gnod pa yang byed du gzhug go zhes mchi bas/ de'i slad du lhas gzhon nu me skyes bdag la stsal ba'i rigs so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ khyim bdag gzhon nu me skyes ngas khyod la 0blangs pa ma yin gyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis nga la gtad pa yin pas khyod la gal te gzhon nu dgos na gzhon nu'i ched du bcom ldan 'das la sngar zhus shig /de bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song nas zhabs gnyis la phyag 'tshal te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gi 18—45

nye du po'i mchid nas da yang gal te gzhon nu de blangs na de lta na legs/'on te mi len na ngas khyod gnyen du yang mi brtsi/ rabs yig kyang dor ①zhing /lam po che dang / srang dang / lam gyi sum mdo dang / bzhi ②mdo dag tu yang khyim bdag shin tu bzang pos bdag gi sring mo bsad de②/ chung ma gsod dupa 'di la sus kyang gtam 'dre bar mi bya'o zhes mi snyan pa bsgrag cing /rgyal po'i gnod pa yang byed du gzhug go zhes mchi bas/ de'i slad du gzhon nu me ⑤skyes bdag la stsal ba'i rigs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gal te khyim bdag shin tu bzang po gzhon nu me skyes ma thob na khrag tsha ba skyugs nas 'chi ba'i dus byed par 'gyur ba'i gnas skabs de lta bu yod par gzigs nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo song la rgyal po gzugs can snying po la nga'i bkas a rog gya 0zhes byos la 'di skad ces rgyal po chen po khyim bdag shin tu bzang po la gzhon nu me skyes byin cig /gal te khyim bdag shin tu bzang po gzhon nu me ⑦skyes ma thob na khrag tsha ba skyugs nas 'chi ba'i dus byed par 'gyur ba'i gnas skabs de lta bu yod par 'gyur ro zhes kyang bsgo ⑧shig /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' mnyan nas rgyal po gzugs can snying po ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ rgyal po gzugs can snying po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis khyod la rgyal po chen po a rog gya ⑨zhes bka' stsal te/rgyal po chen po khyim bdag shin tu bzang po la gzhon nu me skyes byin cig /gal te khyim bdag shin tu bzang po gzhon nu me skyes ma thob na khrag tsha ba skyugs nas 'chi ba'i dus byed par 'gyur ba'i gnas skabs de lta bu yod par 'gyur ro zhes 18—46

kyang bka' stsal to/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ btsun pa kun dga' bo bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ji skad bka' stsal pa de bzhin 'tshal lo/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos rgyal po chen po a rog gya ①zhes smras te song ngo / /rgyal pos smras pa/ khyim bdag gzhon nu 'di ngas bskyed de yid du 'ong zhing ②sdug pa yin pas dam tshig bcas la sbyin par bya ste/nyi ma re re la yang dus gsum gsum du nga blta ba'i phyir gtong na sbyin par bya'o//des smras pa/ lha khyod kyi spyan sngar mi gtang ②na gzhan su'i thad du gtang rjibar bgyi/ gtang bar 'tshal lo/ /rgyal pos de rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan te glang po che la bskyon dunas btang ⑤ngo / /'di ltar 'jig rten pa rnams kyi kun du spyod pa ni ji skad ⑦du pha gson pa de srid du bu'i ming mi sgrogs sodu / /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na khyim bdag shin tu bzang po 'chi ba'i dus byas nas gzhon nu me skyes pha'i khyim na gnas par gyur te/ de sangs rgyas la mngon par dad/ chos dang dge 'dun la mngon par dad/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song / chos dang dge 'dun la skyabs su song ngo / /des khyim bdag shin tu bzang pos phyogs gang du bdag gi ma bsad pa'i phyogs der gtsug lag khang rtsig 0tu bcug tshunas yo byad thams cad phun sum tshogs par sbyar te phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun la phul nas 'di ltar gnas brtan dag gis kyang mdo sde dag la bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na dku mnyed pa'i tshal na bzhugs so zhes yinye bar sbyar to/ /khyim bdag shin tu bzang po'i mi zho shas 'tsho ba yul gzhan du dong ba dag gis khyim bdag shin tu bzang po ni 'chi ba'i dus la bab po/ /gzhon nu me skyes ni rang gi khyim na gnas te/ de sangs 18—47

rgyas la mngon par dad/ chos dang dge 'dun la mngon par dad①/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song / chos dang dge 'dun la skyabs su song ngo zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang de dag gis tsan dan sa mchog pa'i lhung bzed cig rin po che dag gis bkang ste khyim bdag me skyes la skyes su bskur ②ro/ /des kyang de shing ring po'i rtse mo la btags te bzhag ②nas/ 'di skad ces 'di su/ kyang skas dang / ya gad dang / kyo ba tang dag gis blang bar mi bya'i/ 'di ltar dge sbyong ngam bram ze gang dag rdzu 'phrul che ba'am/ mthu che ba/ de dag las 'ga' zhig gis len na des ni 'di ci bder khyer la ④rag go zhes dril bsgrags pa yang byas so/ /gzhan mu stegs can rnams nang par sngar langs nas chu ngogs dag tu nye reg byed du 'dong ba de dag gis ⑤mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang khyim bdag me skyes la smras pa/ khyim bdag 'di ci yin/ des de dag la rgyas par bsnyad pa dang / de dag gis smras pa/ /khyim bdag khyod shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong rnams la mngon par dad pas de dag nyid len par 'gyur ro zhes smras nas dong ngo / /ji tsam na dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan dag rgyal po'i khab tu bsod snyoms la zhugs pa de dag gis de mthong nas de dag gis kyang khyim bdag me skyes la smras pa/ khyim bdag 'di ci yin/ des de dag la de ༷kho na bzhin du rgyas par bsnyad pa dang / de dag gis smras pa/ khyim bdag bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag gis ⑦yon tan ni bcab par bya/ skyon ni bsgrag par bya'o zhes bka' stsal na/ ji dulhung bzed tsam gyi ched du bdag nyid bstan par bya'am zhes smras nas dong ngo / /ji tsam na tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung ⑨stobs bcu pa de phyogs der 'ongs te/ khyim bdag la smras pa/ khyim 18—48

bdag 'di ci yin/ des ji lta bu yin pa smras pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung 0stobs bcu pas bsams pa/ bdag gis thog ma med pa'i dus nas bsags pa'i nyon mongs pa'i tshogs rnams spangs shing bor la bsal cing sbyang ba ②byas na khyim bdag gis bdag mu stegs can dang rdzu 'phrul 'gran ①par chad kyis ༷de'i phyir 'di'i yid mgu bar bya'o snyam nas/ des lag pa glang po che'i sna lta bu brkyang ⑤ste lhung bzed de blangs nas des de khyer te gtsug lag khang du song ngo / /de la dge slong dag ༷gis smras pa/ gnas brtan khyod kyi latsan dan sa mchog pa'i lhung bzed 'di ga las mchis/ des ji ltar gyur pa ⑧brjod pa dang / dge slong dag gis smras pa/ gnas brtan khyod lhung bzed tsam gyi ched du khyim pa'i mdun du rdzu 'phrul rnam par bstan du rung ngam/ de tshe dang ldan pa dag rung yang bla mi rung yang bla ste byas zin pas da ④ci byar yang med do zhes zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong gis khyim pa'i mdun du rdzu 'phrul rnam par bstan par mi bya'o/ /rnam par ston na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang lhung bzed rnam pa bzhi po gser las byas pa dang / dngul las byas pa dang / be+e ḍūr+ya tshulas byas pa dang / shel las byas pa dang / gzhan yang lhung bzed rnam pa bzhi po ra gan dang /zangs dang / khar ⑩ba dang / shing las byas pa dag las 'di ltar lhung bzed snga ma bzhi po gang dag yin pa de dag ni ma blangs pa yang blang 8bar mi bya la / blangs pa yang gtang tibar bya'o/ /lhung bzed phyi ma bzhi po gang dag yin pa de dag ni ma blangs pa ni blang bar mi bya zhing blangs 8pa na sman phor du 10—49

longs spyad ①pas spyad par bya ba yin no/ /'di ltar lcags dang / sa'i lhung bzed gnyis ni byin gyis brlab tu rung ba dag yin no/ /de nas dus gzhan zhig na khyim bdag me skyes lha dang mi'i dpal yang myong bar gyur nasal/ rgyal po'i khab dang tsam pa dag gi bar na sho gam gyi gnas shig yod pa de'i sho gam pa 'chi ba'i dus la bab nas de gnod sbyin gdug ②pa zhig tu skyes pa dang / des bu'i rmi lam du 'di skad ces bu khyod kyis gnas 'dir gnod sbyin gyi rten 'dzugs dusu chug la der dril yang gyis la thogs shig dang / gang gi tshe der su dag zong las sho gam mi 'jal bar 'gro bar byed pa de'i tshe dril de sgra 'byin par byed cing / de dag phyir ldog pa las sho gam chod par du'agyur ro zhes bstan to/ / des gnyen bshes ⑥dang / nye du dang / rtsa lag dag la rmi lam de bzlas nas nyi ma dang / tshes grangs dang / yud tsam dang / gza' dang /rgyu skar dang / dus shis pa la bab pa'i tshe gnas der gnod sbyin gyi rten 'dzugs su bcug nas der dril yang byas te btags so/ /grong khyer tsam pa na bram ze zhig gis rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs pa dang / bram ze mo des ⑦bsams pa/ bdag bram zes thabs de dang de dag gis bsgrubs ⑧pa'i nor dag spyod cing las ci yang mi byed par 'dug pa ni bdag gi tshul dang mthun ⑨pa ma yin ⑩rna snyam nas/ de tshong dus yisu song ste ras bal ⑩nyos nas sel gyis zhag par byas shing bkal te tha ga pa mkhas pa la kār ṣā pa ṇa stong 8ri ba'i ras zung gcig 'thag tu bcug go/ /de nas des bram ze la byasmras pa/ ras zung 'di kār ṣā pa ṇa stong ri ba lags kyis/ tshong dus tsos bzhud la gang dag kār ṣā pa ṇa stong gis 'jal ba la ni stsol cig /gal te des mi 'jal na tshong ⑫10—50

'dus ma yin no zhes bsgrags nas gzhan du bzhud par mdzod cig /des de khyer te tshong 'dus su song ba na kār ṣā pa ṇa stong gis nyo ba su yang med nas/des tshong 'dus ma yin no zhes bsgrags te/ ras zung de gdugs kyi rtsa ba'i nang du bcug ste 'gron ①pa dag dang lhan cig rgyal po'i khab tu song ngo ji tsam na rim gyis ② sho gam gyi laganas su phyin pa dang / sho gam pas 'gron pa rjode dag la sho gam bcad pa dun de dag gis sho gam phul nas dong ngo / /de na rjodril sgra 'byin par byed nas sho gam pa dag gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag dril 'di ltar sgra 'byin pa las na 'gron pa ⑦dag gis sho gam legs par ma phul gor ma chag gisal/ yang sho gam gcad 0do zhes de dag gis 'gron pa byadag yang phyir bkug ste btsal na sho gam ma phul ba 'ga' yang med do/ /de dag dong ⑩ba dang yang dril sgra 'byin pa 8nyid du byed nas/ de dag gis 'gron pa ⑫dag yang phyir bkug ste btsal na sho gam ma phul ba 'ga' yang med par gyur nas/'gron pa byadag deng la khyed cag chom po byed par sems sam/ ci na yang dang yang du phyir 'gugs par byed ces smod par byed do/ /de dag gis 'gron pa ⑫de dag tshoms gnyis su byas te bkye ba dang / tshoms gang gi nang na bram ze de ⑫med pa dag ni de bzhin dong ngo / /tshoms cig shos 'dong ba na dril de de bzhin du sgra 'byin par 0byed nas de dag gis de dag kyang de bzhin tsodu tshoms gnyis su byas shing byas shing bkye ba dang / tha mar bram ze de gcig pu nyi tshe lus par gyur nas de de dag gis bzung ngo / /des bdag la cung zad kyang med kyis yitshol cig ces smras pa dang / de dag gis btsal na 0ci yang med nas btang ba na yang dril de sgra 'byin pa nyid du byed do/ /de dag gis bram ze 18—51
