ba ①'di nyid rig ste/ 'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad nyams pa dang /ltung ②ba dang / rnam par 'thor ba dang / rnam par 'jig pa'i chos nyid kyis ①zil gyis mnan nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/ dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa las 'dod chags dang bral ba bong ba dang gser du mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil du mtshungs pa'i sems dang ldan pa tsan dan zhag lon par bzhag pa lta bu rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs dral bar gyur cing rig pa dang / mngon par shes pa dang /so so yang dag par rig pa ④thob pa/ srid pa dang 'dod pa'i rnyed pa dang /bkur sti ⑤la rgyab kyis phyogs pa/ dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod par bya ba dang / rjed par bya ba dang / gus par smra bar bya bar gyur to༅/ /gang gi tshe des skad kyi gtang rag gis chos smras pa/de'i tshe na chatshangs pa'i 'jig rten man chad khyab par gyur cing sems can mang po dag gi rgyud la yang thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dag skyed ⑤par cibyed de/ mdor na dud 'gro'i skye gnas su gtogs pa'i sems can dag kyang sgra snyan pa de la rna blags te nyan to0/ /de nas brtsom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag nga'i nyan thos kyi dge slong skad kyi gtang rag snyan pa rnams kyi nang na 'di lta ste dge slong snyan pa bzang ldan 'di mchog yin no/ /de'i skad kyi gtang rag snyan pa yid du 'ong ba'i sbyor ⑩bas dge slong 'dod chags dang ma bral ba rnams rang gi bya ba btang nas nyin gcig bzhin de'i gan du 'gro bar byed do/ /ji tsam dus gzhan ⑩zhig na ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal glang po che'i gtso bo pad ma dkar po gcig pa la zhon nas kha 10—103

lo sgyur ①ba dpal 'phel dang nam gyi tho rangs ri brags shig ②tu song ba'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa snyan pa bzang ldan gyis chanang par skad kyi gtang rag gis chos smra bar brtsams pa glang po che'i gtso bo pad ma dkar po gcig pas thos so/ /des tshe dang ldan pa snyan pa bzang ldan gyi skad kyi gtang rag thos nas kyang yang rna ba blags te mi g.yo bar sdod do/ /kha lo sgyur ④ba dpal 'phel gyis phan tshun nas lag pa dang rkang pa dag g.yabs te bskyod par brtsams kyang de bzhin mi g.yo ba dang / rgyal pos smras pa/ dpal 'phel glang po che thob shig ⑧lha btab kyang mi mchi na 'di rgyu gang lags ma 'tshal to/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ zhog shig rjodang lam gang du 'gro ba blta'o/ /des ji thobader bzhag pa dang / de rgyal byed kyi tshal logs su song nas khad kyis khad kyis ⑧rgyal byed kyi tshal du phyin pa dang / rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi sgo na rna blags te sdod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa snyan pa bzang ldan gyis 0skad kyi gtang rag gis chos dag smras pa'i mjug ()tu/'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur te/ /sa'am 'on te bar snang gnas pa dag /sems can rnams la rtag tu byams byed cing / /nyin dang mtshan du chos kyang spyod par shog /ces yongs su bsngo ba byas pa dang / de nas glang po che'i gtso bo pad ma dkar po gcig pas tshe dang ldan pa snyan pa bzang ldan gyis ⑫skad kyi gtang rag gis chos dag smras pa mtha' tsophyin par shes nas yid dang mthun par gang dang gang du bskyod 0pa de dang der song ngo / /rgyal pos smras pa/dpal 'phel rgyu gang gis 'dir cigang dang gang du bskyod pa de dang der 'gro/des smras pa lha ma 'tshal te/ 'phags pa zhig gis skad kyi gtang rag gis chos smras pa'i sgra gang lags pa de dag thos nas glang po che 'di 8yid phrogs te tso18—104

dbang ma mchis par gyur to/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ dpal 'phel glang po che phyir zlog shig ①dang / 'phags pa de btsal la na bza' zhig dbul zhing sang nang par ri brags su ②'dong ngo / /lha de bzhin 'tshal lo/ /de phyir log ste khyim du song ba dang / btsun mo phreng ldan mas dris pa/ lha ③ci'i slad du slar gshegs / des ji ltar gyur pa brjod nas 'di skad ces kyang ⑦smras so/ /phreng 0ldan ma nga la gos byin cig dang song la 'phags pa de la dbul lo/ /des bsams pa/ 'phags pa snyan pa bzang ldan gyis 0skad kyi ⑦gtang rag gis chos smras par gyur pa lta 0zhig na/ /de 0ni mdog ngan zhing lus chung la rgyal po 'di ni rgya chen 0po la mos pa yin pas 'dis de mthong na gal te ma dad par 'gyur ba'i gnas yod par 'a gyur srid kyis yithabs kyi rnam pa zhig bya'o snyam nas smras pa/ lha ni ri brags su tsogashegs shig /bdag gis ni 'phags pa de la na bza' dbul lo/ /des smras pa/ phreng ldan ma khyod kyis kyang gos gzhan phul cig /ci gos gnyis kyis 'ako sa la'i pho brang dbul por 'gyur ram de cang mi smra bar 'dug pa dang / rgyal pos 6chen po la 'os pa'i gos khyer nas rgyal byed kyi tshal du song ngo / /de'i tshe na tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi sgo na 'chag cing 'dug nas rgyal po glang po che las babs nas rkang pa gnyis la phyag 'tshal te smras pa/ 'phags pa da tsonang skad kyi gtang rag gis chos smras pa'i 6)'phags pa de gang lags/ des smras pa/rgyal po chen po de cir 'tshal/ 'phags pa de la na bza' dbul lo/ /des bsams pa/ tshe dang ldan pa snyan pa bzang ldan gyis skad kyi gtang rag gis chos dag ni smras na de ni mdog ngan zhing lus chung la rgyal po 'di ni rgya chen po la 10—105

mos pa yin pas 'dis de mthong na gal te ma dad par 'gyur ba'i gnas yod par 'gyur srid kyis ①thabs kyi rnam pa zhig bya'o snyam nas smras pa/ rgyal po chen po bdag la stsol cig dang / bdag gis de la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ 'phags pa ②bcom ldan 'das kyis rang gi lag nas dbul ba bsngags pas rang gi lag nyid nas dbul gyis ②de ston cig /de'i tshe na 0tshe dang ldan pa snyan pa bzang ldan nyin mo spyod pa'i phyir shing ljon pa zhig gi drung na nye bar rten cing 'dug go/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos smras pa/rgyal po chen po de ni shing ljon pa zhig gi drung na nye bar rten cing mchis kyis ⑤bzhud cig /de de'i gan du song ste bltas pa dang / re zhig na de shin tu mi sdug pa mthong ba dang / de ma dad pa skyes nas mi ⑥dga' ste bzhin phyir phyogs nas gos 'phangs te phyir song ngo / /tshe dang ldan pa snyan pa bzang ldan gyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad ⑦pa dag smras pa/ gang dag nga yi ⑧gzugs la rtog/sgra la'ang rjes su 'brang byed pa/ ci /'dod pa'i dbang du gyur pa yi0/ /skye bo de dag nga mi mthong / /gal te nang ni shes gyur cing / /phyi rol dag la mi lta ba / /nang gi ⑩'bras bu mthong ba gang / /de nyid ⑩sgra yis khrid 8par 'gyur//gal te nang ni mi tsoshes shing / /phyi rol rnam par mthong gyur pa/ /phyi rol 'bras bu mthong ba gang / /de yang sgra yis khrid ④par 'gyur/ /gal te nang yang mi shes shing / /phyi rol dag kyang ma mthong ba/ /kun tu rmongs pa'i byis pa dag /de yang sgra yis khrid par 'gyur/ /gal te nang yang rab shes shing / /phyi rol dag kyang mthong ba yi/ /brtan po shes rab phyogs pa de/ /sgra yis khrid par mi 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe dge slong rnams 'the tshom ⑩skyes nas the tshom ⑩10—106

thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa snyan pa bzang ldan gyis las ci zhig bgyis na las de'i rnam par smin pas mdog ngan zhing lus ༅chung la skad snyan par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag rigs kyi bu snyan pa bzang ldan nyid kyis ②las tshogs rnyed pa/ rkyen yongs su bsgyur ba 'od pa bzhin du nye bar gnas pa/gdon mi za bar 'byung bar 'gyur ba dag byas shing bsags pas ③snyan pa bzang ldan nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa dag gzhan su zhig gis so sor myong bar 'gyur/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa dag ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams la mi 'gyur/ me'i khams la mi 'gyur/ rlung gi khams la mi 'gyur gyibya/ 'di ltar las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa dag ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khams dang /skye mched dag la rnam par smin par 'gyur te/ las rnams bskal pa brgyar yang ni/ /chud mi za ba'ang tshogs dang dus/ /rnyed na lus can rnams la ni/ /'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i ①tshe lo bzhi khri thub pa na ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur dub/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'khor ba 'jig 'jig rten du byung ste/ des sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mtha' dag mdzad nas/ bud shing zad pa'i me bzhin du ⑦phung po'i lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las ⑧'das pa'i dbyings su ②mya ngan las 10—107

'das so/ /rgyal po mdzes ldan gyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'khor ba 'jig ①de'i sku la mchod pa rgya chen po sridag byas nas mchod rten khor ②yug tu dpag tshad re re yod pa gnam 'phang ④du dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis pa zhig byed cidu gzhug par brtsams nas de'i lag gi gla ⑤mi dad pa dang ldan zhing bzang la dge ba'i bsam pa can las byed pa la brtson pa zhig bskos so/ /de na yang gla mi gzhan zhig yod pa des mchod rten ha cang chen po rtsom pa de mthong nas lta zhing shes ldan dag rgyal po 'dis 'di lta bu'i mchod rten chen po byed du gzhug par brtsams pa nam tsam zin par 'gyur ma shes so zhes 'phya bar brtsams pa dang / de la lag gi blas ༅smras pa/ kwa'e ⑦nang rje ci'i phyir ⑧'phya bar byed/gal te mi nus na las bya ba thong shig⑨ /de cang mi smra bar 'dug pa dang /lag gi gla ⑩des de phyir dbyung bar brtsams so/ /des de la bzod pa gsol nas77/ yang las bya bar brtsams pa na mchod rten de ma zin nas de 8yang 'phya bar brtsams pa dang / lag gi gla 8des phyir phyung ④ngo / /yang shin tu 'bad de bzod pa gsol nas tsolas bya bar brtsams pa dang / ji tsam na mchod rten blta tshubs mi ngoms pa srog chags 'bum phrag mang po dag gi mig dang yid 'phrog par byed pa zhig zin par gyur to/ /de nas gla mi des de mthong nas 'di ltar las byed pa na bdag gis ⑩'di la dpyas 8pa ni ma legs pa zhig byas so zhes 'gyod pa skyes nas 'di la rnam pa thams cad du mchod pa bya'o zhes des de'i gla rngan ci thob pa de las gser gyi dril bu byed du bcug nas sems mngon par dad pas mchod rten de la btags yiso/ /dge slong dag de'i tshe de'i dus na gla mi gang yin pa de ni dge slong snyan pa bzang ldan 'di nyid 18—108

yin te/ des yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig gi mchod rten gyi las byed pa na dpyas ①pa gang yin pa de'i las kyi rnam par smin pas ni mdog ngan zhing lus chung bar skyes so/ /yang dad pa skyes nas gser gyi dril bu byed du bcug nas mchod rten la btags pa'i las kyi ②rnam par smin pa gang yin pa de ②ni skad snyan par gyur to/ /de nas yang dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas/ the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa snyan pa bzang ldan gyis las ci zhig bgyis na des tshangs pa'i 'jig rten man chad sgras khyab par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag rigs kyi bu snyan pa bzang ldan nyid kyis las tshogs rnyed pa zhes bya ba nas 'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid ces bya ba'i bar du snga ma bzhin no/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba / bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung 'jig rten du byung ste/ de bā rā ṇa sī ④na drang srong smra ba ri dgas kyi gnas na khyonye bar rten cing bzhugs so/ /bā rā ṇa sī dang drang srong smra ba'i bar na a mra'i ⑥shing ljon pa zhig yod pa de la bya ko ki la pho zhig gnas pa des gang gi tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung bā rā ṇa sbor bsod snyoms la gshegs pa de'i tshe de la shin tu rtog ⑦cing sgra snyan pa khyad par can phyung nas de bzhin du ⑧yang dang yang du bltas pas/ sems tshim par gyur nas 10—109

dad pa skyes so/ /des ①dus gzhan zhig na skad 'byin cing ②yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od sung la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas dga' ba dang bde ba skyes te a mra'i shing ljon pa de nyid la 'dug go/ /'dug ma thag tu bya khra zhig gis srog dang phral te 'chi ba'i dus byas nas las drug la mkhas pa'i bram ze zhig tu skyes so/ /dge slong dag de'i tshe de'i dus na bya ko ki la gang yin pa de ni dge slong snyan pa bzang ldan 'di nyid yin te/ des yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung la sgra snyan pa phyung ①ste bskor ba byas pa de'i las kyi rnam par smin pas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten man chad sgras khyab par gyur to/ /de nas yang dge slong rnams the tshom ༅skyes nas/ the tshom ⑤thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa snyan ⑥pa bzang ldan gyis las ci zhig bgyis ⑦na las de'i rnam par smin pas dubacom ldan 'das kyi bstan ⑨pa la rab tu byung ste nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du bgyis te bcom ldan 'das kyis skad kyi gtang rag snyan pa ⑩rnams kyi mchog tu bstan/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ni smon lam gyi dbang gis te/ gang du smon lam btab ce na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung de nyid kyi gsung rab la dge slong zhig rab tu byung bar gyur pa de bcom ldan 'das 'od srung gis 7skad kyi gtang rag snyan pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan to/ /de na 'dis kyang tshe ji srid par tshangs par spyod pa spyad na yon tan gyi tshogs 'ga' yang ma thob nas de'i 'og tu tso'achi ba'i tshe 'di skad ces bdag gis bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi spyan sngar tshe ji srid par tshangs par spyod pa spyad na yon tan gyi 10ba 110

tshogs 'ga' yang ma thob ste/ bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od sung gis bram ze'i khye'u bla ma la bram ze'i khye'u khyod ma 'ongs pa'i dus na skye dgu'i tshe lo brgya thub ①pa na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa de'i bstan pa la bdag rab tu byung ste/nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byed cing ji ltar mkhan po 'di bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis skad kyi gtang rag snyan pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa de bzhin du bdag kyang bcom ldan 'das des skad kyi gtang rag snyan pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan par gyur cig ces btab pas smon lam de'i dbang gis da ②ltar nga'i bstan pa la rab tu byung ste/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/ ngas dge slong skad kyi gtang rag snyan pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan to/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na las gcig tu gnag ③pa rnams kyi rnam par smin pa ni gcig tu duganag dupa zhes bya ba nas/ dge slong rjikhyed kyis de ⑦ltar bslab par bya'o zhes bya ba'i bar du snga ma bzhin no//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na ⑧rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /ji tsam na dge slong dag chos 'don pa nyid na rgya shug gi 'bras bu'i tshogs gtor ba bzhin 'don la mu stegs can rnams ni skad kyi gtang rag gis gzhung 'don to/ /khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun du spyod pa ni nang par sngar langs nas bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑨zhabs la phyag 'tshal du 'gro'o⑩/ /des mu stegs can rnams skad kyi yigatang 10—111

rag gis gzhung 'don pa thos nas des bsams pa/ mu stegs can rnams kyi ①chos 'dul ba ni nyes par smras pa yin yang 'di dag ②skad kyi gtang rag gis gzhung 'don la/ bdag gi 'phags pa rnams ni gzhung 'don pa nyid na rgya shug gi 'bras bu'i tshogs gtor ba bzhin 'don pas 'di nyid bdag gi bya ba yin no snyam nas/ de bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'dug go//mtha' gcig tu 'dug nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa 'di ltar re zhig mu stegs can rnams kyi chos 'dul ba ni nyes par smras pa lags kyang / de dag skad kyi ③gtang rag gis gzhung 'don par bgyi ④la/ 'phags pa rnams ni gzhung 'don pa nyid na rgya shug gi 'bras bu'i tshogs gtor ba bzhin ⑤'don pas de la gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis 'phags pa rnams kyang skad kyi gtang rag gis gzhung 'don par gnang na legs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin ⑥gyis bcom ldan 'das kyis cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑨zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas song ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na khyed kyis skad kyi gtang rag gis chos 'don par gnang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis gyeskad kyi gtang rag gis chos gdon ⑨par bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong rnams skad kyi gtang rag gis lung 'bogs ⑩par byed/ 'don par byed/ kha ton yibyed/10—112

yongs su 'dri bar byed do/ /ji tsam na khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin rgyal byed kyi tshal du song ba na des ①thos nas smras pa/ 'phags pa dag ci khyed kyi gtsug lag khang 'dir rol mo mkhan gyi brang btab bam/ skabs de dge slong rnams kyis ②bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong gis skad kyi gtang rag gis lung dbog ②par mi bya gdon par mi bya/ kha ton mi bya/ yongs su 'dri ④bar mi bya'o/ /'di ltar ston pa'i yon tan yang dag par bsgrag ⑤pa dang / rgyud ⑨chags gsum pa gdon pa dag ni skad kyi gtang rag gis ⑦gdon par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis skad kyi gtang rag gis de dag gdon par bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / gzhon nu zhig skad kyi gtang rag mi shes nas/ des gzhung ⑧dag ston ⑨pa nyid na rgya shug gi 'bras bu'i tshogs ⑨ gtor ba bzhin ston ⑩par gyur nas / dge slong dag gis tsoms pa/ tshe dang ldan pa bcom ldan 'das kyis skad kyi 'gatang rag gnang gis 8skad kyi gtang rag gis thon cig /des smras pa / tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag gis skad kyi gtang rag mi shes so/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ skad kyi gtang rag bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 8skad kyi gtang rag bslab ⑩par bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang /dge slong rnams khyams dang / gnas khang dang / sgo khang dag na skad kyi gtang rag dag ②slob par byed pa na/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gtsug lag khang du 'ongs pa dang / des thos nas smras pa/ 'phags pa dag gtsug lag khang 'di rol mo mkhan gyi brang ni tsom lags na/ khyed kyis yid dung ⑥yang 10—113

rol mo mkhan dag ma btang ①ngam/ skobs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dben pa'i phyogs su skad kyi gtang rag dag bslab par bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu ②rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /dge slong zhig 'greng ste ③lhung bzed 'byin pa dang / dge slong dag gis ④de la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa 'greng ste lhung bzed ma 'byin cig /des smras pa/ ci nyes/ de dag gis smras pa / lhung bzed de chag 0par 'gyur mod gzhan ci nyes par 'gyur/ de cang mi smra bar 'dug pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong gis 'greng ⑥ste lhung bzed dbyung bar mi bya'o/ /de bzhin du gzhug pa dang / bkru ba dang /skam ⑦pa dag la yang rgya cher sbyar bar bya'o// // sdom la/ lam phran dang ni snod gsum dang / /phying pa dra bar mi bya dang / /gding ba dang ni mi 'bral ba/ /drang srong lachen pos rjes su gnang / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ngan spong gi bu ⑨dag na chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri la 'jigs rung gi nags ri dgas kyi gnas na tshubazhugs so/ /gang gi tshe rgyal bu gzhon nu rtogs ldan gyis yikhang bzangs pad ma can/ tshon brgya rtsa gcig gis bris pa byed du bcug 8cing ras sar pa kha tshar ring po can dag gis chal 0par bting ste/ bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa gdugs tshod la spyan drangs pa'i tshe bcom ldan 'das khang bzangs 10—114

pad ma can du gshegs par ①bzhed pa na ma gshegs pa dang / rgyal bu gzhon nu rtogs ldan gyis smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das gshegs su gsol/ 'on kyang bcom ldan 'das ma gshegs pa dang / rgyal bu gzhon nu rtogs ldan gyis ras rnams bsdus pa mu stegs can rnams kyis thos nas de rnams kyis smras pa/shes ldan dag dge sbyong gau ta ma ni bkur sti ②de lta bu'i gnas ma yin no zhes zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag gal te bram ze dang /khyim bdag dad pa can dag gis lam phran dag tu yang ras sar pa kha tshar ring po ③can dag bting ④zhing 'phags pa dag bdag cag la thugs brtse ⑤ba'i slad du gshegs su gsol zhes zer na/ mu stegs can rnams zil gyis mnan pa'i phyir mi rtag pa nyid yid dul bya bas zil gyis mnan ⑦cing 'dong bar bya ste/'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ngan spong gi bu ⑧dag na chu srin byis pa gsod 0kyi ri la 'jigs rung gi nags ri dgas kyi gnas ⑩na bzhugs so/ /dge slong zhig lhung bzed lag na thogs te song ba dang / de phyogs gzhan zhig tu snyel yinas lhung bzed de sa la lhung ste 'chag nas de'i bar chad du gyur pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na dge slong gis lhung bzed lag na bkur bar mi bya bar lhung bzed kyi snod du bcug ste bkur bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gis lhung bzed lag na bkur bar mi bya bar lhung bzed kyi snod ⑩du bcug ste bkur bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge 10—115

slong rnams lhung bzed kyi snod du bcug ste lag pa nyid na khyer te 'dong ba na nyes dmigs de nyid du gyur pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lhung bzed kyi snod lag na bkur bar mi bya bar lung thag btags te mchan khung gis bkur bar bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /dge slong rnams don mthun dag dang lhan cig ljongs rgyu zhing dong ①ngo / /ji tsam na bram ze zhig na nas de sman pa'i gan du song ste smras pa/ kye bdag nyid chen po kho bo'i nad kyi rnam pa 'di lta bu'i sman ston cig /des smras pa/ jo bo a ru ra gsol dang ④snyan gdangs ②par 'gyur ro/ /des smras pa/ lam ka ④'di na a ru ra ga la yod/ des smras pa/ bram ze shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong 'di dag ni mkhas pa lags pas 'di dag la khyod kyis bslangs na 'di dag la mchis par 'gyur gda'ophye/ /de dge slong rnams kyi drung du song ste dris pa/ 'phags pa dag la a ru ra lta mchis sam/de dag gis ༅smras pa/ bram ze yod na de cir dgos/ bdag la sman pa'i mchid tsonas a ru ra tshol cig ces mchi ⑤na gal te mnga' na bdag la stsal du gsol / dge slong des de'i mdun du lhung bzed kyi snod phye ba dang / de nyid na lasmyung ⑨ bu yang 'dug cing yi/ de nyid na gri'u tsodang / de nyid na 'breng bu tsodang / de nyid na sman dag 'dug pa bram zes mthong nas smras pa/'phags pa dag khyed ni kun du spyod pa mi gtsang ba yin te/ 'di 'dra ba za ba bas ni bdag shi yang ches bla'i mi gtsang ba za ba ni de lta ma yin no zhes zer ba'i 18—116

skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ snod gsum bcang bar bya ste/ lhung bzed kyi ①snod dang / sman snod dang / bar bur ②sdod rnams so/ /dge slong dag gis de dag gi lung thag mnyam par btags pas de dag gis mchan khung rlo ③bar gyur pa dang / ma dad pa ④dag 'phags pa dag ci khyed rdza rnga thogs te ⑤'gro'am zhes co 'dri bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis ⑥bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mnyam par ⑦gdags par mi bya bar ci rigs par gdags par bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis ras ma phra mo dag btags pas de dag la na bar gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ras ma zheng chen po dag gdags par bya'o/ /de dag gis zheng chen po dag ⑧btags pa dang de dag nyid zhum nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dkyil phying bu dang sbyar te skabs skabs su srubs bya rog rkang dag drub par bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /dge slong zhig gis phying pa zhig rnyed nas des bsams pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos gos gsum dras te bcang bar ⑨bya'o zhes bka' stsal gyis ༅dra'o snyam nas/ de gri'u yidang khab dag khyer nas shing ljon pa zhig gi drung du song ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyang phyogs der gshegs te gzigs nas bka' stsal pa/ dge slong 'di ci yin/des gsol pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gis chos gos gsum dras te bcang bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pas bdag gis phying pa 'di rnyed 10—117

nas chos gos su 'dra ba lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bslab pa la gus pa'i bsngags pa brjod nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na lnga po 'di dag ni dra bar mi bya ste/ be'u ras thams cad dang /la ba thams cad dang / phying pa thams cad dang / klam ①thams cad dang /seng ba thams cad do//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /dge slong zhig bya ba zhig gi phyir ②gtsug lag khang gzhan du song ba dang / de der nam sros par gyur nas gnas mal gyi zhal ta byed pas smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa gnas mal dag nos shig /des smras pa/ bdag gis gding ba khyer te ma 'ongs so/ /gnas mal gyi zhal ta byed pas smras pa/ gal te de lta na khri brling ③ba nos shig /des khri brling ④ba mnos nas nyal ba dang / de grang ba'i sdug bsngal gyis nyen bzhin du mtshan mo 'das nas na bar gyur pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na dge slong gis gding ba med par 'gro bar mi bya'o/ /'gro na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gis gding ba med par 'gro bar mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong rnams deng nyid phyir ldog pa'i bsam ⑤pas de'i nyen kor ⑥gyi gtsug lag khang gzhan du 'gro ba dang / 'chag tu 'gro ba dang / grong gzhan du 'gro ba de dag tu yang gding ba khyer ba na gnas brtan rgan po rgas pa nyam ༅chung ba rnams dang / nad pa sbyor mi bzod pa rnams ⑤nyam thag par gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis deng nyid 10—118

phyir ldog pa'i bsam pas 'gro ba der yang gding ba med par 'gror ma gnang ngo zhes 'khod pa'i ①skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na dge slong gis nyen kor dang nyin mo spyod du 'gro ba la gding ba bkur bar mi bya'o/ /grong gzhan du 'gro ba na deng nyid phyir ldog pa'i bsam pas 'gro na der kyang ②bkur bar mi bya'o/ /dge slong gzhan dag gding ba med par grong gzhan du de ②nyid ④ldog pa'i bsam pas 'gro ba na de rnams la bya ba'i rnam pa de lta bu dag byung nas des ⑤nam sros par gyur pa dang / de dag bslab pa la gus pas nub mo phyir dong ba na seng ge dang / stag dang / chom kun pa dang / g.yon can dag gis bgrod par gyur pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gal te de ltar bsams te ༅dong ba dag der nam sros par gyur na ⑦de nyid du gnas par bya ste/'di ltar tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa dag las gding ba brnyas ⑤te nyal bar bya'o / /gal te rnyed na de lta na legs/ gal te ma rnyed na bla gos bzhi ltab ⑨tu byas te bting la yun thung du ni nyal/ yun ring du ni mi nyal bar mtshan mo 'da' bar bya'o/ /dge slong gzhan zhig gis dge slong zhig las gding ba brnyas pa dang / de la rmi lam gyi gnod pa byung nas des mi gtsang bas ma rung bar gyur pa de bzhin du dge slong de la phyir dbul bar brtsams pa dang / des ma 'dod pa'i skabs de zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bkrus te sbyin par bya'o/ /dge slong des bkrus te byin na 'on kyang de len par mi byed pa'i skabs de zhes bya ba'i bar du yang snga 10—119

ma bzhin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ri ba'i rin sbyin par bya ba'am/ de'i sems mgu bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag gtsug lag khang gzhan ①dang / grong gzhan dag tu deng nyid phyir ldog pa'i bsam pas chos gos gsum po dag med par dong ba dang / de rnams ②der dong ba dag la ci ②tsam na bya ba'i rnam pa de lta bu dag byung ste der nam sros par gyur to/ /de dag bslab pa la gus pas mtshan mo phyir dong ba na seng ge dang / stag dang /chom rkun pa dang / g.yon can dag gis bgrod par gyur pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gal te de lta bu'i bsam pas thudong ba rnams der nam sros par gyur na/ de nyid du 'dug par bya zhing / tshangs pa mtshungs par ⑤spyod pa dag las chos gos dag brnyas ༅te byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de rnams chos gos dag brnyas nas ji ltar byin gyis brlab par bya ba ma ༅shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ snga ma rang gi sems kyis phyung ba labyin gyis brlab ⑨par bya'o/ /lnga po 'di dag ni sems bskyed pas tshu'agrub ste/ gso sbyong dang / dgag dbye dang / chos gos byin gyis brlab pa dang / chos gos dbyung ba dang / gang zag mgron du bos pa'o/ /dge slong de dag gis chos gos dras shing kha dog ma bsgyur ba dag rnyed nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gal te dras shing kha dog ma bsgyur ba dag rnyed na dras shing kha dog ma bsgyur ba dag byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ / ji ste yikha dog ma bsgyur cing ma dras pa dag rnyed na lhan thabs 8kyis glan la byin gyis brlab 0par bya'o/ /gal te rnyed na de lta na legs/ gal te ma rnyed na de ④bzhin byin gyis brlab par 10—120

bya'o / /①tha na khyim pa'i gos la ②yang byin gyis brlab par bya stedu/ 'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /dge slong dag cig gding ba med par yul gzhan du 'dong ④ba dang / der ⑤dong ba de rnams 'gyod par gyur pa'i 0skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ngas chos gos gsum dang bral ⑦bar ni gsungs kyil/ gding ba dang ni ma yin te/ de lta bas na bsams bzhin du bzhag ste 'gro bar mi bya'o/ /brjed pa la ni ltung ba med do// //sdom ni0/ chu tshags la ni rnam bzhi dang / /sder ⑩rnams dang ni gcig tu za/ /gos gcig gis ni za ba dang / /sgren mor khrus ni byed pa'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /lho lam nas yidage slong bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal ba gnyis shig mnyan yod du dong ngo / /de gnyis lam du chu zad nas skom pa'i sdug bsngal gyis gdungs pa na rdzing bu zhig gi drung du phyin nas de gnyis las gcig gis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod kyis myur du chu rtogs shig dang btung ngo / /des brtag par brtsams pa dang /ji tsam na chu ma dag par gyur nas des tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ bskal pa 'bum phrag stong dag tu/ /gang zhig mthong bar rab dka' ⑩bas/ /bdag 10—121

gis chu dag 'thungs nas ni/ /de nas 'dren pa blta ①bar bya/ /cig lashos kyis tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ gang zhig sems can rnams la thugs rgyanas thugs rje zhing / /srid pa kun la chags pa gtan dunas spangs gyur pa/ /de yi bstan mchog 'di la bslab pa blang ba 0yis/ /srog nyid spang gi srog chags gsad dupar bya ba min/ /de nas gang gis chu 'thungs pa ⑦de ni song ngo / /gang gis ma ⑧'thungs pa des ni brtson 'grus brtsams te/ shing ljon pa zhig gi ⑨drung du 'dug nas/ de ⑩ji srid du lus kyi mthu yod pa de srid du yidage ba'i phyogs dag byas shing gang gi tshe lus kyi mthu dang bral ba de'i tshe 'chi ba'i dus la bab nas rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams kyi nang du skyes so/ /lha'i bu'am / lha'i bu mo'i chos nyid ni skyes nas ring po ma lon pa la sems gsum ⑫skye 0ste/ gang nas shi 'phos pa dang / gang du skyes pa dang / las gang gis skyes pa'o/ /des mi rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos pa dang / rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams kyi nang du skyes pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la sems mngon par dad par byas pas skyes par mthong ngo / /de nas sngon dge slong lha'i bu de ⑫'di snyam du sems te/ gang gi phyir bdag yongs su gnas pa bsten te bcom ldan 'das la blta ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir nye bar 'gro ba ni bdag gi 8tshul dang mthun pa ma yin gyis skyabadag yongs su gnas pa ma bsten ⑩pa kho nar bcom ldan 'das la blta ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir nye bar 'gro'o snyam mo/ /de nas sngon dge slong lha'i bu rna cha gdub kor g.yo zhing dri ma med pa thogs te/ do shal dang se mo dos brgyan pa'i lus kyis lha'i me tog ut+pa la dang / pad ma dang ku mu da tsodang / pad ma dkar po dang / man dā ⑩10—122

ra ba dag gis thu ba bkang ste kha dog shin tu 'das pas mtshan mo la bab pa dang /bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das la ①me tog dag gis mngon par gtor te bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas mtha' gcig tu 'dug pa dang / 'di ltar sngon dge slong lha'i bu'i kha dog gi mthus rgyal byed kyi tshal thams cad snang ba rgya chen pos khyab par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑤sngon dge slong lha'i bu'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal ba dudang / khams dang / rang bzhin thugs su chud nas / gang thos nas ⑤sngon dge slong lha'i bus stan de nyid la 'dug bzhin du 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas pa de lta bur 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi yang dag par so sor rtogs par byed pa'i chos bstan pa mdzad do/ /des bden pa mthong nas btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la gang mdzad pa 'di lta bu ni bdag la phas kyang ma bgyis/ mas kyang ma bgyis/ rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis/ lha rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ sngon gyi pha mes dag dugis kyang ma bgyis/ dge sbyong dang bram ze dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ byams pa dang mdza' bshes dang rtsa lag gi tshogs kyis kyang ma bgyis te/ khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho ni bskams⑥/ rus pa'i ri dag ⑦las ni bsgral/ ngan song gi sgo dag ni bkum/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo dag ni phye/ sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas dag nas ni rkang pa phyung / lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du ni bzhag go zhes lan gsum ched du brjod pa ched du brjod do/ /yang smras pa/ khyod mthus rab dregs ninyes pa mang ldan pa'i/ /ngan song 10—123

shul bkag bsod nams rab ldan pa'i/ /mtho ris 'gro ba phye zhing bdag gis ni / /mya ngan 'das pa'i shul yang thob par gyur/ /shin tu rnam dag khyod brten bdag gis ni/ /de ring skyon bral dag pa'i mig ①thob cing go 'phang zhi ba 'phags pa dgyes thob ste/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i pha rol rgal ②bar gyur/ /'gro ba ②lha min mi dang lhas mchod pa/ /skye dang rga dang na 'chi bral ba po/ /srid pa stong du mthong ba rab dkon pa/ /thub pa de ring khyod mthong 'bras bu mchis/ /de nas gdud ④byas do shal rab 'phyang bas/ /zhabs la phyag 'tshal rangs pa skyes gyur nas/ /dgra thul g.yas nas yongs su bskor byas te/ /lha yi ⑤'jig rten mngon phyogs mkha' la song / /de nas ⑥sngon dge slong lha'i bu tshong pa khe spogs ⑨rnyed pa lta bu dang / zhing pa lo tog 'byor pa lta bu dang / dpa' bo g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba lta bu dang /nad pa nad thams cad las yongs su thar ba lta bur gyur te/ cha lugs gang gis bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'ongs pa'i cha dulugs de nyid kyis rang gi gnas su song ngo / /dge slong cig shos de yang khad kyis mnyan yod du phyin to//de nas lhung bzed dang chos gos mkhos su phab ⑨ste/ rkang pa dag bkrus nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos nyid kyis dge slong glo 0bur du 'ongs pa la dge slong khyod da gzod gang nas 'dir 'ongs/ dbyar gang du gnas zhes yang dag par dga' bas yang dag par dga' bar mdzad pa yin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong de la khyod ga las 'dir 'ongs/ dbyar gang du gnas zhes yang 10—124

dag par dga' bar ①mdzad pa dang / des gsol pa/ btsun pa bdag lho phyogs nas ②da gzod ③'dir mchis te/ lho phyogs su dbyar gnas lags 0so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong khyod la grogs dge slong lta yod dam/ bcom ldan 'das mchis so/ /de gar song / des ji ltar gyur pa gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ nga yi bstan la ma gus gang / /des ni nga mthong ci zhig phan/ /des ni nga la bltas na yang / /mthong ba ma yin mchod pa min/ /nga yi bslab rjol gang slob pa'i/ /dge slong des ni nga mthong ste/ /shes rab dman pa khyod kyis niyi/ /sangs rgyas mngon sum ma mthong ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ༅nyid kyi sku las bla gos phye nas yang tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ltos shig dge slong lus 'di la/ /gtsang zhing gser gyi mdog 'dra ba/ /sngon gyi las kyi rnam smin dang / /pha dang ma las byung ba'o/ /gang gis chos nyid ma mthong ba/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas des ma ⑧mthong / /gang gis chos nyid mthong gyur pa/ /de yis thub pa chen po mthong / /gzhan yang brtan zhing dge ba'i blo gros can/ /bslab pa rjes su srung ⑨byed pa/ /de yis ⑩dang por nga la ni/ /gzugs kyi sku dang chos skur mthong / /bdag nyid chen po 'od srung 0gi/ /bslab mtshams 8'das pa da rung tsodu/ /e la'i 'dab ④de klu yi ni/ /skye gnas dag las ma thar to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/nyes dmigs gang cung zad byung ba ni dge slong rnams chu tshags mi 'chang ba las gyur gyis8/ de lta bas na dge slong gis chu tshags nye bar gzhag par bya'o / /bcom ldan 'das kyis chu tshags nye bar gzhag par bya'o zhes bka' 18—125

stsal pa dang / dge slong dag chu tshags du yod mi shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chu tshags ni lnga ste/ chu tshags gru gsum dang /bum tshags lce'u ①can dang / ril ba zhabs tshags can dang / dpyangs ②tshags dang / bsal tshags rnams so//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /mnyan yod na dge slong phan tshun zhe 'gras pa gnyis shig ljongs rgyu zhing dong ngo / /de dag las gcig la ni chu tshags yod/ cig shos la ni med do/ /gang la yod pa des ②chu btsags ④te 'thungs pa dang / gang la med pa des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa chu tshags g.yor cig des ma ster nas de phongs par gyur pa'i ①skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag de lta bas na dge slong gis zhe 'gras pa dang lhan cig ljongs rgyu zhing 'gro bar mi bya'o/ /gal te de lta bu'i rkyen cig byung na gcig la gcig bzod ⑥pa gsol te 'dong ⑦bar bya'o// // 'dul ba phran tshegs kyi gzhi/⑧ bam po lnga pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /mnyan yod na dge slong gnyis zhig 0ljongs rgyu zhing dong ba dang / de dag las gcig la ni chu tshags yod/ cig shos la ni med nas de la des dris pa/ khyod la chu tshags ⑩yod dam medaskye/ des smras pa yod do/ /sbyin nam mi sbyin zhes ni ma smras so/ /de dag las gang 8chu tshags yod pa des ni chu 'thungs pa dang / gang la med pa des smras pa/ tshe 18—126

dang ldan pa chu tshags g.yor cig /des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod kyis bdag la chu tshags ni dris kyi sbyin nam mi sbyin ma dris pas ma gus ①pa khyod la kho bos chu ②tshags ci'i phyir sbyin/ mi sbyin gyis song gshig /des de la ma byin pas ④de phongs par gyur pa'i skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'gro bar 'dod pa'i dge slong gis gal te chu tshags med na dge slong grogs po la khyod ⑤la chu tshags yiyod dam med dri bar bya'o/ /gal te yod do zhes zer na bdag la sbyin nam mi sbyin zhes brjod par bya zhing gal te sbyin no zhes zer na 'gro bar bya'i gzhan du na 'gro bar mi bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /mnyan ⑦yod na dge slong gnyis shig ljongs rgyu zhing dong ngo / /de dag las gcig la ni chu tshags yod / cig shos la ni med pa dang / gang la med pa des de la dris pa/khyod la chu tshags yod dam med/ des smras pa/ yod do/ /bdag la g.yar ram mi g.yar/ g.yar niro/ /de dag dong ba dang ji tsam na lam kur 'gron pa ⑨dag cig 'ongs nas gang la chu tshags yod pa de'i bya ba gang yin pa de 'gron pa ⑩ de nyid las grub ste/ de phyir ldog par brtsams pa dang / cig ⑪shos des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod kyis bdag la chu tshags khas blangs pa g.yor cig /des smras pa/ de lta chan de ni bden na 'badag gis chu btsag ⑫pa'i slad du byin gyi8/ thams cad kyi thams cad du byin pa ni ma yin no zhes des tsom byin pas de phongs par gyur pa'i skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom 10—127

ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong gang la chu tshags med pa des dge slong grogs po la ①khyod la chu tshags yod dam med ces dri bar bya'o/ /gal te yod do zhes zer na des ji bdag la sbyin nam mi sbyin zhes brjod par bya'o/ /gal te sbyin no zhes zer na gal te khyod slar ldog par gyur tam/ gzhan du 'gro bar gyur na sbyin nam mi sbyin zhes brjod par bya'o//gal te sbyin no zhes zer na 'gro bar bya'i ②gzhan du na 'gro bar mi bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ③ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa nye ba ④'khor gyis ⑤sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa chu tshags ma mchis par gtsug lag khang gzhan nam/ grong gzhan du mchir gnang ngam / nye ba ⑥'khor mi gnang ngo / /gal te der song nas phongs par mi 'gyur na gnang ngo / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa nye ba ⑦'khor gyis sangs rgyas ⑧bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/btsun pa chu tshags gcig gis gnyis ljongs rgyu zhing mchir gnang ngam/ nye ba ⑨'khor gal te der song nas phongs par mi 'gyur tshun gnang ngo / /btsun pa chu tshags gcig gis mang po rnams sam/ dge 'dun dag ljongs rgyu zhing 0mchir gnang ngam/ nye ba 8'khor gal te der song tsonas phongs par mi 'gyur na gnang ngo / /btsun pa chu tshags ma mchis par chu klung gi 'gram nas mchir gnang ngam/ nye ba ④'khor gnang ste/ tsomagyogs pa la gal te chu gzhan dang 'dres par ma gyur na rgyang grags re re zhing brtag par bya'o/ /chu gzhan dang 10—128

'dres ①par gyur na gang dang gang du len pa de dang der brtag par bya'o/ /mi mgyogs pa la ni 'gram dang 'gram du brtag par bya'o/ /de la mgyogs pa ni rgyun myur ba'o/ /mi mgyogs ②pa ni rgyun bul ba'o/ /btsun pa 'gram gyi nye 'khor ③gang lags/ nye ba du'akhor 'dom rjogang kho ra khor yug go/ /btsun pa chab ma btsags shing ma brtags pa 'tshal du gnang ngam/ nye ba rjo'akhor mi gnang ngo / /btsun pa chab ma btsags shing brtags pa 'tshal du gnang ngam/ nye ba ⑦'khor mig gis dag go zhes bya ste gnang ngo / /btsun pa chab btsags ⑧shing brtags pa 'tshal du gnang ngam/ nye ba ⑨'khor gnang ngo //'on kyang chu rung ba ni lnga ste/ dge 'dun gyis rung ba dang / gang zag gis rung ba dang / chu tshags kyis rung ba dang / chu mig gis spre) rung ba dang /khron pas rung ba'o/ /de la dge 'dun gyis rung ba ni gang dge 'dun mthun pas bskos pa'i dge slong gis chu btsags par gyur pa ste/ dge 'dun gyis rung ba de la dge slong gis longs spyad par bya'o/ /gang zag gis yirung ba ni dge slong gang tshul khrims ma nyams pa dang / lta ba ma nyams pa dang / spyod pa ma nyams pa dang / 'tsho ba ma nyams pas yongs su dag par gyur pa ste/gang zag gis rung ba de la dge slong gis longs spyad par bya'o/ /chu tshags kyis rung ba ni chu tshags gang nam yang ma dag pa tho)ma yin pa des btsags pa ste/btung bar bya'o/ /chu mig gis rung ba ni 'bab pa'o/ /khron pas rung ba ni khron pa gang gi chu dag pa de las nyi ma nub kur 0blangs nas ji srid nyi ma shar gyi bar du ste/ khron pas rung ba'i chu btung bar bya'o/ /dge slong rnams ha cang yun ring du chu rtog pas 'khrul 8pa mthong bar gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das 10—129

kyis bka' stsal pa/ glang ①drug gi shing rta snyig ②mas bkang ba 'khor ba tsam mam la/ ji tsam gyis yid ches pa de tsam du brtag 0par bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi ༷kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can rnams dge slong rnams la sder spyad dag 'bul bar byed pa na dge slong rnams mi len to/ /de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag gang gi tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du byung bar ma gyur pa de'i tshe ni mu stegs can dag yon gnas lags/ da ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du byung bas khyed yon gnas lags te/ gal te khyed kyis mi ༷bzhes na ci bdag cag 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol du dge ba'i lam rgyags ma mchis par 'chi'am ⑦bzhes shig /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal ⑧pa/dge 'dun gyi phyir sder spyad dag blang bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge 'dun gyi phyir sder spyad dag blang bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis de dag blangs nas mdzod du bcug ste bzhag ⑨nas de bzhin du lhung bzed dag tu za ba dang / bram ze dang / khyim bdag dad pa can rnams kyis mthong ste smras pa/ 'phags pa dag bdag cag gis sder spyad phul ba de dag mi gda' yin/ dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ bzhin skyebazangs dag mdzod na 'dug go/ /de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag ci bdag cag gi khyim na gnas ma mchis te/ bdag cag gis khyed la phul lam/ yongs su longs spyad 8na bdag cag la yongs su longs spyad pa'i rgyu las byung ba'i bsod 18—130

nams su 'gyur ba zhig na khyed kyis kyang mdzod du bcug pa lta/ skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sbyin bdag gis byin pa'i sder spyad dag yongs su longs spyad par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis sbyin bdag gis byin pa'i sder spyad dag ①yongs su longs spyad par bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis yongs su longs spyad par brtsams so/ /bram ze dang khyim bdag gzhan rgya chen po la mos pa de dag gis sder spyad tshad chen po dag phul ba dang / dge slong gnas brtan ②gnas brtan rnams de dag 'khru bas ngal bar gyur nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sder spyad kyi zhal ta ba bsko bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis sder spyad kyi zhal ta ba bsko bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / bye brag med par bskos chanas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / chos lnga dang ①ldan pa'i sder spyad kyi zhal ta ba ma bskos pa ni bsko bar mi bya⑤ / bskos pa ni dbyung bar bya ste lnga gang zhe na 'dun pas 'gro ba dang /zhe sdang dang / gti mug dang / 'jigs pas ⑥'gro ba dang / sder spyad brims pa dang ma brims pa dag mi shes pa'o/ /chos lnga dang ldan pa'i sder spyad kyi zhal ta ba ma bskos pa ni bsko bar bya/ bskos pa ni dbyung bar mi bya ste/lnga gang zhe na/ 'dun pas mi 'gro ba dang / zhe sdang gis ⑦ma yin pa dang /gti mug gis ⑧ma yin pa dang / 'jigs pas mi 'gro ba dang / sder spyad brims pa dang ma brims pa dag shes pa'o/ /bsko ba ni 'di ltar bya ste/gnas mal bshams nas/ gaṇ+ḍi brdungs te/ dris pa'i tshig gis dge 'dun rnams la bsgo nas dge 'dun thams cad 'dus te 'dug pa dang / re zhig 10—131

dang por spro ba bya stenyu/ ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di ②dge 'dun gyi sder spyad 'brim par bsko rgyabar spro'am gal te spro na des spro'o zhes smra bar bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu dge slong gcig gis gsol ba byas nas las bya ste/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams dugasan du gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun gyi sder spyad 'brim 0par spro ste/ gal te dge 'dun gyi rjodus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis ⑦gnang bar ⑧mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 0sder spyad kyi zhal ta bar bskos te/ sder spyad kyi 0zhal ta ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dge 'dun gyi sder spyad 'brim ⑨par 'gyur ro/ /'di ⑤ni gsol ba'o/ /las ni 'di ltar bya ste/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun la sder spyad 'brim ④par spro ste/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis ming 'di zhes bgyi ba sder spyad kyi zhal ta bar bsko zhing sder spyad kyi zhal ta ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dge 'dun la sder 8spyad 'brim 8par 'gyur na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba sder spyad kyi zhal ⑩ta bar bsko bar bzod pa de dag ni 0cang ma gsung 8shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsung ⑩shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang du nas sder spyad kyi zhal ta ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dge 'dun la sder spyad dag 'brim ⑥par 'gyur te③/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas ⑥de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /dge slong rnams kyis zas zos nas lhag mas bya'abags bzhin du de nyid la byin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / lhag mas 'bags pa dag lhan cig gnas pa dang / nye gnas rnams kyis bkru chabar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyalhag mas 'bags pa dag 10—132

lhan cig gnas pa dang / nye gnas rnams kyis bkru bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong gzhan dag cig la 'khor med nas de dag bdag nyid 'khru bar byed pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de dag ①ni sder spyad kyi zhal ta ba dag kho nas bkru bar bya zhing de dag gis kyang de dag ②la sbyin par bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi ②kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /drug sde rnams lhung bzed nag po gcig tu cig char bza' ④bar brtsams nas de drug car ⑤gyis mnyam du lag pa bcug pa dang / lhung bzed lag pa la thogs te de 'phyang bar gyur pa dang / de dag gis tshe dang ldan pa dag lhung bzed yinag po cho 'phrul byed pa la ltosal/ de dag gis lag pa drangs te lhung nas chag pa ⑧dang / de dag gis rta gad kyis ⑨btab pa dge slong rnams kyis mthong ste de dag gis smras pa / tshe dang ldan pa dag ⑩'di lta bu mi mdzes pa byas nas gnong ste 'dug par bya ba yin na/ khyed dgod pa lta0/ de dag gis smras pa/8 ci byas chang ()'thungs sam kun dong tsu )zos/ dge slong rnams kyis smras pa dang ⑫/ci de yang byed dam/ gzhan ci byas/ lhung bzed nag po ma bcag ⑩gam/'di la 'gal ba ci zhig yod/ ci rdza mkhan shi'am/ 'jim pa med dam/gzhan byar zad mod/ de dag cang mi smra bar 'dug pa dang / skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ nyes dmigs gang cung zad byung ba ni dge slong rnams gcig tu za ba las gyur gyis / de lta bas na dge slong gis gcig tu bza' bar mi bya'o//10—133

za na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams kyis gcig tu bza' bar mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong dag cig 'gron pa ①dang / thabs cig chas pa 'gron pa laphyogs gcig tu zan bza' ③ bar brtsams pa na dge slong de dag thams cad la sder spyad dag mi bdog ④ste/de dag re re nas zan za ba la ring zhig thogs nas 'gron pa ⑤thal ba dang /chom po dag gis bcom mo/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' 455 pa/ lam du zhugs pa na gal te sder spyad dag ma rnyed na gcig tu bza' ⑥bar bya ste/ lag pa ni re re nas gzhug ⑦par bya zhing dbyung bar bya'i cig car ⑧du ma yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis lam du zhugs pa na gal te sder spyad dag ma rnyed na gcig tu bza' bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / de na dge tshul gang dag 'khod pa de dag dang lhan cig gcig tu ⑨za bar byed pas nyes dmigs de nyid du gyur nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lhung bzed bzung la de dag dang ⑩lhan cig bza' bar bya'o/ /rung ba byed pa gzhan dag cig yod pa de dag zan za ba na 'gron pa ⑨rnams dang bral nas nyes dmigs de nyid du gyur pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa'/ gong bur sgongs tsol byin cig /dge slong gzhan dag cig gnyen gyi khyim du song ba dang / gnyen dag gis smras pa / bdag cag lhan cig zos nas ring zhig lon pas zan lhan cig bzas tshur8—/ de dag gis smras pa/ khyed ni khyim pa/ bdag cag ni rab tu byung ba yin pas bzar mi rung ngo / /de dag mi dga' nas mchi mas brnangs shing 'dug go/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /18—134

bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gal te yang dang ①yang du don du gnyer na gdon mi za bar dus kyis 'chu ②bar shes nas gang du gzhan dag gis mthong na ②mi mdzes par mi 'gyur ba der sder spyad bzung la bza' bar bya ste/'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi chakun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /drug sde rnams gos gcig pu dang bsod snyoms za ba bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis mthong nas dris pa/ shes ②ldan dag zan za ba 'di dag su zhig /gzhan dag gis smras pa / dge sbyong ༅shākya'i bu yin no/ /de dag 'phya zhing shes ldan dag ston pa ngo tsha shes pa dang ldan pa de lta bu la ngo tsha shes pa dang khrel yod pa dang bral ba 'di dag lta bu ga la yod ces zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ nyes dmigs gang cung ༅zad byung ba ni dge slong rnams gos gcig gon ④pa las gyur gyis ⑨de bas na dge slong gis gos gcig tshudang zan bza' bar mi bya'o/ /za na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gis gos gcig ⑪dang zan bza' tsobar mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / rgan po rgan 8te nyam chung ba dang / nad pa sbyor mi bzod pa dag chos gos rnams gyon te zan bza' bar mi nus nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de dag gis rngul zan 'jam po dang / zan bza' bar bya ste/ 'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o/ /'on kyang gzhan dag cig gis ma nus pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal ④pa/ de dag gis phyogs dben par bza' bar bya ste/ 'di la 'gyod 10—135

par mi bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /drug sde rnams chu bo dregs ldan la gcer bur khrus byed pa bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis mthong nas dris pa/ shes ldan dag gcer bu pa khrus byed pa 'di dag su zhig gzhan dag gis smras pa/ dge slong ཿshākya'i bu yin no/ /de dag 'phya zhing shes ldan dag ③ston pa ngo tsha shes pa dang ldan pa de lta bu la ngo tsha shes pa dang khrel yod pa dang bral ba 'di lta bu dag ga la ②yod ces zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa nyes dmigs ④gang cung zad byung ba ni ⑤dge slong rnams sgren 0mor khrus byed pa las gyur gyis ⑦de lta bas na dge slong gis sgren mor khrus mi bya'o/ /byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /'on kyang khrus ras bcang bar ⑧bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis khrus ras bcang bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong rnams nyis 0sbyar 'chang nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chig rkyang ⑩bcang bar bya ste/ gang la nyis 7sbyar yod pa des ni chu brtags la bkru chubar bya'o / /chos gos gsum pa rnams mi rung ngo snyam nas mi 'chang ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de rnams kyis kyang byin gyis brlabs te bcang bar bya'o/ /gzhan dag cig gis khrus ras ma rnyed ④pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang dag gis khrus ras ma rnyed pas 8lo ma dag gis mdun dang rgyab nas g.yogs te/ phyogs dben pa gang na gzhan dag gis mthong nas ma dad par mi 'gyur bar khrus bya'o/ /dge slong rnams khrus ras 10—136

gcus te ①de dag 'gyod par gyur pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ras chig brkyang la ni srog chags chadag med mod kyi 'on kyang ras bshal nas gcu dubar bya ste/ 'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o// //sdom ni/ mon sran gre'u ⑤dang mi rung ba'i/ /sa dang bskyugs shing ⑥za ba dang / /bdams ༅shing zas ni za ba dang / /'gyod dang khar ⑧ba'i lhung bzed do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa nam gru gang ci la yang khu phrig ⑨za ba cig pas de'i ming nam gru khu phrig 0can nam gru khu phrig 0can zhes bya bar chags so/ /de dus gzhan zhig na chab khung tsosar zhugs pa dang / des de na mon sran gre'u'i zhal tsolu zhig mthong nas de ④yang dag pa ma yin pa'i rtog pa skyes pa bdag gis sa bon gyi 8chos ma rung bar byas so snyam mo/ /ci (9tsam dus gzhan zhig na dge 'dun la mon sran gre'u'i 4)bza' ba dag cig grub pa de mi za bar lhung bzed bkab ste 'dug pa dang /lhan cig gnas pa dang / nye gnas dag gis smras pa/ mkhan po dge 'dun la mon sran gre'u'i tsobaza' ba dag byung ba ci'i slad du mi gsol/ des smras pa/bu dag kho bos sa bon gyi chos ma rung bar byas so/ /de dag gis tho)smras pa/mkhan po jici lta bu zhig ⑥bgyis/ des ji ltar gyur pa bsnyad pa dang / de dag gis kyang mi bza' 0bar brtsams so/ /de dag la 'grogs bshes rnams kyis dris pa/ ci'i phyir mi za/ de dag gis ji ltar gyur pa bsnyad 3pa dang / de 'khor mang po can zhig pas de la brten nas dge 'dun thams cad kyis ma zos 10—137

sol/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' ①stsal pa/ dge slong dag sa bon gyi ②rigs tshos dka' ba zhes bya ba yod de/ de yang rlangs ③pa byung na tshos so zhes byas nas bza' bar bya ste/ 'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ④ba na bzhugs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa nye ba ⑤'khor gyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa mi rung ba'i sa nas shing 'khrungs la rung ba'i sar 'bras bu ༅lhags na yongs su longs spyad par bgyi'am/ yongs su longs spyad par mi bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nye ba ⑦'khor yongs su longs spyad par mi bya'o/ /btsun pa re zhig mi 0rung ba'i sa nas shing 'khrungs la mi rung ba'i sar 'bras bu dag lhags na yongs su longs spyad par bgyi'am/ yongs su longs spyad par mi bgyi / nye ba ⑨'khor ⑩yongs su longs spyad par mi 7bya'o/ /btsun pa re zhig rung ba'i sa nas shing 'khrungs la mi rung ba'i sar 'bras bu dag lhags na yongs su longs spyad par bgyi'am/ yongs su longs spyad par mi bgyi/ /nye ba ci'akhor gal te zhag tu ma lon na 8yongs su longs spyad par bya'o/ / btsun pa re zhig rung ba'i sa nas shing 'khrungs la rung ba'i sar 'bras bu dag lhags na yongs su longs spyad par bgyi'am/ yongs su longs spyad par mi bgyi/ nye ba 'khor yongs su longs spyad par bya'o//⑫sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /mnyan yod na bram ze 10—138

zhig gnas pa des slong ①mo btab pas glang zhig rnyed do/ /de'i 'og tu ba ②zhig rnyed do/ /de'i 'og tu yang glang zhig rnyed do/ /de'i 'og tu yang ba zhig rnyed de de'i ba lang khyu longs par gyur to/ /bram ze des thog mar rnyed pa'i glang la bkra shes kyi blo ①byung nas/ glang de ④yan du btang ngo / /dus gzhan zhig na de rgas 'khogs nyam chung bar gyur te/ de chu 'dod nas chu bo dregs ⑤ldan gyi 'gram du song ba las 'dam du song ngo / /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu yang lam der song ba las/ des de mthong nas bsams pa/ glang 'di la dge ba'i rtsa ba lta cung zad yod dam snyam pa dang / yod par mthong ngo / /su la rag las snyam pa dang / bdag kho na la ste/ des 'dam nas phyung yinas lag pas phyis so/ /de nas bzhin bzangs 'di ltar 'du byed thams cad ni mi rtag pa'o / /chos thams cad ni bdag med pa'o/ /mya ngan las 'das pa ni zhi ba'o zhes chos tshig ⑦gsum bshad ⑧de nga la dad par yang gyis shig dang ⑨/ de lta na byol song gi skye gnas las 'dod chags dang bral bar 'gyur ro zhes smras nas song ngo / /de yang wa dag gis zos pa dang / de chawa dag gis za ba'i tshe bsams pa/ gal te 'phags pa de ⑩'dir ma phyin na bdag 'di 'dra ba'i gnas skabs su mi 'gyur ro snyam nas/ de tsotshe dang ldan pa shā tho)ri'i bu la sems mngon par dang bar byas nas dus las 'das te/ mnyan yod na 'bram ze las drug la brtson pa'i rigs zhig 8tu skyes so/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā tshuri'i bus glang de'i gnas skabs de ji lta bu zhig yin skyabasams pa dang tso/ ji tsam na dus las 'das par mthong ngo / /yang gar skyes bsams pa dang / mnyan yod 7nyid du bram ze las drug la brtson pa'i rigs su skyes par mthong nas de 10—139

khyim der yang dang yang du song zhing des bram ze de chung ma dang bcas te skyabs su 'gro ba dang /① bslab pa'i gzhi dag la bkod ②do/ /de dus gzhan zhig ②na phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i dge tshul med par song ba dang / bram ze des smras pa/'phags pa ci phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i dge tshul mi mnga' 'am/ des smras pa/bzhin bzangs ci kho bo'i phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i dge tshul dag rtswa ku sha las rjobazung ba'am/ rtswa ⑤ku sha la bzung bas 'byung ngam/ khyod lta bu las rnyed pa gang yin pa de kho bo'i phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i dge tshul du 'gyur yimod/ 'phags pa bdag gi mchis 'brang ⑦⑧'di la ⑨sems can zhugs te gal te khye'ur btsas na de khyod kyi phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i dge tshul bgyi'o/ /bzhin bzangs nad med cig blangs so ⑩zhes smras nas song ngo / /de zla ba brgyad dam dgu 'das nas bu ba lang gi sha tshugs lta bu zhig btsas pa dang / de'i nye du rnams lhags te 'dus nas zhag bdun gsum nyi shu gcig tu 7btsas pa'i btsas ston rgya cher byas nas ming 'dogs par byed de/ khye'u'i 8ming cir gdags/ nye du rnams kyis smras pa/ gang gi phyir khye'u 'di sha tshugs ba lang dang 'dra ba'i 8de'i phyir khye'u'i ④ming ba lang bdag tu gdags so zhes ming ba lang bdag ces bya bar btags tsoso/ /de bskyed bsrings —nas chen por gyur pa dang / de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā tu9ri'i bu snga dro sham thabs dang chos gos bgos tho)lhung bzed thogs te/ mnyan yod du bsod snyoms kyi phyir zhugs so/ /mnyan yod du bsod snyoms la rgyu ba na des bram ze de'i khyim du phyin pa dang / bram ze des byon pa legs so zhes bya ba'i smra ba tsokun du spyad nas rkang pa la phyag byas so/ /chung mas kyang de la bza' ba dang bca' ba gtsang zhing bsod pas lhung bzed 18—140

bkang ste phul lo/ /khye'u ①de tshe dang ldan pa shā ②ri'i bu'i gdong du lta nas des bram ze la brda byas pa dang / des khye'u de la smras pa/ bu khyod ngas ma btsas pa nas 'phags pa shā ③ri'i bu'i phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i dge tshul du phul gyis rjo'aphags pa dang lhan cig song ⑤sheg /sems can de srid pa tha ma pa zhig ste/de'i phyi bzhin song ba dang / des de rab tu phyung ⑥bsnyen par rdzogs par byas te / gdams ngag byin no/ /des 'bad brtsal ⑦bsgrims pas 'khor ba'i 'khor lo g.yo ba dang / mi g.yo ba cha lnga pa 'di nyid rtogs nas 'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad chos nyid kyis 'jig pa ltung ba/ 'gyes pa/ rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can du bsgoms te nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/ khams gsum gyi 'dod chags dang bral ba/sems gser dang bong bar mtshungs pa/ tsan dan dang ste'ur 'dra ba/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil du mnyam pa/ ma rig pa'i sgo nga'i sbubs bcom pa/rig pa dang / mngon par shes pa dang / so so yang dag par rig ⑧pa thob pa / srid pa dang rnyed pa la chags pa dang bkur sti ⑨la rgyab kyis yi phyogs pa/dbang po dang nye dbang du bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod pa dang / phyag bya ba dang / gus par smra bar bya ba'i dgra bcom par gyur to/ /de la las las skyes pa'i mid pa gnyis yod de/ gcig nas ni skyugs pa 'byin to/ /cig shos nas ni mid yido/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis dus ma yin pa'i zas kyi bslab pa ma bcas pa de'i tshe ni bskyugs shing 8mid do/ /gang gi tshe bcas pa de'i tshe ni bskyugs shing tso'ador bas de lus rkebya/ nyam chung / shig shig po / rod nyams par gyur to/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni 10—141

mkhyen bzhin du rmed pa yin pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la rmas ①pa/ kun dga' bo ba lang bdag ci'i phyir lus rke/nyam chung / shig shig po/ rod nyams par ⑧gyur/ des ji ltar gyur pa gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo gang la las kyi rnam par smin pa las skyes pa'i mid pa gnyis grub pa des skyugs ①pa lan gnyis sam/ gsum bor ④te kha bkrus nas lhag ma mid par bya ste/'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o/ /dge slong rnams zas zos nas bskyugs ⑤te de dag 'gyod par gyur pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gal te dge slong gzhan zhig zan zos te skyugs na des kha bkru bar ⑥bya ste/ 'di ⑦la 'gyod par mi bya'o/ /gang gi tshe tshe dang ldan pa ba lang bdag rab tu byung ⑧ba de'i tshe bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams 'phya smod/ kha zer zhing dge sbyong shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong ⑨rnams kyi dge sbyong gi tshul nyams shing tshangs pa'i tshul nyams te/ da ⑩ni ba lang bdag la sogs pa 'jigs 'jigs lta 0rnams kyang rab tu 'byin to 8zhes pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nyan thos chen po ri rab dang 'dra ba la skye bo'i tshogs phal po che ma dad par byed kyis0/ de lta bas na ba lang bdag yul dbus su gnas su mi gzhug go snyam nas/ tshe dang ldan pa ba lang bdag la bka' stsal pa/ ba lang bdag khyod deng phyin chad (sreyul dbus na ma gnas par mtha' 'khob kyi gnas mal dag sten cig /btsun pa de ltar 'tshal lo zhes tshe dang ldan pa ba lang bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan nas mnyan yod nas mi snang bar gyur tebya/ shing shir ⑩sha ku'i 10—142

gzhal med khang ②stong par 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag nga'i nyan thos kyi dge slong bas mtha'i gnas mal la dad pa rnams ②kyi nang na mchog ni 'di lta ste/ dge slong ba lang bdag 'di yin no/ /dge slong rnams the tshom ②skyes nas the tshom ④thams cad gcod ⑤pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa ba lang bdag gis las ci zhig bgyis na las de'i rnam par smin pas sha tshugs ba lang lta bur gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag ba lang bdag nyid kyis las rnams byas shing bsags pa/ tshogs rnyed pa/ rkyen yongs su bsgyur ba/ chu bo bzhin ⑥nye bar gnas pa nges par myong bar 'gyur ba yin te/ ba lang bdag nyid kyis byas pa'i las rnams gzhan su zhig gis myong bar 'gyur/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin ⑦par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams la ma ⑧yin/ me'i khams la ma yin/ rlung gi khams la ma yin gyi/ 'on kyang las dge ba dang / mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang / skye mched dang / khams dag kho na la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /bskal pa brgya phrag rnams su yang / /las rnams chud zar 0mi 'gyur te/ /tshogs shing dus tshul bab pa na/ /lus can rnams la 'bras bur smin/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung zhes bya ba/ rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i tunyekha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/10—143

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du byung ste de'i bstan pa la 'di rab tu byung bar gyur to/ /dge slong gang gis rab tu byung ba de ①rgas 'khogs nyam chung ba zhig ste/ des ⑧de'i lhung bzed 'khru ba na dge slong gzhan zhig dang lhan cig kha ton zer ba las ②ring zhig thogs nas de'i mkhan po des rang dgar zan zos pa dang / de kha ton la chags pas mkhan po de las ④'phyas so//ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na zan zos nas bdag nyid kyi ②lhung bzed bkrus te mkhan po'i drung du song ba dang / da dung zan za ba mthong nas ⑥de kun nas dkris ⑦pas smras pa/ mkhan po ci khyod glang rgan bzhin du ldad cing bzhugs sam / des bsams pa/ 'di kun nas dkris pas gal te cung zad cig smras na/ je thu bar ⑧'khrug pa skyed par 'gyur gyis ⑨gang gi tshe 'di kun nas dkris ⑩pa dang bral ba de'i tshe dri bar bya'o snyam nas/ des de kun nas dkris pa dang bral ba dang smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa ci zer/ des smras pa/ khyod glang rgan bzhin ldad dam zhes de skad mchi mod/ des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod kyis nga su yin shes sam/ 'tshal te khyod kyang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od sung gi gsung yirab la rab tu byung ba lags la/ bdag kyang de kho na'i gsung rab la rab tu byung ba lags so/ /des smras pa/ de ni de lta yin te bden na 'on kyang rab tu byung bas bya ba'am byed pa gang yin pa de ngas byas te/ de lta bas na nga ni 'ching ba thams cad las grol ba yin/ khyod ni 'ching ba mtha' dag gis bcings pa yin na khyod kyis ngag gi las rtsub mo smras kyisaX / khyod kyis las de ci tsonas kyang bsrabs 8pa nyid dang / yongs su zad pa nyid dang / yongs su gtugs par 'gyur bar 8nyes pa la nyes par 10—144

shogs shig① /des nyes pa la nyes par bshags ②so/ /gang 'dis dge slong dgra bcom pa la glang rgan zhes bya ba'i smra ba kun du spyod pa kun du spyad pa'i las ③de'i rnam par smin pas byam rabs lnga brgyar rjob lang gi skye gnas su skyes so/ /las kyi lhag ma de nyid kyis da ltar sha tshugs ba lang lta bur skyes so/ /yang dge slong rnams kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa ba lang bdag gis las ci zhig bgyis na las 0de'i rnam par smin pas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bas mtha'i gnas mal la ⑦dad pa rnams kyi nang na mchog tu lung ⑧bstan lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' lcal pa/ smon lam gyi dbang gis so/ /gang du smon lam btab lags/ 'di yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung de kho na'i gsung rab la rab tu byung bar gyur te/der 'dis tshe gcig tu tshangs par spyod pa spyad na yon tan gyi tshogs 'ga' yang ⑨thob par ma ⑩gyur to/ /gang gi thad du rab tu byung ba de ni bcom ldan 'das 'od srung gis bas mtha'i gnas mal la dad pa rnams kyi nang na mchog tu lung bstan to/ /de na 'dis smon lam btab pa/ 'di ltar bdag gis bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yon gnas 0bla na med pa 'od srung gi thad du tshe gcig tu tshangs par spyod pa spyad kyang yon tan gyi tshogs 'ga' yang thob par ma gyur gyisatso/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis bram ze'i khye'u bla ma la/bram ze'i khye'u khyod skye dgu'i tshe lo brgya thub pa na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa gang yin pa de'i gsung rab la bdag rab tu byung tsonas nyon 10—145

mongs pa thams cad spangs te/ dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byed par 'gyur ①zhing / ji ltar bdag gis ②mkhan po bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs ①pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis bas mtha'i gnas mal la dad pa rnams kyi nang na mchog tu bstan pa de bzhin du bdag kyang shākya'i rgyal po ④shākya thub pa des bas mtha'i gnas mal la dad pa rnams kyi nang na mchog tu ston par gyur cig⑤ /smon lam de'i rjodabang gis da ltar de bzhin gshegs ⑦pas bas mtha'i gnas ⑧mal la dad pa rnams kyi nang na mchog tu bstan to/ /dge slong dag de ltar na las gcig tu gnag ⑨pa rnams kyi rnam par smin pa ni gcig tu gnag ⑩la / gcig tu dkar ba rnams kyi ni gcig tu dkar/ 'dren ma rnams kyi ni 'dren ma yin no/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na las gcig tu gnag ⑩pa dang 'dren ma rnams spangs nas las gcig tu dkar ba dag la brtsal bar tsobya ste/dge slong dag gis de lta bu la bslab par bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das tsomanyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /drug sde rnams 'di byin cig /'di las byin cig ces 'dam zhing 'dam zhing zas za ba dang 'drim pa 'khrugs 8par gyur nas skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong gis bdams ⑫shing zas bza' bar mi bya ste/ skyaza na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /dge slong rnams zas za ba na lhung bzed bzed pa las de lhung bzed kyi gzhi'i ⑩steng du lhung 0lhung 10—146

bzed kyi gzhi bzed ①pa las lhung bzed du lhung nas de rnams 'gyod de mi za ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag lhung bzed bzed pa las lhung bzed kyi gzhi'i steng du lhung na byin len byas pa zhes bya/ lhung bzed kyi gzhi bzed pa las lhung bzed kyi nang du lhung na byin len byas pa zhes bya/ lhung bzed bzed pa las lhung bzed kyi nang du lhung na byin len byas pa zhes bya/ lhung bzed kyi gzhi bzed ②pa las lhung bzed kyi gzhi'i nang du lhung na byin len byas pa zhes bya ste/ 'on kyang byin ①len gyi sems ni nye bar gzhag par bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa nye dga' bo khar ④ba'i mgar ba'i drung du song nas des smras pa/ bzhin bzangs khar ba'i lhung bzed cig bya na nus sam/ des smras pa/ 'phags pa 'di nyid bdag gi bzo lags kyis 'tshad ji tsam zhig bgyidu/ chen por bya'o/ /'phags pa khyod la khar ba'i lhung bzed chen po ci 'tshal/ bkren pa khyod ci rin med par byed du 'jug snyam mamal/ rin thang ⑧sbyin gyis byos 0shig /des bsams pa/ 'di la bdag gi khar ba ci zhig 'god bya'o snyam nas des de'i khar ba'i lhung bzed chen po zhig byas so/ /des smras pa/ gang 'di'i ⑩nang du chud pa gzhan zhig kyang gyis shig /des gzhan yang byas so/ /de bzhin du gzhan gang yin pa bdun pa'i bar du byas nas de rnams tshe dang ldan pa nye dga' bos dge tshul 'khrur bcug ste/ tshon sna lnga pa'i skud pa las dra ba byed du bcug nas de rnams der bcug ste/ go rims yibashams nas dge tshul gyi 10—147

mgo la bskur ①te gang du mgron ②du bos pa ①der 'gro'o/ /son nas de dag bkram ste 'dug pa dang / khyim bdag dang bram ze rnams kyis smras pa/'phags pa ci khyod kyis khar ba'i mgar ba'i zong bkram mamadu/ des smras pa/bkren pa khyed ci shes/ 'dir ni re zhig phye dag blang ngo / /'dir ni snum khur dag go/ /'dir ni 'bras chan dudag go/ /gzhan rnams su ①ni tshod ma dag blang ngo / /de rnams kyis smras pa/ 'phags pa gal te de lta na ko ⑦res 'ga' tshod ma mang po dag 'byung bas gzhan dag dudang gzhan dag kyang nye bar gzhag dgos so zhes byas pa dang / de cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑨dgongs pa/ nyes dmigs gang cung zad byung ba ni dge slong rnams khar ba'i lhung bzed 'chang ba las gyur gyis ⑩de lta bas na dge slong gis khar ba'i lhung bzed bcang bar mi bya'o/ /'chang na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /kha gzar dang / tshwa ⑩khug dang / phul ba'i btung phor ni ma gtogs so// //sdom ni/ rkang pa bkru ba bkag 8pa dang / /shol 0zangs dag ni gnang ba dang / /de bzhin bsil yab nyid dang ni/ /sbrang ma rnams la g.yab pa'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /dge slong rnams bab bab tu rkang pa 'khru ba der sbrang bu chadag gis gang bar 'dug go/ /ji 8tsam na bram ze dang khyim bdag gtsug lag khang ltar tso'ongs pa de dag gis mthong nas 10—148

smras pa/ 'phags pa sbrang bu za ①zi mchi bas gang ba'i laphyogs 'di ci zhig /dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ bdag cag gis 'dir rkang pa bkrus so/ /de dag 'phya ②ste/ shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong rnams ni gtsang sbra med de bab bab tu rkang pa 'khru'o zhes pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rkang pa bab bab tu bkru bar mi bya'i/ 'on kyang gnas khang gi steng shar lho'i mtshams su rkang pa bkru ba'i gnas bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 0rkang pa bkru ba'i gnas bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis ji lta bu bya ba mi shes nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ru ⑤sngal lta bur bya'o/ /rab tu 'jam par byed pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rtsub por ༷bya'o / /dge slong rgas pa 'khogs pa nyam chung ba de dag phyogs der 'gro mi nus pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de dag gi lagyo mo nye bar gzhag par bya'o/ /dge slong rnams gyo mor 'khru ba na de chag nas ji ⑧ma rung bar gyur pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shol ⑨zangs nye bar gzhag par ⑩bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis shol ⑨zangs nye bar gzhag par bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / drug sde rnams kyis gser dang / dngul dang / bai ḍūr+ya tsodang / shel las byas pa'i shol 8zangs dag nye bar bzhag ⑫go / /bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis mthong nas smras pa/ 'phags pa 'di ci zhig /de rnams kyis smras pa/ bzhin bzangs dag bcom ldan 'das kyis shol 8zangs gnang ngo / /'phags pa ci dge sbyong khyed ⑩'dod pa'i yon tan dag gis gnod dam/ de dag gis smras pa/ khyed ⑩kyi mgrin par 18—149

rdog ①pas mnan to②/ /de dag 'phya ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/gser dang / dngul dang / shel dang / be+e ḍūr+ya rgyalas byas pa'i shol rjozangs dag nye bar gzhag par mi bya ste/ 'on kyang 'jim pa dulas byas pa'i shol rjizangs nye bar gzhag par bya'o/ /rnga mo lta bu nye bar gzhag pa dang ⑦/de ldeg nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ glang po che'i rkang pa lta bur bya zhing de'i dbus su 'bur ka dam pa'i me tog lta bur bya'o/ /shin tu 'jam por byas pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rtsub por bya'o/ /dge slong rnams shol ⑧zangs bab bab tu 'jog nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge 'dun gyi ni 0khang tog 0tu khas phub la zhog cig⑩ /gang zag dag gi ⑩ni gnas khang gi sgo lkog 0tu zhog cigatso /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yul ⑫ kau shāsbyi tshun sgra len ⑦gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /dpyid kyi dus tsol bab nas dge slong rnams tsha bas rmya ste/de dag lus skya yibo bseng bseng gupor gyur cing rke/ nyam 0chung / shig shig pophyo/ rod nyams par gyur pa khyim bdag dang / bram ze rnams kyis mthong nas smras pa/ 'phags pa khyed duci'i slad du lus skya tsobo bseng bseng por gyur cing rke/ nyam byachung shig shig po / rod nyams par gyur/ de dag gis ji ltar gyur pa bsnyad ⑦pa dang / de rnams kyis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag khyed bsil yab mi 'chang ngam/ bzhin bzangs dag bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang ngo / /'phags pa dag khyed kyi ston pa ni thugs rje can yin pas gnang bar 'gyur ro/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la 18—150

gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na gnang gis ①bsil yab bcang bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bsil yab bcang bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / drug sde rnams kyis yu ba gser dang /dngul dang / shel dang / bai ḍūr+ya ②las byas pa bsrubs pa/ bkra ba dang /nye bar bkra ba'i yu ba can gyi bsil yab dag bcangs pa dang / bram ze dang /khyim bdag rnams kyis zhes bya ba nas/ khyed kyi mgrin pa rdog pas mnan to ①zhes bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin no/ /de dag 'phya ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/yu ba gser dang / dngul dang / be+e ḍūr+ya rjodang / shel las byas pa bsrubs pa bkra ba dang / nye bar bkra ba'i yu ba can gyi ⑤bsil yab dag nye bar gzhag par mi bya'i/ 'on kyang bsil yab gnyis po rtswa ba ru ta dulas byas pa dang / shing ta la'i 'dab ⑦ma bcang bar bya'o/ /bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag dge slong rnams la ⑧bsil yab rnam pa sna tshogs 'bul ba na zhes bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin te⑨/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/de lta bas na gnang gis tshudage 'dun gyi phyir bcang bar bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yangs pa can na spre'u rdzing gi 'gram khang pa brtsegs pa na bzhugs so/ /dge slong rnams la sbrang ma dag za ste/ de dag gi ⑫lus sbrang mas zos pas 'brum bus gang ste/ de dag gis yang dang yang du phrugs pa dang / bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag khyed ci'i phyir lus 'di ltar 'brum bus gang / de dag gis ji ltar gyur pa bsnyad ⑫pa dang / de rnams kyis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag khyed sbrang yab mi 'chang 10—151

ngamal / bzhin bzangs dag bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang ngo / /'phags pa dag khyed kyi ston pa ni thugs rje can yin pas gnang bar 'gyur ro②//skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na gnang gis ③sprang yab bcang bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis sbrang yab bcang bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / drug sde rnams kyis yu ba gser dang / dngul dang / be+e ḍūr+ya rjodang /shel las byas pa dang / rnga ma las byas pa'i sbrang ༷yab dag nye bar gzhag pa dang / bram ze dang / khyim bdag rnams zhes bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin no/ /sbrang yab ni lnga ste/ bal las byas pa dang / sha na las byas pa dang / ras bal las byas pa dang / ras ma dang / lo ma sbams pa'o// //sdom ni/ gos mdud pa dang lus dang ni/ /khar ba dra ༅ba 'chang ⑦ba dang / /sgog skya ⑧dag ni bkag pa dang / /nad pa la ni gnang ba'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis stongs mo bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / de na dge slong gcig skas la 'dzeg pa na 'og na shing mkhan zhig 'dug pa des de mdoms dang ba ⑨mthong nas smras pa/ 'phags pa khyod ⑩skyes pa'i dbang po yidang ldan pas bdag gis pho lags par gdod 'tshal lo/ /de gnong nas cang mi smra bar 'dug pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa 8nyes dmigs gang cung zad byung ba ni dge slong 10—152

rnams gos mdud pa ma bor ba nyid du skas la 'dzeg pa las gyur gyis ①de'i phyir dge slong mkhar len ②byed pa gos mdud pa bor nas mkhar len ②byed du gzhug go snyam du dgongs nas/ dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na dge slong stongs mo byed pas gos mdud pa bor nas mkhar len dubya'o / /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gis gos mdud pa bor nas mkhar len dubya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong rnams gos mdud pa bor nas mkhar len ༅byed pa na ma dad pa rnams 'phya ste/ 'phags pa ci stobs 'gyed dam / de dag gis smras pa/ bzhin bzangs dag mkhar len ⑦byed do/ /de dag cang mi smra bar 'dug pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang dag skas la 'dzeg ⑧pa de dag gis mdud pa bor bar ⑨bya'i gzhan dag gis ni ma yin no//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /drug sde rnams lus kyis khur khyer ba dang / bram ze dang / khyim bdag rnams 'phya ste/'phags pa bdag cag ni re zhig pha ma dang bu dang chung ma'i slad du khur thogs na khyed su'i slad du lus kyis ⑩khur bsnams/ de dag gis smras pa/ bzhin bzangs dag bdag cag la yang ston pa mchod pa dang / dge 'dun bshos ⑩gsol ba dang / nad pa rnams kyi rim gro dang / bya ba mang po yod do/ /de dag cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta 10—163
