bas na dge slong gis lus kyis khur bkur bar mi bya'o/ /khyer na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na ①bya rgod kyi ②phung po'i ri la bzhugs so/ /dge slong rnams bya rgod kyi ①phung po'i ri la 'dzeg cing 'bab pa na de dag gred ④cing rdeg 'chos te snad par gyur to/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa dang ⑤/ de lta bas na dge slong rnams kyi 0khar ba bcang bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams kyis khar ba ⑦bcang bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / drug sde rnams kyis gser dang / dngul dang / bai ḍūr+ya ⑧dang / shel las byas pa'i khar ba bsrubs pa/ bkra ba nye bar bkra ba dag bcangs pa/ bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis mthong nas 'phya ba'i skabs ⑨de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na gnyis kyis khar ba ⑩bcang bar bya ste/ rgan po rgas te nyam chung ba dang / nad pa sbyor mi nus pas so0/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gnyis kyis khar ba bcang bar bya ste/ rgan po rgas te nyam 8chung ba dang / nad pa tsosbyor mi bzod pas so zhes bka' stsal pa dang ④/ rgan por gtogs pa dang / nad par gtogs pa rnams kyang khar ba 'chang ba la skezhugs pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgan po dang nad pas dge 'dun la khar ba'i sdom pa gsol bar bya zhing / gang la dge 'dun gyis khar ba'i sdom pa byin pa des khar ba bcang bar bya'o/ /gsol ba ni 'di ltar bya ste/ gnas mal bshams la gaṇ+ḍi ⑩brdungs te dris pa'i tshig gis dge 10—154

slong rnams la bsgo nas dge 'dun thams cad 'dus shing 'khod pa dang /dge slong rgan po rgas te nyam chung ba'am/ nad pa sbyor mi bzod pas rgan pa'i mthar tsog tsog por 'dug la thal mo sbyar te 'di skad ces smra bar ①bya'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bdag dge slong rgan po rgas te nyam chung ba'am nad pa sbyor mi bzod pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dge 'dun las khar ba'i sdom pa gsol na/ dge 'dun thugs brtse ba can btsun pa rnams kyis ②thugs brtse ba ①nye bar bzung ste/ bdag dge slong rgan po rgas te nyam rjochung ba'am/ nad pa sbyor mi bzod pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la khar ba'i sdom pa stsal rjodu gsol/ de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum gyi bar du'o/ /de'i 'og tu dge slong gcig gis gsol ba byas nas las bya ste/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan ༅du gsol/ dge slong rgan po rgas te nyam chung ba'am/ nad pa sbyor mi bzod pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun ⑦las khar ba'i sdom pa gsol te/ gal te dge 'dun gyi ⑧dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis ⑨dge slong rgan po ⑩rgyas te nyam chung ba'am/ nad pa sbyor mi bzod pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la ⑩khar ba'i sdom pa ⑫stsal to/ /'di ni gsol pa'o/ /las ni 'di ltar bya ste/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong rgan po rgas te nyam chung ba'am/nad pa sbyor mi bzod pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dge 'dun las khar ba'i sdom pa gsol te/ de'i slad du tsodage slong rgan po rgas te nyam chung ba'am/ nad pa sbyor mi bzod pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la ④khar ba'i sdom pa stsol na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag tsodage slong rgan po rgas te nyam chung ba'am/ nad pa sbyor mi 18—155

bzod pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la khar ba'i sdom pa stsal bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung ①shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsung ②shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis dge slong rgan po rgas te nyam chung ba'am/ nad pa sbyor mi bzod pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la khar ba'i sdom pa stsal chalags te 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas ④de de bzhin du 'dzin ༷to/ /gang la dge 'dun gyis khar ba'i sdom pa byin pa des khar ba bcang bar bya ste/'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o// // 'dul ba phran tshegs kyi gzhi/0 bam po drug pa/ sangs rgyas ba:ma ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la bzhugs so/ /dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams dang / rlung nad can rnams bya rgod phung po'i ri la 'dzeg pa dang / 'bab pa na gred ⑦cid rdeg 'chos nas snad ⑧par yang gyur/bya ma bum dang / ril ba spyi blugs ⑨dag kyang chag go/ /skabs ⑩de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na dge slong rnams kyis dra ba bcang bar 0bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams kyis 'dra ba bcang bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / drug sde rnams kyis tshon sna lnga pa'i skud pa las 0byas pa'i dra ba bcangs pa dang / bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis mthong nas 'phya bar byed do/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshon sna lnga pa'i skud pa las byas pa'i dra ba bcang bar mi bya'i 'on kyang tshon sna chagacig pa las byas pa'o⑩/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis tshon sna gcig las byas pa'i dra ba bcang bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa 10—156

dang / rgas pas nyam chung bar gtogs pa rnams dang / rlung nad can du gtogs pa rnams kyang dra ba 'chang ba la zhugs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgan po dang rlung nad can gyis kyang dge 'dun las ladra ba'i sdom pa gsol bar bya ②zhing / gang la dge 'dun gyis dra ba'i sdom pa byin pa des dra ba bcang bar bya'o/ /gsol ba ni 'di ltar bya ste/ gnas mal bshams la gaṇ+ḍi brdungs te dris pa'i tshig gis dge slong rnams la bsgo nas dge 'dun thams cad 'dus te 'dug pa dang / dge slong rgan po rgas te nyam chung ba'am / rlung nad can gyis rgan pa'i mthar tsog tsog por 'dug ste/ thal mo sbyar nas tshig 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o / /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bdag dge slong rgan po rgas te nyam chung ba'am/rlung nad can ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dge 'dun las dra ba'i sdom pa gsol na/dge 'dun btsun pa thugs brtse ba can rnams kyis thugs brtse ba nye bar bzung ste / bdag dge slong rgan po rgas te nyam chung ba'am/ rlung nad can ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la dra ba'i sdom pa stsal du gsol/ de bzhin du lan gnyis ④lan gsum gyi bar du'o/ /de'i 'og tu dge slong gcig gis gsol ba byas nas las bya ste/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong rgan po rgas te nyam chung ba'am/ rlung nad can ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun las dra ba'i sdom pa gsol na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi rjodus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis rjodage slong rgan po rgas te nyam chung ba'am/ rlung nad can ⑦ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la dra ba'i sdom pa gsol nito/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /las ni 'di ltar bya ste/ 10—157

dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan ①du gsol/ dge slong ①rgan po rgas te nyam chung ba'am/ rlung nad can ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dge 'dun las dra ba'i sdom pa gsol ①te/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis dge slong rgan po rgas te nyam chung ba'am / rlung nad can ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la rjodra ba'i sdom pa stsol na/tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong rgan po durgas te nyam chung ba'am/ rlung nad can ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la rjod ba'i sdom pa stsal bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung ④shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsung ⑧shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis dge slong rgan po rgas te nyam chung ba'am/ rlung nad can ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la dra ba'i sdom pa stsal lags te / 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /gang la dge 'dun gyis dra ba'i sdom pa byin par gyur pa des dra ba bcang bar bya ste/ 'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o/ /dge slong gzhan dag cig la khar ba yang dgos/ dra ba yang dgos nas de dag la dge slong rnams kyis khar ba dang / dra ba'i sdom pa so sor byin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khar ba dang dra ba'i sdom pa cig car 0snga ma bzhin sbyin par bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu ⑩rgyal byed kyi tshal ⑫mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /mnyan yod na dge slong zhig 'dug pa des sgog skya zos nas/ de bcom 8ldan 'das ga la ba ⑫der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi 8zhabs la mgo bos 8phyag 'tshal nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong de la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dge slong khyod la chos bstan gyis ⑩rna ba gtod la 10—158

'dug cig① /des bcom ldan 'das kyi rgyazhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de la chos bstan par brtsams te/ ji lta ji ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis de la chos bstan pa de lta de ltar dge slong de bcom ldan 'das la dris gnod par gyur na mi rung ngo snyam nas kha logs ②shig tu lta'o/ /lan gnyis lan gsum du bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong de la 'di skad ces dge slong ④dge slong khyod ⑤la chos bstan ⑥gyis ⑦rna gtod cig ces bka' stsal na/ dge slong de lan gnyis lan gsum du yang kha gzhan du bltas nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑧zhubs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga ⑨nas song ngo / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du med 0par mdzad pa yin pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la rmas ⑩pa/ kun dga' bo ci'i phyir ngas ji lta ji ltar chos bstan pa de lta de ltar (smedage slong de kha gzhan 4)du lta/des gsol pa/ btsun pa dge slong des sgog skya 'tshal to/ /kun dga' bo dge slong dag gang gis ④na bden pa rnams kyi 8bar chad du 'gyur ba sgog skya za ⑩lta / bcom ldan 'das 'tshal lags so/ /kun dga' bo gal te dge slong 'dis de ring sgog skya zos par ma gyur na deng 0nyid du 'dis 'jig tsotshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas par 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo de lta bas na dge slong gis yid phyin cad sgog skya dang kun dong rjodang / gi'u 0yongs su longs spyad par mi bya ste/ yongs su longs spyod tshun 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /yang de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'khor 0de nyid du 'dus par gyur te 10—159

'dug pa des bsams pa/ dge slong 'dis de ring bden pa dag ma mthong na re zhig sang ①mthong bar 'gyur ram ②blta'o snyam nas sems pa la zhugs pa dang ma mthong ngo / /des rab kyi mtha' ①ba'i bsam gtan bzhi pa la rnam par bltas nas dus ⑦ji tsam na mthong bar 'gyur ba sems pa la zhugs na/ 'on kyang ma mthong ste/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu ting nge 'dzin de las langs nas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ dal ba'i mchog 'di 'dir ②bor nas/ /'di yis 'di na bden pa dag / nams kyang ༷shin tu mthong bar ni/ /mi 'gyur ba yi gnas de yod/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kyis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu'i sems mkhyen nas/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la bka' stsal pa/shā ri'i bu khyod sangs rgyas kyi yul la lag 'jug par ma byed cig /'di ni 'di nas nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi yul las 'das pa'i dus na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa skyes ⑦bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ②ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad zil gyis gnon pa zhes bya ba'i ston pa 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de'i bstan pa la 'di rab tu byung nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du ⑨byed par 'gyur ro/ /de skad ces gsungs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa nyes dmigs gang (sprecung zad byung ba ni dge slong yisgog skya 8za ba las gyur gyis 8de lta bas na dge slong gis sgog skya bza' bar mi bya'o/ /za na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gis sgog skya bza' bar mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal 10—160

pa dang / dge slong zhig na ba de sman pa'i drung du song ste/ nad med cig ces byas ①nas smras pa/ bzhin bzangs kho bo la nad 'di lta bu zhig byung na sman ston cig /sman pas smras pa/ 'phags pa sgog skya gsol cig dang khyod sos par 'gyur ro/ /des smras pa/ bzhin bzangs bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang ngo / /'phags pa khyod kyi sman 'di yin te/ gzhan gyis ni gsos ②par mi nus so/ /skabs de dge slong rnams la smras so/ /dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/gal te sman pas rgyadage slong khyod kyi sman 'di yin te/ gzhan gyis ni gsos ①par mi nus so zhes zer na bza' bar bya ste/ 'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong nad pas sman pa'i lung gis sgog skya bza'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong nad pas bsgog skya duzos nas gtsug lag khang la yang longs spyod ⑦par byed/ gnas mal dang / snam phyis dang / chab khung du yang 'jug /dge 'dun gyi nang du yang 'gro/ bram ze dang khyim bdag 'ongs zhing ⑧lhags pa rnams la yang chos ston⑨/ mchod rten la yang phyag byed/bram ze dang khyim bdag gi khyim dag tu yang nye bar 'gro/ skyed mos tshal dang /'dun sa dang / lha khang dang / skye bos gang ba'i phyogs gzhan dag tu yang 'dug pa dang / bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis dri tshor nas 'phya smod kha zer zhing / dge slong 0shākya'i bu rnams kyi yidage sbyong gi tshul nyams/ tshangs pa'i tshul nyams te/ da ni rab tu byung ba rnams sgog skya za'o zhes pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ngas dge slong sgog 4)skya za ba'i kun du spyad pa'i chos 18—161

bca' ①bar bya ste/ dge slong sgog skya za bas sgog ②skya za bzhin du chagatsug lag khang la yongs su longs spyad par mi bya/ gnas mal la ma yin/ snam phyi sar 'jug par mi bya/ chab khung sar ma yin/ dge 'dun gyi nang du 'gro bar mi bya / bram ze dang khyim bdag 'ongs shing dulhags pa rnams la chos bstan par mi bya/ mchod rten la phyag mi bya/ bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyi dukhyim du nye bar 'gro bar mi bya/ skyed mos tshal dang / 'dun sa dang / lha khang dang /skye bos gang ba gzhan dag tu gnas par mi bya'i/ phyogs dben pa gang du gzhan dag gis mthong na ma dad pa ༅skye bar mi 'gyur bar bza' bar bya'o/ /gang gi tshe bya ba zin par gyur pa de'i tshe phyogs de nyid du zhag bdun 'dug par bya'o/ / kun dong ⑦na ni zhag gsum/ ki'u ⑧na ni zhag gcig go/ /de nas khrus byas la chos gos dag kyang bkru bar bya zhing bdug pa dag gis bdug par bya'o/ /de nas dri nga ba ⑨med pa dang / gtsug lag khang du 'jug par bya zhing ji ltar bkag pa yang bya'o/ /sgog skya za ba'i dge slong gis kun du spyad pa'i chos ji ltar bcas pa rnams yang dag par blangs te/ mi gnas na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro⑩/ /phran tshegs las sgo dang po rdzogs soyi// //bsdus pa'i sdom ni/ chan pas 'dreg tsodang gdugs dang ni/ /be'u ras dang ni rgyan spel ma/ /len dang tshogs dang khrus tsodang ni/ /gcin dang sgo 'phar spo ba'o/ /sdom ni/ chan pas 'dreg tsodang mdoms byadang ni/ /de bzhin byin pa nyid dang ni/ /khri dang rtswa stan skyagacig dang ni/ /khyim na gnas dang bgo ba min / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan ⑩yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal 10—162

mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /gang gi tshe khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis 7phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun la rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal phul ba de'i tshe des 'phags pa rnams kyi skra dang kha spu bregs shig ces 'breg ②mkhan gyi mi btang ba dang zhes bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin no/ /nye dga' bos smras pa/ bzhin bzangs khyod skra chan pas 'breg gshes sam/ des smras pa/'phags pa de nyid bdag gi bzo ④lags so/ /bzhin bzangs gal te de lta na tshur shog bregs 0shig /des skra chan pas bregs pa dang / nye dga' bos smras pa/ da rung bregs ⑥shig /des yang bregs pa dang / des smras pa/da rung ༅yang bregs ⑧shig /des yang bregs so/ /de bzhin du ji tsam nyi ma nub kyi bar du ma btang ⑨nas/ de'i 'og tu 'di skad ces smras sotshu/ /bkren pa khyod ci yang mi shes pa zhig 'di kho na bzhin mnyam 0par byos ④te song shig ces bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong gis skra chan pas breg par mi bya'o/ /dge slong skra chan pas 'breg ⑫na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gis skra chan pas breg par mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong dag gi mgo la rma byung nas spu gris reg pa na de dag snad pa'i skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rma'i than kor gyi skra 8chan pas breg par bya zhing / lhag ma rnams 8spu gris breg par bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de nas ⑩yang khyim 10—163

bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis 'breg ①mkhan gyi mi btang ②ste zhes bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin no/ /bzhin bzangs mdoms kyi phyogs kyi spu 'bregs ③shes sam/des smras pa/ 'phags pa de nyid bdag gi dubazo lags so/ /bzhin bzangs gal te ⑤de lta na 0tshur shog bregs ①shig /'phags pa ji 'dra bar breg /bzhin bzangs mdzes par bregs ⑧shig /des breg ⑨par brtsams pa dang /nye dga'as ⑩smras pa/ bzhin bzangs 'di ltar byos shig /des de ⑩bzhin byas pa dang / yang smras pa/ gzhan 8'di lta bur yang byos shig ces des de ji ④tsam nyi ma nub kyi bar du ma btang nas/ dge sbyong shākya'i sras rnams kyi ④dge sbyong gi tshul ni nyams/ tshangs pa'i tshul ni nyams te/ da 0ni gsang ba'i phyogs kyi spu yang 'breg (9par byed do zhes smod par byed/ gzhogs ⑪'phyas byed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na dge slong gis mdoms kyi phyogs kyi spu breg par mi bya'o/ /dge slong mdoms kyi phyogs kyi spu 'breg 8par byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gis mdoms kyi phyogs kyi spu breg ⑩par mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong dag gis ⑥ mdoms kyi phyogs su rma byung ba dang /dge slong ⑥dag phye'agyod nas spu 'breg ④par mi byed do/ /dge slong gzhan dag la yang srin bu byung ste/ de dag de'i gnod ④pas dudage ba'i phyogs kyi bya ba mi nus pa'i skabs de ( 9dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan dag la bstan tshunas rma'am srin bu'i phyir ni mdoms kyi phyogs kyi duspu breg par 18—164

bya ste/ 'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de nas yang khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis 'breg ①mkhan gyi mi btang ba dang zhes bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin no/ /bzhin bzangs khyod byin spu 'breg lashes sam/'phags pa de nyid bdag gi ①bzo lags so/ /bzhin bzangs gal te de lta na tshur shog bregs ༷shig /'phags pa ci 'dra bar breg par bgyi/ bzhin bzangs mdzes par bregs 0shig /des breg par brtsams pa dang / nye dga' bos smras pa/ bzhin bzangs 'di ltar byos shig /des de bzhin byas pa dang yang smras pa/ gzhan 'di ltar yang byos shig /des de ji tsam nam sros ⑥kyi bar du ma btang bas/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis ⑦de la zhes bya ba nas/ dris pa zhes bya ba'i ⑧bar snga ma bzhin no/ /des ji ltar gyur pa smras pa dang / de smod par byed pa'i skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta ⑨bas na dge slong gis byin spu breg par mi bya'o/ /dge slong byin spu 'breg ⑩par byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yangs pa can na spre'u 0rdzing gi 'gram khang pa brtsegs pa na bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gis byin spu breg par mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang /dge slong rnams kyi 8brla la rma byung zhing dge slong gzhan dag la srin bu byung nas/de dag de'i gnod pas dge ba'i phyogs bya bar mi nus par gyur pa'i skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das 10—165

kyis bka' stsal pa/ rma byung ba'i phyir ram/ srin byung ba'i ①phyir ni byin spu breg par bya ste/ 'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu ②rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /drug sde rnams khri gcig la nyal bar ②byed cing / de dag der nyal nas ku re byed/ rtse bar byed / ca co smra bar byed/ dgod ①pa dang 'phyar g.yeng dang / lus la rdeg par byed pa'i skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ nyes dudamigs gang cung zad byung ba ni dge slong rnams khri gcig la nyal bar byed pa las gyur pas de'i phyir dge slong gzhan dang lhan cig khri gcig la nyal du ⑥mi gzhug go snyam du dgongs nas / dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyed kyis ⑦deng phyin cad ⑧dge slong gis khri gcig ⑨la nyal bar mi bya'o/ /byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gis khri gcig la nyal bar mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / ji tsam na dge slong mang po rnams ljongs rgyu zhing dong ste/ ljongs rgyu ba na ri brags shig ⑦tu phyin nas de dag gis der khri brnyas yipa dang / de dag gis khri dag byin no/ /de rnams kyis smras pa/'di dag nyung gis 8gzhan yang snoms 0te spyon cig /de dag gis smras pa/'phags pa dag bdag cag ni khri re re la skye bo mang po dag nyal bar bgyid na/khyed gzhan yang g.yor ram/ re re la gnyis sam gsum gzims ④par mdzod cig /de rnams kyis smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis khri gcig la gnyis sam gsum nyal du ma gnang na ji ltar nyal bar bya/ de dag gis smras pa/10—166

'phags pa dag khri gzhan ni ma mchis sonyu/ /de skad smras pas cang mi smra bar 'khod pa'i skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong gang dag ngo tsha shes shing 'gyod pa dang ldan rgyal/ bslab pa 'dod pa de dag gis dran pa nye bar bzhag ste / gding ③ba bting ba dul bar du chos gos kyi gtur ༷bu'am/ lhung bzed ⑥kyi snod dag rgyabacug la nyal bar bya ste/ 'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o/ /khri la ji lta bar rtswa stan ⑧dang gzhan dag la yang de dang 'dra'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan ⑨yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed ⑩kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /dge slong mang po rnams ljongs rgyu zhing dong ba dang / ri brags shig 0tu phyin nas de rnams kyis khyim bdag cig tsolas bste gnas brnyas 0so/ /grang ba'i dus la bab pas de rnams kyis gos brnyas pa dag 8bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis 'di dag ni rab tu byung ba yin no snyam ste/ snying rje nye bar bzhag ste gos dag byin pa dang /gang gis gang thob pa des de gyon te nyal nas dge slong gzhan dag grang bas sbrebs par gyur pa'i skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang gis gang thob pa de dag nyid kyis bgo bar mi bya'i thams cad kyis bgo bar bya ste/ gcig rnyed par gyur pa gang yin pa de 'thams cad kyi steng du rgan rims ⑩bzhin ji tsam yog pa dgab par bya'o/ /ji tsam na yang 0ri brags tsogazhan zhig tu dong ⑩ba dang / der gos chagacig cig rnyed nas de dag gi ⑥steng du g.yogs pa na nye dga'as de gyon te 'chag ②tu song ba dang / dge slong rnams grang 10—167

bas sdug bsngal bar gyur nas smras pa/ btsun pa nye dga' bo bdag cag ni grang bas sdug bsngal na khyod 'ba' zhig lagyon nas 'chag gam/ des smras pa/kho bos bkag gam ci/ khyed kyang ci'i ②phyir mi 'chag /de rnams grang ba'i sdug bsngal gyis mtshan 'das par gyur pa'i skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/'chag pa gang yin pa des gang zag gi ③gos bgos te bcag par ④bya'o/ /gzhan gyis 'chag na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal ①bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /grang ba'i 0dus la bab pas dge slong rnams grang ba'i ⑦gnod pas glos phab ste ⑧'dug go/ /ji tsam na khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gtsug lag 0khang du 'ongs pa dang /des de dag mthong nas smras pa/ 'phags pa ⑩ci'i slad du gcig tu brtson pa'i gsung rab la glos phab ste bzhugs shing dge ba'i phyogs dag mi rimadzad/de dag gis smras pa/ khyim bdag bde ba dang ldan pa dag ni chos dran par 'gyur phyi/ kho bo cag shin tu grang bas sdug bsngal bar gyur to/ /des khyim du song nas be'u ras lnga brgya bskur yib dang / dge slong rnams kyis 'khyim pa'i gos de dag bgos te phyi rol du dong ba bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis mthong nas co dri ⑩zhing smras pa/ 'phags pa dag ci khyed babs sam/ de dag gis smras pa/ kho bo cag gis cigang bar gyur nas bgos kyis 8tshe dang ldan pa dag de skad ma zer cig /de rnams smod par byed pa'i skabs ⑩de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis 18—168

bka' stsal pa/ dge slong gis khyim pa'i gos bgo bar mi bya'o/ /de lta bu'i rkyen cig ①byung na steng du gos ngur smrig gis g.yogs nas bgo bar bya'o/ /dge 'dun gyi yang de bzhin du gyon par byed nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge 'dun gyi ni 'og tu gos bcug nas steng nas g.yogs te bgo bar bya'i gzhan du na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro// //sdom ni/ gdugs dang 'jig rten rgyang 'phen rgyadang / /bsdebs sbyar de bzhin nags me dang / /gnas med par ni lam dag dang / /la ba bgos pas mi 'chag ①pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /mnyan 0yod na bram ze gos spyod pa zhig du'adug pa de dugos byas shing byas shing 'tshong bar byed do / /dus gzhan zhig na des gos mang po ⑨rnyed par gyur nas/ des bsams pa thabs ji lta bu zhig byas na des bsod nams kyang 'thob ③cing rnyed pa yang 'grub ⑨par 'gyur snyam pa dang / de dad pa can zhig pas de'i blo skyes te sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun spyan drangs la gos kyi gdan bshams ⑦te gdugs tshod gsol lo/ /de 0ltar byas na ⑩gos kyang yongs su spyad par 'gyur la/ gos 8yongs su longs spyad pa dang / zhal zas yongs su longs spyad pas bsod nams chen po yang 'thob par 'gyur ro snyam du ris/ nas / des sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun rang gi khyim du gdugs tshod la spyan drangs nas zhal zas gtsang zhing bsod pa bshams te gdan dag gi steng du gos bting ngo / /de nas gdam thostebashams zin pa dang /10—169

bcom ldan 'das spyan 'dren gyis ⑦spyan drongs na dge slong gi dge 'dun ni gshegs / bcom ldan 'das ni gtsug lag khang na bzhugs shing bsod snyoms drangs so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni rgyu rnam pa lngas gtsug lag khang na bzhugs shing bsod snyoms 'dren ②te/ lnga gang zhe na/ nang du yang dag 'jog ②bzhed par gyur pa dang / lha rnams la chos ston bzhed par gyur pa dang / nad pa gzigs bzhed par gyur pa dang / gnas mal gzigs bzhed par gyur pa dang / nyan thos rnams 'dul ba la dubaslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bzhed pa'o/ /don 'di la ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos rnams 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bzhed nas/ gtsug lag khang na bzhugs shing bsod snyoms drangs so/ /dge slong rnams lam kur ⑤char dupa bab nas de dag gi gos char pas gsher bzhin du 'khod pas gang gi gos ci 'dra bas 'khod pa de'i de kho na lta bu'i sbra sbre byung bar gyur pa bram ze des ⑦mthong ba dang 'khrugs nas smras pa/ bdag gi zong 'di lta bu dag zong du ⑧mi rung bar bgyis kyis 0gos 'di dag khyed thal byung snoms shig ces zer ba'i skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag bram ze des ma dad pa skyes nas byin pas blang bar mi 0bya'o/ /de 'khrugs pa de dang bral nas yang des dad pa'i sems kyis phul ba'i skabs yide dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag da ni bram ze des dad pa'i sems kyis phul 8bas blang bar bya ste/ blangs nas kyang rung ba byas la bgo bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis blangs pa dang / bram ze des 18—170

smras pa/ e ma'o 'phags pa dag gdugs bcang ba'i rigs so/ /skabs ①de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol ②pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gal te de lta na rjes su gnang ste/ dge slong dag gis gdugs bcang bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag gis gdugs bcang bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / drug sde rnams kyis lagadugs kyi rtsa ba gser dang / dngul dang / be+e ḍūr+ya ④dang / shel las byas shing /gzhan yang bkra zhing 0nye bar bkra ba dang / bsrubs pa ⑥las byas ⑦la/gdugs ni dkar po dang / rma bya'i mdongs dag las byas pa dang / bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis ⑧mthong nas de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag 'di ci lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gdugs gnang ngo / /'phags pa dag dge sbyong khyed ci 'dod pa'i yon tan gyis gzir tam/ gang gi phyir 'di ⑨'dra ba'i gdugs dag 'chang / de dag gis smras pa/ dgra bo rnams kyi mgrin pa rdog pas mnan nas 'dod pa'i yon tan gyis gzir to/ /de dag smod par byed pa'i skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bu'i gdugs dag bcang bar ⑩mi bya'oyi/ /'on kyang rtswa 8ba ru rta tsodang / lo ma las byas pa'i gdugs rnam pa ④gnyis bcang bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gdugs rnam pa tsoganyis bcang bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / drug sde rnams kyis gdugs kyi rtsa ba ring po ④ring por byas nas gdugs kyi rtsa ba bsgreng ste grong khyer gyi nang du song ba dang / bram ze dang khyim bdag ⑦gis mthong nas 'di lta bu nor can nam/ tshong tsodapon nam/ ded dpon nam/ su zhig 'ong ⑩zhes 10—171

langs nas rtog par byed do/ /kha cig snar ①dong ba dang / gang gi tshe mthong bar gyur pa de'i tshe ②ma dad par gyur pa'i skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/gdugs kyi rtsa ba ring po ①ring por mi bya'i 'on kyang gdugs ④kyi tshad tsam gyi rtsa ba gdags par ⑤bya zhing grong gi nang du gdugs thogs te 'gro bar mi bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis grong gi nang du gdugs thogs te 'gro bar mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / ji tsam na dge slong mang po dag don mthun dang lhan cig ljongs rgyu zhing dong ba dang / re zhig na grong du lam byung bar gyur nas de dag gis bsams pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis grong gi nang du gdugs ༅thogs te 'gro bar mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal pas grong dor bar bya'o snyam nas de dag gis grong spangs ⑦pa dang / don mthun rnams dang bral bas chom pos bcom pa'i skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gal te grong gi dbus su lam byung bar gyur na ⑧gdugs glor bsnyal nas 'dong bar bya ste/ 'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o/ /bsod snyoms pa rnams bsod snyoms la zhugs pa dang / char pa bab nas char chus gos ⑨gsher bar gyur pa'i skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bsod snyoms pas gdugs kyi rtsa ⑩ba rung bar byas nas 'jug par bya ste/ zhugs nas gal te char pa chad na gdugs khyim dang por bzhag la 'jug par bya zhing de nas phyir blangs te 'gro bar bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal 10—172

mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /lho phyogs kyi yul nas kun du rgyu 'jig rten rgyang 'phen ①pa 'char ba zhes bya ba zhig ljongs rgyu zhing mnyan yod du 'ongs so/ /de ngal bsos ②nas tshe dang ldan pa kun shes kauṇ+ḍi ②n+ya ga la ba der song ste phyin nas smras pa/ kye dge slong kho bos bla ma dag las blangs pa'i yi ge cung zad yod de/ de'i phyir khyod dang lhan cig gtam bya bar 'dod do/ /des de la smras pa/ bram ze kho bo smra ba don du gnyer ba ④ma yin gyis song ༅shig /de tshe dang ldan pa rta thul dang / bzang po dang /rlangs pa dang / ming chen dang / grags pa dang / gang yipo dang / dri med dang / ba lang bdag dang / lag bzangs ga la ba der song ba dang /de rnams kyis kyang de kho na skad smras so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu ga la ba der song ste phyin nas smras pa/ kye dge slong kho bos bla ma las yi ge cung zad blangs pa dag yod de/ de'i phyir khyod dang lhan cig gtam bya bar 'dod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus bsams pa/ ci kun du rgyu 'di la dge ba'i rtsa ba cung zad yod dam 'on te med snyam na ⑦yod par mthong ngo / /su la rag las brtags na bdag nyid la'o/ /ci smra bas 'dul ba gzhan cung zad yod dam snyam na yod par mthong ngo / /ji tsam na tshogs pa brtags na zhag bdun tshun chad kyis chogs ⑧par shes nas smras pa/ legs te de bzhin bya na rig pa'i gnas gang du bya/ che ge mo zhig tu'o/ /smra ba'i zhal che ⑨ba bzhag ste phyogs snga ma dang phyi ma rnam par bzhag ⑨ nas/ sus 7phyogs snga ma/ sus gzugs shes glengs ⑩pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus smras pa/ kun du rgyu glo bur du 'ongs pa yin pas 'di nyid kyis phyogs snga ma tshugs shig /kun du rgyus 10—173

phyogs snga ma smras pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus bzlas nas khyod kyi 'di ni mi rigs so/ /'di ni mi 'dra'o/ /'di ni mi 'thad do ①zhes skyon btags ②so/ /des yang smras pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus 'jug ①tu ma phyin par bzhag go/ /lho phyogs kyi yul nas kun du rgyu 'jig rten rgyang 'phen ④pa 'char ba zhes bya ba zhig mnyan yod du 'ongs te/ de dang 0tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dang lhan cig brtsad nas/ deng du zhag bdun lon no zhes kun du sgra grags pa dang / srog chags brgya phrag ⑥mang po dag kha cig ni ya mtshan skyes/ kha cig ni sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba dag gis bskul nas 'dus pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus bsams pa/ bdag gi smra bas ⑦'dul ba 'dus sam snyam na 'dus par mthong ngo / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus ma lus par smras pa dang / kun du rgyu de tshar gcad ⑧do/ /de nas mngon par dad par gyur te smras pa/ btsun pa shā ri'i bu bdag gis legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i ⑨dge slong gi dngos po 'thob na/ bdag bcom ldan 'das kyi chaspyan sngar tshangs par spyod pa spyad do/ /de nas 7tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus de tsorab tu phyung bsnyen par rdzogs par byas te/ gdams ngag byin no/ /des brtsal tsob dang 'bad pa dang bsgrim pa byas pas 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'cha lnga pa g.yo ba dang mi g.yo ba 'di nyid rig ste zhes bya ba nas gus par smra bar bya bar gyur to zhes bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin no/ /de nas 'khor de dag 'phags pa shā ri'i bus 'di lta bu'i smra ba chen po pham par byas so/ /zhes shin tu ya mtshan skyes so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus 'khor de dag gi bsam (nyepa dang / bag la nyal dang /18—174

khams dang rang bzhin rtogs nas de dag dang mthun par chos bstan te/ srog chags 'bum phrag mang po dag gis ①de thos nas lhag pa'i khyad par chen po thob pa 'di lta ste/ kha cig gis ni rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas/kha cig gis ni lan gcig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu kha cig gis ②phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu zhes bya ba nas dge 'dun la gzhol zhes bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin no/ /skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag thams cad du dge slong shā ri'i bu'am/shā ri'i bu dang 'dra bar mi 'gyur bas de lta bas na gnang gis ②dge slong dag gis 'jig rten rgyang 'phen ④pa la sogs pa phyi ④rol pa'i bstan bcos bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag gis 'jig rten rgyang 'phen ⑥pa la sogs pa phyi rol pa'i bstan bcos bslab par bya'o zhes ⑦bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong byis pa'am/ rmongs pa'am/ mi gsal ba dudag gis kyang thams cad kyis khyad par med par bslabs ⑨pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ phas kyi rgol ba tshar gcod ⑩ nus pa gang yin pa de dag gis 'jig rten rgyang 'phen yipa la sogs pa phyi rol pa'i bstan bcos bslab par bya'i8—/ byis pa dang / rmongs pa dang / mi gsal ba dang / mi mkhas pa dag gis tsom yin no/ /de rnams de la brtson pa nyid du gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dus gsum du byas la/ dus gnyis ni sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab bklag ④par bya zhing gsum pa la ni phyi rol pa'i bstan bcos dag go//bcom ldan 'das kyis dus gsum du bya'o ④zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong rnams lo dang zla ba'i dus dag tu slob par byed nas(9/ bcom ldan 10—175

'das kyis bka' stsal pa①/ dge slong dag tshe ni skad cig ma yin pas ngas lo dang zla ba'i dus la ②dgongs te ma gsungs kyi / 'on kyang nyin gcig la cha gsum du bya'o/ /dge slong rnams gsal ba'i ④dus su ni phyi rol pa'i bstan bcos 'don la/ gzhan dag tu ni sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab 'don nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gsal ba'i dus su sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab gdon ⑤par bya ste/ phyi rol pa'i bstan bcos ni ma yin no//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus bram ze'i khye'u lha sbyin dang / ba lang 'byor gnyis rab tu phyung nas/de dag tshe dang ldan pa shā ⑥ri'i bus mdo sde 'don du bcug go/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na ljongs rgyu zhing dong nas ri brags shig ⑦tu phyin pa dang / cider de dag la rnyed pa dang bkur ste lachen po byung nas de gnyis der 'khod do/ /de gnyis sngon goms pa'i shugs kyis sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab sdeb 0sbyor dang /tshig dang rim pa ༅sbyar nas kha ton du 'don to sh+yi/ /de dag las gcig ni shi'o//cig shos kyis tsogazhung brjed par gyur nas/ de la kha ton las byung ba'i rnyed pa med nas de dang de dag tu 'khyam 'khyam tsonas phyir mnyan yod du 'ongs sol/ /de nas ngal bsos te tshe dang ldan pa kun shes kauṇ+ḍi ④rgya ga la ba der song ste phyag byas nas tho)smras pa/ gnas brtan g.yar ton dbog tu gsol/des smras pa/ bu legs so de bzhin kha ton bslab bo zhes des de dang lhan cig kha ton bya bar brtsams pa dang / kha ton thung 4)ngur 'don nas smras pa/gnas brtan khyod kyis ring por ma bton pas gdon 0nongs so/ /des smras 10—176

pa / bu kho bos de ltar bslabs sol/ /des de'i rkang pa la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas/ tshe dang ldan pa rta thul dang / bzang po dang / rlangs pa dang /ming chen ②dang / grags pa dang / gang po dang / dri med dang / ba lang bdag dang / lag bzangs ga la ba der ②song ste phyin nas rkang pa la phyag 'tshal te/ smras pa/ gnas brtan g.yar ton dbog tu gsol/ des smras pa / bu legs so de bzhin kha ton bslab par bya'o zhes des de dang lhan cig kha ton gdon ④par brtsams pa dang / de nas kha ton thung ngur bton nas smras pa/ gnas brtan khyod kyis gdon nongs so/ /des smras pa/ bu kho bos de ltar bslabs sol/ /des de'i rkang pa la phyag byas khyenas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu'i rkang pa la phyag byas nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /mkhan pos ⑦g.yar ton dbog tu gsol/ des smras pa/ bu legs so/ /de bzhin du kha ton du ⑤bslab bo/ /des de dang lhan cig kha ton bya bar brtsams pa dang /ji tsam na kha ton ring por bton nas/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ⑨ri'i bus kyang ring por bton pa dang / des smras pa/ mkhan po dge slong de dag kun gyis ni gdon nongs kyi/ khyod nyag tshugacig gis ma nyams par bton to/ /des smras pa / mi 0blun po khyod nyid kyis gdon nyes kyitso/ dge slong dag gis ni ma nyams par bton to zhes des de 8spyos nas cang mi smra bar 'dug pa'i skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ nyes dmigs cung zad gang byung ba ni dge slong rnams sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab sdeb ④sbyor dang / tshig dang rim pa sbyar nas 'don pa las 10—177

gyur gyisal/ de lta bas na dge slong gis sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab sdeb sbyor ②dang / tshig dang rim par ②sbyar nas gdon par ④mi bya'o/ /dge slong gis sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab sdeb sbyor ⑤dang / tshig dang rim par ①sbyar nas 'don na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /yul gyi rtsinges pa'i tshig dang /skad kyi nges pa'i tshig dang / ljongs kyi nges pa'i tshig yin na ltung ba med do//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal ⑧mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /drug sde rnams rgas pa'i gnas skabs na yang rgod bag byed pa dang / dge slong ⑨dag gis smras pa/tshe dang ldan pa dag khyed mgo skyas 0kyang yid dung rgod bag mi gtong cingam/ de dag cang mi smra bar 'khod nas mtha' gcig tu dong ste smras pa/ dga' bo mnye dga' lhung bzed nag po can dkos ④thag pa 'di dag la mi dga' ba zhig bya'o zhes de dag de ltar glags tshol ba la brtson par 'khod pa na dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan dag dgon pa'i gnas su dong ste bsam gtan dang bklag ⑫par bya ba dag brtsams so/ /de nas drug sde rnams kyis gnas gsum nas nags mes btang ste ngos gcig tu 'dus nas bsdad pa dang / dge slong rnams nags mes tshig pa'i gnod pa byung bas rings pa rings par 'bros par brtsams so/ /drug sde rnams kyis smras pa/ gnas brtan dag ci'i slad du rings rings ltar bzhud/ tshe dang ldan pa dag nags kyi me ma mthong ngam/gnas brtan dag bcom ldan 'das kyis bde ba'i gnas skabs su tshul khrims gsungs sam ci lags zhes cung zad bgad ⑩pa dang / de dag gis smras pa/tshe dang ldan pa dag khyed kyis kho bo cag la bsams bzhin du ma gtses grang /10—178

bkren ①pa dag khyed de ltar mi dga' bar bya'o zhes zer ba'i skabs de ②dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong gis nags mes gtang ③bar mi bya'o/ /gtong ④na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /mnyan yod na dge slong rgan po zhig dang / gsar ⑤du zhig ljongs rgyu zhing dong ba dang / rgan po la ni snod mang zhing yo byad mang la/ gsar bu ni ma grags shing chos gos gsum las lhag pa med pa zhig pas/ rgan pos smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa kho bo ngal gyis yire zhig chos gos ⑦ kyi gtur bu khyer te shog shigashe /gsar bu des smras pa/gnas brtan bka' 'bab par mi 'gyur na re zhig cung zad cig gsol ba mchis so/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'di la su zhig rtsigashe smros shig /gnas brtan sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun la rtsom gzigs sam rtsi rmongs pa'i yo byad 'dis ci zhig bgyi/ bzhin bzangs gal te mi bkur ba ni re zhig rung na 'di dri ⑩bar bya ste/ khyod kho bo'i mkhan po'am/ slob dpon yin nam/ ci gang gi phyir rjes su ston par byed/ de cang mi smra bar 'dug pa dang / rgan pos bsams pa/ bkren pa 'di mi dga' bar bya'o 8snyam mo/ /ji 8tsam na de gnyis gtsug lag khang du dong ba dang / de na nub gcig kyang mi gnas par 'dug par mi bya ④ba'i khrims su bya ba yod de/ de gnyis la gnas mal gyi zhal ta byed pas gnas mal dag snoms 6)shig ces smras pa dang / rgan pos ni blangs so/ /gsar bu des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa kho bos gnas ma bcas 10—179

kyisal / je gnas gsol lo ②zhes de dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyi gan du song ste rkang pa la phyag 'tshal nas smras pa/ gnas brtan bdag gi ③gnas mdzad du gsol/ des smras pa/ cibazhin bzangs khyod su dang lhan cig 'ongs/gnas brtan dge slong che ge mo zhig dang ngo / /bzhin bzangs de dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyis ④bdag 'khor dang phye'o zhes zer du 'ong gis ⑤song la de nyid la gnas gsol cig /de gzhan yidag gi ⑦gan du song ba dang / thams cad kyis de bzhin spangs nas nam sros te rgan po de nyid kyi gan du song nas sgo la brdabs ②te smras pa/ gnas brtan phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod su zhig bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba de lags so/ /khyod nad med par gyur cig /gnas brtan gtsug lag khang 'di na nub gcig kyang mi gnas par mchis par mi ⑨bgyi ba'i khrims su mdzad pa mchis na bdag gi gnas mdzad du gsol/ bzhin bzangs dge 'dun gyis de lta bu'i khrims su bca' ba 4) mdzad pa legs te/gal te ma mdzad na kho bos 'char gzhug pa zhig de'i tshe ni kho bo snod mang zhing yo byad mang ba yin la/ nga ༅ni gnas brtan yin nam/ khyod ma gus pa byas kyang gnas ster ba gang yin pa de la gnas chos shig /de spobs pa med par gyur nas cang mi smra bar 'dug ste/ de'i gnas bar chad du gyur pa'i skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das ⑫kyis bka' stsal pa/ gnas med par ljongs rgyu zhing 'gro bar mi bya/ dge slong gis seng 'ge bzhin gtum por mi bya/ dge 'dun gyis kyang dge slong rnams la gnod par 'gyur ba'i khrims bca' bar mi bya ste/ dge slong gnas ma bcas par ljongs rgyu zhing 'gro'am/ seng tsoge bzhin gtum por byed dam/10—180

dge 'dun gyis nyakhrims su bya ba de lta bu bcas na thams cad 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das zhabs ②'bring ba tshe dang ldan pa klu skyong dang yul ma ga d+mar snoljongs rgyu zhing gshegs te grong khyer sad kur ④can du gshegs nas / sad kur ⑤can na gnod sbyin ba ku la'i gnas yin bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das mtshan mo nam sros te/ mun gnag cing khad kyis cung zad ⑥cung zad char 'bab cing glog 'byung ba na bla gab med pa'i 'chag sa na 'chag ⑧pa mdzad do/ /chos nyid kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi zhabs 'bring ⑨ba dge slong rnams ni ji srid sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams nang du yang dag 'jog la mi bzhugs pa de srid du ⑩ nang du yang dag 'jog la mi 'jug go/ /brgya byin lha'i dbang po'i shes pa dang mthong ba ni 'og tu 'jug pa yin pas des bsams pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de grong khyer sad kur 0can na sad kur 8can gyi ri la gnod sbyin ba ku la'i gnas na bzhugs shing / de tsomatshan mo nam sros te mun gnag cing khad ④kyis cung zad cung zad char 'bab cing tsoglog 'byung ba yin/ bla gab med pa'i 'chag sa na 'chag ste0/ ma la bdag der nye bar 'gro'o snyam du rig nas be+e ḍūr+ya ⑫las byas pa'i dri yigatsang khang mngon par sprul te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das 'chag pa mdzad pa'i zhabs ⑩'bring na 'chag cing 'dug go/ /de'i tshe yul ma ga dhā ⑥pa'i mi rnams khye'u dang bu mo ngu ba gang yin pa de dag la de rnams gnod sbyin ba ku la'i ming gis sdigs ④par byed do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa klu skyong gis 'di snyam du bsams te④/ kye ma 18—181

bcom ldan 'das ha cang yun ring du bla gab med pa'i 'chag sa na 'chag pa mdzad pas ma la bdag gis de la gnod sbyin ba ku las bsdigs so snyam du rig nas la ba bzlog ①ste bgos nas 'chag sa'i ②slad du 'dug ste/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /ba ku la ba ku la dge sbyong nga ni gnod sbyin ba ku la yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa klu skyong la 'di skad ces bka' gastsal to/ /mi blun po ༅khyod kyang de bzhin gshegs pa la gnod sbyin ba ku las bsdigs par sems sam⑤/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni bsnyengs ⑥pa dang bag ⑦tsha ba dang bral ba ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa la bsnyengs ⑧pa'am/ zhum pa'am/spu zing zhes byed pa mi mnga'o/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin ma dad par gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa chos 'dul ba 'di la 'di 'dra ba'i gang zag kyang mchis sam/ kau 0shi ka khyod sdod cig /gi ta ma'i rigs ni rgya che ba yin pas 'di yang phyis rnam par dag pa'i chos can du 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ nyes dmigs gang cung zad byung ba ni dge slong dag la ba bzlog byaste gyon pa las gyur par mkhyen nas/ dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag mi ⑪blun po klu skyong gis la ba bzlog 8ste bgos nas de bzhin gshegs pa la ④ba ku la ba ku la/ dge sbyong nga ni gnod sbyin ba ku tsol yin no/ /zhes zer te/ de lta bas na dge slong gis la ba bzlog ④ste bgo bar mi bya'o/ /gyon na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis yidage slong dag tshugis la ba bzlog ⑫ste bgo bar mi bya'o/ /gyon na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro zhes bka' stsal pa 10—182

dang ①/ dge slong ba lang gi gnas na 'khod pa de dag gis der la ba'i bgo ba dag rnyed ②pa dang / de dag la shig zhugs te/ dge slong rnams shig gis zos pas bde ba mi 'thob ③pa'i skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ la ba bzlog ④ste gyon pas 'dug par bya⑤/ nyal bar bya'i bcag par ni mi bya'o// //sdom ni/ be'u ras dang ni la ba dang / /de bzhin la ba'i mchog dang ni//sgrog mig sgrog rten mdud ⑥pa dang / /ska rags dag ni gsum yin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag gal te dge 'dun la be'u ras grub na yang gnang la/ gang zag la yang gnang ngo / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs shing snga ma bzhin te/ dge 'dun la la ba grub na yang gnang la/ gang zag la yang gnang ngo / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs shing snga ma bzhin te/ dge 'dun la la ba mchog grub na yang gnang la / gang zag la yang gnang ngo //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba ⑦na bzhugs so/ /mnyan yod na dge slong bsod snyoms pa zhig 'dug pa de snga dro sham thabs dang chos gos bgosal/10—183

lhung bzed ①thogs te mnyan yod du bsod ②snyoms kyi phyir zhugs so/ /de bsod ①snyoms kyi phyir rgyu ba na ༷chos gos nar nas/ des myur ba myur bar lhung bzed sa la bzhag nas/ de tshags byas pa dang / de bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis mthong nas 'phya zhing dge slong lashākya'i bu 0rnams ni gtsang sbra med de/ lhung bzed bab bab tu 'jog go zhes pa'i ⑦skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong gis lhung bzed bab bab tu gzhag par mi bya'o/ /dge slong lhung bzed bab bab tu 'jog na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /'on kyang chos gos bsrung ba'i phyir chos gos kyi sgrog mig nigadags par bya'o/ /dge slong rnams kyis btags pa dang / des chos gos ral nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sgrog zungs kyis glon la thogs shig /dge slong rnams kyis sgrog zungs kyis glan nas btags pa dang / de sgrog mdud med pas ma chags te nyes dmigs su ⑨gyur pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mdud pa bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /mnyan yod na dge slong bsod tsosnyoms pa zhig 'dug pa de snga dro sham thabs dang chos gos bgosayi/ lhung bzed thogs te mnyan yod du bsod tsosnyoms kyi phyir zhugs so/ / de bsod snyoms kyi 0phyir rgyu ba na 0smad g.yogs snyil tsob dang / de 8myur ba myur bar lhung bzed sa la bzhag 0ste/ de tshags bcos so/ /bram ze dang / khyim bdag rnams kyis mthong nas zhes bya ba snga ma bzhin tsono/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 10—184

bka' stsal pa/ chos gos bsrung ①ba'i phyir ska rags ②rnam pa gsum po/ shur bu dang / shur bu phre'u dang / lcag pod ①bcang bar bya'o// // 'dul ba phran tshegs kyi gzhi/④ bam po bdun rjopa/ sdom ni/ ston pa duser skya'i gnas bzhugs pas/ /rgyan spel ma dang phyang phrul ④can/ /zla gam dang ni gser skud can/ /khra ⑧bo thams cad bkag pa yin/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ser skya'i gnas na n+ya gro dha'i 0kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe shākya tho) ming chen gyi khyim gyi zhal ta ba dus las 'das pa dang / ri brags yin gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs dag ④shākya ming chen ga la ba der song ste smras pa/ rje ⑫khyod kyi khab kyi zhal ta ba gum na/ zhal ta ba gzhan ④zhig bskor 8gsol/ des de'i drung na bram ze'i khye'u zhig 'dug pa de la smras pa/ bram ze'i khye'u re zhig khyod song ⑩shig /ji tsam na zhal ta ba gzhan ⑩zhig btang ngo / /de song nas des chos bzhin du rigs par spyad pas dpya nar ma dang / bla skyes rab tu mang por phul ba dang / shākya tsoming chen gyis smras pa/ bram ze'i khye'u skyidapya nar ma dang bla skyes 'di ltar mang ba khyod kyis skye bo'i tshogs la gnod par ma byas grang / des smras pa/ rje dpya nar ma dang bla skyes 'di rigs pas mchis pa lags te/ bdag gis skye bo'i tshogs la gnod pa bgyis pa ma lags so/ /des ri brags tshun gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs de la smras pa/ shes ldan dag bram ze'i khye'u 'dis khyed 'ga' la gnod pa mi byed 0grang / rje dpya nar ma dang bla skyes 'di rigs pas mchis pa lags te(spre/ 'dis 'ga' la yang gnod pa ma bgyis so zhes smras pa dang /18—185

des de ri brags kyi ①zhal ta bar bcug go/ /'jin rten ni 'byor pa 'dod cing rgud pa dang mi mthun pa yin pas/ de la bram ze gzhan zhig gis bu mo byin pa dang / des de nyi ma dang / tshes grangs dang / yud tsam dang sbyar nas bag mar blangs so/ /de de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/dga' mgur spyod par byed do②/ /de rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las bu khye'u zhig btsas te/ de btsas pa'i btsas ston rgya cher byas nas rigs dang mthun pa'i ming yang ②btags so/ /yang de rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las bu mo zhig btsas te/ de'i btsas ston yang rgya cher byas nas ming zla ba zhes bya bar btags so/ /de bskyed bsrings te chen mor gyur pa dang / de mkhas shing spyod lam dang 'gro 'dug 'o gze ④bas ri brags ⑤na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs duthams cad kyi yid du 'ong bar gyur to༅/ /ji tsam dus gzhan ⑤zhig na bram ze'i khye'u de na bar gyur nas rtsa ⑨ba dang / sdong bu dang / lo ma dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu'i sman gyis rim gro byas kyang nad de zhi bar ma gyur nas/ ri brags ⑩ pa des dpya nar ma dang / bla skyes phul ba gang yin pa de dag thams cad spyad cing skyin po gzhan dag blangs nasayi/ 'on kyang sos par ma gyur nas de de nyid du dus las 'das so/ /ri brags 8na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs dag shākya ming chen tsog la ba der 'ongs te smras pa/ rje zhal ta ba de ni gum lags so/ /des smras pa/ shes ldan dag de na dpya nar ma dang bla skyes su phul ba yod dam/ rje te por mang du phul mod kyi des bro 'tshal ba'i yo byad du spyad na 'on kyang sos par ma gyur nas skyin po gzhan dag kyang bgyis so/ /18—186

nged ①la de na lhag ma cung zad ci yod pa des bu lon sobs shig /rje de na cung zad kyang ma mchis te/ lus par btab na de'i mchis 'brang ⑧dang /bu pho dang bu mo mchis te/ de'i bu mo de mkhas shing spyod lam dang 'gro 'dug 'o gze ②ba lags pas ri brags ④na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs thams cad kyi yid du mchi bar gyur to/ /ming chen gyis smras pa/ shes ldan dag de'i chung ma dang bu pho dag ci dgar thong la bu mo de 'dir khug shig⑤ /de rnams kyis de'i chung ma dang bu pho de dag ci dgar btang nas bu mo de ming chen gyi gan du khrid do/ /shākya ⑥ming chen gyi chung ma rgan mo gcig ④kha zas g.yo ba dang / me tog thu ⑧ba'i las rnam gnyis byed pa des ⑨smras pa/ jo bo da ⑩ni bdag shin du rgas pas sug las rnam gnyis bgyid rngo mi thog yin/ zla ba 'di bdag gi dan grogs su bskor gsol/ des de dan grogs su bskos so/ /8de la des ⑫smras pa/ zla ba khyod ni kun dga' ④bar song la me tog thus shig /ngas ni kha zas g.yo'o/ /de kun dga'i cir bar song nas me tog btus te de nas phreng ba legs par brgyus nas ming chen gyi gan du song ba dang / de tsomathong nas yongs su dga' ste smras pa/ legs so zhog shig ces ⑩smras nas chung ma 8rgan mo de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /ci'i phyir sngon ni me tog nyung la de ring mang bar gyur/ des smras pa/ sngon ni khyod kyi gnyen yidag mchis nas bdag la slong ba na bdag gis ⑥de dag la stsal pa/ 'dis ༷ni su la yang ma stsal ba dang bdag ni rgas pas mig rtul ⑤la/ 'di ni mig rno bas thu 'amakhas pa las gyur to/ /des smras pa/ gal te de lta na de kun dga' ra bar rdzithong la der zhig shigadu /des de kun dga'i char ba de nyid du bzhag pa dang / de me 18—187

tog gi phreng ①ba bzang po rgyud par byed pas de'i ming phreng ldan ma ⑤phreng ldan ma zhes bya bar grags so/ /dus gzhan zhig na ②de khyim nas rang gi zan blangs rjote kun dga' ra bar song ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyang bsod ①snyoms la gshegs so/ /des bcom ldan 'das sku blta bas chog ⑥mi shes pa mthong nas shin tu bde zhing rab tu dga' bas lartog par byed cing bsams pa/ 'di lta bu'i yon gnas yang dag pa la bdag gis bya ba ma byas pas des na bdag 'di lta bu'i gnas skabs su gyur par gdon ma zos sol/ /de'i phyir gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag las bsod ①snyoms bzhes na/ bdag gis bcom ldan 'das la dbul lo snyam pa dang / skabs de lta bu la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la mi mkhyen pa dang / mi gzigs pa dang / mi rig pa dang /rnam par mi mkhyen pa ci yang mi mnga' bas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ⑩ni chos nyid kyis zhes bya ba nas/ lus can rnams la 'bras bur smin ces ⑩bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de rjes su gzung ⑫ba'i phyir lhung bzed bzed de sring mo khyod kyis tsogal te yongs su btang na lhung bzed 'dir byin cig ces bka' stsal pa dang / des shin tu dad pas bcom ldan 'das la bsod snyoms de phul nas zhabs gnyis la phyag 'tshal te smon lam btab pa/ bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bran mo dang dbul por mi 'gyur bar shog shigatso /ji tsam na de'i pa'i grogs po bram ze mtshan mkhan zhig yod pa des de mthong nas smras pa/ bu mo khyod ga las 'ongs/ ri brags ⑫de kho na nas so/ /su la gnas shing 'dug des smras pa/ gang na skal ba ⑫chung ngu gnas pa na ste/ bdag ming chen gyi bran mo ⑩bgyis so/ /khyod kyi pha 18—188

de gar song / gum mo/ /ma dang ming po de dag gar dong / gar mchis ma 'tshal to/ /zla ba khyod bran ①mo'i 'os ma yin na lag pa rkyong ②shig dang blta'o//des lag pa brkyang ba dang / des bltas nas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/gang gi lag pa'i mthil dag la/ /lcags kyi 'khor lo'i mtshan yod pa/ /bran gyi rigs su skyes gyur kyang / /rgyal po'i btsun mor bzhes par 'gyur/ /gang gi bzhin ni rgyas pa dang / /ngang pa'i rgyal po'i gdangs 'dra ba/ /bran gyi rigs su skyes gyur kyang / /rgyal po'i btsun mor bzhes par 'gyur/ /gang gi rkang pa'i mthil dag la/ /grong khyer cog chadang rta babs bcas/ /bran gyi rigs su skyes gyur kyang / /rgyal po'i btsun mor ༷bzhes par 'gyur/ /khyod mi dgar ⑤ma byed par song shig dang / khyod bran mor mi 'gyur gyi khyod rgyal po'i btsun mor 'gyur ro/ /de gnas de nas skyed mos tshal du song ba dang /yul ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal ri dgas shor du chas pa ①rtas kha khyer te/gcig pu ser skya'i ⑦gnas su phyin to/ /de phan tshun 'khyam ⑤pa las ming chen gyi kun dga' ra bar song ⑨nas/ des bu mo de la dris pa/ bu mo 'di su'i kun dga' ra ba yin/ des smras pa/ lha shākya ming chen gyi lags so/ /de ⑩rta las babs te smras pa/ bu mo rkang pa bkrus chu long yishig /de ⑩shin du myur bar rdzing bur song ste nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis bsros ⑩pa'i chu blangs pa dang /des rkang pa bkrus nas yud tsam zhig bsdad de ⑩smras pa/ bu mo gdong bkrus chu long 8shig /des chu'i steng rim lag pas bsal 8te/ chu ha cang 0dro ba yang ma yin ha cang grang ba yang ma yin pa blangs nas des gdong bkrus so/ /des yang smras pa/ bu mo btung dgos kyis chu long 8shig /des chu rnam 18—189

par glongs te chu bsil ba'i ①mo ma'i snod du blangs pa rgyal pos 'thungs rgyanas smras pa/ bu mo kun dga' ra ba 'di na rdzing bu gsum yod dam ci na/ khyod kyis ②chu rnam pa gsum khyer te 'ongs/ des smras pa/ lha 'di na rdzing bu gcig kho na mchis kyi/ gsum ni ma mchis so/ /des smras pa/ 'o na khyod kyis chu rnam pa gsum ga las khyer te 'ongs/ des ji ltar gyur pa brjod pa dang /rgyal pos smras pa/ des ④ni go'o 'di dri ⑤bar bya ste/ ci'i phyir khyod kyi 0chu rnam pa gsum khyer te ⑦'ongs/ des smras pa/ lha bdag gis dang por chab dron po ⑧'tshal te mchis pa ni lha mnyel bsos ⑨par bgyi ba'i slad ⑩du'o/ /slad kyis ha cang dro ba yang ma lags/ ha cang grang ba yang ma lags ⑩pa 'tshal te mchis pa ni dro ba dang grang ba gang lags pa dag spyan la gnod pa'i ⑫slad du'o/ /rnam par glongs nas shin tu bsil ba 'tshal te mchis pa ni lha skyems ⑩pa dang bral bar bgyi ba'i slad du'o/ /des bsams pa/ bu mo 'di ni mkhas pa yin no snyam du rig nas smras pa/ bu mo mdzangs ④shing mkhas pa khyod rkang pa mnye dgos kyis re 8zhig mal chos shigatso /des de'i rkang pa mnyes pa dang / de reg bya dang ldan pa yin pas mnyes ma thag nyid du de gnyid log go⑩/ /de gnyid log pa dang / des bsams pa/ rgyal po 'di dag la ni dgra mang bas gal te 'di gnyid log pa la 'ga' zhig gis gnod pa byed tson nges par bdag gi rje bo la grags pa ma yin par 'gyur bas sgo gcad ⑪par bya'o snyam nas/ de chasgo bcad ⑥de 'dug pa dang / ji tsam na gcig nas gcig tu thos te dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa dag skyed mos tshal der lhags nas de rnams sgo phye zhes zer ro/ /des sgo ma phye ba dang / rgyal po ku 10wa 190

cho'i ①sgras sad nas smras pa/ bu mo de ci zhig /des smras pa/ lha mi dag cig chab sgo phye zhes mchi ②zhing / lha'i mtshan yang ⑤smos so/ /des smras pa/bu mo sgo 'di sus bcadadu/ lha bdag gis bkum dumo/ /ci'i phyir bcad/lha bdag gis duglo ba la rgyal po 'di dag la ni dgra mang bas gal te 'di mnal log pa la 'ga' zhig gis gnod pa bgyis na nges par bdag gi rje bo la grags pa ma lags par 'gyur ro snyam nas/ de'i slad du bdag gis ⑦chab sgo bkum mo / /des smras pa/ bu mo mdzangs nim 0khyod la nga'i the tshom ⑩'di dri ⑪bar bya ste/ re zhig khyod ming chen gyi cir 'ong tsozlos shig /des smras pa/bdag de'i mngag gzhug bgyid pa'i bran mo lags so khyod de'i mngag gzhug byed pa'i bran mo ma yin gyi/ khyod nges par de'i bu mo yin gyis 'drang por smos shig/de cang mi smra bar ci'adug pa dang / rgyal pos smras pa/ bu mo khyod ming chen gyi gan du song la/ rgyal po gsal rgyal khyod kyi kun dga' ra ba tson bzhugs so zhes byos shig /de myur ba myur bar song ste/ jo bo ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal khyod kyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so zhes smras so/ /shākya ming chen gyis thos nas bza' ba dang / btung ba dang / dri dang phreng ba dag bshams nas/skye bo phal po ches bskor 0te kun dga' ⑩ra bar song ngo / /de nas gcig la gcig byon pa legs so zhes bya ba'i tshig gis kun du spyad pas so so tsoyang dag par dga' bar byas nas/ rgyal po khrus byas shing zan zos nas gtam dag byas te yud tsam zhig bsdad nas smras pa/ ming chen bu mo 'di khyod kyi cir 'ong /lha mngag gzhug yibagyid pa'i bran mo lags so/ /'di khyod kyi mngag gzhug byed pa'i bran mo ma yin gyi/ 'di khyod kyi bu mo yin gyis byang la byin cig /10—191

des smras pa/ lha shākya'i bu mo gzhan ①'di bas ches rgyakhyad par ②'phags pa dag mchis na de dag bzhes su gsol/ 'di cir 'tshal/ rgyal pos smras pa/'di nyid nga la dgos kyisaX/ 'di nga la byin cig /des smras pa/ lha gal te de lta na tshul bzhin bgyis te dbul lo/ /de bzhin byos shig /de nas shākya ming chen gyis grong ༅khyer mdzes par byed du bcug ste/ bu mo de rgyan thams cad kyis bklubs nyanas glang po che la bskyon te lam po che dang / srang dang / lam gyi sum mdo dang / bzhi mdo dag tu grong khyer ser skya'i gnas na 'khod pa dang / yul sna tshogs nas lhags pa'i skye bo'i tshogs la shes ldan dag nyon cig shākya ming chen gyi bu mo phreng ldan ma ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi btsun mor phul lo zhes dril bsgrag pa ④byas so/ /de nas de ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi btsun mor phul ⑧bar skye bo phal po che rnams kyis kyang shes so/ /de nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis dpal gyi 'byor pa chen pos blangs nas mnyan yod du khrid pa dang / de'i mas bdag gi bus bran mo chung mar blangs so zhes thos te/ de kun nas dkris pa skyes nas ⑨bsams pa/ 'di ni nges par pha de'i bu ma yin pa'am/ bdag gi khong du don med pa zhig bsrel te/'di ltar bran mo'i khyor ⑩skyes par gyur to snyam yinas/ de yang sems khong du chud cing 'dug pa dang / rgyal pos kyang phreng ldan ma la smras paX/ phreng ldan ma song la sgyug tsomo'i zhabs la phyag byos shig /de song ste de'i rkang pa gnyis la bzung ba dang / de reg bya dang ldan pa yin pas des reg pa tsam gyis de gnyid log ste sad nas bsams pa/ bu zan ma'i bu mo 'di'i reg ④pa 'di 'dra bas ko sa la'i rigs 'di rgyas par 'gyur ro snyam mo/ / de'i tshe ko byas 10—192

la'i rgyal po gsal ①rgyal la btsun mo dam pa rgyal rigs dbyar tshul ma dang /phreng ldan ma gnyis yod de/ gang gi tshe rgyal po phreng ldan ma dang thabs cig tu ②bzhugs ③pa de'i tshe/ phreng ldan ma rgyal rigs dbyar tshul ma ni 'di lta bur yang gzugs bzang ngo zhes dbyar tshul ma'i bsngags pa brjod pa dang / des smras pa/ lha de bdag gis nam zhig na mthong bar 'gyur lags/ rgyal pos smras pa/ ma rings shig dang ring po mi thogs par mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de re ba dang bcas pas 'dug go/ /gang gi tshe rgyal rigs dbyar tshul ma dang thabs cig tu ④'dug pa de'i tshe yang dbyar 0tshul ma phreng ldan ma ni de lta bu'i reg bya dang yang ldan pa yin no zhes phreng ldan ma'i bsngags pa brjod pa dang /des smras pa lha de bdag gis nam zhig na mthong bar 'gyur lags/ rgyal pos smras pa/ ma rings shig dang ring por ⑥mi thogs par mthong bar ⑦'gyur ro/ /de dag rgyal pos ji lta ji ltar ya mtshan bskyed pa de lta ⑧de ltar phan tshun mthong bar spro bar gyur to0/ /ji tsam dus gzhan yi zhig na so yiga'i dus la bab ste/nags tshal na shing rnams me tog rgyas par gyur cing ngang pa dang / khrung khrung dang / rma bya dang / ne tso tsu)dang / ri skegs dang / khu byug dang /shang shang te'u sgra 'byin pa'i skyed mos tshal gyi gnas su rgyal po btsun mo'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor cing gshegs so/ /bud med ni me tog dang 'bras bu la dga' ba yin pas skyed mos tshal de dang de dag tu 'khyam 0par brtsams pa dang /rgyal rigs dbyar tshul ma ngal bas skyo zhing snyom par gyur nas shing mya ngan 'tshang la snyes ④te 'dug pa dang / ji tsam na phreng tsoldan mas mthong ngo / /de de'i gzugs bzang ba ⑩mthong bas shing gi lha mo yin no snyam du rig nas/ med la 10—193

rkang pa la phyag byas pa dang / phreng ldan ma'i lag pas reg ma thag pa nyid du gnyid log par gyur to/ /ji tsam na rgyal pos dbyar tshul ma la phreng ldan ma'i bsngags pa brjod par brtsams pa dang / des smras pa/ lha de bdag gis ①nam zhig na mthong bar 'gyur lagasal/ rgyal pos smras pa/ de khyed kyis ③mthong ngo ④/ /lha bdag mi ②dran no/ /ngas khyod dran par bya'o/ /legs so//gang gis ⑥lag pa gnyis kyis khyod kyi rkang pa la bzung ba de dran nam/ lha de lha mo phreng ldan ma lags sam/ de yin no/ /lha gang khyod reg bya dang ldan pa'i btsun mo de lta bu spangs te/ bdag gi drung ⑦du gshegs pa de ni khyod bdag la nges par byams shing thugs gcugs ⑤pa lags so/ /de bzhin du phreng ldan ma la dbyar tshul ⑨ma ni 'di lta bu yin no zhes bsngags pa brjod par brtsams pa dang / des smras pa/ lha bdag gis nam zhig na mthong bar 'gyur lags/ rgyal pos smras pa/ de khyod kyis mthong ngo / /lha bdag mi dran no/ /ngas khyod dran par bya'o/ /legs so/ /khyod kyis shing mya ngan 'tshang la snyes 0te 'dug pa gang la phyag byas pa de dran nam/ lha ci de dbyar tshul ma lags sam/ de yin no/ /lha gang khyod kyis btsun mo gzugs bzang ba de lta bu spangs te bdag gi drung du gshegs pa de ni khyod nges par bdag la byams shing thugs gcugs 0pa lags so/ /skabs der ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la tsobatsun mo dam pa rgyal rigs dbyar tshul ma dang / phreng ldan ma gnyis yod de/ de dag las gcig ④ni gzugs bzang ba rnams kyi mchog yin la / cig shos ni reg bya dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog yin no zhes phyogs su sgra 8grags pa dang / dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas/ the tshom thams cad 18—194

gcod ①par mdzad pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun mo phreng ldan ma dang / dbyar tshul mas las ci zhig bgyis na/ las de'i rnam par smin pas gcig ni ②reg bya dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog tu gyur la/ cig shos ni gzugs bzang ba rnams kyi mchog tu gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de dag nyid kyis las tshogs rnyed pa/ rkyen yongs su bsgyur ba/ 'od pa bzhin du nye bar gnas pa gdon mi za bar 'byung bar 'gyur ba dag byas shing bsags pas de dag nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa dag gzhan ①su zhig gis so sor myong bar 'gyur/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa dag ni sa'i khams la rnam ④par smin par mi 'gyur/chu'i khams la ma yin/ me'i khams la ma yin/ rlung gi khams la ma yin gyi②/'on kyang las dge ba dang / mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa dag ni zin pa'i phung ༅po dang / khams dang / skye mched dag la rnam par smin par 'gyur te/ bskal pa brgya phrag rnams su yang / /las rnams chud zar mi 'gyur te/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /lus can rnams la 'bras bur smin / /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na ri brags shig ⑦na bram ze zhig 'dug pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs te ⑧de de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed de/ de rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyad ⑨pas bu khye'u zhig btsas so//yang rtse ⑩bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las bu mo zhig btsas te/ de dag bsrings shing ⑩bskyed nas chen por gyur to/ /ji tsam dus gzhan rkyezhig na bram ze de chung ma dang bcas te shi nas bram ze'i khye'u 10—195

de pha ma dang bral bas dben pa la dga' bar gyur te/ de ⑨sring mo de khrid de dgon pa'i gnas su song nas 'khod de/ der de dag rtsa ba dang / sdong bu dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu dag gis 'tsho bar brtsams so bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' 475 pa/ dge slong dag sbrul nag po la ni nyes dmigs rnam pa lnga yod de/ lnga gang zhe na/ khro ba dang / khon ②du 'dzin pa dang /'khu ba dang / byas pa mi gzo ③ba dang / dug rno ba'o/ /zade bzhin du bud ④med kha cig la yang nyes dmigs rnam pa lnga yod de/ lnga gang zhe na/ khro ba dang / khon 0du 'dzin pa dang / 'khu ba dang / byas pa mi gzo 0ba dang / dug rno ba'o/ /phrodage slong dag de la bud med kyi dug rno ba ni 'di yin te/ 'di ltar bud med ni phal cher 'dod chags lhag par che ba'o/ /de'i sring mo de nyon mongs pa dag gis gdungs ⑧nas/ des smras pa/ ming po bdag dgon pa'i rtsa ba dang / sdong bu dang / me tog dang / 'bras bus 'tsho ba'i rngo mi thog gis 0grong mthar bzhud do/ /des ⑩de khrid de grong mthar song ste/ de bram ze zhig gi ⑩der slong tsomo la zhugs so/ /des sring mo dang lhan cig slong tsomo'i phyir cig car sgra phyung ba bram zes thos nas ④phyir phyung nas smras pa/ drang srong dag kyang chung ma dang bcas te rgyu'am/ des smras pa/ 'di bdag 8gi chung ma ma yin gyi sring mo'o/ /'di su la byin/ su la yang ma byin no/ /gal te de lta na kho bo la ci'i phyir mi byin / 'di ni dam pa ma yin pa sdig pa'i chos de spangs pa yin no/ /de 'dod pa'i 'dod chags kyis gdungs pas smras pa/ ming po ci bdag dgon pa'i rtsa ba dang / sdong bu dang / lo ma dang / 0me tog dang / 'bras bus 'tsho ba'i tsorngo mi thog ⑩pa 10—196

med snyam mamanyu/ bdag gis ni nyon mongs pa spang rngo ma thog ②pa'i slad du khyod la 'di ①skad bgyis kyisaX/ bdag bram ze 'di la stsol cig /des smras pa / de ni 0chos dang 'gal bas ngas khyod sbyin par mi bya'i khyod nyid shes par zad do/ /⑥byam ze des de dang de'i bsam pa shes pa ⑦nas 'byor pa'i dpal chen pos de bag mar blangs te/ rang gi khyim du bcug go/ /de nas de'i ⑧ming po de la smras pa/ ming po tshur spyon khyod kyi 0khab dbub par mdzod cig dang thabs cig tu ⑩bzhugs so/ /des smras pa/ sring mo kho bo ni 'dod pa don du mi gnyer te/ khyod kyis yiganang na rab tu 'byung ngo / /des smras pa/ dam zhig bca' ste/ gal te khyod skabs skabs su bdag gzigs ⑫shing byon na gnang bar bgyi'o/ /des smras pa/ legs te de bzhin bya'o/ /de des gnang nas drang srong rnams kyi nang du rab tu byung ngo / /de dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa yin pas des slob dpon med par byang chub kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i chos sum bcu rtsa bdun mngon du byas te rang byang chub mngon sum du byas nas des bsams pa/ bdag gis sring mo de la 'ong ngo zhes dam bcas pas de'i phyir de'i gan du 'gro bar bya'o snyam nas/ de de'i gan du song ngo / /song nas 'bar ba dang / gsal ba dang / char 'bab pa dang / glog ⑫'byung ba'i cho 'phrul dag bya bar brtsams pa dang / so so'i skye bo dag ni rdzu 'phrul la myur du dad pa yin pas de shing drungs tsonas bcad pa bzhin du rkang pa la phyag 'tshal te smras pa/ ming po khyod kyis yon tan gyi khyad par 'di lta bu thob bam/ thob bo/ /gal te de lta na khyod ni bsod tsosnyoms don du gnyer ba lags/ bdag kyang bsod nams ⑩don du gnyer ba lags pas de'i slad du 10—197

'di nyid du bzhugs shig dang / khyod la bdag gis bsod ①snyoms dbul bar bgyi'o / /des smras pa/ sring mo khyod ni gzhan rgyal rag las pa yin gyis③/khyim thab la je dris 0shig /legs te de bzhin bgyi'o/ /des khyim thab ⑤la smras pa/ rje'i sras bdag gi ming po rab tu byung ba brtul duzhugs grub pa bdag nyid chen por gyur te/ gal te khyod kyis gnang na bdag gis zla ba gsum du bsod snyoms la spyan drang ngo / /des smras pa/ bzang mo gal te 'di rab tu byung bar ⑦ma gyur na bdag cag gis mi 'dod bzhin gso dgos par 'gyur na/ da ⑧rab tu byung ste brtul zhugs grub pa bdag nyid chen por gyur na lta smos kyang ci dgos/ song la spyan drongs shig /des de zla ba gsum du bsod 0snyoms la spyan drangs so/ /bram ze de'i chung ma gnyis pa gzhan zhig yod pa des 0bsams pa/ bdag cag longs spyod thun mong skyelas 'di ni bsod nams 'di lta bu byed na bdag gi 8ci'i phyir mi bya snyam du rig nas de la smras pa/ phu nu mo khyod kyi dral tsogang lags pa de bdag gi ④ming po yang de kho na lags pas rkyud kyi tsogadugs gcig bshos ⑩gsol la/ bdag gis kyang gdugs gcig bshos tshugasol bar bgyi'o/ /des smras pa/ legs te/ de bzhin bgyi'o/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi sring mo de de'i sems bsrung ba'i phyir zas bsod pa reg bya phun sum tshogs pa zas dman pas g.yogs te de la bstan ⑫nas phu nu mo khyod rjes su yi rang bar yirgyas shig /bdag gi ming po la zhal duzas 'di lta bu gsol lo/ /des smras pa/ legs so/ /rjes su yi rang ngo de yang de'i sems bsrung ba'i phyir zas dman pa bsod pa dag gis g.yogs te de la bstan nas/ phu nu mo khyod kyang rjes su yi rang ba ⑥gyis shig /bdag kyang 10—198

dral la zhal zas bsod pa kha dog phun sum tshogs pa 'di lta bu gsol lo/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sring mo gang yin pa des rang sangs rgyas la reg bya phun sum tshogs pa zas dman pas bkab ste 'bul ①ba gang yin pa de ni lha mo phreng ldan ma 'di nyid yin te/ de'i tshe de'i dus na 'dis gang ②rang sangs rgyas la reg bya phun sum tshogs pa zas dman pas bkab ste / phul ba'i las de'i rnam par smin pas tshe rabs lnga brgyar reg bya dang ldan par gyur te/ da'i ②bar du yang reg bya dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog tu gyur to/ /cig shos gang yin pa des rang sangs rgyas la zas dman pa kha dog phun sum tshogs pas bkab ste phul ba gang yin pa de ni rgyal rigs dbyar tshul ma 'di nyid ④yin te/ de'i tshe de'i dus na gang 'dis rang dusangs rgyas la ⑨zas dman pa kha dog phun sum tshogs pas bkab ste phul ba'i las de'i rnam par smin pas tshe rabs lnga brgyar gzugs bzang bar gyur te/ da'i ⑦bar du yang gzugs bzang ba rnams kyi mchog tu gyur to⑤/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na las gcig tu gnag ⑨pa rnams kyi rnam par smin pa ni 0gcig tu gnag 0pa yin la zhes bya ba nas/ dge slong dag 'di ltar bslab par bya'o zhes bya ba'i bar ④snga ma bzhin no/ /dus gzhan 8zhig na lha mo phreng ldan ma ④sems can zhugs par gyur to/ /nyi ma gang la sems can zhugs par gyur pa de nyid kyi nyi ma la bram ze mdun na 8'don gyi chung ma la yang sems can zhugs par gyur te/nyi ma gang la sems can zhugs par gyur pa de nyid kyi nyi ma nas sdug bsngal gyis ⑫nyen to/ /ji tsam na lha mo phreng ldan ma zla ba dgu lon nas khye'u gzugs bzang ba ⑩blta na sdug pa mdzes pa zhig btsas 8so/ /de'i btsas ⑩pa'i btsas ston rgya kya10—199

cher byas nas/ khye'u 'di'i ming cir gdags zhes ming 'dogs par byed pa na/rgyal pos smras pa/ song la 'di phyi mo la phul cig dang / de nyid ming 'dogs par 'gyur ro/ /blon po rnams kyis ①de khyer te de'i gan du dong nas smras pa/ lha mo lha'i zhal nas gzhon nu'i ming gdags su gsol zhes byung ngo ②//des smras pa/ shes ldan dag ngas dang po nyid nas bu zan ma'i bu mo 'dis ko sa la'i rigs 'di rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes ma smras sam/ blon po dag gis smras pa/ de'i don 'tshal te/ lha mos 'di ma bltam ③pa nyid nas 'phags skyes po zhes kun du spyad pas de'i slad du gzhon ④nu'i mtshan 'phags skyes po zhes gdags so zhes de'i ming 'phags skyes po zhes bya bar btags so/ /gang gi nyin par gzhon ⑤nu 'phags skyes po btsas pa de nyid kyi nyi ma la mdun na 'don gyi bu btsas nas/ de'i nye du dag kyang 'ongs shing 'dus nas zhag bdun gsum nyi shu gcig tu btsas 0pa'i btsas ston rgya cher byas nas khye'u 'di'i ming cir gdags zhes ming 'dogs par byed pa na/ de na kha cig gis smras pa/'di gang gi nyi ma la ma'i ⑦mngal du zhugs pa de'i nyin mo nyid nas ma sdug bsngal gyis nyen cing / skyes nas kyang sdug bsngal ba kho na yin pas de'i phyir khye'u'i ⑧ming ma la gnod ces gdags so zhes de'i ming ma la gnod ces bya bar btags so / /gzhin nu 'phags skyes po ma ma brgyad po nu ma snun ⑨pa'i ma ma gnyis dang / pang tshun 'tsho ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / dri ma 'phyi ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / rtsen ⑩grogs kyi ma ma gnyis la gtad de/ ma ma brgyad po de dag gis ⑫'o ma dang / zho dang / mar dang / zhun mar dang mar gyi snying khu dang /gzhan ⑩yang yo byad kyi khyad 8par gtso bo gtso bo byadag gis rdzing na gnas pa'i 18—200

pad ma bzhin du bsrings ①shing bskyed ②do/ /gang gi tshe de chen por gyur pa de'i tshe yi ge bslabs te③/ yi ge mthar phyin nas brtag ①pa brgyad po 'di lta ste / rin po che brtag ⑤pa dang / shing dubartag pa dang / gzhi brtag pa dang / gos brtag pa dang / glang po che brtag pa dang / rta brtag ⑦pa dang /bud med brtag ⑧pa dang / skyes pa brtag pa dag ⑨la mkhas par gyur cing /dbye ba dang / bklag ⑩pa la mkhas shing spyod 0pa gsal ba/ rnam pa thams cad kyi tshul la mkhas te/ de rgyal po 8rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba/yul gyi dbang phyug mthu dang / brtson 'grus thob pa sa'i dkyil 'khor chen po cham 'du phab ste/ gnas pa rnams kyi bzo'i gnas dang las kyi gnas gang dag yin pa 'di lta ste/ glang po che'i gnyar bzhin ④pa dang / rta la bzhon ⑫pa dang / shing rta'i thabs dang / ral gri'i thabs dang / gzhu gzung ⑩ba dang / mdun du bsdur ba dang / phyir bsdur ba dang / lcags kyus sgyur ⑩thabs dang / zhags pa gdab pa dang / mda' bo che'i 'phen thabs dang /'dzin stangs dang / gom stabs phyedang / thor tshugs yidang / rgyang nas phog pa dang / sgra grag 0par phog pa dang / gnad du phog pa dang / mi 'chor bar ༷phog pa dang / tshabs che ba dang / dral dub dang / dbug pa dang / gcad 3pa'i gnas lnga po dag la mkhas par gyur to/ /khye'u cham la gnod kyang ma ma brgyad po dag la gtad de ⑥zhes bya ba nas rdzing na gnas pa'i pad ma bzhin du zhes bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin no/ /de gang gi tshe chen por gyur pa 0de'i tshe yi ge bslabs te⑦/ bram ze'i lta ba tsodang / spyod lam dang /tshul dang / gtsang 0sbra dang / spyod tshul dang / ril ba gzung zhub dang /10—201

sa blang ba dang / thal ba blang ba dang / oṃ ①zhes bya ba dang / bho zhes bya ba ②dang / nges brjod kyi rig byed dang / mchod sbyin gyi rig byed dang / snyan tshig gi rig ①byed dang / srid srung gi rig byed dang / drang srong ga durgas byas 0pa dang / mā tha ༷ras byas pa dang / sa g.yo ba'i dpyad dang /bar snang gi dpyad dang / bram ze'i las kyi mtha' drug po ⑦mchod sbyin byed pa dang / mchod sbyin byed du 'jug pa dang / klog pa dang / klog tu 'jug pa dang / sbyin pa dang / len pa dag la mkhas par gyur to/ /ji tsam dus gzhan ⑤zhig na 'phags skyes po dang / ma la gnod lhan cig ri dgas bshor ba'i phyir dong ba dang / de rtas kha khyer te ser skya'i gnas su phyin nas de dang de dag na 'khyam 0zhing ser skya na gnas pa'i shākya rnams kyi skyed mos tshal du song ngo / /skyed mol tshal srung ba'i mis ser skya na gnas pa'i shākya ⑩rnams la smras pa/shes ldan dag 'phags skyes po rtas kha khyer te khyed ⑩kyi skyed mos tshal du 'ongs so//de rnams mi bzod pa skyes nas smras pa/ shes ldan dag gal te de lta na dus la bab pa 'di yin gyis 8'dong de bsad ⑫ do/ /de bzhin bya'o zhes de rnams go bgos te dong ba dang / shākya 8rgan rabs rnams kyis mthong nas de dag gis ⑫smras pa/ gzhon nu (9dag gar 'dong (spre/ de rnams kyis 4)smras pa/'phags skyes po bdag cag gi skyed mos tshal du mchis yite/ de 'gums su mchi'ocha / /shākya rgan rabs rnams kyis smras pa/ gzhon nu dag de glo bur pa yin pas de'i nyes pa 'ga' bzod pa gyis la phyir log shig⑥ /de rnams phyir log pa dang / ji 3tsam na 'phags skyes po'i 'dapung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pas gcig nas gcig tu thos nas tshol zhing skyed mos tshal du 'ongs nas 18—202

dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pas skyed mos tshal kun nas khyab par gyur pa dang /skyed mos tshal srung ba'i mis ser skya na gnas pa'i shākya rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag 'phags skyes po'i dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa rnams skyed mos tshal du lhags te/ glang po che dang / rta'i mi gtsang ①ba dag gis skyed mos tshal thams cad ma rung bar byas so/ /de rnams shin tu mi bzod pa skyes nas shākya rgan po'i tshig bcag ste 'phags skyes po gsad ②pa'i phyir dong ba dang /'phags skyes pos 'di ltar ser skya na gnas pa'i shākya rnams bdag gsod du 'ong ngo zhes thos nas/ des mi zhig bzhag ①ste smras pa/ kye skyes bu nga ①gud du 'gros⑤/ khyod kyi ⑥ser skya na gnas pa'i shākya rnams ci zer ba de nga la zlos shig /ser skya na gnas pa'i shākya rnams skyed mos tshal du 'ongs pa na 'phags skyes po mi snang nas/ de rnams kyi ⑦mi de la bran mo'i bu de gar song zhes dris ⑧pa dang / des smras pa/ bros te mchis so/ /de dag las kha cig gis smras pa / de gal te bdag cag gis mthong bar gyur na/ bdag cag gis de'i lag pa bcad ⑨par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan ⑩dag gis smras pa/ gal te bros par yim gyur na/ de kho bo cag gis rkang pa bcad 8par 'gyur ro/ /kha cig gis smras patso/ kho bo cag gis ni thams cad kyi thams cad du srog dang phral ⑫bar 'gyur ba zhig na/ gal te bros na da 'ji ltar bya/ de dag gi 8gla mi rnams la bsgo ba/ skyed mos tshal phyag dar byos la bran mo'i bus phyogs gang du bcag ⑦pa'i phyogs de'i sa tsodag 'or la sa gzhan ⑥gyis khong ① shig /cig pa'i phyogs gang la brten pa de dag kyang zhal zhal khogs la gzhan ⑥gyis yugs shig /'o ma'i chus chag chag thob la spos chus thor te ⑤/ dri dang me tog la sogs pas 10—203

kyang shin tu phun sum tshogs par byos shig /des de bzhin du byas so/ /de nas mi des ji ltar gyur pa dag mthong nas 'phags skyes po'i gan du song ste rkang pa gnyis la phyag 'tshal nas mtha' gcig tu 'dug go/ /'phags skyes pos smras pa/ kwa'e ②skyes bu ser skye tshon gnas pa'i shākya rnams ci zer/ lha ji skad mchi ba lha la gsol ba'i rngo mi thog stergya/ de ni de dag nyid la gyur cig /kwa'e ③skyes bu de yang shes pa tsam du byas ⑤spros shig /des de dus kyis ⑤'chu bar rtogs nas rgyas par bsnyad pa dang ⑥/ des nang mi rnams la smras pa/shes ldan dag gang gi tshe nga yab 'das te rgyal por gyur pa de'i tshe ngas de dag srog dang dbral ⑦ba gang yin pa de kho na thog mar bya dgos kyis/ khyed ⑤kyis ji ltar gyur pa 'di thams cad skul 0cig dang / ngas ser skya na gnas pa'i shākya rnams kha gdag 4)go/ /de rnams kyis 0kyang khas blangs so/ /ma la gnod kyis smras pa/ legs so legs so/ /lha khyod kyis kyang tsode ni gdon ⑫mi 'tshal bar bgyi bya'atshal te/ dge ba rnams ni dam bcas 8pa la brtan pa lags so/ /des smras pa/ nga dus ji tsam zhig na rgyal por 'gyur ba de mi shes so/ /ma la gnod kyis smras pa/ de ltar ma dgongs shig /rgyal po bgres skyepo ni ring por 0mi thogs par lha nyid du gshegs pas khyod nyid rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /'dod pa bsten 8pas ni sdig pa'i las mi ⑩bya ba ci yang med pas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la blon po lnga brgya yod pa las 'phags skyes po ⑥blon po rnams dang dbye bar brtsams pa dang / spyod pa'i bu ring po ma gtogs pa ⑥thams cad kha phyin to/ /blon po'i mchog de ni rje bo la snying nye 9ba yin pas kha ma phyin to/ /ji tsam dus gzhan 3zhig na spyod pa'i bu ring po bya ba zhig 10—204
