gi phyir 'phags skyes po'i gan du song ba dang / 'phags skyes pos rgyal po gsal rgyal gsad ①pa'i sbyor bas spyod pa'i ③bu ring po la ser skya na chaganas pa'i shākye rnams la ngas sha glan par bya na/ nga nam rgyal por 'gyur ba smros dushig /des smras pa/ lha ci'i slad du bsod ⑤nams ma lags pa skyed par mdzad/rgyal po bgres po ni ring por ⑥mi thogs par lha nyid du gshegs te rgyal por gzhan ⑦mi 'gyur gyi khyod nyid 'gyur ro/ /spyod pa'i bu ring po de ni ngas bgam par khyod kho na la smras kyini/ khyod kyis su la yang smra bar mi bya'o/ /lha bdag gis ma 'tshal tam ci/ su la yang ji ltar brjod par bgyi zhes smras te song ngo //de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das shākya rnams kyi nang na shākya rnams kyi 0grong rdal me tsu ru di ⑩zhes bya ba na bzhugs te/ de nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal bzhon pa bzang po la zhon te kha lo sgyur ⑩ba spyod pa'i bu ring po dang / ljongs rgyu zhing 'gro ba na grong khyer zhig tu phyin nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis dgon pa'i nags 'dab 8bas mtha'i gnas mal dben pa skye bo sdig can dang bral ba mi chig rkya thub 8pas so sor bsten pa nang du yang dag 'jog dang mthun pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas yang spyod pa'i bu ring po la smras pa/ spyod pa'i bu ring po bcom ldan 'das de dgon pa nags 'dab 8bas mtha'i gnas mal dben tunyepa skye bo sdig 8can rnams dang bral ba mi cig rkya 0thub pas so sor bsten pa nang du yang dag 'jog dang mthun pa 'di lta bu na bzhugs te/der ngas bcom ldan 'das de la re tso'aga' bsnyen bkur byas na ring po bcom ldan 'das da ltar gang na bzhugs/ ji ga khyod kyis thos sam/ lha bdag gis ⑩thos te bcom ldan 'das ni shākya rnams kyi nang na 0shākya rnams kyi grong 18—205

rdal me tsu ru di ①zhes bgyi ba na bzhugs so/ /ring po shākya rnams kyi grong rdal me tsu ru di ②zhes bya bar thag ji srid yod/ lha rgyang grags gsum lhag tsam mchis so/ /des ring po shākya rnams kyi grong rdal me tsu ru di rgyag la ba ④der shing rta drongs ⑤sheg /lha de bzhin 'tshal lo zhes spyod pa'i bu ring pos ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi ltar mnyan nas/ shākya rnams kyi grong rdal me tsu ru di ga la ba ⑥der shing rta khrid de bzhon pas 'gro ba'i sa ji srid pa de ⑦ji lasrid du zhon te song nas bzhon pa las babs te rkang pas kun dga'i ⑨ra bar zhugs tshuso//de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das gtsug lag khang chen po sgo bcad pa zhig na nyin mo gnas pas bzhugs so/ /dge slong mang po rnams ni gtsug lag khang gi phyi rol bla gab med pa'i 'chag sa na ⑩'chag par byed pa ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis tsomathong ngo / /dge slong mang po dag thag ring po nyid nas mthong nas kyang dge slong mang po dag ga la ba der song ste phyin nas dge slong mang po dag la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun tshupa dag bcom ldan 'das ga la bzhugs/ rgyal po chen po bcom ldan 'das ni gtsug lag khang chen po chab sgo bkum pa 'di na ⑫nyin mo gnas pas bzhugs te/ rgyal po chen po khyod tsobazhed na gtsug lag khang chen po sgo bkum pa ga la ba 8der ⑩bzhud de/ der byon pa dang khad kyis dal bu tsodal bus sgo glegs la rdungs shig dang / bcom ldan 'das chab sgo 'byed par 'gyur ro/ /de nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi yirgyal po'i rtags lnga po gtsug tor dang / gdugs dang / ral gri dang / rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can dang / lham ⑩khya bo dag phud de/ spyod ⑥pa'i bu ring po la byin nas kha phyir lta'o/ /de nas spyod pa'i bu ring po 'di snyam du sems te/10—206

lhas rgyal po'i rtags lnga po gtsug tor dang / gdugs dang / ral gri dang /rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can dang / lham khra bo dag bdag la bzhag ①ste/ zhal phyir gzigs pa las na/ lha ni phrin ②las gsang ba zhig mdzad par bzhed pas bdag 'di nyid du 'dug par bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gtsug lag khang chen po sgo bcad ②pa ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/khad kyis ④dal bu dal bus sgo glegs ⑤la brdabs pa dang / de la bcom ldan 'das kyis ༅sgo phye'o/ /de nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi ①zhabs gnyis la mgo bos ⑤phyag 'tshal te/ gdong dang kha phyis nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis ring mo zhig lags nas mthong ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa bdag gis ring mo zhig lags nas mthong ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑨ka sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rgyal po chen po khyod ci'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa la shin tu dman pa bas kyang ches dman pa byed/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag la chos las byung ba'i dad pa mchis te/ des na bdag 'di snyam du bcom ldan 'das ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas so/ /khyod kyi chos 'dul ba ni legs par gsungs pa'o/ /nyan thos kyi dge 'dun ni legs par zhugs pa'o snyam mo/ /rgyal po chen po khyod nga la chos las byung ba'i dad ⑩pa ji lta bu zhig yod/ btsun pa bdag gis 'di na dge sbyong dang bram ze mkhas pa mkhas pa'i nga rgyal can ⑩smra ba dang / phas kyi rgol (spreb la goms 0par bgyis pa/ skye bo phal po che la byis pa'i dang yas 8'bigs pa'i ngo bor bkur 10—207

ba kha cig mthong ste/ de dag rang gi shes rab dang spobs pas gzhan gyi lta ba'i rnam pa 'dren ma'i ngo bo dag 'jig cing de dag zhu ba rtsom ①par bgyid de/bdag cag shes ldan go ta ma de'i drung du dong la dri ba 'di dang 'di lta bu dag dri ste/ gal te lung ston par mi byed na ni brtsad par bya'o/ /gal te 'di lta bu dang 'di lta bu yin no/ /zhes lung ston par byas rgyan/ de lta na ③de la 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ kye gi ta ma khyod kyi 'di ni mi rigs so/ /'di ni mi 'dra'o/ /'di ni mi 'thad do/ /zhes brjod par bya'o/ /zhes de rnams kyis zhu ba de dag bsdogs nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bab par mchis pa'i rngo yang ma thog dun smra bar lta ga la rngo thog ste/ btsun ⑤pa bdag bcom ldan 'das la chos las byung ba'i dad pa de lta bu mchis te/ des na rjobadag 'di snyam du bcom ldan 'das ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lags/ khyod kyi ①chos 'dul ba ni legs par gsungs pa lags/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun ni legs par zhugs pa lags so snyam bgyid do/ /btsun pa bdag la bcom ldan 'das la chos las byung ba'i dad pa gzhan yang mchis te/ btsun pa 'di na ⑧bdag gis dge sbyong dang /bram ze mkhas pa mkhas pa'i nga rgyal can zhes bya ba nas/ kha cig mthong ste zhes bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin no/ /de rnams kyis zhus pa ⑨de dag bsdogs nas/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der mchis te phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 0zhu ba zhu ba'i rngo mi thog gi⑩/ gzhan du na bcom ldan 'das kho na'i zhal du lta ba dang / zhal du rtog par bgyid cing / bcom ldan 'das gi ta ma 'di kho nas shes par ()bya ba tho)mkhyen to/ /gzigs par bya ba gzigs so snyam ste/18—208

btsun pa 'di yang bdag bcom ldan 'das la chos las byung ba'i dad pa lags te / zhes bya ①ba snga ma bzhin no/ /btsun pa bdag la chos las byung ba'i dad pa gzhan ②yang mchis te/ btsun pa 'di na bdag gis dge sbyong dang /bram ze mkhas pa mkhas pa'i nga rgyal can zhes bya ba nas kha cig mthong ste zhes bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin no/ /des zhu ba de dag bsngogs nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der mchis te phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la zhu ba yongs su ma rdzogs par zhus pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis de dag la zhu ba yongs su ma rdzogs par zhus bzhin yongs su rdzogs par lung bstan pa dang / de dag zhu ba lung bstan pa de yi charangs shing mgu nas sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi zhing bslab pa'i gnas dag kyang len pa rjobagyid de/ btsun pa 'di yang bdag bcom ldan 'das la chos las byung ba'i dad pa lags so zhes bya ba'i ⑤bar snga ma bzhin yino/ /btsun pa bdag la bcom ldan 'das la chos las byung ba'i dad pa gzhan yang mchis te/ 'di na bdag gis bram ze dang khyim bdag mkhas pa mkhas pa'i nga rgyal can zhes bya ba nas / kha cig mthong zhes bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin no/ /de dag gis zhus pa ⑦de dag bsdogs nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der ⑧song ste phyin nas/ zhu ba rdzogs par zhus pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis de dag la chos yongs su rdzogs par lung bstan nas/ de dag lung bstan pa des yi ⑨rangs shing mgu nas bcom ldan 'das la rab tu byung ⑩ba dang / bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po gsol zhing / bcom ldan 'das kyis rab tu byung bar 0mdzad/bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad de/ rab tu byung ba tsobasnyen par rdzogs pa dgra 10—209

bcom pa nyid thob pa rnam par grol ba'i dga' ba dang bde ba nyams su myong ba de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag cag de'u ma rung ngo / /bdag cag rab tu de'u ma rung ngo / /bdag cag sngon ①dge sbyong ma yin bzhin du bdag cag dge sbyong ngo ③snyam du khas 'che 'chel/ bdag cag bram ze dang / dgra bcom pa ma yin bzhin du bdag cag dgra bcom pa'o snyam du khas 'che'i/ nga ni bdag cag dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / dgra bcom pa yin no ④snyam ste/btsun pa 'di yang bdag bcom ldan 'das la chos las byung ba'i dad pa lags te zhes bya ba snga ma bzhin no/ /btsun pa bdag la bcom ldan 'das la chos las byung ba'i dad pa gzhan ⑤yang mchis te/ btsun pa 'di la ⑥bdag gis dge sbyong dang bram ze skya bo ⑦bseng bseng lapo sha bri srab pa/ nyam chung ba mdog ngan pa/ dbang po nyams pa skye ⑨bo mang po'i mig gis bltar ⑩mi chags pa dag cig mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang bdag 'di snyam du sems te/ shes ldan 'di dag mi 'dod bzhin du tshangs par spyad pa yispyod pa'am/ nad yun ring po 'ga' zhig gis thebs tsosam/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i las 'ga' zhig lkog tu byas nas bcabs par ma gyur grang / 'di ltar shes ldan 'di dag skya bo bseng ④bseng po 8sha bri skyangan pa/ nyam chung ba dbang po nyams pa/ skye bo mang po'i mig gis bltar mi chags so snyam mo/ /de dag gi drung du mchis shing mchis nas 'di skad ces bgyis te/ shes ldan dag ci'i phyir skya bo bseng bseng po sha bri ngan pa/ nyam chung ba dbang po nyams pa/ skye bo mang po'i mig gis ⑩bltar mi chags par gyur/ de dag gi mchid nas rgyal po chen po 'dod 8chags kyis gnod do/ /btsun pa de la bdag 'di snyam du sems te 10—210

gal te 'dod pa rnams rnyed pa dang bsten pa dang bsags pas gzugs bzang ba'am blta na sdug pa'am/ mdzes pa zhig tu 'gyur na ni da lta ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal bdag ①gzugs ches bzang ba dang / ches blta rgyan sdug pa/ches mdzes par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal ③rgyal bdag ni 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga po rnams 'dod dgur rnyed 0pa dang /tshegs med par rnyed ⑤lags so/ /gang gi 0phyir 'dod pa rnams rnyed ⑦pa dang bsten pa dang bsags pas gzugs ches ⑧bzang ba dang / ches blta na sdug pal/ches mdzes par mi 'gyur ba de'i phyir bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi 0nyan thos kyi dge 'dun gzugs shin tu bzang ba/ dbang po rgyas pa/ bzhin gyi mdangs gsal ba/ pags yipa'i mdog yongs su dag pa/ sems khral chung ba / 'tsho ba gzhan kyil rag ma lus pa mthong ste/ des na ji srid 'tsho'i bar du tshangs par spyod pa ma 'dres ⑩pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ yongs su dag pa/ yongs su byang ba spyod par nus so snyam ste/ btsun pa 'di yang bdag bcom ldan 'das la chos las byung ba'i dad pa lags te zhes bya ba snga ma bzhin no/ /btsun pa bdag la bcom ldan 'das la chos chalas byung ba'i dad pa gzhan 8yang mchis te/ btsun pa 'di na bdag gis nor gyi 0slad du mchis pa rnams 'dod pa'i rgyu dang / 'dod pa'i gzhi dang 'dod pa'i ched kyi slad du ma ni bu dang lhan cig rtsod/ bu ni ma ⑩dang / pha ni bu dang / bu ni pha tsodang / ming po ni sring mo dang / sring mo ni ming po dang / grogs po ⑩ni grogs chadang rtsod pa dag mthong na skye bo dang skye bor lta smos kyang ci 'tshal de dag rtsod cing 'gyed 0par gyur pa na/ ma ni bu'i mi snyan pa smra/ bu ni ma'i/ pha 10—211

ni bu'i/ bu ni pha'i/ ming po ni sring mo'i/ sring mo ni ming po'i/ grogs ni grogs kyi mi snyan pa smra na/ skye bo skye ①bo'i lta smos kyang ci 'tshal yang 'di na bdag gis mthong ba/ dge slong gnyis shig dge slong dag dang lhan ②cig gzhi 'ga' zhig gi slad ③du rtsod nas bslab pa phul te babs par gyur na/de dag rnam grangs gang gis kyang sangs rgyas la mi snyan pa 0brjod pa'am/chos dang dge 'dun la mi snyan pa brjod 0par mi bgyid kyi/ gzhan ༷du na bdag nyid kho na la yongs su smod pas ⑦yongs su smod par ⑧bgyid de0/bdag cag gnyis ni 'di na dman pa dang ma rabs dang dpal med pa ste bdag cag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar ji srid 'tsho ba'i ⑩bar du tshangs par spyod pa/ ma 'dres pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ yongs su dag pa/ yongs su byang ba/ spyad par ma nus so ⑩zhes mchis teX/ btsun pa 'di yang bdag 'bacom ldan 'das la chos las byung ba'i dad pa lags so zhes bya ba snga ma bzhin no/ /btsun pa bdag la bcom ldan 'das la chos las byung ba'i dad pa gzhan ④yang mchis te/ btsun pa 'di na ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal bdag dgum par bgyi ba ma lags pa rnams kyang 'gums/ dgum skepar bgyi ba rnams ni gtong bar dbang na/ bdag don gyi ched du mchis pa la ⑩rgyal rigs rgya chen po shing sā tshul chen po lta tsobu dag dang / bram ze rgya chen po shing sā tshul chen po lta bu dag dang / khyim bdag rgya chen po shing sā cil chen po lta bu dag gtam mjug 0tu phyin pa la mi sdod par bar skabs bar skabs su bka' mchid mchi zhing / ma gus pa dang zhe sa ma mchis par smra bar bgyi bar sems lags so/ /btsun pa dus gcig cig na/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor brgya 10—212

phrag du ma'i gung la bzhugs shing / chos ston par mdzad pa de na lud pa'i sgra yang ①mi gda' sbrid pa'i sgra yang mi gda'o/ /de nas mi zhig gis lud pa'i sgra phyung ba dang / ci yang mi zhig gis mi de la 'di skad ces kye skyes bu khyod kha rog par 'dug /bcom ldan 'das sbrang ma'i sbrang ②rtsis tshim ③par mdzad pa lta bu'i chos snyan pa bas 0snyan pa ston par mdzad pa ma mthong ngam zhes smras lags sol/ /de skad ces bgyis ⑤pa dang / mi de cang mi mchis par rjomachis so/ /de la bdag 'di snyam bgyid de/ bcom ldan 'das ni de tsam du mthu che zhing /rdzu 'phrul che ba lags na/ 'di na da ltar chad pa med pa dang / mtshon cha med pa'i chos snyan ⑦pas 'khor btul ba ngo mtshar to snyam ste/ btsun pa 'di yang bdag bcom ldan 'das la chos las byung ba'i dad pa lags te zhes bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin no/ /btsun pa bdag la dubacom ldan 'das la chos las byung ba'i dad pa gzhan ⑨'di yang mchis te/ btsun pa 'di na bdag gis dge sbyong dang / bram ze kha cig mthong na nor med par bgyis te/ tshangs par spyad pa spyod pa las de ⑩zla ba dgu'am zla ba brgyad 'das pa dang / rnam pa de dag dang / rtags de dag dang mtshan ma de dag bor te/ phyir 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga po dag 'byor cing ldan par gyur cing rtse yibar bgyid/ dga' bar bgyid/ dga' mgur spyod par yang 8bgyid do/ /btsun pa 'di na bdag gis mthong ba bcom ldan 'das kyi 0nyan thos dag ji srid 'tsho'i bar du tshangs par spyod pa/ ma 'dres pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa8/ yongs su dag paX/yongs su byang ba spyod cing zhes bya ba nas/ srog gi mtha'i bar zhes bya ba dang /btsun pa 'di yang bdag tshubacom ldan 'das la chos las byung ba'i dad pa lags 10—213

so zhes bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin no// // 'dul ba phran tshegs kyi gzhi/① bam po brgyad pa/ btsun pa bdag la bcom ldan 'das la chos las byung ba'i dad pa gzhan ②'di yang mchis te/btsun pa 'di na ③bdag drang srong dusbyin pa dang / rnying pa dang / de dag la yid rton cing rjode dag la longs spyod rnams kyang stsol/ grags pa yang stsol ba nas / de dag gi srog gi bar yang stsol na/ de dag bcom ldan 'das la ji lta ba de ltar bdag la 0bgyi ba bgyid par mi sems te/ btsun pa dus gcig cig na bdag drang srong yid brtan pa sbyin pa dang / rnying pa dag brtag par 'tshal nas/ 'khor gyi nang nas byung ste phyogs dog ⑦pa zhig tu mchis nas/'di ltar 'di dag bcom ldan 'das dang bdag gang logs su rkang pa ston ⑧blta'o snyam na⑨/ de dag gis ⑩rnam grangs du mar sangs rgyas kyi bsngags pa ⑩brjod / chos dang dge 'dun gyi bsngags pa brjod nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de logs su ni mgo bstan/ bdag ga la ba de logs su ni rkang pa bstan to/ /de la bdag 'di snyam bgyid de⑩/ bcom ldan 'das ni de tsam du rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ste/ 'di na da ltar bdag 'di dag la longs spyod rnams kyang sbyin/ grags pa yang sbyin pa nas/ srog gi bar yang stsol na/'di dag bcom ldan 'das ji lta ba de ltar bdag la bya ba byed par mi sems pa ni ngo mtshar to snyam ste ⑩zhes bya ba nas/ btsun pa 'di yang bdag bcom ldan 'das la chos las byung ba'i dad pa ④lags tsoso zhes bya ba'i tsobar snga ma bzhin no//btsun pa bdag la chos las byung ba'i dad pa gzhan yang mchis te/ btsun pa bdag kyang yul ko sa la pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyang yul ⑦ko sa la pa 10—214

lagasal/ bdag gi rigs kyang rgyal rigs lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyi rigs kyang rgyal rigs lags/ bdag kyang rgas pa 'khogs ①pa②/ gtugs pa na tshod lo brgyad bcu lon pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyang bgres pa/'khogs pa/ gtugs pa/ sku na tshod lo ⑧brgyad bcu lon pa lags/btsun pa bdag kyang rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur rjob lags/bcom ldan 'das kyang bla na med pa'i chos kyi rgyal po lags pas/ btsun pa 'di yang bdag bcom ldan 'das la chos las byung ba'i dad pa lags te/des na bdag 'di snyam du bcom ldan 'das ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas so/ /khyod kyi chos 'dul ba ni legs par gsungs pa'o/ /nyan thos kyi dge 'dun ni legs par zhugs pa'o/ /snyam du sems lags so/ /de nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar chos sna tshogs rgya ②cher bshad nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal te song ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal song nas ring po ma lon par mkhyen nas/ dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyed ⑥kyis chos sna tshogs pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs zung ①shig /chongs shig /lhogs ⑧shig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/dge slong dag chos sna tshogs pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs ni don dang ldan pa/ chos dang ldan pa/ tshangs par spyod pa dang 0ldan pa ste/ mngon par shes par byed pa dang / rdzogs par byang chub par byed pa dang / mya ngan las 'das par byed pa yin no/ /de ⑩lta bas na rigs kyi bu dad pas rab tu byung bas chos sna tshogs pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs blangs te 0kun chub par byas nas de lta de 10—215

ltar gzung ①bar bya/ bcang bar bya/ bklag ②par bya'o/ /ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga na ③chos nyan pa la ring zhig thogs pa dang / spyod pa'i bu ring po yang cung zhig bsdad nas shing rtar zhugs te mnyan yod du song nas/ des 'phags skyes po rgyal srid la bzhag rjogo/ /phreng ldan ma dang / dbyar tshul mas spyod pa'i bu la dris pa/ spyod pa'i bu lha ga la bzhugs / grong rdal me tsu ru di dun bzhugs duso/ /de dag rtsirkang gis ⑧grong rdal me tsu ru dir ⑨chas so/ /ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal yang bcom ldan 'das las chos mnyan nas gtsug lag khang nas byung na spyod pa'i bu ring po mi snang nas/ des dge slong rnams la dris pa/ 'phags pa dag spyod byed kyi bu ring po gar mchis/ de dag gis smras pa/ de lha nang du gshegs ma thag tu shing rtar zhugs nas mchis so zhes byas pa dang / rgyal po rkang gis song ngo //bcom ldan 'das kyang ches snga ba zhig tu rgyal po'i khab 0tu gshegs so/ /ji tsam na rgyal pos lam kur tunyephreng ldan ma dang / dbyar tshul ma mthong nas/des de dag la dris pa/ khyed ci'i tsophyir rkang gis 'dir 'ongs/ de dag gis smras pa/ lha spyod pa'i bu ring pos 'phags skyes po rgyal srid la bzhag ⑩ste/de nas bdag cag lha'i gan du mchis mod/ bdag cag gzhan tsogar mchi/rgyal pos smras pa/ phreng ldan ma khyod kyis khyo'i rgyal srid nyams su myong zin gyis ⑫song la da bu'i rgyal srid nyams su myong bar gyis shig nga yang dbyar tshul ma dang lhan cig rgyal po'i khab tu 'gro'o ⑩zhes byas pa dang / 0phreng 8ldan ma yisnying rje rje skad du smre sngags 'don cing ngu bzhin phyir log go/ /ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal yang dbyar tshul ma dang lhan cig rgyal po'i khab tu chas te rim gyis 10—216

rgyal po'i khab tu phyin nas phan tshun 'khyam 'khyam ①pa las ma skyes dgra'i skyed mos tshal du 'dug ste/ des dbyar tshul ma la smras pa/ dbyar tshul ma song la rgyal po ma skyes dgra la ②ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal skyed mos tshal na 'dug go zhes gyis ⑧shig /des rgyal po ma skyes dgra la smras pa/ lha ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal khyod kyi skyed mos tshal na bzhugs 0te/ lha gzigs par bzhed do/ /des thos nas bsngangs ⑤te smras pa/ shes ldan dag rgyal po de dmag mang po can yin te / glo bur kho nar 'ongs na khyed sus kyang ma tshor ram/ dbyar tshul ⑦mas smras pa/ lha de la dmag ga la mchis/ bus rgyal srid las phyung nas de g.yog dang gnyis ⑧'dir mchis so/ /des smras pa/ de rgyal po byed pa legs te/ bdag ni gzhon nu'i gnas na gnas so zhes smras nas/ blon po rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag gang ngas rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba bkur snyi ⑨med par spyan drang ba ni nga la rigs pa ma yin par 'gyur bas deng tshul grong khyer mdzes pa dang / lam mdzes par gyis shig /de dag gis grong khyer de rdo ba yidang / gsog ma dang / gyo mo med par byas zhes bya ba nas/ lha rnams kyi skyed mos tshal dga' ba'i tshal bzhin du zhes pa'i ⑫bar snga ma bzhin no/ /de nas lam mdzes pa dang / grong khyer mdzes pa so sor khyad par du 'phags par byas nas/ dril bsgrags pa shes ldan rgyal po'i khab na gnas pa dang / pho brang 'khor ba dang / yul sna tshogs nas lhags pa'i ⑩skye bo'i tshogs dag nyon cig /ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal skyed mos tshal na 'dug gis/ de khyed ④lha dang lhan cig tu gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dag gis bsu bar bya'o/ /de nas rgyal po ma skyes skyedagra shing 10—217

rta stong phrag du ma phyi bzhin du khrid de/ dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa dang /ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal snar ①dong ngo / /de yang ma skyes dgra ring du thogs pas bru bas bskyed pa'i sdug bsngal bar gyur to/ /②skyed mos tshal dang ha cang yang mi ring ba zhig na la phug gi ra ba zhig yod pa der song ba dang /de la ldum pas la phug spar gang byin no/ /de nas des la phug gi rdog ma dang /lo ma dag zos ②pa dang / skom rab tu gyur nas rdzing drung du song ste chu ngoms par 'thungs ④nas langs pa dang / lag ⑤pa rengs shing ma zhu bas thebs ⑥nas shing rta'i lam du 'gyel ⑦ba dang / de 'khor lo'i ⑧dril ba'i rdul gyis lakha gang nas dus las 'das so/ /rgyal po ⑩ma skyes dgra skyed mos tshal du song ste phan tshun btsal bar bsams nas yim rnyed de'/ des phyogs bzhir pho nya rta pa bkye ste tshol cig ces byas pa dang / de na 'pho nya gcig ④la phug gi char bar phyin nas/ des tho)ldum pa de la dris pa/ kye skyes bu skyed mos tshal 'dir 'ongs pa 'ga' lta yod tshudam/ 'ongs so de gar song la phug 8spar gang khyer nas lam 'di nas rdzing 7bur song ngo / /de de'i rjes bzhin du song na shing rta'i lam na dus las 'das par mthong 0 ngo / /des rgyal po ma skyes dgra la smras pa/ lha shing rta'i lam ga ge mo zhig gi phyogs su dus las 'das so/ /rgyal pos kye ma kyi hud ces smras nas skye bo brgya stong du mas bskor te phyogs der song ba dang / ji tsam na shi ba'i ro shin tu mi sdug pa mthong nas yang blon po rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba 'di nga'i yul du dus las ( 〉'das pa nga la snyan pa ma yin par gyur gyis( spre/ khyed kyi 3'di bkur sti chachen pos bsil ba'i tsotshal gyi dur khrod du skyol cig /18—218

nga yang 'di'i khog pa la mchod pa lhag par bya ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das la zhu'o//de dag gis kyang de bkur sti ①chen pos bsil tshal gyi dur khrod chen por bskyal ②tol/ /rgyal po ma skyes dgra yang bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal ①rgyal bdag gi yul du dus las 'das na de'i khog pa la bdag gis ④mchod pa ji lta bu zhig bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po ci nus ci phod kyis lus la mchod pa 0cher gyis shig /de nas rgyal pos de'i khog pa la mchod pa chen po byas nas/ yang bcom ldan 'das kyi kyispyan sngar song ste bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal ⑦rgyal gyis las ci zhig bgyis na las de'i rnam par smin pas la phug gi rdog ma dang / lo ma dag 'tshal nas sug pa rengs shing ⑧ma zhu bas thebs te/ dus las 'das lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' 475 pa/ ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal 0rgyal nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa tshogs rnyed pa rkyen ⑩yongs su bsgyur ba/ dba' yirgal bzhin du nye bar gnas pa / gdon mi za bar 'byung ba dag gzhan tsos zhig gis myong bar 'gyur te/rgyal po chen po las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par 0smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams la ma yin/ me'i khams la ma yin/rlung gi khams la ma yin gyibya/ 'on kyang las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched dag kho na la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /bskal pa brgya phrag rnams su yang / /las rnams chud zar mi 'gyur te/ /tshogs shing dus dang ldan pa na/ /lus 10—219

can rnams ①la 'bras bur smin/ /rgyal po chen po sngon byung ba ri brags shig ②na bram ze zhig gnas pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas de ③de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed do/ /de rtse bar byed/ dga' bar ①byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las bu pho zhig btsas te/ ji tsam na bskyed bsrings nas chen por dugyur to/ /de rjodus gzhan gzhig na slong dumo la song ba dang / la phug spar gang zhig rnyed do/ /des ma la 'di re shig zhog shig 0khrus byas te 'ong ngo zhes btams 0so/ /des de la btams yinas khrus byed du song ngo / /sangs rgyas rnams ma byung ba'i tshe 'jig rten du rang sangs rgyas ngan pa dang dman pa la thugs brtse ba can/bas mtha'i gnas mal la dad pa/ 'jig rten gyi yon gnas gcig pu dag 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /ji tsam na rang sangs rgyas shig ljongs rgyu zhing 'gro ba na ri brags 8der phyir te/ de phyogs shig byatu zhag lon nas/ snga dro sham thabs (sredang chos gos bgos/ lhung bzed blangs te ri brags su bsod ⑫snyoms la zhugs pa dang / rim gyis khyim der phyin to/ /bram ze mo des de lus mdzes pa dang / sems mdzes pa la sogs ⑩mthong ste/ de sems dang ba skyes pa des tshul phug spar gang rang sangs rgyas de la phul lo/ /bdag nyid chen po de dag ni lus kyis 8chos ston gyi tshig gis ma yin pas/ des ngang pa'i rgyal po 'dab ma brkyang yib bzhin du nam mkha'i dbye dul 'phags te/ cho 'phrul sna tshogs dag bstan par brtsams so/ /so so'i skye bo ni rdzu 'phrul la myur du dad par byed pa yin pas de ⑥shing rtsa ba nas chabacad pa bzhin du rkang pa la 'di dugatugs pa dang / des de la snying brtse ba ④byas nas song ngo ji tsam 10—220

na bram ze'i khye'u de 'ongs nas smras pa/ yum la phug spar ①gang po de stsol cig/des smras pa/ bu rjes su yi rang ba gyis shig /ngas de rab tu byung ba zhi ba'i bdag nyid can/ bsod ②snyoms don du gnyer ba phyin dunas de la phul lo zhes byas pa rjodang / de bkres pas dusdug bsngal dang yid mi bde ba skyes te smras pa/ rab tu byung ba des de zos nas ci ste lag pa rengs shing gsud de dus byas par ma gyur/ rgyal po chen po ji snyam du sems/ bram ze'i bu gang yin pa de ni ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal 'di nyid yin te/ de'i tshe de'i dus na 'dis rang sangs rgyas la tshig rtsub mo smras pa'i las de'i rnam par smin pas/lo mang po/ lo brgya phrag mang po/ lo stong phrag mang po/ lo brgya stong phrag mang por dmyal ba rnams su skyes so/ /las kyi lhag ma de nyid kyis lan drug tu lag pa rengs shing gsud 0pas dus las 'das te/ da lta'i dus kyi bar 'di dang lan bdun du lag pa rengs shing gsud pa kho nas dus las 'das so/ /de lta bas na rgyal po chen po las gcig tu gnag ⑦pa rnams kyi zhes bya ba nas/las gcig tu dkar ba rnams kho na la 'bad par bya ste/ rgyal po chen po khyod kyis de lta bur ⑧bslab par bya'o zhes bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin no/ /de nas rgyal po ma skyes dgra bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par dad nas rjes su yi rangs te⑨/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la ⑩mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga yinas song ngo / /ji tsam na ma la gnod kyis ⑫'phags skyes po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha yab rgyal po mdzad cing lha dbang ma bskur ⑩ba na/ gang gi tshe nga rgyal por gyur pa de'i tshe ngas shākya rnams kha gdag byaste/ de ni ngas dang por bya ba yin no zhes de lta bu'i khyu mchog gi tshig 10—221

rlabs po che gsungs nas①/ gcig tu chad par mdzad de 'khor gyi nang du seng ge'i sgra ②yang dag par bsgrags pa gang lags pa de dgongs sam/ da ni de'i dus la bab lags so/ /des smras pa/ ma la gnod cing niji snyed smras pa de thams cad bya'am/ don de 'das pa yin pas thong / rgyal po'i bya ba dag dang rgyal po'i byed pa dag yongs su nyams par 'gyur ro/ /des smras paX/lha dge ba rnams ni dam bcas pa la brtan pa lags pas ji ltar dam bcas pa bzhin bsgrub ⑤tu gsol/ ma la gnod ⑥ro zhig zhog shig rgyadang / de yang mi dka' snobar 'gyur ro/ /des smras pa/ lha 'di ni thog mar dam bcas pa lags pas gdon mi 'tshal bar bgyi 'tshal te/ deng kho na gdugs kyang bzang /yud tsam yang bzang / skar ma yang bzang / bsod ⑨nams kyi gdugs kyang bzang bas lha de dag gis ngo lon ma bshams par deng nyid gshegs pa'i rigs so / /de nas 'phags skyes po ma la gnod kyis bslus pas dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi ⑩pa glang po che'i tshogs dang / rta pa'i tshogs dang / shing rta'i ⑪tshogs dang / dpung bu chung gi tshogs go bskon nas ser skya'i gzhi na gnas pa'i shākya rnams gsad pa'i phyir mnyan yod nas ser skya'i gzhir chas so/ /skabs de lta bu la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la mi mkhyen pa'am/ mi gzigs pa'am/ rnam par mi mkhyen pa cung zad kyang mi mnga' ste/ de ser skya na gnas pa'i shākya rnams kyi las chud mi za bar mkhyen nas ches sngar mnyan yod nas ser skya'i gzhir gshegs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das lam kur shing shā 8ko ṭa ka shun pa ra ri 'chus shing mi sdug pa/ lo tsom srab pa/ grib ma chung ba 8zhig gi drung du skyil mo krung byabacas te nyin mo'i gnas pas bzhugs 10—222

so / /rgyal po 'phags skyes pos bcom ldan 'das thag ring po nas mthong ngo //mthong nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa shing lo ma ②sdug cing grib ma chung ngu ma ②lags pa gzhan dag mchis na ci'i slad du bcom ldan 'das de dag spangs te/ shing shā ⑦ko ṭa ka shun pa 'chus shing mi sdug pa/ lo ma srab pa/grib ma chung ngu 'di'i drung na bzhugs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rgyal po duganyen bshes ⑤rnams la ni gnyen bshes ⑥kyi grib ma bsil ༅lo/ /'phags skyes pos bsams pa/ bcom ldan 'das la gnyen rnams la gzigs shing / thugs brtse ba mnga' ste/ kye ma bcom ldan 'das ⑧ni gnyen rnams la thugs brtse ba mdzad do snyam du rig nas de nyid nas slar log go/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ gal te ser skya na gnas pa'i shākya rnams kyis bden pa ma mthong bar 'phags skyes po'i dmag gis thebs na bden pa dag mthong ba'i snod du mi 'gyur ro snyam du mkhyen nas/ shākya rnams kyi nang du ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa las ser skya'i gzhir 'byon te/ ser skya'i gzhi ⑩rgya gro dha'i 7kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /ser 8skya na gnas ⑩pa'i shākya rnams kyis 8bcom ldan 'das shākya rnams kyi nang na ༷ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa las 'dir byon te/ n+ya gro dha'i tsokun dga' ra ba 'di kho na na bzhugs so zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do//de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de rnams kyi bsam pa dang / bag la nyal ba dang /khams dang / rang bzhin mkhyen nas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 10—223

'gyur ba'i chos de lta bu bstan pa ①mdzad pa dang / de thos nas srog chags brgya stong phrag du mas khyad par chen po thob ste/ kha cig gis ni rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas/ kha cig gis ni lan gcig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu zhes bya ba nas/ dge 'dun la 'bab ②pa la bkod do zhes bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin no/ /ma la gnod kyis 'phags skyes po mthong nas/ des smras pa/ lha ci ste slar log /des smras pa/ ma la gnod bcom ldan 'das la ①nye du rnams la gzigs shing thugs brtse ba mnga' ste/ kye ma bcom ldan 'das nye du rnams la thugs brtse ba mnga' bas rgyal po chen po nye ༷du rnams la ni nye ⑤du'i grib ma bsil lo zhes de lta bu'i gsung 'di bka' stsal to/ /de ni nga'i snying la lhangs ⑥zhes byas kyisal/ ser skya ⑧na gnas ⑨pa'i shākya rnams gsad ⑩pa thong ⑩shig /des smras pa/ lha dge sbyong gi ta ma ni 'dod chags dang bral ba lags te/ 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi nye 8du la mi lta bas deng kho na lha'i nyi ma yang bzang / yud tsam yang bzang / skar ma yang bzang /bsod tsonams kyi gdugs kyang bzang bas 8deng nyid ser skya'i gzhir gshegs shig /de mi dge ba'i grogs pos 8log par bzung bas dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa glang po che'i tsotshogs dang / rta pa'i tshogs dang / shing rta'i ⑩tshogs dang / dpung bu chung gi tshogs go bskon nas ser skya'i gzhir tsosong ste ha cang mi ring ba zhig tu phru ma btab nas 'dug go/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal ()gyi bu chen po bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas0/bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo 0bos phyag 'tshal 0te phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas/ bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos 'di 10—224

skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag gis skyes bu gti mug ①'phags skyes po dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa glang po che'i 0tshogs dang / rta pa'i tshogs dang / shing rta'i 0tshogs dang / dpung bu chung gi tshogs go bskon nas ser skya na gnas pa'i ༷shākya rnams dgum pa'i slad du ser skya'i gzhir mchis zhes thos te/ de'i slad du bdag de dpung dang bzhon pa dang bcas te/ 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan ⑤du bskur ⑥ba'am/ khor yug gi slad rol du 'phang ba'amacha / ser skya'i gzhi'i grong khyer lcags kyi ra bas bskor ba'am/ lcags kyi dra bas bskor bar spro lags so/ /mod gal gyi bu de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ khyod kyis ⑤snga ma bzhin du bskor ba zhes bya ba'i bar nus mod kyi/'on kyang ser skya'i gzhi na gnas pa'i shākya rnams nyid kyis las tshogs rnyed pa/rkyen yongs su bsgyur ba/ dba' 0rgal bzhin nye bar gnas pa/ gdon mi za bar 'byung bar 'gyur ba dag byas shing bsags pa rnams gzhan byas zhig gis myong bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags yipa rnams ni phyi'i sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ me'i khams la ma yin/ chu'i khams la ma yin/ rlung gi khams la ma yin gyi8/ 'on kyang las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags 8pa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khams dang /skye mched dag kho na la rnam par smin par 'gyur te/ bskal pa brgya phrag rnams su yang / /las rnams chud zar mi 'gyur te/ /tshogs shing dus dang ldan pa na / /lus can rnams la 'bras bur smin/ /mod gal gyi bu 'jig rten ni las bdag gir bya ba/ las kyi skye gnas pa/ las kyi bgo skal la ④spyod pa/las la rton pa yin pas gang gis las dge ba'am sdig pa byas pa de ni las de'i 10—225

skal ba can du 'gyur ro/ /mod gal gyi bu de lta bas na las la gzhol bar ①bya'o / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu ②bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas song ngo / /ser skya'i gzhi na gnas pa'i shākya rnams kyis skyes bu gti mug ③'phags skyes po dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa glang po che'i ④tshogs dang / rta pa'i tshogs dang / shing rta'i ①tshogs dang / dpung bu chung gi tshogs go bskon skyonas bdag cag gsod ⑦du 'ongs so zhes thos so/ /thos nas de dag gis kyang dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi ⑧pa glang po che'i ⑨tshogs dang / rta pa'i yitshogs dang / shing rta'i tshogs dang / dpung bu chung gi tshogs go bskon nas g.yul sprad pa'i phyir 'phags skyes po logs su spags so/ /de dag bden pa mthong ba yin pas gsod par ni cung zad kyang mi byed ⑩kyi/ gzhan du tson de'i tshe dbyug pa dang lcag 'dag gis bsnun ④cing /gzhu rgyud dang / rgyun dang / 'bring 8pa rnams gcod ⑩pa dang / rna rgyan dag la mda' 'phen par byed do/ /'phags skyes po'i dpung go cha ⑩zhig par byas nas ser skya'i gnas su zhugs te sgo dag bcad nas tsor ba la sbrengs te 'khod do/ /de dag gis pha rol gnod ⑩pa'i mthu nye bar bcom pa dang / ma la gnod la smras pa/ ma la gnod mthong ngam/ shākya rnams kyis bdag cag brlag 0par byas su 'ong gis thong dul 'dong / des smras pa/ lha thugs ma 'chad ③cig /ser skya na gnas pa'i shākya rnams ni bden pa mthong ba lags pas 'di rnams srog chags grog sbur yang srog dang 'bral chaba'i thugs mi thub ste/de ni 'di dag gis bdag cag gi sems can gcig kyang ma bsad pa las mngon no/ /de des bslus nas cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /shākya rnams kyis 10—226

kyang khrims su bcas pa/ shes ldan dag bdag cag las sus kyang 'phags skyes po'am / 'phags skyes po'i dpung la bsnun par mi bya ste/ gang zhig bsnun ①pa de ni bdag cag ②gi nye du yang ma yin/ shākya yang ma yin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na shākya sham+bha ①ka zhes bya ba zhig ri brags shig skyin rang zhal ta byed cing las kyi mtha' byed pa des shākya rnams kyis khrims su bcas pa ma thos so/ /de yang so so'i skye bo zhig yin te/ des 'phags skyes po bdag cag gsad pa'i phyir ser skya'i gnas su 'ongs nas phyogs che ge mo zhig na 'dug go zhes ji lta bu yin pa thos so/ /thos nas kyang khro bas kun nas dkris pas ⑤bskyed pa'i yid mi bde ba'i ⑥med la 'phags skyes po'i dpung gi thog tu drangs nas des der skye bo'i tshogs mang po zhig ni kha btag /kha cig ni tha ma ma shi tsam du byas so/ /de nas 'phags skyes po yid mi bde nas smras pa/ ma la gnod khyod kyis mthong ngam / khyod cag ⑦na re 'di dag bden pa mthong ba yin pas srog chags grog sbur yang srog dang 'bral bar mi byed do zhes dun/ re zhig 'di ⑨gcig gis kyang bdag cag gi skye bo mang po 'di lta bu bsad ⑩na/ gal te thams cad lhags par gyur na bdag cag gi ⑩sems can 'ga' yang mi 'tsho 8bar 'gyur ⑫ba lta smos kyang ci dgos/ dus kyis tsogacus pas chog gis 8slar 'dong /des smras pa/ lha shākya rnams kyis 'di lta bu'i khrims su bca' ba bgyis te bdag cag las gang gis kyang 'phags skyes po'am/ 'phags skyes po'i dpung la bsnun par mi bya ste/ gang zhig snun ⑩pa de ni bdag cag gi ⑥nye du yang ma yin / shākya yang ma yin no zhes dam bcas na de 'dis ma thos pas da 8ni 'di nang du yimi chud pa'i gnas gang lags pa de mchis so/ /de ser skya'i 10—227

gnas kyi sgor song ste 'dug nas smras pa/ shes ldan dag nang du 'ong gis ①sdo phye zhig② /de dag gis smras pa/ khyod kyi ③kho bo cag gi 0khrims su bcas pa ⑤dral bas rjod phyin chad ⑦khyod kho bo cag gi gnyen yang ma yin/ shākya yang ma yin na⑧/ khyod nang du lta ga la gtang 0song shig /des smras pa/ bdag gis khyed kyi ()khrims su bca' ba ma thos te 'on kyang mang du smra ci (7dgos/gal te bdag gis khyed kyi 8khrims su bca' ba dral tshun bdag gi 'khor phyir phyung shig dang gzhan du 'gro'o/ /de dag gis de'i 'khor phyir phyung pa dang /des de dag khrid nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go//phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la shākya sham+bha 8kas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag gis bcom ldan 'das la gang la bgyi ba bgyi ba'i ⑫mtshan ma cung zad ⑩cig bdag la stsal du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de la rdzu 'phrul gyi ⑩dbu skra dang / sen mo dang / tshems dag cig gnang ba dang /des de dag khyer nas yul ba ku dar chas so/ /de rnams kyis shākya sham+bha 8ka zhes bya ba brtson pa dang / stobs dang / pha rol gnon pa chen po phun sum tshogs pa zhig bdag cag gi yul du rgyal srid 'dod de yi'ong ngo zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang gros 0bya bar brtsams pa/ shes ldan dag shākya sham+bha 0ka zhes bya ba brtson pa dang / stobs dang / pha rol gnon pa chen po phun sum tshogs pa zhig bdag cag gi yul du 'ong ngo zhes grag gis phyede'i phyir re zhig tshur shog 'dus shig /ci de dang phrad cing 'dong ngam mi 'dong / de dag thams cad re zhig gi drung du 'dus te re zhig 'dug pa de'i bar du sham+bha dukas 'khor 10—228

rnams phyogs gcig tu bzhag nas bang ①chen gyi cha lugs su byas te de dag gi drung du song ba dang / de dag gis 'ongs pa legs so zhes bya ba'i smras pa ②kun du spyad nas dris pa/ khyod ga las 'ongs ①des smras pa/ shākya sham+bha dhika zhes bya ba brtson pa dang / stobs dang / pha rol gnon pa chen po phun sum tshogs pa de rgyal srid 'dod cing 'dir 'ong bar 'dod de ༷des spring yig 'di bskur gyis du'akhod la lhogs shig /de dag gis smras pa/ stan yang med na gang du 'khod/ des ral gri shubs ⑦nas phyung nas pha bong dum bu dum bur gshegs te 'di la 'khod cig ces byas pa dang / de dag gis mthong nas ngo mtshar gyi mig gdangs te smras pa/ kye skyes bu de la khyod 'dra ba de lta bu'i mi ji tsam yod/ des smras pa/ shes ldan dag kho bo ni de'i bang chen te/ kho bos lta ci ②zhig nus/ de la skyes bu dpa' bo gzhan mang du yod do/ /de dag gis thos nas bsngangs 0te phan tshun smras pa/ shes ldan dag gang gi skyabang chen 'di 'dra ba de'i mi gzhan ci 'dra ba zhig yod/ tshur de yong bdag cag gi rgyal por gzhug 0go zhes de dag gis spring yig bklags 8nas de la spring yig gi lan byin pa/ byon pa legs so/ /sman btags te bdag cag ni tshubaka' bzhin bgyid pa lags 8so/ /des spring yig gi lan khyer nas 'khor dang bcas te 'byor pa mchog dang / yul ba ku dar 'ongs pa dang / de dag gis de bkur ④ste chen pos bsu tshunas/ rgyal srid la bzhag ⑩go/ /yul ba ku da 8pa rnams kyis shākya sham+bha yika zhes bya ba rgyal srid la dbang bskur ⑥ro zhes kun du sgra grags te/ rgyal po sham+bha 0ka rgyal po sham+bha ༷ka zhes bya bar ming chags so/ /des der bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu skra dang / sen mo'i mchod rten byed du 10—229

bcug ste sham+bha ①ka'i mchod rten sham+bha ②ka'i mchod rten zhes bya bar ming chags so / /de'i chung ma dad pa med pa zhig na②/ de yang de'i btsun mo rjodam pa yin pas des de'i ngo cung zad kyang mi chod pas des blon po rnams la bsgo ba/dgon pa bsrung rjob gyis shig de dag gis dgon pa bsrung rjob byas pas da dung yang de na ri dgas dag mi ⑦gsod do/ /'phags skyes pos ma la gnod la smras pa/ ma la gnod da ni shākya rnams kyis sgo rnams bcad de ra ba rnams su sbrengs nas/ bag brkyang ste 'khod na nges pa'i dus kyis 'chu bas ci zhig bya 'dod / des smras pa/ lha ci grong khyer thams cad pha rol gnod ⑧pa gcig pus choms lasam/ bdag rgyal po'i pho brang na spyod pas thos pa ni/ mkhas pa rnams ni bzham ⑩pa dang / /rab tu sbyin dang bslu ba dang / /kun du spyad dang 0lnga pa ni/ /dpung gis don rnams sgrub par byed/ /ces bgyi ste/ de lta bas na de dag la dbyen bgyi ba dgongs shig /'phags skyes pos de dag la spring ba/ shes ldan dag da ni khyed tsol rjes su chags pa yang med/ khong khro ba yang med kyitso/ 'on kyang nga 'o nir bya ba cung ④zhig yod de/ de ngas byas shing thob nas myur ba myur bar 'gros ④sgo phye shig /shākya tsornams kyis smras pa/shes ldan dag 'dus la ci sgo dbye'am/ 'on te mi dbye ba dpyad par bya'o zhes de dag thams cad 'dus pa dang / de na kha cig gis smras pa/ dbye bar bya'o//gzhan ⑩dag gis smras pa/ gal te phye na ma legs so/ /kha cig gis smras pa/shes ldan dag kha cig ni dbye'o zhes zer/ gzhan tsodag ni phye na ma legs so zhes zer bas/ de'i phyir gal te khyed ⑩'dod na tshul shing rims ⑥shig dang /skye bo mang po'i 'dod pa gang yin pa de bya'o zhes de rnams kyis tshul shing 10—230

brim par brtsams so/ /skabs der bdud sdig can 'di snyam du sems te/bdag gis ①lan du ma zhig dge sbyong gi ta ma la glags btsal zhing klan ②ka btsal te phyi bzhin phyi bzhin du 'brangs kyang glags ma rnyed kyisal/ ma la da bdag gis 'di'i nye du rnams kha btag rjogo snyam du rig nas bdag nyid shākya rgan po zhig tu mngon par sprul te rgan pa'i mthar 'dug nas des thog mar tshul shing 0blangs pa dang / shākya rgan pos tshul shing blangs so zhes thams cad kyis blangs so/ /de nas blo gcig pas 'phags skyes po la spring ba dunang du zhugs shig /de dpung gi ④tshogs yan lag bzhi pa dang nang du zhugs te zhugs nas smras pa/ ngas shākya rnams kha btag go⑧/ /ngas shākya rnams yongs su spangs so zhes smras pa'i tshig rjes chad ⑨ma thag tu bskyes bu mtshon gzas pa ⑩rnams kyis shākya rnams kun nas gsad par brtsams pa dang / ku cho tsochen po 'thon to / /shākya tsoming chen gyi ④sgra de thos nas nye du la byams pas bskyed pa'i yid mi bde bas rings pa rings par 'phags skyes po'i drung du song ste/ des smras pa/ lha dam pa 'os 8pa bdag la dam pa stsol cig /des smras pa/ khyod dam pa ci slong smros shig /des smras pa/ lha bdag gi spre'unye du rnams la mi 'jigs pa 475 cig /'phags skyes pos ⑩smras pa/ ngas khyod 8kyi nye du rnams la ni mi 'jigs pa mi sbyin no/ /'on kyang khyod 'khor dang bcas te phyir byung ⑩shig /des smras pa/ lha ji srid bdag chu'i nang du nub ste 'dug pa de srid du gang dag phyir 'byung ba de dag la mi 'jigs pa stsol cig /des blon po rnams kyi gdong du blta dubar brtsams pa dang / de dag gis smras ⑥pa/ lha ming chen 'di ni khyod kyi ( )yum mes kyang lags/ yab kyi grogs po yang 10—231

lags pas 'di la ni dam pa de stsal ①ba'i rigs so/ /des smras pa/ gal te de lta na de skad cig byin no②/ /shākya ming chen nye du la chags pas bskyed pa'i yid mi bde ba snying rjes brlan pa'i sems kyis chu'i rdzing du song ste/ de'i 'gram na shing sā rgyal zhig yod pa de'i yal ga rdzing gi chu'i nang du 0nub pa de la des gtsug phud btags nas nam srog dang bral ba de'i ⑤bar du nub ste 'dug go//de na ser skya'i gnas na gnas pa'i shākya gang dag gis tshogs pa can gyi las ma byas pa de dag las kha cig ni ser skya'i gnas nas byung ste rgyad rgyu bar song ngo / /kha cig ni bal yul du dong ngo / /kha cig ni 0grong dang grong rdal dang / rgyal po'i yul 'khor dang / pho brang de dang de dag tu song ngo / /gang dag gis tshogs pa can gyi las byas pa de dag ni ser skya'i gzhi'i shar sgor byung nas lho nas 'jug /lho nas byung nas nub nas 'jug /nub nas byung nas byang nas 'jug /byang nas byung nas shar nas 'jug pa dang / blon po rnams kyis smras pa⑦/ lha kye ma shākya rnams ni tshig go/ /kye ma shākya rnams ni tshig ste/'di na da ltar shar sgo nas nang du zhugs nas lhor 'byung / lho nas zhugs nas nub tu 'byung ⑧/ nub nas zhugs nas byang du 'byung ⑨/ /byang nas zhugs nas lhor 'byung ngo / /'phags skyes pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag mes po de chur nub nas ring zhig lon gyis ⑩nyos shig blon po rnams kyis rings par chu'i rdzing du song nas brtag par brtsam pa yilas de tsam na dus las 'das so/ /de dag 'ongs te lha dus las 'das tsoso zhes byas pa dang / de che thang du kun nas dkris ⑩pas smras pa/ shes ldan dag stan shoms shig /ji srid du lam po cher khrag gi 'od pa bab par ma gyur ④pa de srid du phyogs 'di nas mi 'gro'o/ /18—232

skyes bu dpa' bo rnams bsad na khrag nyung ngu 'byung ba 'di ni chos nyid yin pas blon po rnams phan tshun bgro ①bar brtsams pa/ shes ldan dag sems can 'di ni sdig pa'i las byed pa dang / dam bcas pa la brtan ②pa yin na/ 'dir 'di snyed kyi khrag cig ga las 'byung / rgya skegs dudag cig len du gzhug go zhes de rnams kyis rgya skegs dublangs nas rgya skegs 0kyi chu bum pa brgya stong du ma lam po cher phab pa dang / 'phags skyes pos bsams pa/ bdag gi dam bcas pa rdzogs pas 'gro'o dusnyam mo/ /de nas skyes bu gti mug 'phags skyes pos shākya bdun khri bdun stong bsad de phal cher ni bden pa mthong ba sha stag go//des sems can de snyed bsad nas gzhon ⑦nu lnga brgya dang / bu mo lnga brgya khrid de gzhan nimu stegs can kun du rgyu rnams kyi kun dga' ra ba phag 0mo'i gnas zhes bya ba ga la ba der song ba dang / ma la gnod kyis ⑩smras pa/ lha khyod kyis dgra yongs su bskyangs so/ /dgra 'di dag ci ste yal bar bzhag 0sod cig /'phags skyes pos gshed tsoma'i mi rnams la gtad de/ 'di rnams glang po che dag gis rdzir chug shig 0ces bsgo'o④/ /de rnams kyis glang po che 8dag gis rdzir gzhug tshupar brtsams pa dang / de dag gis glang po che de dag gan rkyal ⑩du mnan te lag pa nas lag par sbed par brtsams so ma la gnod kyis smras pa/ lha khyod kyis 'di dag gi 8pa rol gnon ⑩pa gzigs sam mthong ngo / /lha 'di dag yal bar bzhag 0na/ 0lha la gnod pa tshubagyid par mi du'agyur ram/ ma rdzil gnod de de bzhin te/ 'di dag ji ltar gsad par bya ba dris byaspros shig /des smras pa/ lha dong du stsol la/ steng nas lcags kyi shal bas 'tshal chadu stsol cig /de bzhin byed du chug shigadu /10—233

des de dag dong du bcug nas steng nas lcags kyi shal bas ①mnan to/ /de nas gnyis shig bros te bcom ldan 'das kyi ②spyan sngar song ngo / /son dunas de gnyis bcom ldan 'das kyis lhung bzed kyis bkab pa dang de nyid du shi'oX/ /shākya rnams bsad pa na bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu shin tu bsnyung ⑤bar gyur to/ /de nas skyes bu gti mug 'phags skyes pos mi zhig la smras pa/ kye skyes bu khyod tshur de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar song ste 'dug la/ bcom ldan 'das ci gsung ba rjode khyod kyis nyon la nga la zlos shig ces smras nas song ngo mi de bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song ①ste 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo nga la chu lhung bzed gang byin cig /des bcom ldan 'das la chu lhung bzed gang phul lo//bcom ldan 'das kyis der chu'i thigs pa gnyis gsum tsam blugs pa dang /de dag chu'i nang de nas du bar 'thul ②zhing tsi ri ri zer ⑨la sgra yang 'byin to/ /dge slong rnams cho 'phrul de mthong nas yid dad cing sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis phrin ⑩las ci zhig mdzad nas / phrin (sprelas de'i rnam par smin pas bcom ldan 'das dbu bsnyung ⑫bar gyur/ ser skya na gnas pa'i shākya rnams kyis sug las ci zhig bgyis na/des nongs pa yang ma mchis/ gnod pa bgyis pa yang ma mchis par skyes bu gti mug 'phags skyes pos bkum tsolags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag tshur gzhan 0mu stegs tsokun du rgyu rnams kyi kun dga' ra ba phag mo'i gnas gang du skyes bu gti mug 'phags skyes pos shākya rnams bsad tshupa ga la ba de kho nar de rnams dang / bdag nyid kyi las kyi rgyu ba lung 10—234

bstan par bya'o/ /btsun pa de ltar 'tshal lo zhes dge slong de rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi ①ltar nyan to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dge slong rab tu mang po dang thabs cig tu ②gzhan zhumu stegs can kun du rgyu rnams kyi kun dga' ra ba phag ༷mo'i gnas ga la ba der gshegs so/ /bre bo dang rus mthun pa'i bram ze zhig gis dubacom ldan 'das thag ring po kho na nas mthong ste/ mthong nas kyang bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /kye gi ta ma gang gi slad du skyes bu gti mug 'phags skyes pos ser skya na gnas pa'i shākya nongs pa yang ma mchis / gnod pa bgyis pa yang ⑥ma mchis pa rnams srog dang phral ba ni bsod ⑦nams ma lags pa mang po zhig bskyed do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bram ze de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ gang gi phyir skyes bu gti mug 'phags skyes pos ser skya na gnas pa'i shākya nyes pa yang med/gnod pa byed ⑧pa yang med pa rnams srog dang phral ⑨ba ni bsod nams ma yin pa mang po ⑩zhig bskyed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gzhan mu stegs can kun du rgyu rnams kyi kun dga' ra ba phag mo'i gnas ga la ba der gshegs pa dang / de na ser skya na gnas pa'i shākya lcags kyi shal bas bshal ba las srog gi lhag ma cung zad lus pa gang dag yin pa de dag gis bcom ldan 'das mthong nas skad ngan bton to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyogs gcig tu gshegs nas gdan ⑩bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ser skya na gnas pa'i shākya 'di rnams kyi ⑩'di dang lan gsum gyi bar du sgra chen po phyung ste/ sngon nya pa byed pa'i tshe nya 'dod pa'i phyir tsogang yin pa dang / chom rkun pa byed pa'i 10—235

tshe grong 'joms ①pa'i phyir gang yin pa dang / da ltar ②ser skya na gnas pa'i shākya byed pa'i tshe skyes bu gti mug 'phags skyes pos srog gi lhag ma cung zad tsam lus par byas te 'chi ba la mngon du phyogs pa'i tshe gang yin pa'o/ /'di dag thams cad kyi brdol ba la ni khyad par ram/ bsam pa'am/ tha dad du bya ba cung zad kyang med de mtshungs so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ shan ③pa 'di las de dang bzo de dang 'tsho ba des glang po che la zhon te 'gro ba'am/rta la zhon te 'gro ba'am/ shing rtar zhon te 'gro rjoba'am/ dpung bu chung dang bcas ⑤te 'gro ba'am/ nor gyi phung po rgya chen po mang po grub nas gnas pa lta cig la dumathong ngam/ thos sam/ btsun pa ma lags so/ /dge slong dag legs so legs so/ /ngas kyang shan ⑦pa 'di las de dang zhes bya ba nas/nor gyi phung po rgya chen po ⑧mang po bsgrubs nas gnas pa zhes bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin te/ ma mthong ma thos so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar shan ⑨pa rnams ni sdig pa'i bsam pas rtog par byed de/ des na 'di glang po che la zhon te 'gro ba'am/ rta la zhon te 'gro ba'am/ shing rtar zhugs te 'gro ba'am/dpung bu chung tshudang chas te 'gro bar yang mi ⑩'gyur la/ nor 7gyi phung po rgya chen po mang po bsgrubs te gnas par ⑩mi 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ khyed kyis ④bya gag gsod pa'am/ phag gsod pa'am/nya pa'am/ ri dgas shor tsoba'am/ bya ba'am/ bong bu rgyas 'chor ⑩ba'am/ba lang gsod pa dag las de dang zhes bya ba nas/ nor gyi phung po rgya chen po mang po bsgrubs te gnas pa de mthong ngam/ thos sam zhes bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar ba glang gsod pa'i ⑩sdig pa'i 10—236

bsam pas rtog ①par byed de/ des na ②de glang po che la zhon te 'gro bar mi 'gyur zhes bya ba nas/ nor gyi phung po rgya chen po mang po bsgrubs te gnas par mi 'gyur zhes bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin no/ /dge slong dag re zhig byol song gi skye gnas su song ba'i srog chags rnams kyis kyang sdig pa'i bsam pas brtag rgyan glang po che la zhon te 'gro ba'am/ rta la zhin te 'gro ba'am/ shing rta ④la duzhugs te 'gro ba'am/ dpung bu chung dang chas te 'gro bar yang mi 'gyur la/nor gyi phung po rgya chen po mang po bsgrubs te gnas par yang mi 'gyur na/ skyes bu gti mug 'phags skyes po slob bas longs ⑥zhes smras pas latshul khrims kyi gzi brjid kyis ninye bar bcom pa lta ④zhig glang po che la zhon te 'gro ba'am/ rta la zhon te 'gro ba'am/ shing rtar zhugs te 'gro ba'am/ dpung bu chung dang chas te 'gro ba'am/ nor gyi phung po rgya chen po ⑩mang po bsgrubs te gnas pa lta zhig smos kyang ci dgos te/ de ni gnas med do/ /dge slong dag ko yis la'i rigs 'di 8'di nas zhag bdun na sbrul gyis tsobaltas pa bzhin du rabs chad par 'gyur ro/ /skyes bu gti mug 'phags skyes po yang ma la gnod yidang bcas te zhag bdun na mes tshig nas cho nge 8'don bzhin dmyal ba chen po mnar med par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na 'di ltar bslab par bya ste/ gang mgal dum la yang ngan sems mi bya na ⑩rnam par shes pa dang bcas pa'i lus la lta smos kyang ci dgos/ dge slong dag khyed kyis de lta bur bslab par bya'o/ /dge slong rnams the tshom ⑩skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod par mdzad pa tsosangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa shākya lnga brgya po 'di rnams kyi ⑩las ci zhig bgyis na las de'i rnam par smin pas 18—237

nongs pa yang ma mchis/ gnod pa bgyis pa yang ma mchis par skyes bu gti mug 'phags skyes pos srog dang phral/ bcom ldan 'das kyang shākya rnams bkum ①pa'i tshe dbu snyun tshabs chen pos thebs par gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'di dag nyid dang / ngas las byas shing bsags pa tshogs rnyed pa/ rkyen yongs su bsgyur ba/ dba' rgal bzhin nye bar gnas pa/ gdon mi za bar 'byung ba dag yin te/ 'di dag dang ngas las byas shing bsags pa gzhan ②su zhig gis myong bar 'gyur/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams la ma yin/ me'i khams la ma yin/ rlung gi khams la ma yin gyi 'on kyang las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched dag kho na la rnam par smin par 'gyur te/ bskal pa brgya phrag rnams su yang / /las rnams chud zar ③mi 'gyur te/ /tshogs shing dus la dubab pa na/ /lus can rnams la 'bras bur smin/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba chu bo zhig gi 'gram na nya pa lnga brgya gnas so/ /de rnams kyis nya gnyis shig rgya mtsho chen po na phan tshun rgyu rgyu ba las chu bo der zhugs pa mthong ba dang / de rnams rab tu dga' ba skyes nas de dag nya rgya chen pos bcus so/ /de rnams kyis de gnyis kyi ༷lus mthong nas gros bya bar brtsams ①pa/ shes ldan dag 'di la ji ltar bsgrub par bya/'di dag lus che ches pas gal te bsad ⑦na sha ldom par mi 'gyur te/ de 'brul ⑧bar 'gyur ro/ /de na lakha cig gis smras pa/ 'di la ci zhig bsgrub ⑩tu yod/ gcig ni bsad la gcig ni btags 7te gzhag mod/ gzhan ⑫10—238

dag gis smras pa/ 'di yang che ste/ 'di yang ldom par mi 'gyur bas sdong po la btags la gson par ①sha bcad cing bcad cing btsong ngo / /de rnams kyis smras pa/ legs te de ltar bya'o de dag gis de ltar bya bar brtsams pa dang /de dag de ltar gcod ②pa na rang gi skad du 'o dod 'bod par brtsams so/ /de dag mi bde ba de nya pa'i khye'u zhig gis thos nas rab tu dga' ba skyed par byed do/ /de nas nya de gnyis de ltar bcad pa'i tshe de rnams la 'di lta bu'i sems bskyed ③de/ gang bdag cag gis nyes pa yang med/ gnod pa byed dupa yang med par 'di dag gis 'di ltar bsad de / de'i phyir bdag cag kyang gang du 'di dag nyes pa yang med/ gnod pa byas pa yang med par gsod par 'gyur ba der skye bar gyur cig /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ nya gnyis po gang dag yin pa de dag ni 'phags skyes po dang / ma la gnod 'di dag kho na yin no/ /nya pa lnga brgya gang dag yin pa de dag ni shākya lnga brgya po 'di dag kho na yin te/ gang 'di gnyis kyis nya de dag de ltar bsad pa'i ⑥las kyi ⑦rnam par smin pas/ da ltar 'phags skyes po dang ma la gnod dag gis shākya ⑧gyur pa nyes pa yang med/ gnod pa byas pa yang med pa rnams lcags kyi ⑨zhal bas mnan ⑩cing 'o dod 'bod bzhin bsad ⑩do/ /nya pa'i khye'u gang yin pa de ni nga nyid de'i tshe de'i dus na de yin te/ gang ngas nya bsad ⑩pa na rab tu dga' ba bskyed 8pa'i las de'i rnam par smin pas da ltar nga mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyang dbu snyun tshabs chen pos thebs par gyur to/ /gal te ngas yon tan gyi tshogs 'di lta bu thob par ma gyur na nga yang las 'di lta bu dag thob par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag gzhan yang ser skya na 10—239

gnas pa'i shākya rnams kyis las gang byas pa de ②nyon cig /dge slong dag sngon byung ba chom rkun lnga brgya zhig gis lam du 'gro ba dag bcom nas phyogs ②pa'i rdzas dag khyer te/ ri brags shig ②tu 'joms su song ngo / /de dag gis ri brags dun gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs de thams cad bcom nas phrogs sodu//khyim bdag gnyis shig yang tog 0tu 'dzegs te ⑦'dug pa dang / rkun po rnams kyis smras pa/ shes ldan dag gang dag 'dir 'dzegs ⑧pa de dag bobs shig /thams cad kyi thams cad du med par gyur ta re/ de gnyis kyis smras pa / ji srid 'tsho ba de srid du mi 'babs so0/ /de rnams kyis tshur+sā skyedang shing phal mo che bcer nas yang tog ⑩de me btang ba dang de gnyis tsha bas sdug bsngal bskyed pas gdungs te 'di lta bu 8sems bskyed ④do/ /bdag cag nyes pa yang med/ gnod pa byas pa yang med par 'di rnams kyis bsad pas bdag cag kyang 'di rnams nyes pa yang med/ gnod pa byas pa yang med par gsod ④par gyur cig /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ khyim bdag gnyis po gang dag yin pa de dag ni 'phags skyes po dang ma la gnod 'di dag kho na yin no/ /g.yon can lnga brgya po gang dag yin pa de dag ni shākya lnga brgya po 'di dag kho na yin te/ gang 'di rnams chom rkun par gyur pas de dag nyes pa yang med / gnod pa byas pa yang med par srog dang bral tshuba'i las de'i rnam par smin pas da ltar 'phags skyes pos ma la gnod dang bsdongs nas shākya lnga brgya po 'di dag nyes pa yang med/ gnod pa byas pa yang med par srog dang phral lo/ /dge slong dag de ltar ⑩na las gcig tu gnag 8pa rnams kyi rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu gnag tho)la gcig tu dkar ba rnams kyi yang gcig tu dkar/18—240

'dren ma rnams kyi yang 'dren ma yin no/ /dge slong dag ①de lta bas na las gcig tu gnag ②pa dang 'dren ma rnams spangs nas las gcig tu dkar ba dag la brtsal bar ①bya ste/ dge slong rnams kyis de lta bu la ༷bslab par bya'o//'phags skyes pos shākya rnams de ltar bsad dunas mnyan yod du song ngo de nang du zhugs pa dang / rgyal po'i gzhon dun rgyal bu rgyal byed ༅steng gi khang bzangs su ⑧song nas skyes pa med par rol mos rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/dga' mgur spyod par byed pa/ 'phags skyes pos ⑨mthong ⑩nas des smras pa/shes ldan dag rtse ba 'o ni su zhig blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ gzhon nu rgyal bu rgyal byed lags so/ /des smras pa/ shes ldan dag de bos shig /de rnams kyis de yibos pa dang / 'phags skyes pos smras pa/ rgyal bu rgyal byed nga ni dgra bsad tsonas 'ongs na khyod rtse 8zhing 'dug gam/ des smras pa/ lha'i dgra su dag zhig ④lags/ shākya rnams so/ /gal te shākya rnams khyod kyi dgra lags na/ mdza' bo ji lta bu dag cig lags/ de 7smras pa/ shes ldan dag 'di yang de dag gi phyogs kho na yin pas 'di gsad 0par bya'o zhes de dag gis de bsad de dus las 'das nas lha gya nom pa sum bcu rtsa gsum pa rnams kyi nang du skyes nas/ de'i mi'i rol mo'i sgra ma zhi bar lha'i sgra byung ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba de la tshigs su bcad pa dag bka' stsal pa/bsod nams byas pa ⑩'dir dga' phyi mar dga'/ /gnyi gar dga' ste de ni bdag nyid kyi/ /las rnam ༷smin mthong de dga' rab tu dga'/ /'gro ba bzang por song ba phyir zhing dga'/ /bsod tsonams byas pa 'dir mgu phyi mar mgu/ /gnyi cigar mgu ste de ni bdag nyid kyi/ /las rnam 0smin mthong 10—241

de mgu rab tu mgu/ /'gro ba bzang por song ba phyir zhing mgu/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol te①/btsun pa tshigs ②bcad 'di'i ③don ma mjal dulags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo gzhon dun rgyal bu rgyal byed de nyes pa med cing gnod pa med par skyes bu gti mug 'phags skyes pos srog dang phral ༷te de'i mi'i ༅rol mo'i sgra ma zhi bar lha'i sgra byung ngo / /ngas ⑧de las dgongs nas 'di skad du bsod ⑨nams byas pa 'dir dga' phyi mar dga' zhes bya ba nas/'gro ba bzang 0por song ba phyir zhing mgu zhes bya ba'i bar du gsungs 0so/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / de cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /ji tsam dus gzhan ⑫zhig na 'phags skyes po btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang du ngom zhing rnam par ngom ste/nga rgyal can mthu dang ldan pa/ dpa' bo 8brtson 'grus dang pha rol gnon pa can gang dag yin pa de dag ngas rmig med par byas te④/ nga dang 'dra ba su zhig yod ces zer ro/ /de nas 'phags skyes pos shākya'i bu mo lnga brgya khrid pa de dag gis kyang tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ khyod kyi tsogang dag rmeg med byas//de dag rgyal sras shākya'i sras/ /bslab pa'i sdom ⑩pas bsdams ⑩pa yin/ /khyod kyis 'dir smras ci zhig rung / /de skad ces smras pa dang / khros nas blon po rnams la tshigs su bcad pas bsgo ba/ klu rnams bsad na klu'i tsobu mo dag /dug gis gang ba sprin gyis khebs pa ltar/ /'di dag la gor rkang lag rnams chod la / /nye du de dag nyid rjes myur du thong / /blon po rnams kyis shākya'i bu mo lnga brgya po de dag dmar bu can gyi rdzing 'gram du lag pa dang rkang pa dag bcad de/de lag pa'i dong lag pa'i dong zhes bya skyabar ming chags nas gnas brtan rnams 18—242

kyis kyang de bzhin du mdo sde'i mgo la bcom ldan 'das mnyan ①yod na lag pa'i dong gi rdzing 'gram na bzhugs ②so zhes dris ①so// // 'dul ba phran tshegs kyi gzhi/rjo bam po dgu pa/ de rnams sdug bsngal mi bzad pa rtsub pa 0tsha ba yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshor ba nyams su myong ba na bsams pa/ bdag cag mi bzad pa dog pa nyam nga bar ༷gyur na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑦ma dgongs pa lta snyam mo/ /skabs de lta bu la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la mi mkhyen pa'amani/ mi gzigs pa'am/ thugs su ma chud pa'am/ rnam par mi ⑨mkhyen pa cung zad kyang mi mnga' ste/ de nas bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen pos bskul nas phyogs der gshegs pa dang / ji tsam na bud med de dag thams cad sgren mor 'dug pa gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jig rten pa'i thugs bskyed do/ /chos nyid kyis gang gi tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis 'jig rten pa'i thugs bskyed pa de'i tshe srog chags grog sbur rnams kyis kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis byathugs sems kyis shes so/ /gang gi 0tshe 'jig rten las 'das pa'i thugs bskyed pa de'i tshe ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams ⑩kyis kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs sems kyis mi tsoshes na/ dud 'gro'i skye ④gnas su song ba'i srog chags rnams kyis byalta smos kyang ci dgos/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ kye ma lha'i bu mo bde sogs ⑩kyis gos dag dang chu khyer te 'ongs kyang bla na snyam du bcom ldan 'das kyis thugs bskyed ma thag tu lha'i bu mo bde sogs kyis ⑩ras zung lnga brgya dang / mtsho chen po ma dros pa las phyechu blangs nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 10—243

'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun ①pa ras yug lnga brgya 'di dag dang chab 'tshal te mchis so bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ song la shākya'i bu mo 'o ni rnams dbugs phyung ste / dbugs phyung nas rkang pa dang lag pa dag khrus la gos rnams skon cig /btsun ②pa de ltar 'tshal lo zhes smras nas/ des ②de rnams kyi rkang pa dang lag pa dag bkrus ④nas gos rnams bskon no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'khod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑤thu 'phrul gyis shākya'i bu mo lnga brgya po de rnams kyi sdug bsngal rgyun bcad do/ /rgyun bcad nas bka' stsal pa/ sring mo dag khyed nyid kyis las 'di dag byas shing bsags ⑥pa/ tshogs pa 0rnyed pa/rkyen yongs su bsgyur ba/ dba' rgal bzhin nye bar gnas pa/ gdon mi za bar 'byung ba yin te/ khyed kyis las byas shing bsags ⑧pa rnams gzhan ⑨su zhig gis myong bar 'gyur/ sring mo dag las tshul gzhol ⑩bar gyis shig ces gsungs nas bcom ldan 'das gshegs so/ /de dag kyang bcom ldan 'das la sems rab tu dang bar byas nas dus las 'das te/ rgyal chen bzhi'i lha rnams kyi nang du skyes so/ /chos nyid kyis lha'i bu'am lha'i bu mo skyes nas ring po ma lon pa la sems gsum skye ste/ gang nas shi 'phos pa dang / gang du skyes pa dang / las gang gis yin pa'o/ /de rnams kyis mi rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos pa dang / rgyal chen bzhi pa'i lha rnams kyi nang du skyes pa dang /las gang gis zhe tson/ bcom ldan 'das la sems rab tu dang bar byas pas yin par mthong ngo / /de nas sngon shākya'i bu mo byed byed pa'i lha lnga brgya po de 10—244

rnams 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag cag zhag ①tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das blta ba'i phyir 'dong ba ni cha ma yin gyis②/ ma la bdag cag zhag ma lon pa nyid du bcom ldan 'das blta ba'i phyir 'dong ngo snyam mo/ /de nas sngon shākya'i bu mo byed byed pa'i lha rnams rna cha ②gdub kor dudri ma med pa g.yo ba thogs shing / lus do shal dang se ⑤mo dos brgyan nas de nyid kyi mtshan mo lha rdzas kyi me tog ut+pa la dang / pad ma dang / ku mu da dang / pad ma dkar po dang / man dā dur ba rnams kyis thu ba bkang nas rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal thams cad snang ba rgya chen pos snang bar ④byas te/ bcom ldan 'das la me tog rnams kyis gtor nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'dug go/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de rnams kyi bsam pa dang / bag la nyal ⑧dang / khams dang / rang bzhin mkhyen nas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bstan pa mdzad pa dang / de rnams kyis de thos nas 'jig 0tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi 0rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas so/ /de rnams kyis bden pa mthong nas ched du brjod pa lan gsum brjod pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gang bdag cag la sman btags yipa 'di lta bu ni bdag cag la mas ma bgyis / phas ma lags/ rgyal pos ma lags/ lha rnams kyis ma lags/⑫rang gi skye bo dang gnyen 8sdug pa'i tshogs kyis ma lags/ sngon gyi mes po rnams kyis ma lags/ dge sbyong dang bram ze rnams kyis ma lags te/ khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho ni bskams/ rus pa'i ri las ni bsgral/ ngan song gi sgo rnams ni bcad/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo rnams ni phye/ lha dang mi 10—245

rnams la ni bkod do/ /yang smras pa/ khyod kyi mthu yis ngan song lam dag ni/shin tu mi bzad nyes mang ①ldan pa bcad/ /mtho ris sgo phye bdag gis ③bsod nams ni/ /shin tu bzang dang mya ngan 'das lam thob/ /khyod bsnyen ②de ring bdag gis duskyon bral zhing ⑤/ /shin tu rnam par dag mig dag pa thob//'phags pa dgyes pa'i go 'phang zhi ba'ang thob/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho 0pha rol mchog tu rgal/ /'gro bar ⑦lha min lha dang mis mchod cing / /skye rga 'chi ba'i skyon dang bral ba po/ /srid pa stong du mthong rab rnyed dka' ba/ /thub pa khyod deng mthong ba 'bras ③bu mchis/ /de nas se mo do 'phyang dga' skyes rnams / /zhabs gnyis la ni gdud ⑨pa byas nas kyang / /dgra thul ba la yongs su bskor byas nas/ /slar yang lha yi 'jig rten mngon phyogs dong / /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod ⑩par mdzad pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa shākya'i bu mo lnga brgya yipo dag gis las ci 8zhig bgyis na des lag pa dang rkang pa dag bkum/ las ci ⑩zhig bgyis na des lha rnams kyi nang du skyes/ las ci ④zhig bgyis na des bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bden pa mthong bar bgyis lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' su55 pa/ dge slong dag 'di dag nyid kyis las byas shing bsags ⑫pal/ tshogs rnyed pa zhes bya ba nas/ lus can rnams la 'bras bur smin/ /ces bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin no/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba bskal pa bzang po 'di tshunyid la skye dgu'i tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i ⑩kha lo sgyur ba 10—246

bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ston pa 'od srung ①zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de'i gsung rab la 'di rnams rab tu byung bar gyur to/ /de na 'di rnams kyis slob pa ②dang mi slob pa'i dge slong rnams la lag rdum rkang rdum zhes bya ba'i tshig kun du spyod ①pa kun du spyad ④de las de'i rnam par smin ༷pas lo mang por dmyal ba rnams kyi nang du skyes so/ /las de nyid kyi lhag mas 'di rnams 0tshe rabs lnga brgyar lag pa dang /rkang pa dag bcad deX/ da lta'i bar du yang lag pa dang rkang pa dag bcad pa yin no/ /gang nga la sems rab tu dang bar byas pa'i las de'i rnam par smin pas ni lha rnams kyi nang du skyes so/ /gang 'di rnams kyis de na lung mnos ⑧pa dang / bklags ⑨pa dang / kha ton byas pa des na nga'i ⑦spyan sngar bden pa mthong bar byas pa yin no/ /dge slong dag de ltar na las gcig tu gnag ⑫pa rnams kyi zhes bya ba nas/ brtsal bar bya ste/ dge slong dag khyed kyis ⑩de lta bur bslab 8par bya'o zhes bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin no/ /de nas mi de 'phags skyes po'i drung du 'ongs pa dang / 'phags skyes pos smras pa/ kye skyes bu bcom ldan 'das ci gsung / des smras pa/ lha bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas 'di nas zhag bdun tson ko sa la'i rgyal rigs sbrul gyis byabaltas pa bzhin du rabs 'chad ⑩par 'gyur ro/ /'phags skyes po yang ma la gnod dang bcas te mes tshig bzhin sems can dmyal ba chen po mnar med par ltung bar 'gyur ro zhes gsung ngo / /'phags skyes pos thos nas lag pa 'gram pa la gtad nas sems khong du chud de 'dug go/ /ma la gnod kyis smras pa/ lha khyod ci'i phyir phyag 'gram pa la gtad ⑩nas sems khong du chud cing bzhugs/10—247

des smras pa/ ma la gnod 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das 'di skad ces zhag bdun na 'phags skyes po ma la gnod dang bcas te mes tshig ①bzhin sems can dmyal ba chen po mnar med par ltung bar 'gyur ro zhes gsung rgyan/ da ji ltar sems khong du chud cing mi 'dug /des smras pa/ lha gang zhig bram ze 'ongs pa la 'tshal ③ma mi stsol ba de yang phung ba rjobargya stong du sems na/ lhas dge sbyong gi ta ma'i gnyen bshes de snyed ༷cig bkum pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/de de skad gsung yang durung / gzhan gsung yang ⑦rung ste/ 'on kyang lhas ⑧skyed mos tshal du chab kyi nang du khang bzangs ka ba gcig pa zhig bgyid 0du stsal te / lha der gshegs nas dgung bdun du bzhugs tshul dgung bdun 'das pa dang / slar mnyan yod du gshegs par mdzod cig /des smras pa/ de ltar byas 'gro'o zhes de btsun mo'i 'khor dang bcas te der song nas 'dug go//nyin zhag gcig thal ba dang / ma la gnod kyis smras pa/ lha dgung zhag bdun las gcig ni thal lags/ lhag ma dgung zhag drug mchis te/ dgung zhag drug 'das nas mnyan yod du gshegs par mdzad do zhes bya ba nas/nyin zhag gnyis dang gsum nas bdun pa la lha deng kho na la mnyan yod du gshegs par mdzad do zhes bya ba'i bar de bzhin du byas so/ /de na yul ngan zhig kyang byung bar gyur to7/ /bud med ni rgyan la dga' ba yin pas btsun ⑫mo'i 'khor rnams kyis smras pa/ phu nu mo dag bdag cag deng mnyan yod du 'dong dgos pas rgyan thogs par bya'o zhes de rnams kyis rgyan thogs par brtsams so/ /de na btsun mo'i 'khor zhig gis sngas nang tshangs can gyi steng du nor bu me shel bzhag nas rgyan thogs par brtsams so/ /ji tsam na yul ngan 10—248

sangs pa dang / nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis me shel gyi thog tu bab nas me byung ba de sngas nang tshangs can la mched do/ /de las kyang khang bzangs la mched nas btsun mo'i 'khor rnams ni bros so/ /'phags skyes po dang ma la gnod tshig bzhin bros ①par brtsams pa dang / ji tsam na mi ma yin pa dag gis sgo rnams bcad nas 'phags skyes pos tshig bzhin du smras pa/ ma la gnod tshig ②go/ /des smras pa/ lha tshos so zhes de dag de skad du 'o dod 'bod cing dmyal ba chen po mnar med par skyes so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba de la tshigs su bcad pa dag bka' stsal pa/ sdig pa byas pas 'dir tshig phyi mar tshig / gnyi gar ③tshig ste de ni bdag nyid kyi/ /las rnam ④min mthong de tshig rab ⑤tu tshig /'gro ba ngan par song ba phyir zhing tshig /sdig pa byas pa 'dir smre phyi ⑥mar smre/ / gnyi gar lasmre ste de ni bdag nyid kyi/ /las rnam ⑧smin mthong de smre rab tu smre/ /'gro ba ngan par song ba phyir zhing smre/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces ⑨gsol to/ /btsun pa tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gi don ⑩bdag gis ma 'tshal yito/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo skyes bu gti mug 'phags skyes ()po de ma la gnod dang bcas te mes tshig ⑫bzhin dmyal ba mnar med par song ste ngas de las dgongs nas/ sdig pa byas pa 'dir tshig phyi mar tshig /ces bya ba nas/ 'gro ba ngan par song ba phyir zhing smre/ /zhes bya ba'i bar gsungs pa yin no/ /gang gi tshe 'phags skyes pos shākya rnams bsad pa de'i tshe shākya'i bu mo rnams kyis de rnams kyi rgyan dag mthong nas ngu bar brtsams te0/ de rnams kyis bsams pa/ shākya 10—249

rnams ni 'phags pa rnams la mngon par dad pa yin pas rgyan 'di dag 'phags pa rnams la dbul ༅lo zhes de rnams kyis rgyan de dag dge slong rnams la phul lo/ /drug sde rnams kyis rgyan de dag thogs nas ser skya'i gnas su zhugs pa dang / shākya'i bu mo rnams kyis de dag mthong nas de bzhin du ngu bar gyur cing smras pa/ 'phags pa dag bdag cag ②gis de'i slad du 'di dag phul na nyes dmigs de nyid byung bar gyur to zhes byas pa dang / de dag cang mi ②smra bar 'dug go/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ri nyes dmigs gang cung zad byung ba ni dge slong rnams rgyan thogs pa las gyur gyis ④de lta bas na dge slong gis rgyan spel ma dang / 'phyang phrul ⑤can dang / zla gam can dang /gser skud dang / rgyan sna tshogs ༅ci yang rung ba yang thogs par mi bya ste/ thogs na ⑦'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro// //sdom ni/ blangs pa dang ni bslab pa dang / /du ba'i ri lu sman gce'u ⑧bcas / /lhung bzed snod dang zu nga dang ⑨/ /mar dkar 'bru mar byug pa'o / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /ri brags zhig na ⑩khyim bdag cig gnas pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas de de ⑪dang rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed do/ /dus gzhan 4)zhig na de tho)nye du rnams kyang zad par gyur/ nor yang zad/longs spyod ④kyang zad nas/ des bsams pa/ da ④ni bdag rgas pas nor 10—250

bsgrub par bya yang mi nus/ bdag la longs spyod dag ①kyang med/ bdag gi nye ②du rnams kyang dus las 'das pas/ song la rab tu 'byung ngo snyam du rig nas des chung ma la smras pa/ bzang mo da ②ni nga rgas pas nor bsgrub par bya yang mi nus/ nga la longs spyod dag kyang med/ nga'i nye du rnams kyang dus las 'das pas khyod la dris te song la rab tu 'byung ngo / /khyim bdag de drang bo zhig na de ni g.yos rjikun du spyod cing rtag tu skyes pa gzhan dag dul lta ba zhig pas des smras pa/ rje'i sras de bzhin du mdzod cig /'on kyang dus dus su ltar ⑤spyon cig /des de bzhin bya'o zhes dam bcas nas rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du song ste/ dge slong zhig gi drung du phyin nas smras pa/ 'phags pa rab tu 'byung bar 'tshal lo/ /des smras pa/ bzhin bzangs khyod 'jigs pa med par ༅spobs pa dge ste legs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang phan yon lnga yang dag par mthong ba'i mkhas pas ni rab tu 'byung bar mos par bya ba nyid du 'os ⑤te/ lnga gang zhe na/ bdag gis rang gi don ma 'dres pa thob par 'gyur bar yang dag par mthong ba'i mkhas pas rab tu 'byung bar mos par bya bar 'os pa nyid dang / bdag gang dag gi bran dang / mngag gzhug pa dang / bkol ba dang / rang dbang med pa dang / dga' mgur 'gror med pa yin pa de dag gis mchod par bya bar 'gyur ba dang / bstod par bya bar 'gyur bar yang dag par mthong ba'i mkhas pas rab tu 'byung bar mos par bya bar 'os pa nyid dang / mya ngan las 'das pa grub pa dang bde ba bla na med pa 'thob ⑨par 'gyur bar ⑩yang dag par mthong ba'i mkhas pas rab tu 'byung bar 7mos par bya bar 'os pa nyid dang / bdag mya ngan las 'das 10—251

pa grub pa dang bde ba bla na med pa ma thob pa las yongs su nyams kyang lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur bar yang dag par mthong ba'i mkhas pas rab tu 'byung bar mos par bya bar 'os pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi nyan thos skyes bu dam pa yang dag par song ba mchog rnams kyi ①rnam grangs du mar rab tu 'byung ba bsngags par yang dag par mthong ba'i mkhas pas rab tu 'byung bar mos par bya bar 'os pa nyid do ②zhes bka' stsal te/khyod kyis sems bskyed pa dges ①legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba 'di la rab tu byung shig ces des de rab tu phyung ④bsnyen par rdzogs par byas so/ /de nas zhag gnyis gsum zhig kun du laspyad pa'i chos bslabs yinas smras pa/bzhin bzangs ri dgas kyis ri dgas mi sos kyis ⑦mnyan yod rgya chen por rang gi spyod yul ⑧pa'i yul du bsod ⑨stoms la rgyu zhing 'tsho bar gyis shig /de phyi de nyin ⑩snga dro sham thabs dang chos gos bgos/ lhung bzed thogs te mnyan yod du bsod snyoms kyi phyir zhugs so/ /de bsod snyoms la rgyu ba na rang gi chung ma 'dra ba'i bud med cig mthong nas/ des bsams pa/ bdag gi sngon gyi chung ma de la rab tu byung nas ltar skye'ong ngo des 8dam bcas kyis 8de'i phyir bdag da gzod rab tu byung ba yin pas dus cung zad cig bsdad la ④de mi dga' bar mi 'gyur bar de ltar tso'agro'o snyam ⑫ du bsams tshunas/ bsod snyoms la brgyus 8te rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du song ngo / /de yidus cung zhig bsdad nas/ mkhan po la smras pa/ mkhan po bdag la sngon kyi ༷mchis 'brang ⑥zhig mchis te/ de la bdag gis rab tu byung nas ltar 6)mchi'o zhes dam bcas pas de'i slad du gnang bar mdzod cig dang dumachi'o/ /des smras pa/18—252

bu song la khyod kyis sems sungs shig /des smras pa/ bsrung bar bgyi'o zhes smras nas chas pa dang / rim gyis ri brags ①der phyin no/ /des de rgyang ring po kho na nas mthong ba dang / rgyadaga' ba dang bcas shing myur ba myur bas bsu nas smras pa/ rje'i sras byon pa ②legs so/ /byon pa legs ④te/ring mo zhig lon nas mthong ngo zhes smras nas/ reg par brtsams pa dang /des smras pa/ ci byed chos gos dag blangs nas mnyel ⑤bsor gzhug mod/des smras pa/ ma reg shig⑥ /ci'i slad du mkhan pos nga la khyod kyi ⑦sems srungs shig ces bsgo'o⑧/ /des smras pa/ rje'i sras khyod sems srung la ⑨rag mod/ bdag gis tshubakag gam/ ci zhes des de'i chos ⑩gos 8blangs ⑫stan bting ste rkang pa bkrus nas bskus so/ /de nas khrus byas nas zan byin te/de yang de nyid du zan bza' ④bar 'dug pa dang / des smras pa ci byed des smras pa/ rje'i sras khyod dang lhan cig zan zos nas ring mo zhig lon no/ /des smras pa/ mkhan pos nga la khyod kyis sems srungs shig ces bsgo'o8/ /des smras pa/ rje'i sras khyod sems srung la rag mod/ bdag gis bkag gam ci bdag khyod dang lhan cig zan zos nas ring mo zhig lon pas gdon ⑩mi za bar bza'o zhes des de dang lhan cig zan zos so/ /de nas mal bshams nas smras pa/ rje'i sras gzims mal 'dir shul gyis mnyel ba'i mnyel tshusos shig /des rkang pa bkrus nas nyal ba dang / de yang de nyid du nyal bar brtsams so/ /des smras pa ci byed/ des smras pa/ rje'i sras khyod dang lhan cig nyal nas ring mo zhig lags pas ma bkyon 8cig /des smras pa/ mkhan pos nga la khyod kyi yisems srungs shig ces bsgo'o/ /des smras pa/ rje'i sras 18—253

khyod sems srung la rag mod/ bdag gis bkag gam ci/ khyod dang bdag lhan cig nyal nas ring mo zhig lags pas gdon mi za bar nyal bar bgyi'o/ /des ①ma btub pa dang / des bsams pa/ mgul nas 'jus na bdag gi dbang du 'gyur ro snyam nas/ des de'i mgul nas 'jus pa dang / bud med ni reg pa'i dug ②yin pas reg pa tsam gyis log par spyad do/ /dus ring zhig 'dug nas smras pa/ bzang mo 'gro'o/ /des bsams pa/ 'di dang bdag lhan cig gsang ba byas pa gang yin pa de dge slong rnams kyis mi shes pas skye bo ③mang pos shes par bya'o/ /des na de dag gis bskrad pas slar 'ong bar 'gyur ro snyam du bsams nas/ des smras pa/ rje'i sras de bzhin du ji ltar bzhud/ lam rgyags kyi zong kār ṣā pa ṇa dag snoms shig /des smras pa/bzang mo dge slong rnams dbyig la mi reg na ji ltar blang / des smras pa/rje'i sras bdag gis ji ④nas kyang mi reg pa de ltar bgyis ༷snoms shig ces des dbyig thum por bcug nas bcings te/ 'khar gsil ⑥gyi rtsa ba la btags ⑦so/ /dregs pas ldongs ⑧pa dang / sred pas ldongs pa rnams ni mi byed pa cung zad kyang med pas des de khyer te song ba dang / rim gyis mnyan yod du phyin no/ /drug sde rnams kyi kun du spyod pa ni drug sde gang yang rung ⑨ba zhig gis rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi sgo mi stong ⑩pa yin pas tshe dang ldan pa nye dga' bo rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi sgo na 'chag cing 'dug pa des ⑩de thag ring po nas mthong na yispa spra ba'i me tog lta bu smin ma rab tu 'phyang ba zhig nas/des bsams pa/ 'di tsodage slong gnas brtan zhig 'ong gis bsur tso'agro'o zhes de bsur 8song ste/ gnas brtan byon pa legs so/ /byon pa legs so 10—254
