tu nyam nga bar gyur pa'i srog chags kun du tshol ba'i rtsa ba can gyi sdug bsngal don du gnyer ba yongs su tshol ba rnams la yang dang yang du don du gnyer ba la zhen pa ①las 'byung / lus dang sems kyi sdug bsngal drag pa/ rtsub pa/mi bzad pa/ yid du mi 'ong ba/ nad gdung bar byed pa dag skye bar 'gyur te / dga' bo de lta bas na skye ba ni sdug bsngal ba'o/ /rga ba ni sdug bsngal ba'o / /na ba ni sdug bsngal ba'o/ /'chi ba ni sdug bsngal ba'o/ /sdug pa dang bral ba ni sdug bsngal ba'o/ /mi sdug pa dang phrad pa ni sdug bsngal ba'o/ /gang 'dod pa btsal ②te mi rnyed pa de yang sdug bsngal ba'o/ /mdor na nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga sdug bsngal ba'o/ /dga' bo 'chag pa dang / 'dug pa dang / 'greng ba dang / nyal ba'i spyod lam dag kyang so so so sor sdug bsngal bar rig par bya ste/ bsam gtan pas spyod lam de dang / de dag gi rang bzhin ③brtags na/ gal te 'chag pas nyi ma 'da' bar byed cing /'greng bar mi byed/ 'dug par mi byed/ nyal bar mi byed na des 'chag pa de la sdug bsngal kho na so sor myong bar 'gyur zhing / drag pa nyid dang /rtsub pa nyid dang / mi bzad pa nyid dang / yid du ④mi 'ong ba nyid so sor myong bar 'gyur gyi/ 'chag pa de la bde ba'i 'du shes 'byung bar ni mi 'gyur ro / /gal te 'dug pas nyi ma 'da' bar byed cing / 'chag par mi byed/'greng bar mi byed/ nyal bar mi byed na de 'dug pa de la/ sdug bsngal kho na so sor myong bar 'gyur zhing / drag pa nyid dang / rtsub pa nyid dang /mi bzod rjopa nyid dang / yid du mi 'ong ba nyid so sor myong bar 'gyur gyi/'dug pa de la bde ba'i 'du shes 'byung bar ni mi 'gyur ro/ /gal te 'greng 18—356

bas nyi ma 'da' bar byed cing / 'dug par mi byed/ 'chag par mi byed/nyal bar mi byed na des 'greng ba de la sdug bsngal kho na so sor myong bar 'gyur zhing / drag pa nyid dang / rtsub pa nyid dang / mi bzad pa nyid dang / yid du mi 'ong ba nyid dag so sor myong bar 'gyur gyi 'greng ba de la bde ba'i 'du shes 'byung bar ni mi 'gyur ro/ /gal te nyal bas nyi ma 'da' bar byed cing 'chag par mi byed/ 'greng bar mi byed/ 'dug par mi byed na ①des nyal ②ba de la sdug bsngal kho na so sor myong bar 'gyur zhing / drag pa ③nyid dang / rtsub pa nyid dang / mi bzad pa nyid dang / yid du mi 'ong ba nyid so sor myong bar du'agyur gyi/ nyal ba de la bde ba'i 'du shes 'byung bar ni mi 'gyur ro/ /dga' bo 'on kyang spyod lam gyi sdug bsngal de dang de rgyun gcad pa'i phyir sdug bsngal sar pa gzhan dang gzhan du'abyung ba la bde ba'i 'du shes 'byung ste/ dga' bo 'byung ba na yang sdug bsngal 'di kho na 'byung la/'gag pa na yang sdug bsngal kho na 'gag /'byung ba na yang 'du byed dag nyid 'byung la/ 'gag pa na yang 'du byed dag nyid 'gag go/ /de bzhin gshegs pas ni 'du byed rnams kyi rgyud nying mtshams sbyor ba thugs su chud nas sems can rnams kyi 'chi 'pho dang skye ba bka' stsal to/ /dga' bo 'du byed thams cad ni mi rtag pa/ mi brtan pa/ 'du byed thams cad ni dbugs mi phyin pa/ rnam par 'gyur ba'i chos can no/ /dga' bo de lta bas na 'du byed thams cad la yid byung bar bya ba'i rigs spangs pa rjodang / rnam par grol bar bya ba'i rigs so/ /dga' bo bde 'gro'i 'gro ba'o snyam pa'i 'du shes can gang yin pa de dag na yang shin tu mi bzad pa/ 'jigs su rung ba/10—357

smad pa/ brjod dka' ba de lta bu dang / slu ba de lta bu dang / sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa de lta bu 'byung na/ dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi ①dgas kyi yul du skyes pa rnams la lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ de dag gi sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa ni 'di 'dra'o zhes dpe bstan par yang shin tu dka'o/ /dga' bo mngal du 'jug pa ni bzhi ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di na la la shes bzhin du ma'i mngal du 'jug /shes bzhin du ma'i mngal na gnas/ shes bzhin du ma'i mngal nas 'byung ste/ 'di ni mngal du 'jug pa dang po'o/ /dga' bo gzhan yang 'di na la la ⑤shes bzhin du ma'i mngal du 'jug /shes bzhin du ma'i mngal na gnas shing shes bzhin ma yin par ma'i mngal nas 'byung ste/'di ni mngal du 'jug pa gnyis pa'o/ /dga' bo gzhan yang 'di na la la shes bzhin du ma'i mngal du 'jug cing / shes bzhin ma yin par ma'i mngal na gnas / shes bzhin ma yin par ma'i mngal nas 'byung ste/ 'di ni mngal du 'jug pa gsum pa'o/ /dga' bo gzhan yang 'di na la la shes bzhin ②ma yin par ma'i mngal du 'jug /shes bzhin ma yin par ma'i mngal dun gnas/shes bzhin ma yin par ma'i mngal nas 'byung ste/ 'di ni mngal du 'jug pa bzhi pa'o/ /ji ltar na 'di shes bzhin du ma'i mngal du 'jug /shes bzhin du ma'i mngal na gnas/ shes bzhin du duma'i mngal nas 'byung zhe na/ 'di na ༷la la so so'i skye bo nyid yin la ⑦rang bzhin gyis tshul khrims dang ldan par gyur ⑤cing / dge ba'i chos can/ dge ba la 'dun pa/ dge ba kun du spyod pa/ sdom pa mang ba so sor rtog pa mang ba/ bag yod par gnas pa/shes rab chen po can yin zhing / de 'gyod pa med par ramal/ rgyun du 10—358

zhugs pa de ①ltar thogs na srid pa ②lan bdun pa'am/ rigs nas rigs su skye ba'am/ lan gcig phyir 'ong ba'am/ bar chad gcig pa zhig 'chi ba'i dus byed na dge ba'i chos de dag gis nye bar brtan pa de 'chi ma'i ②sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba drag pa/ rtsub pa/ mi bzad pa/ yid du mi 'ong ba/ srog 'phrog par byed pa ①dag gis kun du reg kyang dran pa nyams par mi 'gyur zhing /de dran pa ma ⑤nyams par 'chi ba'i dus byed deX/ de nas de dran pa ma nyams par shes bzhin du ma'i mngal du 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /de der zhugs nas las bdag gir bya ba/ las kyi ⑦skye gnas pa/ las kyi bgo skal la spyod pa/las la brten ⑧pa/ sems pas ⑨byas pa/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba de phug rab tu tsha ba/ las bdag gir bya ba/ las kyi bgo skal la spyod pa/las la rton pa/ sems pas byas pa/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba/bdud la rag las pa/ bdud kyi snod bdud kyi khyim/ mi gtsang ba thams cad kyi gter/ mi brtan pa/ slu ba'i chos can byis pa 'drid pa/ rus pa'i 'khrul 'khor rtsa'i breng 0chags pa can/ chu rgyus kyi dra bas che yilong sbrel ba / sha dang / khrag dang / tshil gyis dkris pa/ pags pa tsam gyis g.yogs pa/ sla tsha'i tsotshogs bcer 0ba skra dang sen mo dang / so dang /spu skye bar 8'gyur bar mngon pa can nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal ngar 'dzin pa dang /nga yir (ge'adzin pa/ gsal bas mngon par zhen pa/ rang dbang med pa/snabs 0rul pa'i rlan sungs shing myags pa dang ⑩/ tshil dang / chu ser dang /rngul gyi dri ma dang / kha chu dang / mkhris pa dang / bad kun dang / glo ba dang / rgyu ma dang / gnye ma dang / mcher 8pa dang / lgang pa dang /10—359

mi gtsang ba rnam pa mang pos yongs su gang ba/ srin bu'i rigs stong phrag mang po'i gnas shin tu dri nga ba'i sgo gnyis dang ldan pa/ rus pa'i bu ga dang /khung bu phug du ma dang ldan pa/ gcin dang / klad ①pa dang / klad ②rgyas dang /rkang gi tshogs kyi ②ldan ljin can du pho ba'i 'og long ku'i 0steng na kha ni sgal tshigs la bltasaX/ rgyab ni lto ba'i pags pa la bstan te/ zla ba re re zhing zla mtshan 'byung bas ni brta duma'i zas kyi rnam pa so'i phreng ba gnyis kyis zhib mor byas shing mid par mid pa/ 'og nas kha'i rdzirma'i dri ma dang kha chus brlan pa steng nas klad nirgyas kyis sbags pa/ skyugs ⑨pa dang 'dra ba'i zas kyi ro khong na lte ba'i bu ga nas 'jug pas ni skyed cing / nur nur po dang mer mer po dang / nar nar po dang / gor gor po dang / rkang lag 'gyus pa'i ngo bor yongs su 'gyur bar 'gyur zhing / lag pa dang / rkang pa dang /'gram pa ni sha ⑩ma'i snod kyis dkris/ snam phyis bzhin du dri nga ba mnam pa mi bzad pa/ mun gnag 'greng bar ⑩ni yan man rgyu/ zas kyi ro kha ba dang /skyur ba dang / rtsub ⑩pa dang / lan tshwa dang / tsha ba dang / bska ba me ⑫stag lta bu dag gis ni reg /srin grol ma bzhin mi gtsang ba'i khu bas ni gso/mi gtsang ba 0myags pa rab tu 'bar ba'i 'dam gyi nang du ni song / srog gi dbang po ni mi brtan/ ma'i lus kyi nang gi mes ni kun nas tsogadung / kun du gdung / yongs su gdung / tsha kun du tsha/ yongs su tsha/ sreg skyakun du sregatso /yongs su sreg 8cing sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba chen po drag pa/ rtsub pa / mi bzad pa/ yid du mi 'ong ba myong bar 'gyur ro/ /ji lta ji ltar de'i ma g.yo ba dang / kun du g.yo ba dang / yongs su g.yo ba dang khur lci ba khyer ram/10wa 360

lus 'phyang ba ①de lta de ltar yang de bcing ba ②lngas bcings ①pa dang / me ma myur gyi dong du bcug pa lta bur sdug bsngal gyi tshor ④ba chen po drag pa/rtsub pa/ mi bzad pa/ yid du mi 'ong ba/ dpe bya bar dka' ⑤ba myong bar 'gyur ro/ /de de ltar ma'i mngal gyi gnas na gnas shing sdug bsngal gyis nyen kyang dbang po rno ba'i phyir dran pa nyams par mi 'gyur ro/ /de ltar ma'i mngal na gnas pa rnams la yang kha cig la sngon gyi las kyi rgyu dang rkyen gyi dbang gis mngal log par 'gyur zhing / mngal na gnas pa la ⑥mi bde bar 'gyur ro/ /mas bza' ba dang btung ba mi mthun pa ha cang grang ba'am/ ha cang dro ba'am/ha cang skyur bo'am/ ha cang mngar ba'am/ ha cang kha ba'am/ ha cang tsha ba'amatshul/ ha cang bska ⑧ba'am/ ha cang rtsub pa'am/ ha cang lan tshwa che ba bsten pa'amal/ btung bas mus 0byung bar gyur pa'am/ skyes pas mus ⑪byung bar gyur pa'am/ nad mang ba'am/ smra 8ba mang ba'am/ mya ngan mang ba'am / chags ches pa'am/ skyel ba'am/ brgyab par gyur na rgyu de dag gis de'i lus la gnod par 'gyur ro/ /lus la gnod na de la brten pa mngal na gnas pa la yang gnod par 'gyur ro/ /de de na gnod cing shin tu sdug bsngal bas nyen pa na 'gul te 'gul bas log par 'gyur ro/ /de nas ⑫de shes pa'i bud med dam/ gzhon nu gso ba la mkhas pas chu 'jam tsam dang /mar dkar dang / 'bru mar gyis lag pa byugs ④nas chab khung tsos lta bur dri nga ba/ mnam pa/ mi bzad pa/ mun gnagatso /ljan ljin gyi 'dam can/srin bu'i rigs rngustong phrag shin tu mang po'i gnas rtag tu 'dzag pa/ rgyun du byi dor bya dgos pa/ btsog 8pa/ khrag gi dri ma dang / chu ser kun du rul/10—361

rnam par rul cing myags pa can/ 'dred ①pa mthong na shin tu 'jigs su rung ba/ bu ga'i pags pas g.yogs pa/ rus pa'i 'khrul 'khor chen po'i bu ga der lag pa bcug ste/ dal bu dal bus mnams shing gnas ji lta ba bzhin du 'jog par byed do/ /de der chu 'jam tsam dang / mar dkar dang /'bru ②mar gyis byugs pa'i lag pas mnams shing cham du 'bebs pa na sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba chen po drag pa/ rtsub pa/ mi bzad pa/ yid du mi 'ong ba myong bar 'gyur ro/ /dga' bo dper na rigs kyi bu shin tu gzhon nu'i rang bzhin can gyi ③lus la spu gri rnon po spu breg tu rung bas yan lag dang nying lag thams cad bcad cing / lus rtsi drag pos kun nas bskus na lus la sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba chen po shin tu drag pa/ rtsub pa/ mi bzad pa/ yid du mi 'ong ba 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dga' bo de bzhin du de la chu 'jam tsam dang / mar dkar dang / til mar gyis byugs pa'i lag pas mnams ④na lus la sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba chen po drag pa/ rtsub pa mi bzad pa/ yid du mi 'ong ba 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mngal gyi gnas na gnas pa de'i lus la sdug bsngal gyi reg pa las byung ba'i sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba chen po drag pa/ rtsub pa/mi bzad pa/ yid du mi 'ong ba de dag byung yang dbang po rno ba'i phyir dran ⑤pa nyams par mi 'gyur te/ de ltar na de shes bzhin du ma'i mngal na gnas pa yin no/ /de nas de yan lag dang nying lag thams cad skyes nas gcin gyi gnas rul ba/ ltung ba/ 'greng ba/ mi bzad pa⑥/ dri nga ba/ mnam pa / mun gnag⑦ /mthong na shin tu 'jigs su rung ba/ phyi sa dang /gcin gyis bsgos pa/ dri mi zhim pa'i dri ma dang / khrag dang chu ser can 10—362

rtag tu 'dzag pa'i rma'i sgor sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pa las skyes pa'i rlung gis rkang pa ni gyen du bstan/ mgo ni thur ①du bstan/ lag pa gnyis ni bskums pa na rus pa'i 'khrul 'khor gnyis kyis gzir/ kun du gzir/yongs su gzir cing / sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba chen po drag pa/ rtsub pa/ mi bzad pa/ yid du mi 'ong ba dag gis lus kyi yan lag rma sar pa lta bu gze ②re can thams cad sngon por 'gyur rgyal/ lus kyi dbang po thams cad ni tsha/mngal gyi dri ma shin tu btsog pas ni lus yogadu /skom pas chu rjodang mgrin pa dang snying ni skams ༷te/ dog pa dang nyam nga bas mi bzad par gnas pa de rgyu dang rkyen gyi dbang gis sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pa las skyes pa'i ①rlung gis phul ba na dka' dka' ltar ji zhig lta ste 'byung ngo / /de byung ma thag tu phyi rol gyi rlung rma la rtsi drag po'i rig pa can lta bu'am/ lag pa'am/ gos kyis ⑧reg na ral gris bcad pa bzhin du sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba chen po drag pa/ rtsub pa mi bzad pa/ yid du mi 'ong ba myong bar 'gyur ro/ /de sdug bsngal de lta bus nyen kyang dbang po rno ba'i phyir dran pa nyams par mi 'gyur te/ de ltar na de shes bzhin du ma'i mngal nas 'byung ba yin no/ /dga' bo de ltar na ma'i mngal du 'jug pa yang sdug bsngal bal/ gnas pa yang sdug bsngal ba ⑩ma'i mngal nas 'byung ba yang sdug bsngal ba yin na/ dga' bo de la srid pa mngon par 'dod pa ma'i mngal gyi gnas na gnas pa la mnog yici zhig yod/ ji ltar na 'di shes bzhin du ma'i mngal du 'jug /shes bzhin du ma'i mngal du gnas shing shes bzhin du tsom yin par ma'i mngal nas 'byung zhe na/ 'di na la la so so'i skye bo nyid yin la/ rang bzhin gyis 8tshul khrims dang ldan par 10—363

gyur cing / dge ba'i chos can/ dge ba la 'dun pa/ dge ba kun du spyod pa / sdom pa mang ba/ so sor rtog pa mang ba/ bag yod par gnas pa yin zhing 'gyod pa med pa'am/ rgyun du zhugs pa de ①ltar thogs na srid pa lan bdun pa'am/ rigs nas rigs su skye ba'am/ lan gcig phyir 'ong ba'am / bar chad gcig pa zhig 'chi ba'i dus byed na dge ba'i chos de dag gis nye bar brtan pa/ de 'chi ku'i ②sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba drag pa/ rtsub pa/mi bzad pa/ yid du mi 'ong ba/ srog 'phrog par byed pa dag gis reg kyang dran pa nyams par mi 'gyur zhing de dran pa ma nyams par 'chi ba'i dus byed de/de canas de dran pa ma nyams par shes bzhin du ma'i mngal du 'jug go/ /de der zhugs nas las bdag gir bya ba zhes bya ba nas/ srin grol ma bzhin du khu bas ni gso/ mi gtsang ba myags ①pa rab tu 'bar ba'i 'dam gyi nang du ni song / srog gi dbang po ni mi brtan/ ma'i lus kyi nang gi mes ni kun nas gdung zhes bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin no/ /sreg /kun du sreg /yongs su sreg cing / sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba chen po drag pa/ rtsub pa/ mi bzad pa yid du mi 'ong ba myong 0bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba nas/ ji lta ji ltar de'i ma g.yo ba dang / kun du g.yo ba dang / yongs su g.yo ba de lta de ltar yang de bcing ba lngas bcings pa dang / me ma mur gyi dong du bcug pa lta bur sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba chen po drag pa/ rtsub pa/ mi bzad pa yid du mi 'ong ba/dpe bya bar dka' ba myong bar 'gyur ro/ /de de ltar ma'i mngal gyi gnas na gnas shing sdug bsngal gyis 0nyen kyang dran pa nyams par mi 'gyur roX/ /de ltar ma'i mngal na gnas pa rnams la yang kha cig la sngon gyi las kyi rgyu dang rkyen 10—364

gyi dbang gis mngal log par 'gyur zhing mngal na gnas pa la ①mi bde bar 'gyur ro/ /mas bza' ba dang / btung ba mi mthun pa ha cang grang ba'am / ha cang dro ba'am zhes bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin no/ /chags ches pa'am / sgyel ba'am/ brgyab ②par gyur na rgyu de dag gis de'i lus la gnod par 'gyur ro/ /lus la gnod na de la rten pa mngal na gnas pa la yang gnod par 'gyur rol/ /de de na gnod cing shin tu ④sdug bsngal bas nyen pa na 'gul te 'gul ⑤bas log par 'gyur ro/ /de nas de shes pa'i bud med dam/ gzhon nu gso ba la mkhas pas chu 'jam tsam dang / mar dkar dang 'bru mar gyis ⑥lag pa byugs nas zhes bya ba nas/ mnams shing gnas ji lta ba bzhin du 'jog par byed do ⑦zhes bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin no/ /de der chu 'jam tsam dang / mar dkar dang / 'bru mar gyis byugs pa'i lag pas mnams pa na sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba chen po drag pa/ rtsub pa mi bzad ⑧pa/ yid du mi 'ong ba myong bar 'gyur ro/ /dga' bo dper na rigs kyi bu shin tu gzhon nu'i rang bzhin can gyi lus la spu gri rnon po spu breg tu rung bas yan lag dang / nying lag thams cad bcad cing lus la rtsi drag pos kun nas bskus na lus la sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba chen po drag pa/ rtsub pa mi bzad pa ⑨yid du mi 'ong ba myong bar 'gyur ro// // 'dul ba phran tshegs kyi gzhi0/ bam po bcu gsum pa/ dga' bo de bzhin du de la chu 'jam tsam dang / mar dkar dang / 'bru mar gyis ⑪bskus pa'i lag pas mnams pa na lus la sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba chen po drag pa/rtsub pa mi bzad pa yid du mi 'ong ba 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mngal gyi gnas 10—365

na gnas pa de'i lus la sdug bsngal gyi reg pa las byung ba'i sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba chen po drag ①pa/ rtsub pa mi bzad pa/ yid du mi 'ong ba de dag byung yang dran pa nyams ②par ni mi 'gyur te/ de ltar na 'di shes bzhin du ma'i mngal na gnas pa yin nol/ /de nas de yan lag dang nying lag thams cad skyes nas gcin gyi gnas rul ba/ ltung ba 'gred pa/ mi bzad pa dudri nga ba/ mnam pa/ mun gnag dumathong na 'jigs su rung ba/ phyi sa dang /gcin gyis bsgos pa/ dri mi zhim pa'i dri ma dang / khrag dang chu ser can durtag tu 'dzag pa'i rma'i sgor sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pa las skyes pa'i rlung gis rkang pa ni gyen du bstan/ mgo ni thur du bstan/ lag pa gnyis ni bskums pa na rus pa'i 'khrul 'khor gnyis kyis gzir kun ⑦du gzir/ yongs su gzir cing / sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba chen po drag pa/ rtsub pa/ mi bzad pal/ yid du mi 'ong ba dag gis lus ①kyi yan lag rma sar pa lta bu gze tshure can yithams cad sngon por gyur tshul/ lus kyi dbang po thams cad ni tsha8/ mngal gyi dri ma shin tu btsog ④pas ni lus g.yogs/ skom 8pas mchu dang / mgrin pa dang / snying ni bskams 8te/ de ⑩dog pa nyam tsong bas mi bzad par tsoganas pa de ⑥ rgyu dang rkyen gyi dbang gis sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pa las skyes pa'i rlung gis phul ba na dka' 0dka' ltar ji zhig lta ste 'byung ngo / /de byung ma thag tu phyi 3rol gyi rlung durma la rtsi drag po'i reg pa can lta bu'am/ lag pa'am/ gos kyis reg na ral gris bcad pa bzhin du sdug bsngal gyi tshor ④ba chen po drag pa/ rtsub pa mi bzad pa/ yid du mi 'ong ba myong bar 'gyur ro/ /de sdug bsngal de lta bus nyen na dbang po 'bring po yin 10—366

pa'i phyir dran pa nyams pa dang / sems nye bar nyams par 'gyur te/ de ltar na de shes bzhin ma yin par ma'i mngal nas 'byung ba yin no/ /dga' bo de ltar na ma'i mngal du 'jug pa yang sdug bsngal ba/ ma'i mngal na gnas pa yang sdug bsngal ba/ ma'i mngal nas 'byung ba yang sdug bsngal ba yin na①/dga' bo de la srid pa 'dod pa ma'i mngal gyi gnas na gnas pa la mnog ②ci zhig yod/ ji ltar na ②'di shes rjobazhin du ma'i mngal du 'jug cing shes bzhin ma yin par ma'i mngal na gnas/ shes bzhin ma yin par ma'i mngal nas 'byung zhe na/ 'di na dul la so so'i skye bo kho na rang bzhin gyis tshul khrims dang ldan par gyur cing / dge ba'i chos can yidage ba la 'dun pa/dge ba kun tu spyod pa/ sdom pa mang ba/ so sor rtog pa mang ba/ bag yod par gnas pa/ 'gyod pa med pa'am/ rgyun du zhugs pa de ⑦ltar thogs na srid pa lan bdun pa'am/ rigs nas rigs su skye ba'am/ lan gcig phyir 'ong ba'am/ bar chad gcig pa zhig 'chi ba'i dus byed na dge ba'i chos de dag gi 2nye bar brtan pa de 'chi ku'i 0sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba drag pa rtsub pa/mi bzad pa/ yid du mi 'ong ba srog 'phrog par byed pa dag gis reg kyang dran pa nyams par mi 'gyur zhing de dran pa ma nyams par 'chi ba'i dus byed de/ de nas de dran pa ma nyams par ⑩shes bzhin du ma'i mngal du 'jug go/ /de der zhugs yinas las bdag gir bya ba las kyi skye gnas pa/ las kyi bgo skal la spyod pa/ las la rton pa/ sems pas byas pa/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba de phug rab tu tsha ba/ las bdag gir bya ba/ las kyi bgo skal la spyod pa/ las la rton pa/ sems pas byas pa/ rten cing 'brel par 10—367

'byung ba/ bdud la rag las pa/ bdud kyi snod/ bdud kyi khyim mi gtsang ba thams cad kyi gter/ mi brtan pa/ slu ba'i chos can/ byis pa 'drid pa/ rus pa'i 'khrul 'khor/ rtsa'i labreng chags pa can/ chu rgyus kyi dra bas che long sbrel ba/ sha dang khrag dang tshil gyis dkris pa/ pags pa tsam gyis g.yogs pa/ sla tsha'i ④tshogs bcer ba/ spa dang sen mo dang / so dang / spu skye bar ②'gyur bar mngon pa can/ nga'o ④snyam pa'i nga rgyal/ngar 'dzin pa dang / nga yir 'dzin pa gsal bas mngon par zhen pa/ rang dbang med pa/ snabs rul pa'i rlan sungs shing ⑤phyags pa dang / tshil ⑥dang / chu ser dang / rngul gyi dri ma dang / khu ༅chu dang / mkhris pa dang /bad kun dang / glo ba dang / rgyu ma dang / gnye ma dang / mcher ⑤pa dang / lgang pa dang / mi gtsang ba rnam pa mang pos yongs su gang ba/srin bu'i rigs stong phrag mang po'i gnas/ shin tu dri nga ba'i sgo gnyis dang ldan pa/ rus pa'i bu ga dang khung bu'i phug du ma dang ldan pa/ gcin dang /klad ⑨pa dang / klad ⑨ rgyas dang / rkang gi tshogs kyi ljan ljin can du pho ba'i 'og long ku'i steng yin kha ni sgal tshigs la bltasatso/ rgyab ni lto'i pags ⑫pa la bstan te/ zla ba re re zhing zla mtshan 'byung bas ni brta ④ma'i zas kyi rnam pa so'i phreng ba gnyis kyis zhib mor byas shing mid par mid pa/ 'og nas kha'i rma'i dri ma dang / kha chus brlan pa/ steng nas klad 8rgyas kyis spags pa/skyugs ⑩pa dang 'dra ⑩ba'i zas kyi ros khong na lte ba'i bu ga nas 'jug pas ni skyed 8cing nur nur po dang / mer mer po dang / nar nar po dang / gor gor po dang / rkang lag 'gyus pa'i ngo bor yongs su 'gyur bar ⑩'gyur zhing 10—368

lag pa dang / rkang pa dang / 'gram pa ni sha ma'i sno da kyis dkris snam phyi sa bzhin du dri nga ba/ mnam pa/ mi bzad pa/ mun gnag 'gred ①par ni yan man rgyu/ zas kyi ro kha ba dang / skyur ba dang / rtsub ②pa dang /lan tshwa dang / tsha ba dang / bska ③ba me stag lta bu rjo dag gis ⑤ni reg /srin grol ma bzhin mi gtsang ba'i khu bas ni gso/ mi gtsang ba myags pa rab tu 'bar ba'i 'dam gyi nang du ni song / srog gi dbang po ni mi brtan/ ma'i lus kyi nang gi mes ni kun nas ⑥gdung / kun tu gdung / yongs su gdung /tsha kun tu tsha/ yongs su tsha/ sreg kun tu sreg /yongs su sreg cing /sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba chen po drag pa/ rtsub pa/ mi bzad pa/ yid du mi 'ong ba myong bar 'gyur ro/ /ji lta ji ltar de'i ma g.yo ba dang / kun tu g.yo ba dang ⑦/ yongs su g.yo ba dang / khur lci ba khyer ⑤ram/ lus 'phyang ⑨ba de lta de ltar yang de bcing ba 0lngas bcings pa dang / me ma mur gyi dong du bcug pa lta bur sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba chen po drag pa/ rtsub pa/ mi bzad pa/yid du mi 'ong ba dpe bya bar dka' ba myong bar 'gyur ro/ /de de ltar ma'i mngal gyi gnas na gnas shing sdug bsngal gyis nyen pa na dran pa nyams par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar ma'i mngal na gnas pa rnams la yang kha cig la sngon gyi las kyi rgyu dang rkyen gyi dbang gis mngal log par 'gyur zhing mngal na gnas pa la mi bde bar 'gyur ro/ /mas bza' ba dang btung ⑩ba mi mthun pa ha cang grang ba'am/ ha cang dro ba'am zhes bya ba nas chags ches pa'am/ sgyel ba'am/brgyab par gyur na rgyu de dag gis de'i lus la gnod par 'gyur ro/ /lus la gnod na de la brten pa mngal na gnas pa la yang gnod par 'gyur ro/ /zhes 10—369

bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin no/ /de de nas log par 'gyur te/ de nas de shes pa'i bud med dam/ gzhon nu gso ba la mkhas pas chu 'jam tsam dang /mar dkar ①dang / 'bru mar gyis lag pa byugs pas mnams shing cham du 'bebs par byed do/ /de der chu 'jam ⑤tsam dang / mar dkar dang /'bru mar gyis byugs pa'i lag pas cham du 'bebs pa na sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba chen po drag pa/ rtsub pa/ mi bzad pa/ yid du mi 'ong ba myong bar 'gyur rol/ /dga' bo dper na rigs kyi bu shin tu gzhon nu'i rang bzhin can gyi lus la spu gri rnon po/ spu breg ①tu rung bas yan lag dang nying lag thams cad bcad cing / lus rtsi drag pos kun nas bskus na lus la sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba chen po drag pa/ rtsub pa/ mi bzad pa/ yid du mi 'ong ba 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dga' bo de bzhin du mngal na gnas pa de la chu 'jam tsam dang /mar dkar ④dang / 'bru mar gyis bskus pa'i lag pas mnams na lus la sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba chen po drag pa/ rtsub pa/ mi bzad pa/ yid du mi 'ong ba 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mngal gyi gnas na gnas pa de'i lus la dusdug bsngal gyi reg pa las byung ba'i sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba chen po drag pa/ rtsub pa mi bzad pa/ yid du mi 'ong ba de dag byung na dbang po rtul ba'i phyir dran pa nyams par 'gyur zhing sems nye bar nyams par 'gyur te/ de ltar na de rjoshes bzhin du ma'i mngal du 'jug cing shes bzhin ma ⑦yin par ma'i mngal na gnas pa yin/ shes bzhin ma yin par ma'i mngal nas 'byung ba yin no/ /dga' bo de ltar ⑧ma'i mngal du 'jug pa yang sdug bsngal ba/ ma'i mngal na gnas pa yang 0sdug bsngal ba/ ma'i mngal nas 'byung ba yang sdug ⑩bsngal ba 18—370

yin na/ dga' bo de la 'khor ba na ⑨srid pa mngon par 'dod pa ma'i mngal gyi gnas na gnas pa la mnog ci zhig yod/ ji ltar na 'di shes bzhin ma yin par ma'i mngal du 'jug /shes bzhin ma yin par ma'i mngal na gnas/shes bzhin ma yin par ma'i mngal nas 'byung zhe na/ 'di na la la rang bzhin kho nas tshul khrims 'chal pa yin zhing mi dge ba'i chos can/ mi dge ba la 'dun pa/ mi dge ba kun tu spyod pa/ sdom pa ma yin pa mang ba so sor rtog pa med pa mang ba/ bag med par gnas pa/ yo byad kun tu 'dzin pa/ser sna can/ 'jungs pa/ brnab ②sems can/ gnod sems can/log par lta ba/ 'gyod ②pa can yin la/ 'chi ba'i dus byed na mi ④dge ba'i chos de dag gis nye bar brtan pa de 'chi ku'i ⑤sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba 0drag pa / rtsub ⑦pa/ mi bzad pa/ yid du mi 'ong ba/ srog 'phrog par byed pa de dudag gis reg na/ dran pa nyams par 'gyur zhing sems nye bar nyams par 'gyur te/ de ⑨na sdug bsngal du ro gcig pa'i rnam par shes pa can ⑩'di gang yin/ 'di ji lta bu yin/ bdag gang yin/ gang nas shi 'phos gang nas 'ongs/ gang du skye zhes bya ba mi shes te/ de ltar na 'di shes bzhin ma yin 0par ma'i mngal du 'jug /shes bzhin ma yin par ma'i mngal na gnas/ shes bzhin ma yin par ma'i mngal nas 'byung ba yin no/ /dga' bo de ltar na ma'i mngal du 'jug pa yang sdug bsngal ba/ ma'i mngal na gnas pa yang sdug bsngal ba/ ma'i mngal nas 'byung ba yang sdug bsngal ba yin na 'daga' bo de la 'khor ba na yang srid pa la mngon par dga' ba de ltar sdug bsngal du mas nyen pa la mnog ci zhig yod/ dga' bo skye ba de ni de ltar 18—371

sdug bsngal du mas gtses par gyur pa yin yang mi nyid ni bskal pa ①bye ba brgya stong du yang rnyed par dka'o/ /dga' bo lha ②dag 'chi 'pho ba na lha gzhan dag kye bde 'gro'i 'jig rten du song la rab tu brtan par so sor gnos ②shig ces skul bar byed do/ /dga' bo lha rnams kyi bde 'gro'i 'jig rten gang zhe na/mir skye ba yin te/ de ltar shin tu rnyed par dka'o/ /de lta bas na rjodal ba phun sum tshogs pa shin tu rnyed par dka'o/ /sems can dmyal ba rnams ni gcig tu sdug bsngal ba dang / gcig tu drag pa dang / gcig tu rtsub pa dang / gcig tu mi ⑤bzad pa dang / gcig tu yid du mi 'ong ba ste/dga' bo de ni ⑤sdug bsngal gyi dpe yang bya bar mi nus so/ /yi dgas rnams ⑦ni gnod sems can/ sems nyon mongs pa ⑤can/ sems 'jam pa ma yin pa / g.yo dang sgyu ⑨yod pa/ rtsub pa/ 'tshe ba/ lag pa khrag gis gsher ba / yid du mi 'ong ba/ sgrib pa can/ gcer bu/ gzugs mi sdug pa/'jigs su rung ba/ bkres pa dang ⑩/ skom pa'i sdug bsngal gyis nyen pa yin no/ /lha rnams ni 'chi 'pho ba dang / ltung ba dang / rnam par 'gyur ba dme / sdug pa dang 'bral ba'i sdug bsngal dang / mya ngan gyi chos can rtag tu 'jigs pa yin no/ /dud 'gro'i skye gnas pa'i sems can ni mtha' med na dga' bo de na don spyod pa ma yin/ bsod nams spyod pa ma yin/chos spyod pa ma yin/ dge ba spyod pa ma yin/ dge legs spyod pa ma yin gyiyi/gcig la gcig za bar byed pa ste/ sems can de dag ni ji ltar mthu chung ba za bar 8byed pa'o/ /dga' bo dud 'gro rnams kyi nang du skyes pa'i sems can dag la gang dag mun par skyes shing timun par rgas/ mun par 'chi ba'i 10—372

dus byed pa dag kyang yod do/ /de dag kyang gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/sbur ba dang / phye ma leb dang / sbrang bu mchu rings ①dang / zas su til gyi phub ma za ba dang / srin bu ṣ+ṭṛ ②ma bu ka chadang / srin bu tre+e ④la ta dang /gzhan yang sems can mun par skyes shing mun par rgas⑤/ mun par 'chi ba'i dus byed pa gang dag yin pa'o/ /de la byis pa so so'i skye bo thos pa dang mi ldan pa / sngon ro la lhag par chags pa/ lus kyis nyes par spyod pa spyad cing ngag dang yid kyis nyes par spyod pa spyad nas sems can de lta bu rnams dang skal ba mnyam par skye bar 'gyur te/ sems can de dag ni mun par skyes shing ⑥mun par rgas mun par 'chi ba'i dus byed par 'gyur ro/ /dga' bo dud 'gro ⑦rnams kyi nang du skyes pa'i sems can dag la gang dag lus las skye zhing lus la ⑤rgas / lus la ⑨'chi ba'i dus byed pa dag kyang yod do/ /de dag kyang tshugang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sro ma dang / shig dang srin bu g.yon can dang /'bu (spredang / gzhan yang sems can lus las 6)skyes shing lus la tu)rgas/lus la ④'chi ba'i dus byed pa gang dag yin ④pa'o/ /de la byis pa so so'i skye bo thos pa dang mi ldan pa sngon ro'i rjes su chags pa/ lus kyis nyes par spyod pa spyad cing ngag dang yid kyis nyes par spyod pa spyad nas sems can de lta bu dag dang skal ba mnyam ⑩par skye bar 'gyur te/ sems can de dag ni lus las skye zhing lus la ⑩rgyas/ lus la 8'chi ba'i dus byed par 'gyur ro/ /dga' bo dud 'gro rnams kyi nang du skyes pa'i sems can dag la gang dag chur skyes shing chur rgas/ chur 'chi ba'i dus byed pa dag kyang yod do/ /de dag kyang gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ nya dang ru 7sbal dang / sbal pa dang / chu srin byis chi 10—373

pa gsod dang / srog chags ba lu ka dang / gzhan yang sems can chur skyes shing chur rgas/ chur 'chi ba'i dus byed pa gang dag yin pa'o/ /de la byis pa so ①so'i skye bo thos pa dang mi ldan pa sngon ro'i rjes su chags pa/ lus kyis nyes par spyod pa spyad cing ngag dang yid kyis nyes par spyod pa spyad nas sems can de lta bu rnams dang skal ba mnyam par skye bar 'gyur te/ sems can de dag ni chur skyes shing chur rgas/ chur 'chi ba'i dus byed do/ /dga' bo dud 'gro rnams kyi nang du skyes pa'i sems can dag la gang dag bshang ba dang gci ba'i dri tshor nas 'di bza'o 'di btung ngo snyam zhing der rgyug /kun tu rgyug pa dag kyang yod do/ /de dag kyang gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ ra dang lug dang /bya gag dang / phag dang / khyi dang / wa dang / bya rog dang / chun ②lag dang / sbrang ①bu dang / gzhan yang sems can bshang ba dang / gci rjoba'i dri tshor nas 'di bza'o 'di btung ngo snyam zhing der rgyug /kun tu rgyug pa gang dag yin pa'o/ /de la byis pa so so'i skye bo thos pa dang mi ldan pa/ sngon dri'i ⑤rjes su chags pa/ lus kyis nyes par spyod pa spyad cing ngag dang yid kyis nyes par spyod pa spyad nas sems can de ⑥de lta bu rnams dang skal ba mnyam par skye bar 'gyur te⑦/ sems can de dag ni bshang ba dang gci ba'i dri tshor nas 'di bza'o 'di btung ngo snyam zhing rgyug /kun tu rgyug par 'gyur rol/ /dga' bo dud 'gro rnams kyi nang du skyes pa'i sems can dag la gang dag rtswa skam po dang / gsher ba lce'i rtse mos bsdus nas so'i skam pas bcad de za ba dag kyang yod do/ /de dag kyang gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ glang po che dang / rta dang / rnga mo dang / ba lang dang / bong bu dang / ri dgas 10—374

dang / ma he dang / phag rgod dang / gzhan yang sems can rtswa ①skam po dang / gsher ba lce'i rtse mos bsdus nas so'i skam pas bcad de za ba gang dag yin pa'o/ /dga' bo 'khor ba ni bzang ②chag pa shin tu bzang rgyarlag pa ste/'di thams cad ni 'bar/ kun tu 'bar kun tu rab tu 'bar zhing me lce gcig tu gyur pa yin no/ /dga' bo gzhan yang thams cad ni mig dang /rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid dang / gzugs rnams dang / sgra dang dri dang / ro dang / reg bya dang / chos rnams sorjo//dga' bo de thams cad gang gis kun tu 'bar/ rab tu 'bar/ kun tu rab tu 'bar zhing me lce gcig tu gyur pa yin zhe na/ 'dod chags kyi me dang du/zhe sdang gi me dang / gti mug gi mes kyang kun tu 'bar kun tu rab tu 'bar zhing me lce gcig tu gyur pa yinadu/ skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang /'chi ba dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa rnams kyis kyang kun tu 'bar sdug bsngal gyis kyang kun tu 'bar ro zhes bshad do/ /dga' bo le lo can sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos kun nas nyon mongs par byed pa/ yang srid pa pa⑦/ rnam par smin pa sdug bsngal ba can/ tshe phyi ma la skye ba dang / rga ba dang / 'chi bar 'gyur ba dag dang / 'dres pa can ni sdug bsngal bar gnas so/ /dga' bo brtson 'grus brtsams pa/ mthu dang ldan pa/ brtson 'grus dang ldan pa/ spro ⑧ba can/ pha rol gnon ⑨pa brtan pa/ nem nur med pa/dge ba'i chos rnams la brtson pa ma btang ba ni bde bar gnas so/ /dga' bo de lta bas na 'di ltar bslab par bya ste/ pags pa dang / chu rgyus dang /10—375

rus pa tsam lus kyang rung / lus las sha dang khrag dag skams ①kyang bla 'on kyang kye ma brtson 'grus brtsams pa mthu dang ldan pa/ brtson 'grus dang ldan pa/spro ba can/ pha rol gnon pa/ brtan pa/ nem nur med pa/ dge ba'i chos rnams la brtson pa ma btang bas thob par bya ba gang yin pa de ma thob par bar skabs su brtson 'grus dor bar mi bya'o zhes dga' bo khyod kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /dga' bo nga ni 'jig rten dang lhan cig rtsod par mi byed de/'jig rten nyid nga dang ②lhan cig rtsod par byed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/chos smra ba ni su yang 'ga' ③dang yang lhan cig rtsod par mi byed dedu/ nga'o zhes rtsod par mi byed/ lta ba rtog ༷pa'i bzod pas ma yin/ skal ba yod pa'i gzugs kyis ma yin gyi/ nga ni bdag gis ji tsam mthong ba dang / rig pa dang / mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa dang / mngon sum du byas pa de kho na smra'o/ /dga' bo de ji snyam rjodu sems/ de bzhin gshegs pa gzhan du 'gyur ba'i tshig gang yin pa de gsung ngam/ btsun pa ma lags so/ /dga' bo legs so legs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzhan du 'gyur ba'i tshig gang yin pa de gsung ba ni gnas ma yin zhing go skabs med del/ dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa ni yang dag pa ⑧gsung ba/ bden pa gsung ba/ chos gsung ba/ de kho na nyid gsung ba/ phyin ci ⑨ma log par gsung ba'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ni yun ring po rkyenas 'jig rten la phan pa bzhed pa/ bde ba bzhed pa/ grub pa dang bde ba bzhed pa/ lam mkhyen pa/ lam grub pa/lam ston pa/ lam brjod yipa/ lam yongs su 'dren pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ni tsodagra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang 10—376

zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das so/ /dga' bo 'jig rten ni dad pa med pa/dbang pos 'khol ba/ 'phral gang du lta ba/ lag tu 'ongs pa mthong ba/'god pa che ba/ bsags pa nyung ba ste/ sla ba ①mi byed kyi dka' bas bdag nyid kun tu rtsol ②bar byed do/ /dga' bo lung yang mi dgos/ shes rab kyang mi dgos/ khyod kyis sha'i mig gis ji tsam mthong ba de kho na la yang dag par rtogs shig dang / ji ltar mthong zhub la yang dag par brtags pa nyid kyis thar bar 'gyur ro/ /dga' bo khyod nga la dad pas ma 'gro/ /dga' bas ma 'gro/ rjes su thos pas ④ma 'gro/ rnam pa la rtog pas ma 'gro/dge sbyong du lta bas ma 'gro/ dge sbyong gi lta ba ⑤rtog pa bzod pas ma 'gro/dge sbyong la gus pas ma 'gro/ bdag gi yibla ma dge sbyong gi ta ma'o ⑦zhes ma 'gro shig ③ /dga' bo 'on kyang gcig pu lkog tu song la ngas chos gang dag nyid kyi ⑨mngon par mkhyen pas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa de dag soms shig /gzhol cig /nye bar rtogs shig /lan mang du gyis shig dang /chos gang dang gang mngon sum du byas pa'i chos de dang de rdzogs par byas na bdag nyid gling dang / bdag nyid skyabs can dang / chos gling tho)dang /chos skyabs can dang / gzhan ma yin pa 7gling dang / gzhan ma yin pa skyabs can du gnas so8/ /dga' bo ji ltar na dge slong tsobadag nyid gling dang / bdag nyid skyabs can dang / chos gling dang / chos skyabs can dang / gzhan ma yin pa gling dang / gzhan ma yin pa skyabs can tsodu gnas 10—377

she na/ dga' bo 'di na dge slong rtun pa dang ldan pa/ dran pa dang shes bzhin can/ 'jig rten la brnab sems dang / yid mi bde ba rnam par spangs nas nang gi lus la lus kyi rjes su lta zhing gnas/ phyi'i lus la lus kyi rjes su lta zhing gnas/ phyi dang nang gi lus la lus kyi rjes su lta zhing gnas/lus la kun 'byung ba'i chos su rjes su lta zhing gnas/ lus la kun 'byung ba la zad pa'i chos su lta zhing gnas/ lus yod do zhes de'i dran pa 'di lta ste/shes pa tsam dang / mthong ba tsam dang / so sor dran pa tsam du ①legs par gnas shing mi rten par gnas la/ 'jig rten na chung ②zad kyang ①len par mi byed do/ /dga' bo de bzhin du dge slong rtun pa dang ldan pa/ dran pa dang shes bzhin can/ 'jig rten la brnab sems dang / yid mi bde ba rnam par spangs nas/ nang gi ④lus la yang lus kyi rjes su lta zhing gnas/ phyi dang nang gi lus la yang lus kyi rjes su lta zhing gnas / nang gi tshor ba dag dang / phyi'i tshor ba dag dang / phyi dang nang gi tshor ba dag la tshor ba'i rjorjes su lta zhing gnas/ nang gi sems dang / phyi'i sems dang / phyi dang ⑦nang gi sems la nisems kyi rjes su lta zhing gnas/ ⑨nang gi chos rnams dang /phyi'i chos rnams dang / phyi dang nang gi chos rnams la chos kyi rjes su lta zhing gnas / chos rnams la kun 'byung ba'i chos su spre) rjes su lta zhing gnas/chos rnams la kun 'byung ba la zad par rjes su lta zhing gnas/ chos rnams yod do zhes de'i dran pa 'di lta ste/ shes pa tsam dang / mthong ba tsam dang /so sor dran pa tsam du legs par gnas shing mi rten ⑩par gnas la/ 'jig rten na cung zad kyang nye bar len par mi byed de/ dga' bo de ⑩ltar na dge 18—378

slong bdag nyid gling dang / bdag nyid skyabs can dang / chos gling dang /chos skyabs can dang / gzhan ma yin pa gling dang / gzhan ma yin pa skyabs can du gnas pa yin no/ /dga' bo tshur skyes bu g.yo med pa/ sgyu med pa/drang po/ brtan ①pa'i rang bzhin can de ni ngas nang btams ②na/ nub kun shes pa lung ston par 'gyur/ nub btams rgyan nang kun shes pa lung ston par 'gyur ro/ /dga' bo nga'i chos ni legs par dugasungs pa/ yang dag par mthong ba/ nad med pa/ dus chad pa med pa/ nye bar gtod pa/'di mthong ba la don duyod paX/ mkhas pa rnams kyis rang gis rig par bya ba yin no/ /gsung rab 'di ni 'di lta ste/ ston pa yang mngon sum du gyur/dam pa'i chos nye bar gtod pa/ yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ba/rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'gro ba/ bde bar gshegs pas thugs su chud pa yang ston pas snying po btung bar bya ba yin no/ /dga' bo de lta bas na khyod kyis rang gi don dang / gzhan gyi don dang / gnyi ga'i don la lta zhing so sor ⑦yang dag par bslab par bya ste/ ci nas kyang bdag rab tu byung nas don yod pa dang / 'bras bu dang bcas pa dang / ⑧rnam par smin pa bde bar 'gyur ba dang / gang dag gi chos gos dang / bsod snyoms dang / gnas mal dang / na ba'i rkyen gyi ⑨yo byad sman dag yongs su spyad pa/ de dag gi bya ba byas pa de dag kyang ci nas kyang shin tu 'bras bu che ba dang / shin tu phan yon che ba dang / shin tu gzi ⑩brjid che ba dang / rgya chen por 'gyur ba de ltar dga' bo khyod kyis bslab par bya'o/ /gang la dga' ba dang / gang la yimangon par dga' ba'i gzugs de la rnam par 'gyur ba dang / gzhan du 10—379

'gyur ba dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa rnams 'byung bar mi 'gyur ba'i gzugs ni ngas gcig kyang yang dag par rjes su ma ①mthong ngo / /dga' bo de ji snyam du sems/ gzugs rtag gam mi rtag /btsun pa mi rtag lags so/ /mi rtag pa gang yin pa de sdug bsngal ba ②yin nam sdug bsngal ba ma yin/btsun pa de ni sdug bsngal ba lags te/ gang mi rtag pa ni sdug bsngal bar ②'gyur ba'i chos can lags so/ /de ji ga 'phags pa nyan thos thos pa dang ldan pa 'di ni bdag gi'o/ /'di ni bdag go/ /de ④ni bdag gi bdag go zhes bdag gir khas 0len tam/ btsun pa ma lags so/ /dga' bo de ji snyam du sems / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa rtag gam mi rtag /btsun pa mi rtag lags so/ /mi rtag pa gang yin pa de sdug bsngal ba yin nam/ sdug bsngal ba ma yin/ btsun pa de ni 0sdug bsngal ba lags te/ gang mi rtag pa ni sdug bsngal bar ⑦'gyur ba'i chos can lags so/ /de ji ga 'phags pa nyan thos thos pa dang ldan pa 'di ni bdag gi'o/ /'di ni bdag go/ /'di ni bdag gi bdag go zhes bdag tu khas len tam/ btsun pa ma lags so/ /dga' bo de lta bas na khyod kyis gzugs gang yin pa ci yang rung / 'das pa'am/ ma 'ongs pa'am da ltar byung ba'am/ nang gi'am/ phyi'i'am/ rags pa'am/ phra ba'am/ngan pa'am/ gya rnam pa'am/ thag ring ba ⑧gang yin pa'am/ nye ba gang yin pa de dag thams cad la/ 'di ni bdag gi ma yin/⑨ 'di ni bdag ma yin/ 'di ni bdag gi bdag ma yin no/ /zhes de de ⑩ltar yang dag pa'i 10—380

shes rab kyis yang dag pa ji lta ①ba bzhin du blta bar bya zhing / tshor ba gang yin pa ci yang rung ba dang / 'du shes gang yin pa ci yang rung ba dang /'du byed gang yin pa ci yang rung ba dang / rnam par shes pa gang yin pa ci yang rung ②/ 'das pa'amacha/ ma 'ongs pa'am/ da ltar byung ba'am/nang gi'am/ phyi'i'am/ rags pa'am/ phra ba'am/ ngan pa'am/ gya rnam pa'am/ thag ring ba gang yin pa'am/ nye ba gang yin pa de thams cad la 'di ni bdag gi ma yin/ 'di ni bdag ma yin/ de ④ni bdag gi bdag ma yin no/ /⑤zhes de de ltar yang dag pa'i shes rab kyis yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du blta bar bya'o/ /'phags pa nyan thos thos pa dang ldan pa de ltar lta ba na gzugs las kyang yid 'byung bar 'gyur zhing / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa las kyang yid 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /yid byung na 'dod chags dang 'bral ༅lo/ /'dod chags dang bral na rnam par grol 0lo/ /rnam par grol na bdag gi zag pa zad do/ /tshangs par spyod pa bsten to/ /bya ba byas so/ /'di las srid pa gzhan mi shes so zhes rnam par grol lo snyam pa'i ye shes mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa na tshe dang ldan pa dga' bo chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang 'bral ba skyes so/ /dge slong lnga brgya 0ni len pa med par zag pa dag las sems rnam par grol lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal te/ bde bar gshegs pas de skad gsungs nas/ ston pas gzhan yang 'di skad ⑩bka' stsal to/ /dga' bo mnyam gzhag min sems la/phung po thams cad zad pa dang / /ye shes dag pa skye mi 'gyur/ /de ltas ⑪10—381

brtson pa lhur blang ①bya/ /phung po skye zhing 'jig pa dag /yang dang yang du so sor brtag /dag ②pa yang dag skyes pa la/ /lha rnams thams cad dga' bar 'gyur/ /sdug dang grogs dang 'grogs pa dang / /ldang ③zhing rim gro byed pa dang / /rnyed dang bkur sti tshigs su bcad/ /gang de dga' bo rjoyongs spang gyis⑤/ /khyim gnas de bzhin khyim pa min/ / gnyi ga rjodang ni mi 'dre na/ /sdug bsngal gyi ni mthar byed khyod/ /de lta na ni mthar phyin 'gyur / /dang po nur nur por 'gyur te/ /de nas mer mer por 'gyur ro//mer mer po las nar nar 'gyur/ /nar nar po las gor gor 'gyur/ /gor gor po las rdziyan lag ni/ /bzhi dang mgo yang ②skye 'gyur zhing ⑨/ /las kyi rgyu las byung ba yi0/ /rus tshigs yisna tshogs skye bar 'gyur/ /mgo yi tsothod pa'i rludagu dang ni/ /'gram pa yi ni rus pa gnyis/ /so ni sum bcu rtsa gnyis dang / /so yi rtsa ba sum bcu gnyis/ /mgrin pa dang ni rna ④ba'i drung //sna dang dkan ④ni gong ma dang / /snying ga ṇilkog ma med 0pa yi/ /rus pa dag ni nyi shur 'gyur/ /mig gi rus pa bzhi dang ni/ /thal gong gi yang rus pa bzhi/ /dpung pa g.yas dang g.yon dag gi/ /rus pa dag ni lnga bcu yod/ /brang gi rus pa brgyad yin te/ /de la sgal tshigs sum bcu gnyis/ /rgyab kyi rtsib ma'i rus 8pa ni/ /rus pa dag ni sum bcu'o/ /ngos gnyis rtsib logs g.yas pa na/ /rtsib 7rus bcu gsum ldan pa ste/ /de bzhin rtsib logs g.yon pa na/ /gzhan yang bcu dang gsum yod do / /de dag nyi shu rtsa drug ste//tshigs gsum pa ni gsum gsum dang / /tshigs gnyis pa ni gnyis dang ldan/ /lhag ma rnams ni tshigs med do0/ /brla ni g.yas dang g.yon dag la/ /rus 10—382

pa dag ni bcwa lnga yod/ /lus ①'di dag la rus pa ni/ /brgya dang lnga dang gsum yod par/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rab mkhyen pa/ /bden pa'i mtshan gyis bka' stsal to/ /'og tu rkang pa'i mthil nas ni/ /gong du klad pa'i bar gyi lus/ /gang dag gis ni nyer brten ②pa/ /'dam bu'i khyim bzhin nyam chung ngo / /gzer gyi gzungs kyis ma zin pa/ /sha dang khrag gis g.yogs pa ste/ /sgyu ma mkhan gyi srad bu yis/ /shing gi 'khrul 'khor sbrel ba ltar / /de bzhin du ni lus 'di yang / /chu rgyus dag gis labreng gis sbrel/ /pags pa rlon pas so sor g.yogs/ /sgo dgu'i rma ni chen por ldan/ /mi gtsang rul pa'i dri mnam pa/ /kun nas rab tu 'dzag par 'gyur/ /ji ltar 'bru ni sna tshogs kyis/ /spyad ni bkang bar gyur pa ltar/ /de bzhin du ni lus 'di yang / /sna tshogs 0rul pa'i 'byung gnas yin/ /rus pa'i 'khrul 'khor 'di 'dra ba'i/ /lus ni rul pa snying po med/ /'di la byis pa bag med deX/ /chags su med par shes par gyis/ /rngul dang mchil ma snabs dag dang / /bad kun rnag dang khrag rnams dang / /mchin pa mkhris pa zhag dang ni/ /zag pa klad pa klad rgyas dang / /snying dang sul mangs rjomakhal ma dang / /mi gtsang glo ba sgang ⑦pa dang / /tshil dang spu dang mcher ⑧pa dang / /rgyu ma dang ni gnye ma ste/ /'di ni rul pa sna tshogs pa/ /'di 'dra ba yi 'byung khung ⑨yin/ /sdig lus 'jigs ⑩pa chen po ste/ /dgra dang 'dra bar shes par bya/ /grong khyer rnying pa ci skyabazhin du/ /rul 8pa'i lus ni nyam chung ngo / /'dus byas nyin dang mtshan du yang / /rnam par 'jig cing tsorab tu 'jig /grong khyer rus pa'i rtsig pa can/ /ṅge dang khrag gis 8zhal zhal byugs/ /18—383

de la 'dod chags zhe snang dang / /gti mug dang ni 'chab pa skyekhya/ /grong khyer rtsig pa'i rus pa can/ /sha dang khrag gis byugs pa dag /phyi dang nang bcas rtag tu yang / /mi mdza' ba yis mngon par gtses/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa dga' bo dang / /dge slong lnga brgya po de dag yi rangs te②/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa dga' bo mngal du 'jug pa'i mdos btams rgyanas 'khor ba'i dgon pa las bsgral te shin tu mthar thug pa'i grub pa dang bde ba mya ngan las 'das pa la bzhag go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag nga'i dge slong dbang po'i sgo bsdams pa rnams kyi mchog ni 'di lta ste / dge slong dga' bo 'di yin no/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa dga' bo dgra bcom pa nyid thob ste rnam par grol ba'i dga' ba dang bde ba myong bas de'i tshe tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ bsro gang ༷gi ni khrus dag dang / /zas dang snum bsku ༷byug pa dang / /gdugs kyis dgab pa ༷byas pa yi/ /bde ba mang po ⑦nyams su myong / /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod ⑧par mdzad pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa dga' bos las ci zhig bgyis na las de'i rnam par smin pas 'di'i lus kyi mdog gser gyi kha dog lta bur grub cing skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcus ni brgyan⑨ske/ bcom ldan 'das pas ni sor bzhis thung la/ 'dod pa dag la lhag par chags pa las bcom ldan 'das kyis nan gyis phral nas 'khor ba'i dgon pa las bsgral te/ shin tu mthar thug pa'i grub pa dang bde ba mya ngan 18—384

las 'das pa la bzhag lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag dga' bo nyid kyis ①las byas shing bsags pa/ tshogs rnyed pa/rkyen yongs su bsgyur ba/ dba' rgal bzhin ②nye bar gnas pa/ nges par gyur pa yin te/ dga' bo ③nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa gzhan su zhig gis myong bar 'gyur/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa dag ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams la ma yin/ me'i khams la ma yin/ rlung gi khams la ma yin gyidu/ 'on kyang las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang khams dang skye mched dag kho na la rnam par smin par 'gyur te/ bskal pa brgya phrag rnams su yang / /las rnams chud zar mi 'gyur te/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /lus can rnams la 'bras bur smin/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba skye dgu rnams kyi tshe lo brgyad khri thub pa na ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rig pa dang zhabs su ②ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa rnam par gzigs zhes 0bya ba mi'i 'jig rten du byung ༅ste/ de 'khor dge slong 'bum phrag drug bcu rtsa gnyis dang ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa na rgyal po'i pho brang gnyen ldan du byon nas ⑧gnyen ldan gyi tshal na bzhugs 0so/ /de'i g.yas khyim gyi gcung 'dod pa dag la shin tu chags par gyur pa las yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyis nan gyis phral nas 'khor ba'i btson tshur las bsgral te shin tu mthar thug pa'i grub pa dang bde ba mya ngan las 'das pa la bzhag go/ /de'i tshe rgyal po'i pho brang gnyen ldan na rgyal po gnyen ldan zhes bya 18—385

ba rgyal srid byed du 'jug ste/ rgyal srid 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang /bde ba dang / lo legs pa/ skye bo dang / mi mang pos gang ba/ 'thab pa dang / rtsod pa dang / 'khrug pa dang / 'khrug long zhi ba chom rkun dang /nad dang bral ba/ sā ①lu dang / bu ram shing dang / ba lang dang / ma he phun sum tshogs ②pa/ chos kyi rgyal po chos rgyadang mthun pas chos bzhin du byed du 'jug go/ /de'i g.yas khyim gyi nu bo ni 'dod pa rnams la shin tu chags par gyur to/ /rgyal po gnyen ldan gyis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs 'khor dge slong 'bum phrag drug bcu rtsa gnyis dang 'dir byon nas 'di nyid na gnyen ldan gyi tshal na bzhugs so zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang btsun mo'i 'khor dang / gzhon nu dang / blon po dang / grong khyer gyi mi dang bcas te duyang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs ga la ba der song ngo / /de la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyis gang zhig thos nas rgyal po gnyen ldan btsun mo'i 'khor dang / gzhon nu dang / blon po dang / grong khyer gyi mi dang bcas te/ khyad par chen po thob pa de lta bu'i chos bstan to/ /de'i g.yas khyim gyi nu bo ni 'dod pa la ⑤lhag par chags pa dang ldan pas khyim nas ma byung ba dang / de la blon po'i bu dang / mdun dun 'don gyi bu dang / gzhan yang chung po grogs rnams kyis dong ste smras pa/ grogs po rgyal po ni btsun ⑦mo'i 'khor dang / gzhon nu dang / blon po dang / grong mi dang bcas te yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs blta ba'i phyir gshegs na/ khyod lta bu ⑧mi nyid ⑨rnyed dka' zhing shin tu rnyed dka' ba thob nas 'dod pa rnams la shin tu chags nas 10—386

khyim nas ma byung ngo / /de de dag gis btams ①pa dang / snying la ngo tsha bar gyur nas de dag ②'grogs te yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs ga la ba der song ngo / /ji tsam na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyi gcung gis de rnams kyis bzhin ②btab nas khrid pa mthong steX/ des dris pa/ ci'i phyir 'di de ltar bzhin ⑤btab nas khrid/de dag gis ji ltar gyur pa de la rgyas par bsnyad ①pa dang / des smras pa/shes ldan dag nga ⑥yang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyi gcung yin te/ de kho na bzhin du 'dod pa rnams la lhag par chags ⑧par gyur pa las/ nga ⑨bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyis nan gyis phral nas 'khor ba'i dgon pa las bsgral 0te shin tu mthar phyin pa'i grub pa dang bde ba mya ngan las 'das pa la bzhag go/ / de lta ⑩bas na skyes bu gti mug ⑩kha cig ni de ltar bya dgos pas khyed kyis 'di khrid de 'ongs pa gang yin pa ⑩ni legs pa byas kyis/ deng byal bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar khrid cig dang / 'di gdon mi za bar bcom ldan 'das la dad pa rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /ji tsam na de dag gis de yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyi spyan sngar khrid pa dang / de la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyis de lta bu'i chos bshad do/ /des de thos nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs la dad pa rnyed pa dang ldan te/stan las langs nas bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar 8te/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs ga la ba de 8logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs la 'di skad 10—387

ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas te bdag gi sdum par khrus khang ①gi khrus mdzad par ci gnang / bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyis cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyis cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas bshad pa la mngon ②par dga' ste/ rjes su yi rangs rgyanas zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ stan las langs nas song ste rgyal po gnyen ldan ga la ba der song ngo / /solnge nas rgyal po gnyen ldan gyi rkang pa la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te rgyal po gnyen ldan la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha bdag gis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas te bdag gi rjisdum par khrus khang 0gi khrus mdzad par spyan drang ba dulas des cang mi gsung bas gnang ste/de ni bkur sti bgyi bar 'os pa lags pas lha de'i slad du de ⑦grong khyer du gshegs pa'i grong khyer du ⑧mdzes par bgyi ⑨ba dang / shul mdzes par bgyi ba'i rigs so/ /rgyal po gnyen ldan gyis ⑩bsams pa/ gal te de ⑪ lta na ⑫bdag gis bcom ldan 'das grong khyer du gshegs pa'i grong khyer mdzes pa dang /lam mdzes par bya na/ ci bcom ldan 'das kyis gdul dka' 0ba gang yin pa 'di yang btul ba lta ④snyam du rig nas smras pa/ nu bo legs pa byas kyis ⑫khyod song la rdzas dag sta tsogon gyis shig /ngas ni grong khyer mdzes pa dang /lam mdzes pa ⑩bya'o/ /de dga' ba dang rab tu dga' ba skyes nas rgyal po gnyen ldan gyi rkang pa la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas stan las langs te song ngo / /rgyal po gnyen ldan gyis blon po rnams la bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag deng tsol grong 10—388

khyer du dril sgrogs ①te/ sang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs grong khyer ②du gshegs kyisal/ de'i phyir khyed 0grong khyer na gnas pa dang / yul sna tshogs nas lhags ⑤pa'i skye bo'i tshogs kyis grong khyer mdzes pa dang / lam mdzes par gyis la rang gi du'abyor pa dang mthun pa'i mdzes pas bsu shig /lha ⑦de ltar 'tshal lo zhes blon po rnams kyis rgyal po gnyen ldan gyi ltar mnyan nas dril bsgrags ②te/ 'di skad du shes ldan grong khyer na gnas pa dag dang / 4grong mi dang / yul sna tshogs nas lhags ⑨pa'i skye bo'i tshogs dag nyon cig /lha'i zhal nas bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs grong khyer du gshegs kyis de'i phyir khyed grong khyer na gnas pa dang / yul sna tshogs nas lhags pa'i skye bo'i tshogs thams cad kyis grong khyer mdzes pa dang / lam mdzes par gyis la thams cad kyis ⑩rang gi 'byor pa dang mthun pa'i mdzes pas bsu shig yices de skad bka' stsal to / /de dag gis grong 7khyer de yang rdo ba dang / gseg tsom dang / gyo mo ni med par byas/ tsan dan gyi chus ni chag chag btab bdug pa dri zhim po can —gyi pog phor ni bzhag /dar gyi lda ldi mang po ④ni bresabya/ rgyal mtshan dang ba dan ni bsgreng / me tog sna tshogs ni bkram ste lha rnams kyi skyed mos tshal dga' ba'i tshal skyabazhin du dga' dga' ltar byas/ lam yang de bas kyang lhag par mdzes par byas te/ der yang dri sna tshogs kyis bsgos pa'i chu dron dang /'bru mar yang sta gon byas/ khrus khang ⑩yang byi dor byas/ gdan yang bshams nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs grong khyer du gshegs pa bsu'o/ /de nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par 10—389

gzigs rgyal po gnyen ldan btsun mo'i 'khor dang / gzhon nu dang / blon po dang / grong mi dang / gzhan yang skye bo'i tshogs phal po che dang bcas pas zhabs ①ring byas te 'byor pa mchog gis rgyal po'i pho brang gnyen ldan du gshegs so/ /de nas rgyal po'i nu bo de dad pa skyes nas khrus khang gi nang du gshegs su gsol to/ /nang du gshegs nas khrus mdzad par brtsams pa dang /ji tsam na sangs rgyas ②rnam par gzigs kyi sku gser gyi mdog lta bu skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyis kun nas brgyan ③pa mthong ngo mthong nas kyang yang dad pa skyes te0/ khrus byas nas zhabs la gtugs te smon lam btab pa/ gang bdag gis yon gnas yang dag pa 'di lta bu la bya ba byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag kyang bdag nyid chen po 'di'i ji lta bar lus gser gyi mdog lta bu dang / 'dis gcung ①po 'dod pa rnams la shin tu chags pa las nan gyis phral te durab tu phyung nas 'khor ba'i dgon pa las bsgral te shin tu mthar thug pa'i grub pa dang ⑦/ bde ba mya ngan las 'das pa la bzhag pas ⑧ji lta bar bdag kyang ston pa 'di lta bu'i gcung du gyur cing gal te bdag de bzhin du 'dod pa rnams la lhag par chags par gyur na yang / bdag bcom ldan 'das des nan gyis phral te rab tu phyung nas 'khor ba'i dgon pa las bsgral te shin tu mthar thug pa'i grub pa dang bde ba mya ngan las 'das pa la 'jog par gyur cig ces byas so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ rgyal po gnyen ldan gyi nu bo gang yin pa de ni rigs kyi bu dga' bo 'di nyid yin te/de'i tshe de'i dus na 'dis yang dag par 0rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs la khrus khang gi khrus kyis khrus byas nas/ smon lam btab pa gang yin 10—390

pa'i ①las de'i ②rnam par smin pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i gcung du gyur cing /'di'i lus kyang gser gyi kha dog lta bur gyur la/ ngas kyang nan gyis phral te rab tu phyung nas 'khor ba'i dgon pa las bsgral te shin tu mthar thug pa'i grub pa dang bde ba mya ngan las ③'das pa la bzhag pa yin no/ /yang dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa dga' bos las ci zhig bgyis na/las de'i rnam par smin pas 'di dul skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu mngon par grub lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'di nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa/ tshogs rnyed pa/ rkyen yongs su bsgyur ⑤ba / dba' rgal bzhin nye bar gnas ༷par gyur pa yin te/ 'di nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa dag gzhan su zhig gis myong bar 'gyural/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa dag ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams la ma yin/ me'i khams la ma yin/ rlung gi khams la ma yin gyi/ 'on kyang dge ba dang mi dge ba'i las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched dag kho na la rnam par smin par 'gyur teni/ bskal pa brgya phrag rnams su yang / /las rnams chud zar mi 'gyur te/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /lus can rnams la 'bras bur smin/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba ri brags shig ⑨na khyim bdag phyug pa0/ nor mang ba/ longs spyod che ba zhig gnas te/ de la skyed ⑩mos tshal me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / rtsa ba sna tshogs dang / chu phun sum tshogs pa/ shing rnam pa sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa rab tu byung ba'i ⑩skye bo 10—391

dang mthun pa zhig yod do①/ /sangs rgyas dag 'byung ba med pa na 'jig rten du rang sangs rgyas dman pa dang phongs pa la snying brtse ba can/ bas mtha'i gnas ②mal la dga' ba/ 'jig rten gyi yon gnas gcig pu dag 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rang sangs rgyas shig ljongs ③rgyu zhing ri brags rjoder phyin te/de gnas tshol zhing phan tshun rgyu ba na/ skyed mos tshal der phyin pa dang /skyed mos tshal srung ⑤ba'i mis byon pa legs so zhes bya ba'i kun tu spyod pas rjochuspyad nas bstir bcug go/ /de nub mo me'i khams la snyoms par zhugs ⑦pa dang / skyed mos tshal srung ba'i mis ⑧mthong nas rab tu byung ba 'di ni 'di lta bur bdag nyid chen po brtul 0zhugs grub pa'o zhes shin tu ngo mtshar skyes par gyur nas de nyid kyi mtshan mo langs te/ khyim ⑩bdag la smras pa/ rje rab tu dgyes pa bskyed du gsol/ khyod kyi skyed mos tshal du rab tu byung ba ⑩bdag nyid chen po brtul zhugs grub pa zhig dgongs btab ste/ des skyed mos tshal de thams cad mtshan mo snang bar bgyis so/ /des thos nas rab tu dga' ba skyes te/ rings pa rings par song 4)ste rkang pa la gtugs nas smras pa/'phags pa khyod ni bsod snyoms don du gnyer ba/ bdag ni bsod nams ⑫don du gnyer ba lags na skyed mos tshal 'di nyid du bzhugs su gsol/bdag gis khyod kyi bsod snyoms sbyar bar bgyi'o/ /des khas blangs nas de der bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang /snyoms par 'jug pa'i bde ba nyams su myong bar byed cing / dus cung zad cig 'dug nas des bsams byapa/ bdag gis 8lus rul pa 'dis thob par bya ba gang yin pa de ni thob zin gyi skyam la bdag zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i 10—392

dbyings su 'jug go snyam du rig nas 'bar ba dang / gsal ①ba dang /char 'bab pa dang / glog 'gyu ba'i cho 'phrul dag byas te②/ phung po'i lhag ma ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das so// // 'dul ba phran tshegs kyi gzhi/③ bam po bcu bzhi pa/ de nas khyim bdag des dri thams cad kyi bsreg dushing dag bcer nas bsregs ⑤te/bsreg dushing de dag 'o mas bsad do/ /rus pa de rnams bum pa sar par bcug ste/ rus pa'i mchod rten byas nas gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang /ba dan dag btsugs so/ /btsugs ⑦nas dad pa skyes te/ de nas gur gum gyis bskus nas dri'i lag ris sum bcu byas so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems / khyim bdag gang yin pa de ni rigs kyi bu dga' bo 'di nyid yin te/de'i tshe de'i dus rne 'dis rang sangs rgyas kyi mchod rten byas nas gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan btsugs ⑤te/ dad pa skyes nas gur gum gyis ⑨byugs shing / dri'i lag ris sum bcu byas pa gang yin pa'i tshulas de'i rnam par smin pas 'di la skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu grub pa yin no/ /yang dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod par mdzad pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa dga' bos las ci zhig bgyis na las de'i rnam par smin pas gal te rab tu byung bar ma gyur na 'dis stobs kyis (spre'akhor lo sgyur 8ba'i rgyal srid bgyis par 'gyur lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag rigs kyi bu dga' bo 'di nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa tshogs 0rnyed pa/ rkyen yongs su bsgyur 10—393

ba / dba' rgal bzhin nye bar gnas pa nges par gyur pha yin te/ las byas shing bsags pa rnams gzhan su zhig ①gis myong bar 'gyur/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi ②sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams la ma yin/ me'i khams la ma yin/ rlung gi khams la ma yin gyi/ 'on kyang dge ba dang mi dge ba'i las byas pa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang khams dang / skye mched dag kho na la rnam par smin par 'gyur te/ bskal pa brgya phrag rnams su yang / /las rnams chud zar mi 'gyur te/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /lus can rnams la 'bras bur smin / /dge slong dag sngon byung ba bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/③ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ④ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī na rten cing drang srong smra ba ri dgas kyi nags na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na bā rā ṇa sī na rgyal po kṛ kri ⑤zhes bya ba rgyal srid byed du 'jug ste/ rgyal srid 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang / lo legs pa/ skye bo dang / mi mang pos gang ba zhes bya ba nas/ chos bzhin byed du 'jug go zhes bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin no/ /rgyal po de la bu gsum ste/ rab dang / 'bring po dang / tha chungs soX/ /gang gi tshe yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mtha' dag mdzad nas bud shing zad pa'i me bzhin du phung po'i lhag ma med pa'i 10—394

mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su ①mya ngan las 'das pa de'i tshe rgyal po kṛ khris ②de'i sku la mchod pa byas nas rin po che bzhi las byas pa ②mchod rten khor yug tu dpag tshad rjogacig pa/ 'phang du dpag tshad phyed pa zhig brtsigs sol/ /de la gdugs 'dogs par byed pa ni ⑧rgyal po kṛ khri'i ༷bu 'bring po dad pa skyes nas gdugs 'bring zhig btags so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems / rgyal po kṛ khri'i ⑦bu 'bring lapo gang yin pa de ni rigs kyi bu dga' bo 'di nyid yin te/ 'dis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi mchod rten la dad pa skyes nas gdugs 'bring btags pa gang yin pa'i ⑨las de'i rnam par smin pas stobs kyis ⑩'khor lo sgyur huba'i rgyal srid nyis 8stong lnga brgya byas te/ gal te da ltar rab tu byung bar ma gyur na da 0ltar yang 'dis stobs kyis ci'akhor lo sgyur 8ba'i rgyal srid byas par 'gyur ro/ /yang dge slong rnams kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun ⑩pa tshe dang ldan pa dga' bos las ci zhig bgyis na las de'i rnam par smin pas bcom ldan 'das kyis dbang po'i sgo bsdams pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ smon lam gyi dbang gis so/ /gang du 0smon lam btab lags/ dge slong dag 'di yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan pa la rab tu byung 8bar gyur te/ gang las 'di rab tu byung ⑩ba de bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis dbang po'i sgo bsdams pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan to/ /de na 'dis tshe ji srid par tshangs par spyod pa spyad kyang yon tan gyi tshogs du'aga' yang ma thob po/ /de na 'dis 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe smon lam btab pa/ 'di ltar bdag gis yon 10—395

gnas bla na med pa bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la'od srung gi spyan sngar tshe ji srid par tshangs par spyod pa spyad kyang yon tan gyi tshogs 'ga' yang thob par ma gyur gyisal/ bdag dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis bram ze'i khye'u bla ma la bram ze'i khye'u khyod skye dgu'i tshe lo brgya thub pa na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom ⑧yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa gang yin pa de'i gsung rab la rab tu byung nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te dgra bcom pa nyid mngon du byed par 'gyur ba dang / ji ltar bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od sung gis bdag gi dumakhan po dbang po'i sgo bsdams pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa de bzhin du bdag kyang bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa shākya'i rgyal po gtso bo des dbang po'i sgo bsdams pa rnams kyi mchog tu lung ston ⑤par gyur ༅cig ces byas te/ smon lam de'i dbang gis da ⑦ltar de bzhin gshegs pas dbang po'i sgo bsdams pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan to/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na las gcig tu gnag ⑧pa rnams zhes ⑨bya ba nas brtsal par bya ste/ dge slong rnams kyis de ⑩ltar bslab par bya'o zhes bya ba'i hubar snga ma bzhin no//gleng gzhi ⑩ni mnyan yod na'o/ /dge slong zhig na ste de sman pa'i drung du song nas smras pa0/ bzhin bzangs bdag la nad 'di lta bu byung na sman ston cig /des smras pa/ 'phags pa sman mas gtang ④ba mdzod cig dang khyod sos par 'gyur ro/ /des smras paX/ bzhin bzangs bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang ngo / /sman ⑩pas smras pa/ 'phags pa khyod kyi ston pa ni thugs rje can 18—396 4

yin pas gnang bar 'gyur ro/ /des skabs de dge slong rnams ①la bsnyad do/ /dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis ②bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na gnang gis chadage slong nad pas sman pa'i lung gis sman mas gtang bar ①bya'o//gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams kyis gtsug lag khang lnga rtseg tu 0byed na dri gtsang khang ni bdun rtsegaX sgo khang steng gi bsil khang yang bdun rtseg tu ⑥bya'o/ /dge slong rnams kyis ⑧gtsug lag khang sum rtseg tu ⑨byed na dri gtsang khang ni lnga rtseg0 sgo khang steng gi bsil khang yang lnga rtseg tu 7bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong dag gis ⑫phyogs gang nas 'dzeg 4)mi shes nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/them skas rnam pa gsum pa 0shing gi them skas dang sa'i them skas dang / rdo'i them skas dag bya'o/ /dge slong dag steng du ni rdo'i bar du ni sa'i tha mar ni shing gi btsugs tsonas 'dzegs ⑩pa dang /⑩ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/tha mar ni rdo'i/ bar du ni sa'i steng du ni shing gi gzugs par 8bya'o/ /phran tshegs kyi gzhi yilas sgo gnyis pa'o// //bsdus pa'i sdom ni/ chos gos gdang dang nang dang bskrad/ /khang bzangs lan tshwa spu bu dang / /gdong phyis dang ni phyi ba dang / /mkhar len 0stan dang spu gri'o/ /sdom ni/ chos gos tshad kyi shing dang ni/ /glegs bu dag dang rdul phyags ⑥dang / /sa drud pa ni nyid dag dang / /mchig ni mchig gur chabacas pa'o / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal 10—397

mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dras pa'i chos gos gsum dge slong dag gis bcang bar bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang / dge slong dag gis chos gos dra bar brtsams te/ de dag gis ① glegs bu dang / glegs bu phyed dag mi mnyam par byas so/ /skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis glegs bu dang glegs bu phyed dag mi mnyam par dra bar mi bya'i 'on kyang mnyam par dra'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / de dag gis ji ltar mnyam par 'gyur ba mi shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ glegs bu dang glegs bu phyed dag gi tshad kyi shing bcad par bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /dge slong dag gis chos gos kyi tshal bu dag mi mnyam par drubs pa dang / de dag mi mdzes nas/skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshal bu dag mnyam par drub par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis tshal bu ②mnyam par drub par bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang /dge slong dag ji ltar mnyam par bya ba mi shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshal bu'i tshad kyi shing bcad zhing des gzhal nas ②drub par bya'o / /bcom ldan 'das kyis tshal bu 0shing gis gzhol la drubs 0shig ces gsungs pa dang / dge slong dag gis tshal bu tshad las 'das par byas nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshal bu tshad las 'das par mi bya'o/ /'on kyang tshal bu ni gsum ste/ chen po dang / 'bring dang / chung bu'o/ /10—398

de la chen po ni sor bzhi'am/ bya rog gi mtho gang ngo / /chung ngu ni sor gnyis sam mthe bo'i lto gang ngo / /'bring ni de dag gi bar ro// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /dge slong dge sa rdul can la chos gos 'drub pa dang / de dri ma can du gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lci ba'i byug pas bskus la chos gos drub par bya'o//bcom ldan 'das kyis lci ba'i byug pas ①bskus la chos gos drubs shig ces gsungs pa dang / lci ba ma rnyed nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/phyogs der chag chag btab cing phyags te drub par ②bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /dge slong dag gis khri'i rkang pa rnon por byas pa dang / de dag gis sa bstar ba ma rung bar gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khri'i rkang pa rnon por mi bya'i 'on kyang zlum por gcad par bya'o/ /'on kyang ma rung par gyur nas ③bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ phub ma'i thum po la gzhag gam/ ras mas dkri bar bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /mnyan yod na bram ze zhig 'dug pa de dgos pa zhig gi phyir phyi rol du byung nas de rjode dang de dag tu 'khyam ⑤pa las nyi ma phyed kyi ༷dus kyi tshe yongs su ngal nas rgyal byed kyi tshal du zhugs pa dang / des de na stan bzang po bshamarme pa dang / kha zas bsod 10—399

par ①sbyar ba ②mthong ngo / /des mthong nas mngon par dad de/ des chen po la 'os pa'i gos gyon pa de des gding ba'i phyir rgan pa'i mtha' logs su gos de phul lo/ /de dus gzhan zhig na dri ma can du gyur lanas dge skos 0kyis gzhon pa'i mtha' logs su bting ngo ⑤/ /re zhig cig na bram ze de gtsug lag khang du zhugs pa dang / des gos de rgan pa'i mtha' logs na mi snang nas de rim gyis dulta zhing gzhon pa'i mtha' logs su song ba dang / ji tsam na dri ma can du gyur nas gzhon pa'i mthar bting ba mthong ste/ des bsams pa/gos 'di sar pa chen po la 'os pa yin na⑦/ gang gis ⑧'di lta bu'i gnas skabs su gyur pa 'di la rgyu gang yin re zhig blta'o snyam nas cung zhig bsdad pa dang / ji tsam na dge skos 0kyis gdan rim bzhin bshams nas phyag dar bya bar brtsams ⑩pa dang / des bsams pa/ gang gis gos 'di dri ma can du gyur pa 'di la rgyu ni 'di yin no snyam du rig nas/ dge skos (trel smras pa/'phags pa khyod kyis ji ltar sa la chag chag btab ste ⑩phyags nas rim bzhin gding bar bya ba 'di tsam yang mi mkhyen tam/ de bas kyang ⑫khyod kyis bdag gi gos dri ma can du byas so/ /skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong dag gis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sa la chag chag btab ste 8phyags nas rim 8bzhin gding bar bya'o/ /dge skos ⑩kyis rdul gyis gang ba'i stan la mal stan dag bting ba dang / nyes dmigs de nyid du gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ stan rnams sprugs la mal stan dag gding bar bya'o/ /ci yis sprug pa dge skos ⑩kyis mi shes nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis de las gos gcig gis sprug par bya'o zhes gsungs pa 18—400

dang / des bzang pos sprugs nas①/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ngan pas sprug ②par bya'o/ /dge skos ③kyis ngan pas sprugs pa dang / gang gi tshe dude rnyings shing zhigs ⑤nas bcos su mi rung ba de'i tshe bor ba dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de nyid tshal bu dang shar bu dag tu gyis la shing la ༷bcings te sprug ⑦par bya'o/ /de shin tu spyad par mi rung ste bor nas / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shin tu spyad par mi rung yang ma dor bar nirtsi ba'am/ 'jim pa dang bsres ⑨la ka ba'i ser ga'amatho)/rtsig pa'i bu ga dag tu skus ⑩shig dang / sbyin bdag gi bsod nams yun ring du 'phel bar 'gyur ro//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de nas dus de'i tshe dge slong gzhon nu zhig phyogs shig na 'chag pa dang / de 'chag pa'i sa phyogs de rkang pas drud pas zad do/ /ji tsam na khyim bdag cig 8de dang de dag tu 'khyam zhing 8phyogs der 'ongs pa dang / des bsams pa/ re zhig ④yang gnas skabs 'di lta bur gyur na 'phags pa 'di'i rkang pa ci 'dra ba zhig tu gyur snyam nas smras pa/ 'phags pa sa 'di ci zhig gis 'di ltar yongs su zad/des smras pa/ khyim bdag bdag 'chag 'chag pas so/ /khyim bdag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa re zhig 8yang gnas skabs 'di lta bur gyur na/ khyod kyi zhabs ci 'dra bar gyur8/ re zhig khyod kyi 0zhabs blta'o/ /des de la rkang pa bstan pa dang / des mthong ste snying rje skyes nas/ des smras pa/'phags pa bdag gis sa 'di la par tang dag gding bar bgyis8/ bde bar 10—401

tshogs ①shig ces smras pa dang / des smras pa/ khyim bdag bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang ngo / /'phags pa khyod kyi ②ston pa ni thugs rje can yin pas gnang bar 'gyur ro/ /skabs de des dge ②slong dag dul bsnyad ⑤do/ /dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na gnang gis rjodage slong ⑦brtson 'grus brtsam ⑧pa'i 'chag sar par tang bting ⑨bar bya'o/ /khyim bdag des bting skyab dang /dge slong de ⑩de la phyogs gcig tu 'chag par brtsams pas ji tsam na de 'dum bu gnyis su gyur nas/ de'i 'dum bu gcig ni phyogs gcig na 'dug /gnyis pa yang gzhan na 'dug go/ /ji tsam na khyim bdag de 'ongs nas par tang de'i dum bu gcig ni phyogs gcig na 'dugatso /gnyis pa yang gzhan na 'dug pa mthong nas des smras pa/ 'phags pa par tang de gnas skabs 'di lta bur gyur na/ e ma khyod kyis byaral ba btsem na ci nongs/ skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong dag gis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag de zer ba bden te de lta bas na ral ba dang ral ba dag drub cing gzungs dang lhan pa dag gdab par bya'o/ /gang gi tshe shin tu rnyings shing ⑩dengs te bcos dka' ba de'i tshe de lci ba'am/ 'jim par bsres tshul de nyid du byugs shig dang / sbyin bdag gi bsod nams yun ring du 'phel bar 'gyur ro//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /dge slong zhig na ste ⑫sman pa'i drung du song ste smras pa/ bzhin bzangs bdag la nad 'di lta bu byung 10wa 402

na sman ston cig ces smras pa dang / des smras pa/ 'phags pa 'di lta bu dang 'di lta bu mdzod dang khyod sos par 'gyur ro/ /des sman btag ①pa'i mchig dgos nas de khyim bdag gcig gi drung du song ste/ mchig brnyas ②pa dang /des de la mchig mchi gu dang bcas te byin no/ /des sman btags nas yang khyim bdag de nyid la slar byin pa dang / des ③'phags pa khyod nyid bzhes la bzhud cig /des smras pa/ khyim bdag bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang ngo / /des smras pa/ 'phags pa gal te de lta na zhog la bzhud cig /skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong dag gis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na gnang gis rjodage slong gis rjomachig mchi gu dang bcas te bcang bar bya'o// //sdom ni/ nang dang phyi rol chos gos gdang / /de bzhin lhag ma thag gu dang / /mar me dang ni 'khor gyi khyams/ /chos gos mtshan mas gdab pa'o//bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /dge slong dag chos gos bab bab tu 'jog ste / de rdul gyis dri ma can du gyur cing / sril ༷gyis zos nas skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong dag gis gsol pa dang bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos gos bab bab tu ⑦gzhag par mi bya'o⑧/ /'on kyang chos gos gdang la gzhag par bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis cig pa la khung brkos ⑨nas chos gos kyi ⑩gdang bcug ⑩pa dang / rtsig pa snyi bar gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rtsig pa la khung brko ⑩bar mi bya'o0/ /'on 10—403

kyang gang gi ①tshe gtsug lag khang rtsig pa de ②nyid kyi tshe bu ga ③gdod par bya zhing /der chos gos kyi gdang gzhug par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gtsug lag khang du chos gos kyi gdang gi bu ga thod cig ces gsungs pa dang / nyen kor ③du ma byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gtsug lag khang du ji lta ba ⑤de bzhin du nyen kor rjodag tu yang bya'o//bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis chos gos kyi gdang la chos gos dag gzhag par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / dge slong dgon pa ⑦pa dag gis chos gos kyi gdang ma rnyed nas skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/de dag gis ⑧lhag ma btags ⑨nas gzhag par bya'o/ /gzhan dag la lcug ma yang med nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de dag gis tha ⑩ga btags te gzhag par bya'o//bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag mtshan ⑩zhing chos mnyan pa sbyin par bya'o zhes gsungs te/ dge slong dag mtshan mo chos mnyan pa sbyin par brtsams so/ /ji tsam na chos nyan pa'i dus su sbrul zhig 'ongs pa de dge slong gzhon nu zhig gis tho)mthong nas de sngangs te/shes ldan dag rgyab rings 8rgyab rings ④zhes smras so/ /dge slong dag kyang so so'i skye bo yin pas sngangs te0/ de dag gis chos nyan ⑩pa bar bcad ⑩do/ /skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong dag gis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 10wa 404

'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos mnyan pa gcad ①par mi bya'i 'on kyang mar me bus te chos bstan par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ②mar me bus te chos bstan par bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang dge slong dag gis dbyar gyi mtshan mo mar me bus te ①chos bshad pa dang / srog chags dag mar mer song nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /mar me'i khang bu bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis mar me'i khang bu ji ltar bya ba mi shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / spyig duma'i tshal pa gzer bur dugyis la ras dkar pos g.yog par bya'o/ /ras dkar po ma rnyed nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lhang tsher gyis g.yog ༷par bya'o/ /de yang ma rnyed nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑦ bka' stsal pa/⑧ ⑨ dge slong dag bu ga brgya pa ⑩bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis bu ga brgya pa ci 'dra bar bya ba mi shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / rdza mkhan gyis 'jim pa gsher ba las gyo mo ⑩byas la bu ga brgya par bya'o/ /rdza mkhan med na bum pa'i gyo mo'am/ gzhan yang rung bcag nas bu ga brgya pa bya ste/ de nas mar me sbar la des g.yog par bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /so ku'i ⑩dus la bab pa dang / dge slong dag tsha bas gdungs te 8lus rmya zhing sha bri ngan pa dang /mdog ngan pa 8skya bo bseng bseng por gyur to/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du 'dri bar mdzad pa yin pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la mas ⑩pa/ kun dga' bo ci'i phyir da ltar dge slong dag lus rmya ⑩zhing / sha bri ngan pa dang / mdog ngan 10—405

pa skya bo bseng bseng por gyur/ skabs de bcom ldan 'das la ①rgyas par gsol nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de bas na gnang gis ②'khor gyi khyams bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis ji ltar bya ba mi shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ngos gsum par bya'o/ /de dag gis nang du ni rtsig pa brtsigs/ phyir ni ka ba'i phreng ba byas pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nang du ni ka ba'i phreng ba bya'o/ /phyi rol du ni rtsig ③pa brtsig go/ /skar khung ma btod ①pas phyir tsha bar gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ skar khung dag gdod par bya'o/ /de dag gis ⑤dma' bar btod pas nyes rjodamigs de nyid du gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bstod ⑦de gdod par bya'o/ /ha cang mthon por btod nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ha cang mthon sgor mi gdod kyi/'on kyang stan dang thad kur gdod par bya'o/ /bye'u dang phug ron dag 'jug nas / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ skar khung dra ba can du bya'o/ /rlung dang char pa dag gis gnod par gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sgo 'phar gzhug ⑧par bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis zan za ba na sgo bcad ⑨pas mun pa gnag par gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / zan za ba'i dus kyi tshe dbye bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag tsha ba'i dus na klog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / rnam par nges pa'i gtam la 'khod pa'am/ chos gos kyi las byed pa'am/ las kyis ⑩shin tu dub pa na der rngul gzan yidang / sham thabs gnyis gyon la 'dug par bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal 10—406
