sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon ①med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /dge slong zhig cham ②lhad bdo ste na ③ba des sa la mchil ma bor bas mal gyi g.yas g.yon rjoganyis mi mdzes par byas so / /ji tsam na de'i lhan cig gnas pa nang par sngar langs te gnas khang du zhugs nas phyag byas te nad dris nas byung ngo / /de phyag 'tshal ba na dpral ⑤ba la mchil ma'i thal ba ༷reg pa de dge slong rnams kyis mthong nas de dag gis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa gang du khyod kyis dpral ⑦ba la mchil ma 'di reg⑧/des smras pa/ mkhan po cham lud na ba ⑨des sa la mchil ma bor bar ma gyur grang / re zhig blta'o ⑩zhes de gnas khang du zhugs pa dang / ji tsam na mal gyi glo g.yas g.yon du mchil ma bor ba mthong ngo / /des dge slong yidag la bsnyad pa dang / de dag 'phya bar byed/ smod par byed/ kha zer bar byed de da 'ji lta bu zhig tu gyur/ dge slong dag mchil mas dge 'dun gyi gnang ⑫khang ma rung bar byed do zhes zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong gi byaganas mal byabacas par mchil ma dor bar yang mi bya/ mun par phyag byed pas mgos drung du gtugs ⑩par yang ⑩mi bya'i/ tshig tsam gyis phyag bya zhing gang cung zad bya ba 8yod na yang der tshig tsam gyis dri bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang gang la cham pa dang kha chu bdo ba des mchil ma'i yisnod nye bar gzhag par bya'o / /dge slong dag gis kham phor du dumachil ma bor ba dang de 'dril te ches mang du ma rung bar gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/mchil ma snod rten ma dang bcas pa'am/ yang na zangs po che gzhag par bya'o//10—458

dge slong dag zangs po che ci 'dra ba yang rung nye bar 'jog par byed pas de yang 'dril te nyes dmigs de nyid du gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ glang po che'i rkang pa lta bu nye bar gzhag par bya'o/ /gzhan dag cig mchil ma 'dor ba na zer ma yar nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gcal dgram ①par bya'o/ /dge slong rnams kyis ②gcal ci zhig gis dgram ③pa mi shes nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ so phag gi bur ma'am bye ma'o/ /der sbrang ma dag 'du nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bskrad par bya'o/ /dri mi zhim par gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dus dus su bshal bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis bshal nas ma bskams ༷pa dang srog chags dag byung nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bshal nas bskam par bya'o/ /dge slong gzhan dag cig lud pa bdo dunas de dag ji srid du bskams ༷pa de'i bar du nyam nga ⑦bar gyur ⑧nas / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nad pa tshabs po che gang dag yin pa de dag gis ni mchil ma'i ༷snod gnyis nye bar gzhag par bya'o/ /dge slong khang bzangs dag tu klog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / chags ⑩pa de dag mchil ma bro ba dang / de dag sems yengs ⑩shing bab bab du mchil ma 'dor bar byed nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ brjid phyal bar gnas mal 8bcas par mchil ma dor bar ⑩mi bya'i 'on kyang gtsug byalag khang gi grwa bzhir ༷ka ba'i drung du dge 'dun gyi mchil ma'i snod bzhi gzhag par bya zhing de dag tu klog ⑩pa dang / kha ton byed pa'am/ 'chags ⑩pas dran pa nye bar bzhag ste mchil ma dor bar bya'o//10—459

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa gang gi ka spun po tshe rabs lnga brgyar sems can dmyal ba dag gi nang nas shi 'phos nas sems can dmyal ba dag gi nang du skyes shing de nas phyir ①'dir skyes pa ②de byis pa'i gnas skabs nas khyim pa/ khyim la lhag ③par chags pa/ rtse ba'i dga' bas dga' ba dang / cha 0ba la brtson pas dmyal ba la dmigs pa'i dran pa ma skyes so / /de dus gzhan zhig na legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mdo sde dang / 'dul ba dang / chos mngon pa'i phyogs de dang de dag tu dmyal ba dang / yi dgas dang / dud 'gro dang / lha dang mi dag bshad pa dang / des dmyal ba'i gtam thos nas sems can dmyal ba'i tshor ba mngon ⑤du gyur te ba spu'i khung bu thams cad nas khrag byung ste/ chos gos dag kyang khra bor gyur/ dri yang mi zhim par gyur to/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na gnang gis rjodage slong rnams kyis lus phyi ba bcang bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis lus phyi ba bcang bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / de dag gis chos gos kyi phyi rol du bgos pas nyes dmigs de nyid du gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/nang du bgo ⑦bar bya'o/ /de dag gis de kho nas lus drud pas ril rma labyung nas / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de kho nas drud par mi ⑨bya'i 'on kyang bska ⑩ba'i chus sbangs nas dal bus bags kyis bkru bar bya'o/ /lus phyi ba'i gos kyis rnag dang khrag kyang dus dus su bkru bar bya zhing de yang 10—460

tshon gyis ①kha bsgyur bar bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa na bzhugs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i bu gang nas bzung ste rab tu byung tshun chad de rtag tu na'o/ /de'i drung du tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams song ste dris pa②/ gnas brtan bde'am/ bzhin bzangs bdag na ste mi bde'o/ /de dag gis smras pa/ gnas brtan khyod kyis sngon ③ci zhig bcangs / bzhin bzangs lcags kyi ④gzhong rings soX/ /gnas brtan gal te de lta na da ci ste mi bcang / bzhin bzangs bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang ngo / /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ⑥lta bas na gnang gis ⑦dge slong gis lcags kyi gzhong rings ⑧bcang bar bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /dge slong dag mchod rten la phyag 'tshal ba na de dag gi rkang pa la 'dam rdzab ①gos nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gcal dgram par bya'o/ /de dag gcal ci las 'gram ⑩pa ⑩mi shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ so phag gi gcal dgram par bya zhing de nas so phag gi phye mas btab ste rdo thal gyis byug par bya'o/ /mchod rten gyi 'khor sa chen por gyur te ma 'byor nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nyen kor 'dom tsogang dgram par bya'o/ /'on kyang ma 'byor nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gal te mi ⑩'byor na spang leb dgram par bya'o/ /de yang ma 'byor nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 10—461

bka' stsal pa/ bar bar tu so phag gzhag par bya'o/ /dge slong sgo gang ①la rten ②pa rnams kyi khyams su 'dam rdzab chags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ der yang rim pa de bzhin du bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /mnyan yod na khyim bdag cig 'dug pa des dgon par spyil bu ③byed du bcug ste/ de na dge slong gcig gnas so/ /dgun stod kyi dus la bab pa dang / de lhags pas nyen nas skya bo bseng bseng por gyur cing lus sha bri ngan pa rid pa rmya ༷bar gyur nas de khyim ⑤bdag de'i drung du song ste/ khyim bdag shes par gyis shig /gzhan zhig tu 'gro'o zhes byas pa dang / des smras pa/ 'phags pa cung zad brel bar ma gyur grang / des smras pa/ brel ba ni cung zad kyang med mod kyi 'on kyang lhags pas skyo'o/ /des smras pa/ 'phags pa bzhugs shig dang /khyed ⑥la nor bu me shel sbyin tol/ /des smras pa/ khyim bdag bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang ngo / /'phags pa bcom ldan 'das ni thugs rje can yin pas gnang bar 'gyur ro/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na gnang gis ⑧dge slong yinor bu me shel nye bar gzhag par ⑩bya zhing des me phyung la me'i bya ba bya'o/ /khyim bdag des yidage slong de la nor bu me shel byin nas/de des me 'byin cing me'i bya ba byed do/ /ji tsam na rkun po lnga brgya ri brags shig tu chalas byed par 'dong ba 8phyogs der phyin pa dang / de dag gis dge slong de la smras pa/ 'phags pa lhags pas sbrebs na 'di na me yod dam/10—462

des smras pa/ bzhin bzangs med do/ /'phags pa khyod me'i bya ba ji ltar byed / bzhin bzangs bdag ni nor bu me shel gyis me phyung nas me'i bya ba byed ①do/ /'phags pa nor bu de dag ②ga re/ bzhin bzangs phyogs 'di na'o / /de dag gis de mthong nas ri brags su ①song ste/ der las byas nas byung ste smras pa/ shes ldan dag tshur 'phags pa de'i nor bu dbrog gis 0'dong rjo/ de dag de'i drung du dong nas/ smras pa/ nor bu me shel de ga re bzhin bzangs phyogs 'di nyid na 'dug go/ /de dag gis de khyer te ༷song ngo //yang dge slong de lhags pas nyen nas khyim bdag de'i drung du song ste smras pa / khyim bdag shes par gyis shig gzhan zhig tu 'gro'o/ /des smras pa/'phags pa chung gzad brel bar ma gyur grang / des smras pa/ khyim bdag brel ba ni chung ⑧zad kyang med ⑩kyi 'on kyang lhags pas skyo'o⑩/ /des smras pa/'phags pa bdag gis khyod la nor bu me shel ma byin tam/ khyim bdag byin no//de ga re rkun po dag gis phrogs soyi/ /chen po la 'os pa'i nor bu de lta bu yang khyod kyis rkun po la bkur 8ba lta/ kye ma khyod kyis phyogs dben pa zhig tu bzhag mod/ skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rin po che de lta bu dag ma byin pa ⑩len pa rnams la bstan par mi bya'i8/ 'on kyang me phyung la gtad par bya'o/ /me shel ji lta bar chu shel yang de dang 'dra'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /drug tsasde rnams btso blag mkhan la chos gos dag 'khrur 'jug go/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na 10—463

mnyan yod du dus ston byung ste/ mnyan yod kyi bram ze dang / khyim bdag rnams kyi ①gos tshon sna tshogs can dag ②btso blag ①mkhan la 'khrur bcug go/ /nye dga' yang nyi ma nub kur chos gos ngur smrig gcig 0khyer te btso blag mkhan gyi drung du song nas/ bzhin bzangs chos gos 'di khrus shig ces byas so/ /des smras pa/ 'phags pa deng 'jig rten pa'i gos mang zhig 'tshal te mchis kyis 0bzhud cig sang bkru rjobar bgyi'o/ /de khros nas bsdigs par brtsams pa dang / des smras pa/ 'pharigs pa bsdigs su ci mchis/ gal te mi bzod na zhog la bzhud cig sang bkru ⑦mod des bzhag ste song ba dang / de'i tug rid kyis btso blag mkhan sems g.yengs par nigyur nas des chos gos de bul tog gi nang du sbangs nas gos tshon sna tshogs can rnams kyi nang du bzhag pa dang / der zhag lon nas gos tshon sna tshogs can rnams kyis thams cad khra bor byas so/ /btso blag mkhan lag pa 'gram pa la gtad de sems khong du chud cing 'dug pa dang / skye bo'i tshogs ma dad par gyur to/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ bram ze dang khyim bdag dag ma dad par gyur pa 0thog tu bab par mkhyen nas/ dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong nye dga'as ⑩chos gos ngur smrig btso blag mkhan la 'khrur bcug pa 'jig rten pa'i gos tshon sna tshogs can rnams kyis khra bor byas so/ /de lta bas na dge slong gis gos ngur smrig dag btso blag mkhan la 'khrur mi gzhug ⑩go/ /dge slong gos ngur smrig dag btso blag mkhan la 'khrur 'jug na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gos 7ngur smrig dag btso blag mkhan la 'khrur mi 10wa 464

gzhug go/ /zhes bka' stsal pa dang / drug sde rnams kyis gos dkar po dag 'khrur gzhug par brtsams so/ /btso blag mkhan gyis de dag bag med par shing leb la ①brdabs nas bkrus ②pa dang / de na ②gos kha cig ni ral/kha cig ni mtha' zegs duso/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na dge slong gis 0thams cad du btso blag mkhan la gos 'khrur mi gzhug ༷go//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gis thams cad kyis ④thams cad du btso blag mkhan la gos 'khrur mi gzhug go zhes bka' stsal pa dang / drug sde rnams btso blag mkhan gyi 'khru ⑧sar dong nas/ mgo chos gos kyis dkris ①te/ btso blag mkhan bzhin du sngam pa su su zhing bdag nyid gos dag 'khru bar byed pa bram ze dang khyim bdag dag gis mthong nas ma dad par gyur to/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/de lta bas na dge slong gis btso blag mkhan gyi 'khru sar song ste/ btso blag mkhan bzhin du sngam pa su su zhing bdag nyid kyis gos dag bkru bar mi bya'o/ /dge slong btso blag mkhan gyi 0'khru sar song ste/ btso blag mkhan bzhin du sngam pa su su zhing bdag nyid kyis 0gos dag 'khru bar byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro// cisangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal 10—465

mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gis btso blag mkhan gyi 'khru sar song ste/ btso blag mkhan bzhin du sngam pa su su zhing bdag nyid kyis gos dag bkru bar mi bya'o/ /zhes bka' stsal pa dang / drug sde rnams shing leb la 'khru bar byed de ①nyes dmigs de nyid du gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shing leb la gos dag bkru bar mi bya'i ②'on kyang gzhong khung du chu 'jam tsam gyi nang du dal bus bzlog cing bzlog cing bdag nyid kyis bkru bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gzhong khung du dal bus bzlog cing bzlog cing bkru bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong gzhan dag cig gis lag pa gnyis kyis bkru bar ma nus nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang dag lag pa gnyis kyis 'khru ③bar mi nus pa de dag gi ༷rkang pa gnyis kyis bkru bar bya'o / /gzhan ⑤dag cig gi dulag pa gnyis kyis kyang ma nus lal/ rkang pa gnyis kyis kyang ma nus nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de dag gi gzhal ta 0gyis la gzhan dag ⑩'khrur chug shigayi/ //sdom ni/ phyi ba dang ni sbrul gyi rnyi8/ /rdo phru 8'gyod pa nyid dang ni/ /tshon gyi gzhong khung rtsig 8pa dang / /tshon rtsi rnam pa bzhi yin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na ()bzhugs so/ /dge slong rnams khrus byas nas lus gsher bzhin du chos gos dag 'gyon pa dang / de dag khra bo dang dri mi zhim par gyur to/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis ⑩bcom ldan 18—466

'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na gnang gis ①lus phyi ba bcang bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis lus phyi ba bcang bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong gzhan dag cig ②la de ②mi bdog nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang dag la mi bdog pa de dag gis re zhig tsog tsog por 'dug la khrus ras kyis lus phyis te chos gos dag bgo bar bya'o/ /dge slong rnams kyis dulham la rdul chags par gyur nas dge slong dag gis de dag brdabs so/ /de dag brdabs pa dang ral cing gzungs kyi srad ༷bu dag kyang chad nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lham brdabs 0par mi bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis chus bkrus pa dang / de dag ma rungs ⑦nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/chus bkru bar mi bya'i 'on kyang ras ②chus sbangs la phyi bar bya ste/ de lta bas na gnang gis 0lham phyi ba bcang bar bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yul tsam pa na drang srong gar ga'i rdzing bu'i 'gram na bzhugs so/ /yul tsam pa na tsam pa'i 0klu'i bu mo dad pa can dge ba'i bsam pa bzang ba zhig yod pa de'i bu ⑩ma dad pa ma dul ba byed pa zhig go//des de chos mnyan pa yang dag par len du bcug ste/ bu song la 'phags pa rnams kyi drung du phyin nas chos nyon cig dang / khyed 8la bsod nams su 'gyur ro zhes byas pa dang / de des yang dag par len du bcug 0pas rang bzhin gyi cha lugs kyis chos byanyan par zhugs pa rnams kyi 8nang du song ngo / /de gzhon tson zhig gis mthong nas de sngangs te/ tshe dang ldan pa dag ⑩rgyab rings po rgyab rings tsopo zhes smras pa dang thos nas dge slong gang dag 'dod 10—467

chags dang ma bral ba de dag sngangs ①nas de dag gis de ske nas rnga ma'i srad bus btags te/ gtsug lag khang gi steng nas 'phangs ②so/ /de ①mas mthong ste rjosmras pa/ bu khyod kyis 'phags pa rnams las chos thos sam/ des smras pa/ma de 'dra ba'i 'phags par ni su yang ma gyur cig /bu de dag gis khyod la ci zhig byas/ des ji ltar gyur pa bsnyad dupa dang / des smras pa/ bu de bas dudang de dag 'phags pa yin no/ /gzhan dag cig gis khyod mthong du zin na bsad par gyur to zhes ⑦pa dang / de cang ⑧mi zer bar 'dug go/ /de la ne'u ldangs ⑨rnams kyis bzhad ⑩gad du mgrin snad mgrin snad ces smras pa dang /de de dag gis ku re ⑩smras pas lus skya bo bseng bseng por gyur cing sha bri ngan pa rke ba skem por red par ⑩gyur to/ /de la mas smras pa/ bu khyod ci ste lus skya bo bseng bseng por 8sha bri ngan pa rke ba skem 8por gyur/ des smras pa/ma bdag la klu gzhon nu 'di dag mgrin snad mgrin snad ces co 8'dri bar byed de ci bya'i gtol med do/ /bu khyod rang gi cha lugs kyis song bas des na ⑩gnas skabs 'di lta bur gyur gyi gal te khyod sprul pa'i gzugs kyis song bar gyur na rnga ma'i rnyis ⑩btags par yang mi 'gyur ro/ /da 8sprul pa'i gzugs kyis song la chos nyon cig dang khyod la thams cad legs ⑩par 'gyur ro/ /'on te rang gi tshugazugs kyis nyan na ⑥khyod gnas na 'dug ste nyon cig ces byas pa dang / de ma dad pa'i phyir dukhas ma blangs te ma'i ngor cang mi zer bar tso'adug go/ /des bsams pa/ 'phags pa dag klu gzhon nu rnga ma'i nyis ④'dogs pa ni gang su yang rung / chos nyan ⑥par 'dod pa de dag gi yang bar chad du 'gyur bas 'di kho na bdag gis tsobya ba yin no snyam ste/ de kha dog 10—468

'phags pas nam sros pa dang / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi ①zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa dang / de'i tshe tsam pa'i klu'i bu mo'i kha dog gi mthus drang slong gar ga'i rdzing 'gram thams cad snang ba rgya chen pos khyab par gyur to/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas ⑤tsam pa'i klu'i bu mos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to①/ /btsun pa bdag gi bu ma dad pa zhig mchis pa de bdag gis rjochos nyan pa yang dag par len du stsal nas de chos nyan du mchis pa dang /'phags pa rnams kyis ༷rnga ma'i nyis ske ༷nas btags te bor bas de'i mgrin pa snad de/ de la ne'u ldangs ⑦rnams kyis ⑧mgrin snad mgrin snad ces ⑨gtses lags so/ /de de ltar gtses pa na lus skya bo bseng bseng por gyur cing /sha bri ngan pa rke ba skem par ⑩gyur nayi/ kye ma bcom ldan 'das kyis thugs brtse bar dgongs te / gang gis na 'phags pa rnams klu gzhon nu rnga ma'i rnyis 8'dogs par mi 'gyur bar 'phags pa rnams dran par bgyid pa chung ⑫zad cig bcar tsogasol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis tsam pa'i klu'i bu mo la cacang mi gsung bas gnang ba dang / de nas tsam pa'i klu'i bu mo bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas de nyid du mi sneng skyabar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de nyid kyi mtshan mo 'das nas dge slong gi byadage 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag mdang tsam pa'i klu'i bu mo nga ga la ba der 'ongs te phyin nas nga'i zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa dang / de'i tshe tsam pa'i klu'i bu mo'i kha dog gi 18—469

mthus drang srong gar ga'i rdzing 'gram thams cad snang ba rgya chen pos khyab par gyur to/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas tsam pa'i klu'i bu mos nga la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag gi bu ma dad pa zhig mchis pa de bdag gis chos nyan pa ①yang dag par len tu stsal nas de 'phags pa rnams kyi drung du chos nyan du mchis pa dang / de dag gis de rnga ma'i rnyis ②btags te ②bor bas de'i mgrin pa snad nas/ de la ༷ne'u ldangs 0rnams kyis mgrin snad mgrin snad ces co dri dub smras lags so/ /de la/ de skad ces ⑦bgyis pa na lus skya bo bseng bseng por gyur cing nisha bri ngan pa/ rke ba skem 0por gyur na kye ma bcom ldan 'das kyis thugs brtse bar dgongs te ⑩gang gis na 'phags pa rnams klu gzhon yin rnga ma'i rnyis 8'dogs par mi 'gyur bar 8'phags pa rnams dran par bgyid pa cung zad ④cig bcar tsogasol zhes zer ro/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na gang la da ltar lha rnams kyang kye ma shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong rnams ni dge ba'i chos rnams las yongs su nyams par gyur to zhes 'phya bar 'gyur ba ⑩'di ni mdzes pa ma yin rung ba ma yin gyis ⑩de lta bas na dge slong gis klu gzhon nu rnga ma'i rnyis tsogadags par mi bya'i yi'on kyang klu gzhon nu mthong na se gol gyi sgra phyung ⑥ste/ bzhin bzangs mthong ba'i lam na ma 'dug shig ②ces brjod par bya'o/ /gal te mthong ba'i lam na mi 'dug na de lta na legs / ji duste 'dug na dbyug gu skam khas dal gyis blangs te bum pa'am rdza mar bcug dul de la bu ga btod ④de kha bcad nas dbyung bar bya'o/ /gal te dbyug gu skam kha med na shur bu'am/ lcags pod dmadu/ rgya cicang gis ②ske nas btags te dbyung bar bya'o/ /ji byaste shur 0bu'am/ lcags pod chadam/18—470

rgya cang med na gdang thag gi rnyi'amakhye/ gres thag gi rnyi ②la ras mas dkris nas des gdags par bya zhing de nas bum par bcug ste dbyung bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis de de bzhin du phyung nas nags kyi nang du bor ba dang / de khros pa'i mes nags bsregs te de yang de nyid du tshig pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nags kyi nang du dor bar mi bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis snang ba'i gnas su bor ba dang / skad cig kyang ma thogs par srog chags 'ol bas khyer nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de'i mod kho na la ldog par mi bya'i 'on kyang snang ba'i gnas su bzhag nas ji srid gnas su ma zhugs pa de srid du bsdad par bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na 'od ma'i tshal ①ka lan da ka gnas pa na bzhugs so/ /rgyal po'i khab na khyim bdag cig 'dug pa rdo'i las la mkhas pa zhig ste/ rdo phru dag byas shing ༷byas shing 'tshong ngo /dus gzhan zhig na de la rnyed pa mang du grub nas des bsams pa/ gang gis na bsod nams su yang 'gyur la rnyed pa yang mang du 'grub ⑤par 'gyur ba'i thabs de gang zhig yin snyam pa dang / de dad pa can zhig pas de 'di snyam du sangs rgyas la 0sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun khyim du spyan drangs la/ rdo phru dag nas bshos gsol na bdag gi bsod nams su yang 'gyur la/ rnyed pa yang mang du 'gyur ro snyam du bsams sol/ /de bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste zhes bya ba nas/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /zhes bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin no/ /de nas khyim bdag des sangs rgyas la ⑧sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun bde bar bzhugs par rig nas 10—471

rang gi lag dar ①te bza' ba dang bca' ba gtsang zhing bsod pas kun tu tshim par byed/ kun tu stobs ②par byed do/ /rnam grangs du mar rang gi lag dar ②te bza' ba dang bca' ba gtsang zhing bsod pas kun tu tshim par byas/kun tu bstabs nas bcom ldan 'das gdugs tshod gsol te phyag bcabs lhung bzed gyu dubar rig nas stan ches dma' ba zhig blangs te chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sbyin pa de la rjes su yi rang ba 'dis rjes su yi rang ba mdzad do/ /mchod sbyin nang na dusbyin sreg rjomachog / bsdebs sbyar ⑦nang na skyong byed mchog /mi yi nang na rgyal po mchog /chu bo'i nang na rgya mtsho mchog /skar ma'i nang na zla ba mchog /gsal ba'i nang na nyi ma mchog /steng dang 'og dang thad kur yang //skye bo'i 'gro ba ji snyed pa/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ /mchod bya dam pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zhes bya ba nas yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas gdan las bzhengs te bzhud do zhes bya ba'i bar ②snga ma bzhin no/ /des yang sangs rgyas la 0sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun khyim du bshos la spyan drangs ⑩nas des rgan rims ⑩bzhin rdo phru sar pa brims nas spyad spyad pa de dag nyid kyang brim par brtsams pa dang / dge slong rnams 'gyod 8de len par mi byed nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim pas yongs su dag go zhes byas nas blang tsobar bya ste/ 'di la 'gyod ④par mi bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin 8gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis tshon gyi las bya'o ⑩zhes bka' stsal pa dang ⑩/ dge slong dag gis tshon 18—472

gsher bar ①bskol ba dang / de zho can yin pa'i phyir btsos ②pa dang mi sdug par gyur cing de dag kyang ma rung nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/bskams nas bskol bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis nyi ma la bskams te gnon chung bar gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nyi ma la bskam par mi bya'o/ /dge slong dag grib ma la skems te rlams rjokhyer nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ grib ⑤ma la bskam par mi bya'i 'on kyang nyi ma phyed yod pa la bskam par bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis tshon dang chos gos dag gcig char duchur bcug ste btsos pa dang / de dag ma rung bar gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshon logs shig tu bskol bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag lan gcig kho na bskol te 'dor bar byed nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lan gsum gyi bar du bskol nas dor bar ④bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis lan gsum gyi bar du bskol na ⑧gcig kho nar bzhag pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ snod so sor gzhag par bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis dang po ni gang yin/ gnyis pa ni gang yin/ gsum pa ni gang yin ma shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'di ni dang po'o/ /'di ni gnyis pa'o/ /'di ni ⑨gsum pa'o zhes yi ge bri bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis tshon nyid du chos gos dag bcug pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshon nyid du chos gos dag gzhug par mi bya'i 'on kyang gzhong khung du tshon blugs la bsug par bya'o/ /dge slong 0gis ha cang gsher yib la bcugs pas de 'khrus tsonas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ha cang gsher ba la bsug par mi bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis ha cang skam pa 0la 10—473

bsugs ①pas chos gos dag khra bor gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ha cang skam po la bsug par mi bya'i 'on kyang ran tsam la bsug par bya'o / /dge slong rnams chos gos dag sa la skems ②par byed de/ de dag rdul gyis dri ma can du gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sa la bskam ③par mi bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis rtswa bting dunas bskams te rgyatshon phyogs gcig tu song nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gzar thag la btags la der bskam par bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis de bzhin du gzar thag la bkal bas bar du tshon ma chags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ grwa ༷nas tha gus btags la rgyang shing ④bres nas gzungs nibatab ste bskam par bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis bsugs ⑨nas ma bzlog ste tshon phyogs gcig tu 'dris yinas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/yang dang yang du bzlog par bya'o/ /snam sbyar gzhan dag cig tshad che ste gzar thag la ma shong nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rtswa bting nas bskam ⑩par bya zhing yang dang yang du bzlog par bya'o/ /dge slong dag chos gos rnying pa dag la ni tshon sar pa 8lcags/ chos gos sar pa tsodag la ni tshon rnying pa ldugs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshon sar pa yang sar pa kho na dag la blug 8par bya zhing rnying pa yang rnying pa dag la blug ⑫par bya'o/ /dge slong rnams chos gos sar pa dag ni grib ma la skemasatso/rnying pa dag ni nyi ma la skems rkyenas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/sar pa dag ni nyi ma la bskam phyepar bya zhing / rnying ⑩pa dag ni grib ma la bskam par bya'o/ /dge slong dag dang por ni tshon gsum pa/ de'i 'og tu ni 18—474

gnyis pa/ de'i 'og tu ni dang po sdugs pas ①dang po lhag ②par gyur nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dang por dang po ②dang gnyis pa blug rjopar bya zhing phyis gsum pa blug ⑤par bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis chu'i nang du ma bsugs pas chos gos dag khra bor gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chu'i nang du bsug ①par bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis de nyid kyi nyin par chu'i nang du bsugs pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/phyi de nyin bsug ⑦par bya'o/ /dge slong gzhan dag cig tshon gyi las byed pa na rlung dang char pa byung nas dge slong rnams phyogs gang du bskam zhes chos gos dag phan tshun sbed par byed nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rlung dang char pa byung na khang bzangs su nitshon gyi las bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis rlung dang char pa byung na khang bzangs su 0tshon gyi tshulas bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong dag gis khang bzangs su yitshon gyi las byas pas 8khang bzangs tshon gyis sbags 0nye bar sbags shing 'dug pa bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis mthong nas smras pa/ 'phags pa khrag 'di ga las bo8/dge slong dag gis smras pa/ 'di khrag ma yin gyi kho bo cag gis phyogs 'dir tshon gyi las byas so8/ /de dag gis smras pa/ bdag cag gis khrag yin no snyam du bsams so8/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ phyogs der ba lang gi lci ba'am 'jim pas byug par bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /gang gi tshe khyim bdag 18—475

mgon med zas sbyin gyis sangs rgyas la ①sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la rgyal byed kyi tshal phul ba na de'i blo ②skyes pa/ bdag gis rgyal byed kyi tshal sangs rgyas la gsogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la phul na der cig ༷pa dag ⑤ri mo ma bris pas song la bcom ldan 'das la bdas 0par gsol te bri'o snyam nas / de bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ④ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis 'dir rtsig pa dag ri mo ma bris te de'i slad du gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis duganang na da rtsig ⑨pa ri mo bri bar 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag gnang gis ②bris shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis cig pa yiri mo bri bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong dag gis tshon sna du'i tsori mo 'bri ba byam shes nas de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la gnang ste④/ rtsig pa ri mo bri bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa de tshon sna du zhig gis bri bar bgyi lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong rmyakhyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis ma shes pa de khyed kyis dris pa legs so legs so/ /tshon sna bzhi po sngon po thams cad dang /ser po thams cad dang / dmar po thams cad dang / dkar po thams cad kyis bri bar bya'o// // 'dul ba phran tshegs kyi gzhi/⑩ bam po bcu bdun pa/ sdom ni/10—476

mkhar len ①pa yi spyad dag dang / /bu ga can gyi khri'u dang ni/ /phyag dang spa rnams bzed pa dang / /phreng ba khab dang tshar ②ma'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /mnyan yod na khyim bdag cig gnas pa de'i khyim du bsod snyoms pa zhig dus dus su 'ong zhing des de ②skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab 0pa'i gzhi dag la bzhag skego/ /dus gzhan zhig na de la rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po bdun gyi bsngags pa brjod pa dang / des smras pa/ 'phags pa bdag gis rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po gang yang rung ba zhig bgyi'o/ /bsod snyoms pas smras pa/ khyim bdag legs kyis ⑥de bzhin du ⑦gyis shig /'phags pa ci zhig bgyi/ khyim bdag dge 'dun gyi gtsug lag khang gyis shig /'phags pa bdag la kār ṣā pa ṇa dag ni mchis na/ 'on kyang chos kyi grogs bgyid pa ma mchis so/ /khyim bdag kār ṣā pa ṇa dag byin cig dang / khyod kyi chos kyi grogs nga yin no/ /'phags pa legs kyis ⑧kar ṣā pa ṇa 'di re zhes des de la kār ṣā pa ṇa dag byin no/ /bsod snyoms pa des bsams pa/'di phyogs bzhi'i latshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams kyi nor yin pas 'di las ji ltar spyad par bya/ bzhag la re zhig gzhan bslang bar bya'o snyam ⑩nas des ⑩tār ṣā pa ṇa mdzod du bcug ⑩ste bzhag go/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na khyim bdag des bsams pa/ 'phags pa bdag gi gtsug lag khang byed kyis ⑫re zhig song la de na ci dag byed blta'o snyam mo/ /de song ba dang ji tsam na ci ④yang mi snang nas/ des smras pa/ 'phags pa bdag gi gtsug lag khang 10—477

cung zad kyang ma bgyis sam/ bsod snyoms pas smras pa/ re zhig gtsug lag khang gi mkhar len ①pa'i lag spyad kyang med na cis bya/ 'phags pa kye ma kār ṣā pa ṇa dag gar mchis/ khyim bdag mdzod na 'dug go/ /'phags pa de nyid las mkhar len ②pa'i lag cha ③bgyid du stsol cig /khyim bdag ngas ④ji ltar phyogs bzhi ⑤pa'i nor gyis mkhar len 0pa'i lag cha ⑦byed du gzhugadu /'phags pa gtsug lag khang 'di yang phyorgos bzhi'i dge slong dag kho na'i slad du bgyid na 'di la ci zhig 'gal/ khyim bdag bcom ldan 'das la zhu'o/ /'phags pa de bzhin mdzod cig /des gnas skabs de dge slong rnams la bsnyad ⑨pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nor de nyid las mkhar len ⑩pa'i lag spyad bya ste/ 'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o/ /bsod snyoms pa de gtsug lag khang byed cing bsod snyoms la yang rgyu ba dang / khyim bdag gis (7smras pa/'phags pa bdag gis cigatsug lag khang mdzad cing bsod snyoms la yang rgyu'am/'di nyid las mkhar len ⑩pa'i bsod snyoms su mdzod cig dang bdag gis kār ṣā pa ṇa gzhan dag kyang dbul lo/ /khyim bdag mkhar len ④pa'i nor las ji ltar bsod snyoms su bya/ 'phags pa 'di bdag nyid kyi sems kyis tsobag yangs su bgyis ⑩pas mdzod cig /'di la 'gal ba ci zhig mchis/ des smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das la zhu'o/ /'phags pa de bzhin mdzod cig /des gnas skabs de dge slong rnams la bsnyad pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/mkhar len ⑦byed pas mkhar len 8gyi nor kho na las bsod snyoms yongs su spyad 10—478

par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ①mkhar len pa'i ②rnar kho na las bsod snyoms yongs su spyad par bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / de ha cang ngan pa za nas / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ha cang ngan pa bza' bar mi bya'o / /de ha cang bsod pa bza' bar ①brtsams pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ha cang bsod pa rjobaza' bar ⑤mi bya'i 'on kyang gtsug lag khang gzhan gyi thad tsam du yongs su spyad par bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /dge slong zhig 'khru bag yin ba de yang dang yang du chab khung ⑦sar 'gro bas rmya'o/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khri'u bu ga can bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis khri'u bu ga can bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong dag gis khyad par med par khri'u dag la mtshon lagyis phug ste bu ga btod pa ⑨dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sbas ⑩btags pa dang / 'breng bus btags pa gang yin pa de la ni phug nas bu ga gdod par bya'o/ /the yigs btags pa gang yin pa de la ni bu ga btod la bcing bar bya'o/ /de bshang ba byed pa na rkub rus na nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ phyogs der lo ma'i khres gzhag par bya'o//bshang ba sa la lhung nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'og tu gyo mo gzhag par bya'o/ /ha cang mthon por 'jog par byed nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ha cang mthon por gzhag par mi bya'o/ /de dri mi zhim par gyur 0te dge slong dag gis de phyung nas bor te gzhan bzhag pa dang /10wa 479

de yang dri mi zhim par gyur to/ /①de yang bor ba dang gzhan ma rnyed nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ thams cad dor bar mi bya'i gnyis bcangs la gcig bkrus te bskam ②par bya zhing cig shos kyang de bzhin du bya'o/ /'on te gnyis su ma rnyed par gyur na de'i steng du lo ma sgrol ba gzhag cing der bshang bar blubya ste/ de lta bu gzhan yang gzhag par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gyo mo de bkru bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / de bkrus kyang dri mi zhim par gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ til mar gyis bsku bar bya'o/ /'on kyang dri mi zhim par gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ yungs mar gyis bsku bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis nad pa la blta bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal nas/ de'i drung du nad pa la blta rjoba'i dge slong rgan po ⑤yang 'ong ngo kya/ /gzhon nu dag kyang 'ong ngo / /de nas ⑦gzhon nu gang dag yin pa de dag ni de ③phyag 'tshal bar byed/ rgan po gang dag yin pa de dag la ni nad pa de phyag 'tshal bar byed pas de skyo bar gyur nas / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /'bags pa la phyag mi bya/'bags pas phyag mi bya/ 'bags pas phyag bdag gir mi bya/ 'bags pa ⑨las phyag bdag gir mi bya'o/ /'bags pa la phyag byed dam/ 'bags pas phyag byed dam/ 'bags pas phyag bdag gir byed dam/ 'bags pa las phyag bdag gir byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur 0ro//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa nye ba ⑩'khor gyis zhus pa/bcom ldan 'das kyis 'bags pa la phyag mi bya/ 'bags pas phyag mi bya/'bags pas ⑩bdag gir mi bya/ 'bags pa las phyag bdag gir mi bya'o zhes 10—480

gang gsungs pa/ btsun pa 'bags pa du zhig mchis lags/ nye bar 'khor 'bags pa ni gnyis te/ zas kyis ① 'bags pa dang / mi gtsang bas 'bags pa'o/ /de la zas kyis 'bags pa ni so shing dang / bza' ba dang /btung ba dang / 'bras bu dang / rtsa ba la ②sogs pa za ③bas brel ba'o/ /mi gtsang bas 'bags ①pa ni bshang ba dang / gci ba dang / de dag bkru bar ⑤mi gtsang ba'i gnas kyi byi ⑥rdor bya ba byed pa'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa nye ba ⑦'khor gyis zhus pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das la bram ze pad ma'i snying pos bcom ldan 'das kyis nam bdag shing rta la 'tshal ba'am/ kha lo sgyur ba'am/ lcag sgreng ⑧ba'am/ skad cher ⑨smra ba gzigs pa de'i tshe bdag phyag 'tshal bar gi ta ma khyod kyis gzung ⑩du gsol/nam srang na mchis sam/ lham 'bud dam/ shul las byol lam/ sug pa brkyang pa gzigs pa de'i tshe bdag phyag 'tshal bar gi ta ma khyod kyis gzung ⑩du gsol / nam 'khor gyi nang nas 8mchis sam/ stan las 'phags sam/gtsug tor dang / gdugs phog pa de'i tshe bdag phyag 'tshal bar gi ta ma khyod kyis gzung ()du gsol zhes gsol pa gang lags pa/ btsun pa ci lags 'phags pa'i chos 'dul ba la de lta bu dag phyag 'tshal bar chud dam/ nye ba tso'akhor phyag byas pa ma yin gyi/ nye ba 8'khor de ni gus par smra ba'i ⑩tshig tsam du zad kyi 0lus 'dud pa dang / tshig tu 'byin pa gang yin pa de ni mchod pa yin tsono/ nye ba ⑩'khor 'on kyang 'phags pa'i chos 'dul ba la ni phyag gnyis 18—481

te / yan lag lnga pa ①dang / byin pa la 'khyud pa'o//gleng gzhi ②ni mnyan yod na'o/ /dge slong dag chos gos gang dag gyon nas skra dang kha spu 'breg pa ③byed pa de dag nyid gyon nas zan za bar byed/de dag nyid dang ston pa la phyag 'tshal bar byed pa dang / ma dad pa rnams 'phya bar byed cing shākya'i bu'i dge slong ①rnams ni gtsang sbra med pa ste/ chos gos gang dag gyon nas skra dang kha spu 'breg ⑤pa de dag nyid gyon nas zan za bar byed cing de dag nyid dang ston pa la phyag 'tshal bar byed do zhes zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos gos dag gyon nas spa dang kha spu breg par mi bya'i 'on kyang spa bzed ⑥kyi gos bcang bar bya zhing de bgos nas skra breg par bya'o / /bcom ldan 'das kyis skra bzed ⑦kyi gos bcang bar bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang / gzhan dag cig ⑧la 'byor pa med nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa⑨/ gang dag la 'byor pa med pa/ de dag gis rngul gzan 0gyis lus dkris la skra breg par bya'o⑩/ /dge slong dag gis skra dang kha spu bregs nas de bzhin du song ba dang / bram ze tsodang khyim bdag ⑫dag shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong rnams ni spu gri'i las byas nas khrus mi byed pas gtsang spra med pa'o zhes 'phya bar byed do/ /skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong dag gis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' sgul pa/ spu gri'i las byas nas khrus bya'o/ /dge slong gzhan byadag cig ni rgas 'khogs shing nyam chung bar gyur/ gzhan dag cig ni na tsonas khrus kyi sbyor ba mi tshubazod par gyur/ gzhan dag cig la ni chu'i rnyed pa med nas/ bcom ldan 'das 10—482

kyis bka' stsal pa/ de dag gis ni ①yan lag lnga tsam bkru bar bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag gis ②dge slong dag ③la me tog gi ༷phreng ba 'bul ba dang / de dag gis ma blangs nas bram ze dang khyim bdag dag ⑤gis smras pa/'phags pa dag gang gi 0tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba nas/ ci bdag cag 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten ⑦pa rol tu dge ba'i lam rgyags ③bral te mchi'am/ bzhes shig ces bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin no/ /skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong dag gis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na me tog gi 7phreng ba len par rjes su gnang ngo / /de dag gis 0blangs te de dag nyid kyi mdun ⑩du bor ba dang / de dag 'phya zhing 'phags pa bdag cag gis tsori ba'i rin gyis nyos pa yin na ci khyed kyis blangs te dor ram zhes zer nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / dor bar mi bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis dbu skra dang sen tsomo'i mchod rten dag la btags pa dang de dag gis smras pa/ ci 'phags pa bdag cag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu skra dang / sen mo'i mchod rten ma mthong snyam mamatso / bdag cag gis khyed la byin pa lags kyi bdag cag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten dag la ni dang po nyid du phul lo/ /dge slong rnams kyis blangs nas gnas khang gi sgor bzhag pa dang / bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can gyis mthong nas dri gtsang khang yin no snyam ste 'phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gnas khang gi sgor 18—483

gzhag par mi bya'i nang du gzhag par bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis sgo'i drang thad du bzhag pas nyes dmigs de nyid du gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dri zhim po thams cad mig la phan pas phyogs dben par gzhag ①cing bsnam par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gnas ②dben par gzhag cing bsnam par bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang / dge slong dag gis ji ltar gzhag pa mi shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sngas logs su khab bam tsher ma btab la 'phyang du gzhug par bya'o// //sdom ni/ stan bzang chadang ni rgyab rten dang / / dris bsku lhung bzed bu ga dang / /du'abru mar snod ni gsum dag dang / /gtur thag dang ni khron pa 'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag dge 'dun la ni 'byor na stan bzang po gnang gi gang zag la ni mi gnang ngo / /dge 'dun la ni 'byor na rgyab rten gnang gi gang zag la ni mi gnang ngo //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag gis dge slong rnams la dri phul ba dang / dge slong rnams kyis ma ⑤blangs nas de dag gis smras paX/ 'phags pa gang gi tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du ma byung ba zhes bya ba nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na gnang gis ༷dri blang bar ⑧bya'o/ /zhes bya 10—484

ba'i bar snga ma bzhin no/ /de rnams kyis blangs nas de dag nyid kyi mdun du bor ba dang / de dag gis 'phags pa dag bdag cag gis ri ba'i rin gyis nyos pa yin na khyed kyis 7blangs te dor ram ②zhes 'phya bar byed do/ /skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong dag gis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dor bar mi bya'o/ /de dag gis sridabu skra dang sen dumo'i mchod rten la phul ba dang / de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag ci ⑤bdag cag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu skra dang sen 0mo'i mchod rten ma mthong ngam/ bdag cag ⑦gis khyed la phul gyi ⑧de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu skra dang sen 0mo'i mchod rten la ni bdag cag gis dang po nyid du phul lags so/ /dge gleng dag gis blangs nas gnas khang gi sgor bzhag ⑩pa dang / bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag gis mthong nas dri gtsang khang yin no snyam ste zhabs la gtugs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' 455 pa/ gnas khang gi sgor mi gzhag gi/ 'on kyang nang du gzhag par bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis sgo'i drang thad du bzhag nas nyes dmigs de nyid du gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sgo'i drang thad du gzhag par mi bya'i 'on kyang dri zhim po thams cad ni mig la phan pas sngas ⑩kyi thad kur dri'i lag 8ris bya zhing de nas dus dus su bsnam par bya'o/ /gzhan dad pa can dag gis dge slong dag khyim du spyan drangs te mchod ston gsol nas de rnams de dag gi 8rkang pa la dri'i lag ris skud pa dang / dge slong dag gis ma blangs nas de dag gis smras pa / 'phags pa gang dag bram ze la mngon par dad pa de dag gis de dag la dang por 8dri dang phreng ba dag phul na 8de dag gis blangs te/ mgo dang lus 10—485

la nye bar sbyor bar bgyid na bdag cag gis ①ni khyed la mngon par dad de zhabs dag la 'bul ba 'gal ba ci zhig mchis bzhes su gsol/ skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong dag gis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rkang pa dag la 'bul ba bdag gir bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis blangs te de dag nyid kyi mdun du bor ba dang / de dag gis smras pa/e ma 'phags pa khyed cag gtsug lag khang du gshegs te ci ②bder mdzod ③cig/ji ltar bdag cag dad pa skyes pa de ltar ma dad pa'ang skyes so/ /skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong dag gis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de dag nyid kyi mdun du dor bar mi bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /dge slong dag lhung bzed bab chol 0du 'jog par byed pas de dag ma rung bar ⑤gyur nas/skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong dag gis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lhung bzed bab chol 0du gzhag ⑦par mi bya'i⑧/'on kyang lhung bzed bzhag pa'i bu ga byas la der gzhag par bya'o/ /dge slong dag rtsig pa rko bar byed nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rtsig pa brko ⑨bar mi bya'i 'on kyang gang gi tshe/ gtsug lag khang rtsig pa de kho na'i tshe 0lhung bzed kyi bu ga bya ste/ de bzhin du 'khor gyi ⑩khang pa la'ang bya'o//bcom ldan 'das kyis lhung bzed gzhag pa'i bu gar lhung bzed gzhag par bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang / dge slong dgon pa pa dag 0lhung bzed gzhag pa'i bu ga med nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de dag gis 10—486

lcug ma'am/ srad bu'i skon bu byas te de la ba lang gi lci ba'am/ 'jim ①pas bskus la der gzhag par bya'o/ /rdul gyis lakhyer nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de la de dang 'dra ba'i kha gab bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis ③de sa la bzhag nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' 455 pa/ sa la mi gzhag gi 'on kyang gdang thag gam/ shing gi yal ga la dpyang rjodu gzhug par bya'o / /de dag gang gi tshe ljongs rgyu zhing 'gro ba de'i tshe de khyer zhing dong nas ma dad pa dag 'phags pa ci 'dir khyim bya'am spre'u khyer zhes 'phya bar byed nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gar 'gro dgur 0skon bu khyer te/'gro bar mi bya'i 'on kyang gang du 'gro ba der gzhan zhig gzhag par bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba dun bzhugs so/ /dge slong zhig ljongs rgyu zhing ri brags shig ⑦tu phyin te/ des khyim zhig tu gnas brnyas nas rkang pa bkrus te 'bru mar bslang bar brtsams pa dang / ji tsam na bud med cig gis til mar khyer te 'ongs nas dge slong des lag pa brkyang ⑧ba dang /des smras pa/ 'phags pa slong bar mdzad la snod mi mnga' ba de ga la gda'/e ma'o khyod kyis ⑨'bru mar gyi snod bcang 'dad ⑩cig /des smras pa/ sring mo bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang ngo / /de cang mi zer bar 'dug nas skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong dag gis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na gnang gis ⑩'bru mar gyi snod bcang bar bya'o / /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'bru mar gyi snod bcang bar bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa nye dga'i dge tshul gnyis 'bru mar gyi 'brag khyer te 10—487

'bru mar gyi bsod snyoms la zhugs pa dang / bud med cig gis 'bru mar khyer te 'ongs pa dang / ji tsam na dge tshul gnyis shig 'bru mar gyi 'brag thogs pa mthong nas des brang brdungs te smras pa/ 'phags pa khyed kyi ①'di su zhig gis 'gengs par byedal/ de dag gis smras pa/ bkren pa mo khyod kyis re zhig ci byin pa de lugs shig /lhag ma lta ①bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag du'agengs so/ /de cang mi zer bar gyur nas skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong dag gis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag gis 'bru mar gyi snod ha cang chen po bcang bar mi bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag gis 'bru mar gyi snod ha cang chen po bcang bar ⑤mi bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang / de dag gis ha cang chung ngu dubacangs pas des dgos pa mi chog nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ha cang chung ngu yang mi bcang gi ⑦'on kyang 'bru mar gyi snod ni gsum ste/ chen po dang /'bring dang / chung ngu'o/ /de la chen po ni phul gang ba'o/ /chung ngu ni phul phyed pa'o⑧/ /de dag gi bar ni 'bring ngo //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /dge slong rgan po dang gsar bu zhig dang gnyis lam du zhugs te dong ba dang / de dag gtam bzang po ma yin pa zer zhing 'gro ba ji tsam na gnod sbyin ma dad pa zhig gis thos nas des bsams pa/ shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong 'di gnyis gtam bzang po ma yin pa zer zhing 'dong bas 'di dag gi ⑨mdangs dbrog par bya'o snyam ⑩bsams te⑩/de de gnyis kyi phyi bzhin 'brang ngo / /yang bsams pa/ gang 'das pa de ni 18—488

'das su zad/ gal te da ①gtam bzang po ma yin pa dag zer na nges par mdangs dbrog par bya'o snyam mo/ /de de ltar sems shing de ②dag gi phyi bzhin ② 'brang ba dulas gnod sbyin dad pa can gzhan zhig phyogs der 'ongs te/ des de la grogs po gar 'gro zhes dris pa dang / des ji ltar gyur pa de la smras so/ /des smras pa/ grogs po dge slong 'di dag ni dka' thub dang ldan pas gor ma chag ⑤par chos kyi gtam zer zhing 'dong ngo / /khyod la dge slong dag gis ci zhig byasaX/ 'dug cig ⑦dang / bdag cag phan tshun yang dag par dga' ba'i gtam dag bya zhing 'dong ngo / /des smras pa/ grogs po bdag gis 'di gnyis nges par mi gtang gis ②tshur shog 'dong ngo / / des de 0dus kyis 'chu ⑩bar shes nas de dang lhan cig tu de gnyis kyi phyi bzhin du 'brangs pa dang /dge slong de gnyis gtam bzang po ma yin pa kho na zer zhing 'dong ba las ji tsam na lam gnyis su gyur nas/ dge slong de gnyis las kyang gcig ni rgyal byed kyi tshal du 'gro'o/ /gcig ni ri dgas 'dzin gyi ma'i khang bzangs su ⑪'gro'o / /de gnyis las gsar bu gang yin pa des rgan po la phyag byas te/des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa bdag ni ri dgas 'dzin gyi ma'i khang bzangs su humachi yis ⑫khyod bag yod par mdzod la nad med par gshegs shig ces smras nas de song ba dang / gnod sbyin ma dad pa de skra gyen du bslang ste mdangs dbrog ces byas pa dang / gnod sbyin dad pa can des smras pa/ grogs po gzu lums byam byed cig /'di gnyis kyis chos bshad de/ gang nad med par gyur cig ces smras pa nad med pa de ni rnyed pa'i mchog yin la/ gang bag yod par byos shig ces zer 8ba bag yod pa ni chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin no/ /10—489

bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang / bag yod 'chi med gnas yin te/ /bag med pa ni 'chi ba'i gnas/ /bag yod 'chi bar mi 'gyur te/ /bag med rtag tu 'chi bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so zhes des de slar bzlog go/ /gnod sbyin dad pa can de 'di snyam du 'di kho na bdag gis bya ba yin no snyam ①bsams nas/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos ②phyag 'tshal nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la gnod sbyin des 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la mngon par ma dad pa/ mi ma lags pa/ gnod sbyin gtum po rtag tu gnas shing mchis lags so/ /btsun pa mngon par dad pa gang dag lags pa de dag ni nyung zad cig mchis lags te③/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la mngon par khyodad pa/ mi ma lags pa/ gnod sbyin gtum posno/ rtag tu gnas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la mngon par ma dad pa'i gnod sbyin gtum po rtag tu gnas pa ni ches mang sgrolags la/ btsun pa 'phags pa 'di dag ni gtam bzang po ma lags pa mchi zhing shul du zhugs te mchi ⑦na/ kye ma bcom ldan 'das kyis brtse bar dgongs te/ gang gis na 'phags pa dag gtam bzang po ma lags pa mchi zhing shul du zhugs te mchi bar mi 'gyur bar ⑧'phags pa rnams dran par bgyid pa cung zad cig bcar ⑨gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gnod sbyin de la cang mi gsung bas tshuganang nas/ de nas gnod sbyin de bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas song ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 18—490

'das kyis gnod sbyin de song ste ring po ma lon par mkhyen nas dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ngas gnod sbyin zhig las dge slong dag gtam bzang po ma yin pa zer zhing lam du zhugs te 'dong ba la gnod sbyin ma dad pa dag skabs tshol zhing ①glugs lta zhes thos so/ /dge slong dag legs ②par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba rnams 'di lta ste/ gtam bzang po ma yin pa zer ba de ni mdzes pa ma yin zhing 'tsham pa ma yin no/ /de lta bas na ngas dge slong lam du 'jug pa'i kun tu spyod pa'i chos dag bca' bar bya ste/ lam du 'jug pa'i dge slong gis chos kyi gtam dang / 'phags pa'i mi smra ba dang rnam pa gnyis kyis lam du zhugs nas 'gro'o rngo/ /ngal bso ba'i gnas kyi duphyogs su gtsug lag gi tshigs su bcad pa gdon par bya'o/ /chu chu ⑤ba na chu de gang gi yin pa dang / de'i lha dul tshigs su bcad pa gdon par bya'o/ /gang du gnas 'cha' ba der rgyud ⑦chags gsum pa gdon par bya'o/ /lam du zhugs pa'i dge slong gis kun tu spyod pa'i chos ji ltar bcas pa dag yang dag par blangs te 'jug par ⑧mi byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /dge slong dag gis ⑨chos gos zin pa/ chos ⑩gos mthar phyin pa tshon sar pa can dag phrag pa la bkal te lam du zhugs pa dang / de dag rdul dang rdul gyis yim rung bar gyur nas / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gtur bu byas la der bcug ⑫10—491

ste bkur bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gos dgo ①gtur bur ②bcug ste ①bkur bar bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang / dge slong dag gis chos gos kyi gtur bu ji lta bu bya ba mi shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ras gang chur ni khru gsum zheng du ni khru phyed rjodang do pa de gnyis su bltab la drub par bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis mtha' mar kha btod pas 0glang po che'i sna ltar gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mthar kha mi gdod kyi 'on kyang dbus su gdod ༷par bya'o/ /de dag gis kha thag ma btags pas de bzhin du rdul zhugs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ srad bus dra ba lta bu byas la de nas srad bu gzhan gyis brgyu ⑦bar bya'o/ /de dag gis chos gos gang dag bgo ba de ⑧dag ni 'og tu bzhag /gzhan ni steng du phyung ba dang / de dag gtur bu yang dang yang du 'byed pa na 'chol bar gyur nas / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang dag bgo ba de dag ni steng du bzhag la/ lhag ma ⑨dag ni 'og tu gzhag par bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe mi rgod dag gis 'gron pa ⑩bcom nas phan tshun khus 'debs shing bros pa dang / so so'i grong na gnas pa dag khyim nas lhags te mi rgod dag btags rab tu btags ⑪nas / mgon med cing skom ⑩pas gdungs te/ gcig nas gcig tu chu btsal ba'i phyir rmed cing khron pa zhig tu phyin pa dang / rkun po'i sde dpon gyis ⑫smras pa/ shes ldan dag 'dir chu snod dang / thag pa dag ltos shig /bltas tson thag 8pa yang med/ chu snod kyang med do/ / sde dpon gyis smras pa/skya10wa 492

shes ldan dag gal te 'gron pa ①'ga' zhig 'ong na de la ②thag pa dang / chu snod brnyasal/ shing la 'dzegs te ltos shig /de dag gis shing la 'dzegs te blta rjobar brtsams na/ ji tsam na thag ring ba 0zhig nas dge slong dag cig 'ong ba mthong ste/ de dag gis smras pa/ sde dpon shākya'i bu mang zhig 'ong ngo //des smras pa/ shes ldan de dag ni mkhas pa yin pas gdon mi za bar de dag la gdang thag dang / chu snod yod do/ /de dag gis smras pa/ sde dpon gal te de dag la yod na de lta na legs/ ji ༷ste med na ⑦de dag gi lto dral te khrag btung bar bya'o/ /de dag gis de ltar gros byas te bsdad pa dang /dge slong dag kyang lhags so/ /mi rgod dag gis dris pa/ 'phags pa bdag skom na khyod ⑧la gdang ⑨thag dang / chu snod yod dam/ de dag gis smras pa/bzhin bzangs med do/ /mi rgod dag 'khrugs par gyur te mtshon cha la rnam pa dang / de na dge 'dun gyi ⑩gnas brtan dgra bcom pa zhig gis ci'i phyir 'di dag 'khrugs shing mtshon cha la rnam zhes bsam (sprepa la zhugs pa dang /dge slong dag gsad ⑩par 'dod par mthong nas/ des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag khyed ci'i phyir 'khrugs par gyur/ de dag gis ji ltar gyur pa smras sol/ / des smras pa/8 tshe dang ldan pa dag thabs yod kyis 8tha mal par 'dug la chu 'thung 0shig /de dag tha mal par 'dug pa dang / dge slong dag gis lhas ma dang / lcag phod dang / rgya cang dag mthud de 0lhung bzed khron par dpyang la btang nas de nas chu bcus te btags so/ /btags ⑩nas mi rgod thams cad ngoms 8par byas pa dang / de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag gal te khyed kyis bdag cag la chu ma stsal bar gyur na bdag cag gis 10—493

khyed thams cad bsad par gyur to/ /e ma khyed gdang thag 'chang bar mdzod cig /de dag gis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag de bzhin bya'o/ /mi rgod dag gis phyag byas te dong ngo / /dge slong dag gis kyang ji tsam ngoms pa ①chu 'thungs nas ril ba dang / bya ma bum dag bkang ste dong nas de rim gyis mnyan yod du lhags ②so/ /dge slong dag gis 'ongs pa legs so zhes bya ba'i kun du spyod pas kun tu spyad nas tshe dang ldan pa dag ci bde bar spyad dam/zhes dris pa dang / de dag gis ji ltar gyur pa smras so/ /skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong dag gis gsol ①pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na gnang gis rjodage slong dag ⑤gis gdang thag bcang bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag gis gdang thag bcang bar bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis shin tu ring po dag 'chang nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shin tu ring po yang bcang bar mi bya'o/ /de dag ༷shin tu thung ngu dag bcangs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shin tu thung ngu yang bcang bar mi bya'o/ /'on kyang gdang thag gsum bcang bar bya ste/ ring po dang / 'bring dang /thung ngu'o/ /ring ༷po ni khru brgya lnga bcu'o/ /thung ngu ni khru brgya'o/ /de dag gi bar ni 'bring ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis gdang thag gsum bcang bar bya'o / /zhes gsungs pa dang / dge slong rnams 'chang bar gyur te/ yul gzhan zhig na chu mod pa ⑧der yang dge slong dag gdang thag khyer te 'dong ⑨nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gdang thag ni yul rnams dang sbyar zhing bcang bar bya'o// // 10wa 494

sdom ni/ spu gri bdar ①dang sen gri dang / /smang tsher rgyadang ni sngas shing dang / /bad tsha'i rigs la 'jim pa ni/ /dri yis yongs su bsgos pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /dge slong zhig gi skra ring po ring por gyur te/ de 'breg ③mkhan gyi gan du song nas bzhin bzangs bdag gi skra regs 0shig /des bsams pa/ shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong 'di dag ni nan che ste rngan pa med par las byed du 'jug pas gal te 'di'i skra bregs nas ②thos pa dang / gzhan dang gzhan dag kyang 'ong bar 'gyur bas dus ring du bsgyangs ༅te bzhag pa dang / 'di rang gi blos 0ldog go snyam nas des dus btab pa/ 'phags pa gshegs la sang gnangs snga dro'am/ slad gro'amadu / gdugs gyi gung zhig la spyon cig /de des bslus pas yang dang yang du 'gro'o/ /de la dge slong mdza' bshes shig yod pa des de yang dang yang du 'gro ba mthong nas smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod ci'i phyir 'dir yang dang yang du 'gro/ ci 'di gnyen gyi khyim mamacha/ rigs kyi khyim yin/ des smras pa / tshe dang ldan pa de ni gnyen gyi khyim dang / rigs kyi khyim yang ma yin mod kyi 'on kyang bdag gi skra ring po ring por gyur nas bdag gis 'breg ⑩mkhan de la 'di skad du/ bdag gi skra ring po ring po regs yishig dang /khyod la bsod nams su 'gyur ro zhes byas pa dang / des dus btab ste ma bregs so/ /des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa bzo bo la bden par smra ba dkon ⑫no zhes khyod kyis ma thos sam/ kho bo ni skra 'breg 0kyang mkhas na bcom ldan 10wa 495

'das kyis ma gnang ngo / /des ①skabs de dge slong dag la bsnyad ②pa dang /dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na gnang gis ③dge slong gang zhig shes pa des phyogs dben par skra breg par bya ste/ 'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gang zhig mkhas pa des phyogs dben par skra breg 0par bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong ⑤dge slong de'i drung du song nas tshe dang ldan pa bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang gis 0spa regs ④shig des smras pa/tshe dang ldan pa bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang ba ni legs na de ci mdzub ⑤mos breg par bya'am/ 'di la spu gri dang / bdar ⑨dang / sen gri dang /smang tsher ⑩dag kyang dgos so/ /des skabs de dge slong dag la smras yinas/dge slong dag gis kyang bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na gnang gis tsodage 'dun gyi phyir spu gri'i lag cha bcang bar bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ser skya'i gnas n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis ser skya na gnas pa'i shākya'i rigs las re re rab tu phyung ba na de dag rab tu gzhon 8pa'i rang bzhin can yin pas de dag sngas shing med par khas bub 0tu nyal nas gnyid tsolog go/ /de dag de bzhin du gnyig tsolog pas khams ma snyoms te drod chung bar gyur nas de dag sman pa'i drung du song ste smras pa/ bzhin bzangs bdag cag drod 0chung bar gyur na sman ston cig /des smras pa/ 'phags pa bzhud cig dang khyed cag ci 8'dra bar nyal zhing 'dug pa ltar yi'adong ngo / /de song ba dang / ji 10—496

tsam na sngas shing med par khas bub tu nyal ba mthong nas des smras pa/'phags pa khyed ①cag khas bub ②tu nyal bas ③de'i phyir khyed khams ma snyoms la drod chung bar gyur gyis dusngas shing chug la nyol cig /des smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang ngo / /des smras pa/ 'phags pa khyed kyi ston pa ni thugs rje can yin pas gnang bar 'gyur ro/ /skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong dag gis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/de lta bas na gnang gis ⑤sngas shing btsugs ⑦te nyal bar bya'o/ /de dag ⑦sngas shing btsugs ⑤te nyal na 'on kyang sos par ma gyur nas de dag gis yang sman pa la smras pa dang / des smras pa/ 'phags pa sngas nang tshangs can bcug ste nyal bar bya'o/ /bzhin bzangs bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang ngo / /'phags pa khyed kyi ston pa ⑨thugs rje can yin pas gnang bar 'gyur ro/ /skabs de bcom ldan 'das la rgyas par gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na gnang gis ⑩ dge slong gis 0sngas nang tshangs ④can bcang bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis sngas tsonang tshangs ④can bcang bar bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang / dge slong dag gis ci 'dra ba zhig ④bya ba mi shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ras de ni srid du khru bzhi zheng du khru dor byas la drub ste/ de nas shing bal gyis bkang tshul sngas su gzhug par bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa na bzhugs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa pi yin da'i 0bu rab tu byung tshun cad 8ces bya ba nas/ gnas brtan khyod kyis ci bcangs zhes bya ba'i bar snga 10—497

ma bzhin no/ /des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dris bsgos pa'i 'jim ①pa dag bcangs so/ /gnas brtan da ②ci'i phyir mi bcang / tshe dang ldan pa dag bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang ngo / /skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong dag gis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong nad pas dris bsgos pa'i 'jim pa bcang bar bya ste/ 'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o//'dul ba phran tshegs kyi gzhi las sgo gsum pa rdzogs stol// //bsdus pa'i sdom ni/ gnas brtan ra ba lhan pa dudang / /nad pa dang ni rigs ngan phag /ri mo lhung bzed med pa dang / /gnas bca' ba dang shing bskyed pa'o/ /sdom ni/ gnas brtan re mos ⑤gzhan dang ni/ /gso sbyong mtshams ni sbyar ba dang / / btung ba rnams duganyis ldan pa dang / /gtsug lag khang ni dus kun pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis zla ba phyed phyed cing gso sbyong gi tshe kha ton gdon par bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong dag gis gang gis kha ton gdon par bya ba mi shes nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyis ༅kha ton gdon par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyis kha ton gdon par bya'o zhes bka' stsal nas/ dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan zla ba phyed phyed cing gso sbyong gi tshe kha ton 'don par zhugs so/ /re zhig cig na ⑧gtsug lag khang gzhan zhig na gnas brtan zhig 'dug pa ⑨de kha ton 'don mi nus pa dang / de la dge slong dag gis smras pa/ gnas brtan gso sbyong nye 10—498

bar gnas na ci mi sems par 'dug gam/ des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag gis mi nus na ji ltar bya/ skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gal te dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyis mi nus na gnas brtan gnyis pas kha ton gdon par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gnas brtan gnyis pas kha ton gdon par bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / re zhig ①na gtsug lag khang gzhan ②zhig na gnas brtan gnyis pas kyang ma nus nas skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/gal te gnas brtan gnyis pas kyang ma nus na gnas brtan gsum pas kha ton gdon par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gnas brtan gsum pas kha ton gdon par bya'o zhes bka' stsal ③pa dang / re zhig cig na gtsug lag khang gzhan zhig na gnas brtan gsum pas kyang ma nus nas skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gal te gnas brtan gsum pas kyang ma nus na dge slong rnams kyis res su bklags te ༷kha ton gdon par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams kyis ⑤ris su bklags 0te kha ton gdon par bya'o zhes bka' stsal nas/ dge slong rnams res su bklags ⑦te kha ton gdon par brtsams pa dang / res su bklags ③te kha ton gdon ⑨pa de dag las kha cig ni nus pa la res bab/ kha cig ni mi nus pa la res bab nas/ de la nus pa gang yin pa des 0ni res ⑩bab pa tshun zla ba phyed phyed cing so sor thar pa'i mdo gdon pa 'don par byed/ mi tsonas pa gang yin pa de ni res bab pa na ④mi shes na ji 10wa 499

ltar bya zhes zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ des kyang nus pa gang yin pa de la bcol bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis mi nus pa la res bab pa gang yin pa des kyang gzhan la bcol bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / re zhig cig na ①gtsug lag khang gzhan zhig na mi nus pa la res bab pa des gang la bcol ba de ma btub nas skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nus pa gzhan gang yin pa de ②kho na la rtag tu bcol bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis zla ba phyed phyed cing dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyis so sor ③thar pa'i mdo gdon par bya'o / /de med na gnas brtan gnyis pas so/ / de yang med na gsum pas so / /rjode yang med na res su bklags ⑤te kha ton gdon par bya ba'am/gzhan nus pa gang yin pa de la bcol bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang /gtsug lag khang gzhan zhig na so sor ༷thar pa'i mdo bstan pa ⑦jil thon pa ni 'ga' yang med kyi ⑧dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyis phas pham par gyur pa'i chos bzhi bton 0te/ lhag ma ma thon nas dge slong ⑩dag gis gso sbyong bzhag go/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gso sbyong gzhag par mi bya'i 0'on kyang gang gis gang 8thon pa des de gdon par bya ste/ gal te dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyis phas pham par 'gyur ba'i chos bzhi thon na 0de dag gdon par bya zhing gzhan gyis dge 'dun lhag tsoma'i chos bcu gsum gzhan gyis ma nges pa'i chos gnyis/ gzhan gyis spang ba'i ltung byed kyi chos sum bcu/ gzhan gyis 10wa 500

ltung byed kyi chos dgu bcu/ gzhan gyis so sor bshags par bya ba'i chos bzhi/gzhan gyis bslab pa mang po'i chos rnams gzhan gyis rtsod ①pa zhi bar byed pa'i chos bdun te/ de ltar gso sbyong gi mtshams sbyar na gso sbyong gi bar chad du 'gyur bar nga mi smra'o// gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la 0tshe dang ldan pa nye ba ③'khor gyis zhus pa/ btsun pa dus su rung ba'i 0btung ba zhes kyang bka' stsal①/ dus ma lags par rung ba zhes kyang bka' stsal nadu/btsun pa dus su rung ba ni gang lags/ dus ma lags par rung ba ni gang lags / nye ba ⑦'khor ma btsags ⑧pa ni dus su rung ba'o/ /btsags te chu dang bsres ⑨pa ni dus ma yin par rung ba'o/ /gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /drug sde rnams sdig pa 'dod pa/ ser snas ⑩mi rigs par gtsug lag khang la yongs su spyod par byed de kha cig la ni dus thams cad pas kha cig la ni gnas res su gcod (7pas/ kha cig la ni dus re zhig pas/ kha cig la ni rting gnon pas yongs su spyod par 'byed do/ /ji ltar dus 8thams cad pas yin zhe na/ 'di ni bdag gi dgun gyi gtsug lag khang ngo / /'di ni dpyid kyi'o//'di ni dbyar gyi'o zhes bya ba ste/ de ltar na ④dus thams cad pas yin no/ /ji ltar na gnas res su gcod pas yin zhe na/ 'di ni bdag gi sang gi gtsug lag khang ngo / /'di ni gnangs kyi'o/ /'di ni gzhes kyi'o zhes bya ba ste/de ltar gnas 8res su gcod pas yin no/ /ji ltar na dus re zhig pas yin zhe na/ 'dir ni snga dro gnas so/ /'dir ni phyi dro'o zhes bya ba ste/ de ltar na dus re zhig pas yin no/ /ji ltar na rting gnon pas yin zhe na/ 'di ni 10—501

bdag gi ①slob dpon gyi gtsug lag khang ngo / /'di ni mkhan po dang / lhan cig gnas pa dang / nye gnas dang / gtam 'dres pa dang / phebs par smra ba'i 'o ②zhes bya ba ste/ de ltar na rting gnon pas yin no/ /yul sna tshogs na gnas pa'i dge slong dag lhags pa dang phongs par gyur nas skabs de dge slong rnams ①kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na dge slong gi rjogatsug lag khang dag la dus thams cad pa dang / gnas ris ⑤su gcod pa dang / dus re zhig pa dang /rting gnon pas yongs su spyad par mi bya ste/ spyod na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro// //sdom ni/ ra ba dang ni shing thags dang / /lam dang 'obs dang skar rgyal dang / /chos gos bcags shing phyis pa dang / /cha ga dang ni bram ze 'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /gang gi tshe khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis rgyal byed kyi tshal phyogs bzhi'i dge slong gi dge 'dun la phul ba de'i tshe 'jig rten dag rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi nang du dga' mgur 'gro zhing 'ong nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis bsams pa/ bdag gi gtsug lag khang lam po cher gyur gyis ༷de'i phyir gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na ⑦bdag gis ⑧ra bas bskor ro snyam du bsams nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te / phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas khyim bdag 10—502

mgon med zas sbyin gyis ①bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa gtsug lag khang 'di shul po cher gyur te de'i slad du ②gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na bdag gis 'di ra bas bskor bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag de lta bas na gnang gis skor ③cig/des ra bas bskor ba dang / gang gi tshe dbyar gyi 0dus la bab pa'i ①tshe rgyal byed kyi tshal chus sbyang ༷bzhin gang ste 'dug go⑦/ /ji tsam na khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal du song ba dang /des rgyal byed kyi tshal chus sbyang bzhin du gang ba mthong nas/ des bsams ⑧pa bdag 0gis rgyal byed kyi tshal ra bas bskor gyi 0stor khung ma btod pas ⑩des na 'di chus sbyang 8bzhin du gang ste 'dug go/ /de'i phyir gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis sanang na stor khung gdod do snyam du bsams nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag gis rgyal byed kyi tshal ra bas bskor gyi stor khung ma btod 8pas des na 'di chab kyis sbyang bzhin bltam ste byamachis so/ /de'i slad du gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na bdag gis stor khung gdod par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/khyim bdag de lta bas na gnang gis 8thod cig /des stor khung btod tsodo/ /ba lang dag 'ongs shing 'ongs nas cig pa la lus kyis bsnyogs ⑩shing ras brud ⑫pa dang / ji tsam na khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin yigyis mthong nas des bsams pa/ bdag gis rgyal byed kyi tshal ra bas bskor gyi shing thags ma bres pas des dun ba lang dag 'ongs shing bya'ongs nas 'di la lus kyis bsnyogs blashing ras brud dudo/ /de'i phyir gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na bdag 18—503

gis 'di shing thags kyis bskor bar bya'o snyam du bsams nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis ①bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag gis rgyal byed kyi tshal ra bas bskor gyi shing thags ma bres pas ba lang dag mchis shing mchis nas de la lus kyis bsnyogs shig ②ras brud ③de/de'i slad du gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na shing thags bre 0bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag de lta bas na gnang gis ⑤shing thags res dushig /des shing thags bres pa dang / ma byin par len pa dag gis shing thags dral ⑦te brkus so/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin 'chag cing song ba dang / shing thags bar bar nas dral zhing shing de yang brkus par mthong ngo / /des bsams pa/ bdag gis rgyal byed kyi tshal ra bas bskor nas shing thags bres na/ 'di bar bar nas dral ③te shing yang brkus kyis ⑨de'i phyir gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na bdag gis 'obs kyis ⑩bskor ro snyam du bsams nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag gis rgyal byed kyi tshal ra bas bskor cing ⑩shing thags bres na de 'obs kyis tsom bskor bas bar bar nas dral nas shing brkus na/ de'i slad du gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na bdag gis 'obs kyis bskor bar 10—504

bgyi'o / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag de lta bas na gnang gis ①thobs kyis skor ②cig /des 'obs kyis bskor to//gleng gzhi ①ni mnyan yod na'o/ /mnyan yod na dge slong ma skar rgyal zhes bya ba zhig 'dug pa de duskra ring po ring por gyur nas de 'breg ⑤mkhan kyi drung du song ste/ bu skra regs 0shig /khyod la bsod nams su 'gyur ro zhes byas pa dang / des bsams pa/ ji ltar shākya'i ⑦bu'i dge sbyong dag nan che ba de ltar 'di dag ④kyang rngan pa med par las byed du 'jug ste/ gal te 'di'i skra bregs na gzhan dang gzhan dag kyang 'ong bar 'gyur bas dus ring du bshol te bzhag pa ⑨dang / 'di rang gi blos ldog par 'gyur ro snyam nas/des 'phags ma bzhud la sang gnangs ⑩snga dro'am/ nyi ma'i gung ngam/ slad dro spyon cig ces dus btab po/ /de des bslus pas yang dang yang du 'gro ba dang / de'i smos 'drin dge slong ma zhig yod pa des de yang dang yang du 'gro ba mthong nasahu/ des smras pa/ 'phags ma khyod ci'i phyir 'dir yang dang yang du 'gro/ ci 'di khyod kyi nye du'i khyim mam(spre/ rigs kyi khyim yin/des smras pa/ 'phags ma 'di ni bdag gi nye du'i khyim yang ma yin/ rigs kyi khyim yang ma yin mod kyi 'on kyang bdag gi skra ring po ring por gyur nas bdag gis 'breg ༷mkhan 'o ni la bu bdag gi skra ring po ring po bregs 0shig dang / khyod la bsod nams su 'gyur ro zhes byas na des ma bregs te dus btab po/ /des smras pa/ 'phags ma khyod kyis bzo bo la bden par smra ba dkon par ma thos sam/ kho tsomo ni skra 'breg tsomakhas na 'on kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang ngo / /des skabs de dge slong ma rnams la bsnyad pa dang /10—505

dge slong ma rnams kyis dge slong rnams la'o/ /dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong ma gang zhig mkhas pa des phyogs dben par skra breg par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong ma gang zhig mkhas pa des phyogs dben par skra breg par bya'o zhes bka' stsal nas/ dge slong ma de ①dge slong ma de'i drung du song ste / 'phags ma bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang gis ②tshur spyon skra regs ①shig/des smras pa/ 'phags ma gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na dulegs na/de ci'i ⑤sor mos breg gam/ 'di la spu gri dang / bdar rjodang / sen gri dang / smang tsher ⑦dag dgos so/ /des skabs de dge slong ma rnams la bsnyad pa dang / dge slong ma rnams kyis dge slong rnams la'o/ /dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na gnang gis ⑧dge slong ma rnams kyis dge 'dun gyi phyir spu gri'i spyad dag bcang bar bya'o// //'dul ba phran tshegs kyi ⑨gzhi/ bam po bcwa ⑩brgyad pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi yitshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis dga' bo rab tu byung ba de'i tshe de la bzang mos chos gos bcags shing rab tu bcags pa dag mnyan yod du bskur 8ro/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa dga' bos chos gos bcags shing rab tu bcags pa sar pa ba sos phyis pa dag tshubagos/ lhung bzed 'tsher ba thogs nas dge slong rnams kyi byamadun na 'gying bag tu rlom nas skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom 10—506

ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ nyes dmigs gang cung zad byung ba ni dge slong dag chos gos bcags pa dang / rab tu bcags pa dag gyon pa las gyur to snyam du mkhyen nas dge slong ①rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de ②lta bas na ③skyes bu gti mug rjodaga' bo chos gos bcags shing rab tu bcags pa sar pa ba sos phyis pa dag bgos lhung bzed 'tsher ba thogs nas/ dge slong rnams kyi mdun du 'gying bag tu rlom ⑤pa 'di ni mdzes pa ma yin zhing 'tsham rjopa ma yin no/ /de lta bas na dge slong gis chos gos bcags shing rab tu bcags ⑦pa dag bcang bar ⑧mi bya ste/ 'chang na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑨dge slong gis chos gos bcags shing rab tu bcags ⑩pa dag bcang bar mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag dge slong rnams la chos gos bcags shing rab tu bcags pa dag 'bul ba na dge slong rnams kyis ma blangs nas/ de dag gis ⑩smras pa/ 'phags pa dag gang gi tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du ma byung ba de'i tshe ni ༷mu stegs can rnams sbyin gnas lags/ tsobacom ldan 'das 'jig rten du byung na da ④ltar khyed sbyin gnas lags na/ gal te khyed mi bzhes na ci bdag cag 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol tu dge ba'i lam rgyags byam mchis par mchi'am zhes zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa dang ⑫/ de lta bas na gnang gis 0blang bar bya zhing blangs nas 'tsher tsob yal bar byas te yongs su longs spyod ⑩par bya'o/ /de dag gis lag pas mnyes nas duyal bar ma nus nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ zil 10—507

pa ①la bzhag ste yal bar bya'o/ /zil pa ②la bzhag ste yal ③bar byas na 'on kyang thams cad kyi thams cad du yal bar ma gyur nas/ ba com ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chu'i nang du bcug par bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis chu'i nang du bsugs dun 'on kyang yal bar ma gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ltar byas kyang ma yal na yongs su longs spyad par bya ste/'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o/ /de bzhin du bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag gis dge 'dun la chos gos bcags pa dang rab tu bcags pa dag phul na de dul yang rim pa 'di nyid kyis yongs su longs spyad par bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe mnyan yod kyi bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams rtog ༷khang du 'dus shing 'khod nas bar skabs kyi gtam 'di lta ⑦bu dag gleng ste/ dge sbyong go ta ma bcom ldan 'das kyang bgo nibasha' byed pa'i rang bzhin can ma yin la/ de'i nyan thos rnams kyang bgo bsha' byed pa'i rang bzhin can ma yin pas/ nyis na mu stegs can dag rung gi dge sbyong mgo reg de dag 0ni ma yin no zhes zer ro/ /de na bram ze gcig cig gis smras pa/ kho bos dge sbyong gi ta ma bgo bsha' byed pa'i rang bzhin can yin nam/ 'on te bgo bsha' byed pa'i rang bzhin can ma yin/ de'i nyan thos rnams bgo ⑩bsha' byed pa'i rang bzhin can yin nam/ 'on te ma yin pa sang khyed kyis ⑩mngon sum du gyur par bya'o/ /de dag gis smras pa legs te/ de bzhin du gyis shig dang blta'o/ /des ras 8lug cig tsokhyer nas rgyal byed kyi tshal du song ste/ des ras yug 8de rgan pa'i mtha' logs ⑫10—508

su bzhag nas/ phyogs bzhi'i dge slong gi dge 'dun la phul te/ 'phags pa bdag gis ras yug 'di dge 'dun la phul gyis ①ci bder mdzod cig ces byas pa dang / de la dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan ②gyis smras pa/ bram ze chen po nad med par gyur cig /sbyin pa 'dis rgyakhyod kyi sems kyi rgyan dang /sems kyi yo byad dang / rnal 'byor gyi tshogs dang / don gyi mchog thob pa dang / lha dang mi'i gos dag thob par gyur cig ces byas pa dang / des bcos rjomar mgos phyag byas nas song ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑤tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo song la dge slong rnams la ras yug 'o ni bram zes glags btsal ba'i phyir phul gyis rjode lta bas na khyed kyis mnyam par bgos rgyal/ la las ni cha gar thob shig⑧ /la las ⑨sgrog gzungs su/ la las ni lhan ⑩par/ la las ni chos gos kyi sgro yigur ⑫gyis shig ces bsgo 0shig /btsun pa de ltar 'tshal lo zhes tshe dang ldan pa ⑫kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das kyi 8ltar mnyan nas/ dge slong rnams la tshe dang ldan pa dag bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas ras yug 'o ni 8bram zes glags btsal ba'i phyir phul gyisabya/ de lta bas na khyed kyis 'amanyam par bgos yil/la las ni cha gar thob shig⑥ /la las ni sgrog 0gzungs su/ la las lhan ⑫par / la las ni chos gos kyi sgro dugur gyis shig ces de skad bka' stsal to④/ /dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ btsun pa kun dga' bo bcom ldan 'das kyis ji skad bka' stsal pa de bzhin 'tshal lo zhes de rnams kyis de mnyam par gsesagade bzhin du bgos so/ /ji tsam na bram ze chanang gar sngar langs nas mnyan yod kyi sgo na 'dug go/ /dge slong dag kyang snga dro sham thabs bgos/ lhung 10—509
