thang cig dang yud tsam de la tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bar du sgra grags par gyur te / tshangs ris pa'i lha rnams kyi ①sgra phyung zhing dbyangs rjes su bsgrags pa/grogs po dag bcom ldan 'das kyis lha dang mi rnams kyi zhes bya ba nas/ 'di yul bā rā ṇa sī drang srong smra ba ri dgas kyi nags su bskor bas lha'i ris dag ni mngon par 'phel bar 'gyur/ lha ma yin gyi ris dag ni yongs su nyams par 'gyur ro ②zhes bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis yul bā rā ṇa sī drang srong smra ba ri dgas kyi nags su chos kyi 'khor lo chos dang mthun pa lan gsum gyi bar du bzlas te rnam pa bcu gnyis pa bskor te/ de'i phyir chos kyi rnam grangs 'di chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba zhes bya'o/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong lnga po dag gi ②rgyud la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te/ de dag bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos por gyur pa de'i tshe de dag ④de bzhin gshegs pa la shin tu mtshan nas smos pa dang / gdung nas smos pa dang /tshe dang ldan pa zhes smos pa kun tu spyod nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de dag la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyed de bzhin gshegs pa la shin tu mtshan nas smos pa dang / gdung nas smos pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa zhes smos pa kun tu ma spyod cig /dge slong dag de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gang zhig de bzhin gshegs pa la shin tu mtshan nas smos pa dang / gdung nas smos pa dang /tshe dang ldan pa zhes ⑤smos pa kun tu spyod pa de ni skyes bu gti mug de la yun ring por gnod pa dang / phan pa ma yin pa dang sdug bsngal bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ nyes dmigs gang cung zad byung ba ni dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa la mtshan nas smos pa dang / gdung nas smos pa 10—612

dang / tshe dang ldan pa zhes smos pa kun tu spyod pa las gyur gyisal/ de'i phyir dge slong gis de bzhin gshegs pa la mtshan nas smos pa dang / gdung nas smos pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa zhes smos pa kun tu spyad ②par mi bya'o snyam du dgongs nas dge slong lnga po dag la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na dge slong gis de bzhin gshegs pa la mtshan nas smos pa dang / gdung nas smos pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa zhes smos pa ①kun du spyad par mi bya ste/ kun tu spyod na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gis ④de bzhin gshegs pa la mtshan nas smos pa dang / gdung nas smos pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa zhes smos pa kun tu spyad par mi bya ste/ kun tu spyod na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong gzhon nu gzhon nu ⑤dag dge slong rgan pa rgan pa ⑥dag la ming nas smos pa dang / rus nas smos pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa zhes smos pa kun tu spyod ⑦nas skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong gzhon nus dge slong ches rgan pa la ⑧ming nas smos pa dang / rus nas smos pa kun tu spyad par mi bya'o/ /'on kyang tshe dang ldan pa zhes bod pa'amakhye/ btsun ⑩pa zhes bod ⑩pa gnyis kun tu spyad par bya'o / /dge slong gzhon nus dge slong ches rgan pa la ming nas smos sam8/rus nas smos 0pa kun tu spyod na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /gleng gzhi tsoni mnyan yod na'o/ /mnyan yod na dge slong 'phral thabs can dang / dge slong ma gsod mo ji lta ji ltar skye bo'i tshogs mang po mi dad par 'gyur ba de lta de ltar khyim dag tu rgyu ba 'byed ces bya ba rgyas par rnam par 'byed pa las ji skad 10—613

'byung ba bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ku sha'i ༅grong khyer na gyad kyi nyen ②'khor shing sā rgyal zung dugi tshal dun bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i dus kyi tshe de na dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ngas 'dul ba rgyas par bstan na/ mdor bsdus te yang ma bstan pas legs par rab rkye nyanyon la yid la zung gshig ⑧bshad do/ /dge slong dag khyed kyis ngas 0sngon gnang ⑩ba yang med/ bkag pa yang med pa gang yin pa de yang gal te mi rung ba sten ⑩cing rung ba dang mi ⑫mthun na rung ba ma 0yin pa'i phyir spyad par mi bya'o/ /gal te rung ba sten ⑫cing mi rung ba dang mi mthun na rung ba yin pa'i phyir spyad par 8bya ste 'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o// //sdom ni/ spangs pa dag ni bged pa dang / /sbrang ma rnams kyi skyabs dang ni⑩/ /spyad tshags dang ni 'gyo mo dang / / sra brkyang tsogading dang mang po'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /dge slong zhig la chos gos kyi spang ba byung nas/ des de rgan pa'i mtha' logs su 'dug ste dge 'dun la spangs so/ /dge skos ⑩kyis bsams pa/ 'di ni dge 'dun gyi rnyed pa grub pa yin te spel nas bgo bar bya'o snyam nas/ des de spel nas dge 'dun la brims pa dang/ dge slong de phongs par gyur 0to/ /skabs de byadage slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa nyes dmigs gang cung zad byung ba ni dge slong dag spang ba dge 10wa 614

'dun la spangs pa las gyur gyis①/ de'i phyir dge slong gis sridage 'dun la spang bar mi bya'o snyam du dgongs nas/ dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag dge slong zhig gis spang ba chadage 'dun la spangs pa dang / de dge skos ①kyis spel te bgos kyis⑤/ de lta bas na dge slong gis spang ba dge 'dun la spang bar mi bya'i/ 'on kyang gang zag la spang bar bya'o/ /gal te mi shes pas spangs na yang dge ⑥'dun gyis bgo ⑦bar mi bya'o/ /dge slong gis spang ba dge 'dun la spangs sam/ dge 'dun gyis bgos na gnyi ga la ⑧'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gi ②spang ba dge 'dun la spang bar mi bya'itshu/ 'on kyang gang zag la spang bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong gzhan zhig la chos gos kyi spang ba byung ste/des dge slong mi shes pa zhig la spangs pa yidang / des blangs nas cang mi zer bar 'dug go/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong gzhan gyis brda 7sprad par bya ste/ gal te byin na legasatso/ ci ste ④mi ster na mthus phrogs 8la byin gyis brlab ⑩par bya'o/ /rung bar bya ba'i phyir spangs pa ⑦yin pas spangs pa gtan 8bkur bar mi bya'i 'on kyang spangs pa slar sbyin ⑩par bya'o//gleng dugazhi ni yangs pa can na'o/ /dbyar gyi dus su dge slong dag sbrang bu mchu rings kyis 0zos te/ de 'dag g.ya' ste sen mos lus kun phrugs pa dang / bar bar du khrag gi thigs pa dang thor bu dag byung bar snang ngo / /de ltar lus mi sdug pa de dag bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis mthong nas/ de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa khyed 0ci zhig gis lus kyi gnas skabs 'di lta 10—616

bur gyur/ de dag gis ji ltar gyur pa bsnyad pa dang / de dag gis smras pa/'phags pa khyed sbrang skyabs mi 'chang ngam/ ribazhin bzangs bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang na ji ltar bcang / 'phags pa khyed kyi ston pa ni thugs rje can yin pas gnang bar 'gyur ro/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na gnang gis ①dge slong dag ②gis sbrang skyabs bcang bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gis sbrang skyabs bcang bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal na/ dge slong gis ci 'dra ba bcang bar ②ma shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ras srid du khru bzhi zheng du khru do ④pa de shing la brgyangs la steng nas dgab par bya zhing ras khru bcu gnyis pas ngos dukhor yug tu ⑥bskor bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis ras de ma lus par byas pa dang / glo nas sbrang bu mchu rings ⑦dag 'jug nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ras lhag ma dang bcas pa bcang bar bya zhing des glo nas dkri ⑧bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis sbrang skyabs byas nas ras de phyogs gcig nas bteg ⑨ste 'dzul ba dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sgo gdod par bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis sgo thad kur btod pa ⑨ dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑩bka' stsal pa/bsnol tsomar bya'o/ /tsha yinas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de nyid du bsil yab gzhag par bya'o/ /'og nas sbrang ma mchu rings byadag 'jug nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gnas mal gyis dgab par bya zhing rnam pa gang dang gang gis sbrang bu skemachu rings 0za ba de thams cad rung ba ⑩bya'o//gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis chu btsag 8par 10—616

bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong dag lag pas chu tshags 'dzin pas de dag ngal bar gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shing ①la btags te btsag par bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis shing la btags ②te btsags ②na 'on kyang ngal nas④/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dbyug ⑤ku gsum bcang bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis dbyug ⑥ku gsum la btags na 'dug tu ma btub nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de dag phug la srad bu'am/ gzer bus sbrel ⑦la chu tshags gdags par bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis chu tshags btags nas chu blugs pa dang / phyed sa la bo nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ci nas sa la mi 'bo bar dran pa nye bar gzhag ste blug ⑧par bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis bum pa zhabs rten med par bzhag pas de 'dril nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ zhabs rten gzhug ⑨par bya'o/ /dge slong gzhan 4) dag gcig gis chu blang bar brtsams pa dang / de chu tshags su ma tshags ⑩pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/gcal cigazhug par bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis ci zhig gzhug pa tsom shes nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bye ma'am/ ba lang gi lci ba'o/ /'on kyang ma tshags tsonas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshags ⑫rten snod bcang bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis tshags rten snod bcang bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong dag gis ji lta bu bcang ⑩mi shes nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshags rten snod ni gnyis te/ zangs las byas pa dang / sa las byas pa'o/ /dge slong dag gis tshags rten snod 10—617

lag pas bzung ba dang / de dag ngal nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / zangs las byas pa gang yin pa de ni phug la lcags thag 'jam pos dbyug gu ①gsum la gdags par bya'o/ /sa las byas pa gang yin pa de ni phug la tha gus gdags par bya'o/ /chu tshags gzhan dag chu ma phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de dag gis tsoglor yang dang yang du brdab par bya'o/ /dge slong dag chu rtog pa na bum pa ma gang ba la brtags pas srog chags dag ma rtogs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bum pa legs par bkang la ji 0srid du chu mi g.yo ba de srid du gzhag par bya zhing /de nas brtag par bya'o/ /bum pa bkang ba dang / steng du rdul zhugs pa dge slong dag gis de ma bsal bas srog chags dag ma rtogs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rdul bsal nas brtag par bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis srog chags mdzub ④mo'i rtse mos bstan pas de dag 'gul te ⑤mig gis ma sod pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shing bu'i rtse mo'am / rtswa'i ⑨rtse mo'am phra mo gzhan gang yang rung bas bstan par bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis chu tshags nyid nas chu khron par pho ba dang / srog chags dag rdab snun ⑦pas gnod par gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / bsal tshags ⑧bsrel bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis bkang ste btang na phyir ⑨gang bzhin du 'ong ba gang yin pa de lta bu bsrel yinas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bkang ste btang na phyir 0stong par 'ong ba ci 'dra ba de 'dra ba bsrel bar bya'o/ /gzhan dag gcig gis bsal tshags byam 'byor nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de dag gis ni chu 10—618 ca

tshags the ①gus btags la ci nas ②bkang ste btang na phyir stong par 'ong ba de ltar gtang ③bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis chu pho nas chu tshags bshal bar mi byed 'khru rjobar mi byed/ 'tshir bar mi byed/ skems 0par mi byed/ lteb par mi byed nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chu tshags kyis 0chu pho nas de bshal bar bya/ bkru bar bya/ bcir bar bya/ bskam par bya/ bltab par ⑨bya'o/ /dge slong dag dge 'dun gyi chu yang chu tshags kyis tshag ⑧par byed pa dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun phal ches bas skyo ⑨bar gyur nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gal te dge slong gi dge 'dun pal che bar gyur na 0chu tshags mang po bcang ba'am/ yang na bum tshags gce'u can bcang bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bum tshags yigace'u can gyis btsag ⑫par bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong dag gis bum tshags gce'u can ji lta bu mi shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sa 'am zangs las bum pa'i dbyibs ⑩lta bu bya zhing de la pad ma'i snying po lta bu'i ④bu ga dag gdod par bya'o/ /de dag bsdu ba'i phyir de dag gi steng du bu ga chen po gcig gdod do/ /de dag nyid bsdu ba'i phyir tsogace'u gzhug par bya'o/ /de nas steng ras kyis g.yogs la chu btsag (9par bya zhing ras de yang bshal bar bya/bkru bar bya/ bskam par bya'o⑩// // 'dul ba phran tshegs kyi gzhi/tso bam po nyi shu yiganyis pa/ dge slong dag gis shig dang / rtswa 0shig dang / srog chags gzhan dag g.yang sa nas bor ba dang / de dag dran pa nyams 0shing gnod par gyur to/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das 10—619

kyis bka' stsal pa/ srog chags thams cad g.yang sa nas dor bar mi bya'o/ /de dag gis gar bab bab tu bor ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / gar bab bab tu bor ①bar mi bya'i/ shig ni ②ra de'i srinang du gzhug par bya/ de ma rnyed na ka ba'i ser ku'am④/ rtsig pa'i bu gar chug shig /rtswa 0shig ni ne'u gsing sngon po'i sa phyogs su gzhag par bya'o/ /de ma rnyed na bsil ༅ba'i phyogs su'o/ /srog chags gzhan yang rang rang gi gnas su gtang ⑦bar bya'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa nye ba cha'akhor gyis zhus pa/ btsun pa chab btsags ⑨pa ma brtags ⑩pa 'tshal du rung lags sam/nye ba 7'khor mig 8gis ma brtags blun mi rung ngo / /btsun pa chab btsags pa brtags pa 'tshal du rung lags sam/ nye ba 8'khor mig 8gis brtags ⑫pa'i phyir rung ngo ⑩//gleng gzhi ni mnyan 8yod na'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dbyar gnas par khas blangs pa'i dge 'dun gyis sra brkyang gding bar yibya'o zhes bka' stsal pa( rte / ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis thos nas des dge 'dun la sra brkyang phul lo/ /de bzhin du btsun mo phreng ldan ma dang / rgyal rigs dbyar tshul ma dang / khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin dang / drang srong byin dang /rnying ⑥pa dag dang / phya mkhan dag dang / gzhan mang po dag gis sra brkyang phul ba dang / dge slong dag gis sra brkyang gcig cig byin gyis brlabs nas lhag ma gzhan de dag nyid la slar bskur bar brtsams pa dang / de dag gis 'phags pa 'di dag ni bdag cag gis dge 'dun la phul ba lags pas bdag cag slar ji ltar 'tshal/ skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la 10—620 byu

gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de'i phyir gnang gis blang ①bar bya zhing blangs nas kyang gtan pa 'ding ②ba'i dge slong mang po bsko bar bya'o/ /ji ltar sngar bskos pa de las phyis gcig ③gding bar bya'o/ /lhag ma rnams ni gzhag par bya zhing / de ni dbyar gnas par ④khas blangs pa'i dge 'dun gyi bgo ⑤ba'i rnyed pa yin pas dbyar gnas par ༅khas blangs pa'i dge 'dun tshogs pas ci dgar bgo ⑦bar bya ste 'di la 'gyod ⑧par mi bya'o// //sdom ni/ nga 'das pa la sbyin med dang / /gang gis bsngos ⑨pa shi ba dang / ci /gang la gtad pa shi ba dang / /babs pa dang ni 'gyod pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /mnyan yod na khyim bdag cig gnas pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ⑩ma blangs te/ de ⑩de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur 8spyod par byed do/ /de rtse bar byed dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las rim gyis bu gsum byung ngo / /de rnams kyi tha chungs tsogang yin pa de legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ngo / /de 'dus gzhan zhig na ljongs rgyu zhing song ngo / /ljongs rgyu zhing song ba na de'i pha nad kyis thebs nas de rtsa ba dang / sdong bu dang / lo ma dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu'i sman rnams kyis rim gro byas kyang de'i nad de zhi bar ma gyur te/ gang gi tshe de 8shi la thug pa'i tshor ba byung ste/ ring po ⑩mi thogs par 'chi ba'i dus byed par 10—621

'gyur ba de'i tshe des mdza' bo dang / gnyen dang phu nu bo dang / khyim tshes rnams bsdus nas bu de gnyis la smras pa/ bu nga'i ༅khyim na cung zad ci yod pa ②de thams cad khyer te shog shig③ /de dag gis kyang de'i tshig mnyan te thams cad khyer te 'ongs pa dang / des mdza' bo dang ①/ gnyen dang /phu nu de dag dang / khyim tshes kyi mi de la smras pa/ shes ldan dag gson ⑤cig/bdag gi bu gsum yod pa las phu bo gnyis ni 'di dag yin/ tha chungs gang ⑥yin pa de ni dge sbyong shākya'i ⑦nang du rab tu byung ngo / /de'i phyir bdag gi khyim na nor gang cung zad ci yod pa de thams cad de rnams mnyam par bgos shig ces smras nas/ bsags pa kun gyi mtha' zad ⑤cing / /mthon po'i mtha' ni rnyil ⑨bar 'gyur/ /'du ba'i mtha' ni 'bral ⑩ba ste/ / gson po'i skematha' ni 'chi tsob yin/ /zhes bya bas dus kyi chos tsodang ldan par gyur te / de khyogs gos sngon po dang / dmar po dang / ser po dang /dkar po dag gis brgyan te dur khrod du tsokhyer nas bsregs so/ /de'i bu de dag gis de'i 8shid btang ba dang mya ngan bsang ba byas te 'dug go/ /de'i bu des bdag gi ⑩pa de shi'o ⑩zhes thos nas/ de 'di snyam du bdag song la ma yar tsomo de dang / phu bo de dag la chos bshad de mya ngan bsang bar bya'o snyam du bsams nas de ji srid 'dod par ljongs na 'dug nas lhung bzed dang /chos gos khyer te/ mnyan yod gang na ba der rgyu zhing song nas/ rim gyis ⑩rgyu zhing song ba las mnyan yod du phyin to/ /des chos gos dang lhung bzed rgyal byed kyi tshal du bzhag ste lam gyis dub pa ngal bso nas charang gi khyim du song ngo //nang mi rnams kyis de mthong nas ngus so/ /ngu ba de thos nas khyim tshes rnams 10—622 ci

'dus te/ la la ni skad phyung ste ngu ①/ la la ni mig ②mchi mas gang bar gyur to/ /de so so'i skye bo yin pas skye bo'i tshogs chen po smre zhing 'dug pa thos nas da yang mig ①mchi mas gang zhing 'dug pa dang / de la khyim tshes kyi bud med gcig ④gis smras pa/ bu mya ngan ma byed cig /khyod kyi pha de ⑤bsod nams byas pas lha yul du song ngo / /khyod la yang phas mdza' bo dang /gnyen dang / phu nu bo ⑥dang / khyim tshes rnams bsdus te nor gyi sum cha gcig kyang byin no/ /des bsams pa bcom ldan 'das kyis nga 'das nas 'di la byin cig ces zer ba ni med pa yin no zhes gsungs pa gang yin pa de ni 'di lta bu yin no snyam du rig nas nga de'i phyir mya ngan byed pa ni ma yin gyi nga'i pha de dka' ba byed byed pas dbang med par mchi ma byung ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang pha ma ni bu la dka' ba byed de/ snyod pa dang / gso ba dang /bskyed ⑦pa dang / 'dzam bu'i nigling sna tshogs ston pa yin te/ bu'i phrag pa gcig gis pha blangs shing / cig shos kyis ma blangs te lo brgya tshang bar bkur ba byas pa'amanya/ sa chen po 'di la nor bu dang / mu tig dang / bai ḍūr+ya ⑨ dang / man shel dang / byu ru dang / dngul dang / gser dang / rdo'i snying po dang / spug dang / pad ma rā ga dang / g.yas su 'khyil pa de lta bu'i dbang phyug gi bdag por bzhag kyang 'di tsam gyis na yibus pha dang ma la phan thogs pa'am tsolan lon 8par mi 'gyur gyi/ gang zhig gis pha ma de dag ma dad pa las dad pa phun sum tshogs pa yang dag par len du 'jug /gzengs stod 4)par byed/ 'dul bar byed/ 'jog par byed/rab tu 'jog par byed cing / tshul khrims 'chal ba tshul khrims phun sum 10—623

tshogs pa dang / 'jungs ①pa gtong ba phun sum tshogs ②pa dang / shes rab 'chal pa shes rab ②phun sum tshogs pa yang dag par len tu 'jug /gzengs stod ④par byed/ 'dul bar byed/ 'jog par byed/ rab tu 'jog par byed na de tsam gyis na ༅bus pha ma la phan btags pa dang lan blan ⑥par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das kyis nga 'das nas de la byin cig ⑤ces zer ba ni sbyin pa ⑤ma yin no zhes bkag go /bud med de cang mi zer bar 'dug go/ /skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ngas ni khyim pa las ⑨dgongs te gsungs pa ma yin gyi0/ 'on kyang rab tu byung ba las yidagongs pa yin no/ /khyim bdag ni chags pa tsodang bcas bzhin du 'chi bar 'gyur la/ rab tu byung ba ni ma yin no/ /de lta bas na de'i phyir khyim pa 'di snyam du nga 'das nas 'di la sbyin no snyam du sems pa ni byin pa yin gyi/rab tu byung ba ni ma yin pas blang bar bya zhing blangs nas kyang ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du 8longs spyod 'du yongs su spyad par bya'o//gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /dge slong zhig gis dge slong zhig la chos gos dag bsngos so/ /des de dag bsngos nas dus las 'das pa dang / dge slong de dag gis de khyer nas sreg 8tu song ngo / /de'i bar du dge slong des de'i gnas khang nas de'i chos gos de dag blangs te rang gi gnas khang du bzhag go / /de nas dge slong de dag gis de'i rim gro byas nas gtsug lag khang du log pa dang / dge skos ⑩kyis de'i gnas khang ⑩du brtags na/ ji tsam na lhung bzed dang chos gos gsum dang / chu tshags mthong nas/ des rgan 10—624

pa'i mthar khyer ba dang / de la dge slong de dag gis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod kyis ①de'i chos gos gsum po 'di khyer te 'ongs sam/ de la chos gos rung bar byas pa gzhan yang mang du yod na de dag 0khyer te shog shig③ /des smras pa/ de'i gnas khang na ni 'dir zad kyi gzhan cung zad kyang med do/ /dge slong dag gis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa de'i smos 'drin dge slong che ge mo zhes bya ba de la dris shig /des de la dris pa dang smras pa/ bdag gis khyer te / des bdag la bsngos so/ /skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag rung bar bya ba'i phyir ngas bsngo bar gnang ste/ gang gis de dag khyer ba de la 'di skad ces gyis shig /shi ba'i yo byad kyi rnyed pa de dag dge 'dun la phul la rang gi skal bas chog par ④gyis shig ces sgos shig⑤/gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /dge slong gzhan zhig gis dge slong zhig la chos gos dag bsngos pa dang / gang la bsngos pa de dus las 'das so/ /de dudage slong rnams kyis dur khrod du khyer nas bsregs te slar 'ongs nas de'i chos gos de dag rgan pa'i mthar khyer ba dang de la dge slong dag ⑦gis smras pa/tshe dang ldan pa 'di dag su'i yin/ des smras pa/ 'di dag ni bdag gi lags mod kyi 'on kyang bdag gis ⑧de la bsngos so/ /dge slong dag gis de ji ltar bsgrub pa mi shes nas/ skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la rgyas par ⑨gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag rung bar bya ba'i phyir ngas bsngo bar gnang mod kyi 'on kyang gang gis bsngos pa de nyid kyi yin no//10—625

gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /dge slong gzhan zhig gis dge slong zhig la chos gos dag bsngos pa dang / gang la bsngos pa de babs nas/ des bsams pa/ bdag la dge slong des chos gos dag bsngos pas bdag babs mod kyi 'on kyang de dag bdag dbang gis ①len du 'gro'o snyam nas/ de dge slong de'i drung du song ste/ des smras ②pa/ 'phags pa khyod kyis chos gos dag bdag la bsngos na de dag bdag la stsol cig /skabs ③de dge slong dag la brjod pa dang / de dag gis ji ltar bsgrub pa mi shes nas/ skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la rgyas par gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis ④dgongs pa/ nyes dmigs gang cung ༅zad byung ba ni dge slong gang kho na la yid brtan te chos gos dag btams ⑥pa de kho na'i mdun du bsngo ⑦ba las gyur gyis 'de'i phyir dge slong gis gang la yid brtan te 0chos gos dag btams ⑩pa de kho na'i mdun du bsngo bar mi bya'o snyam du dgongs nas/ dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na dge slong gis yid brtan cing 7chos gos btams 8pa de nyid kyi mdun du chos gos bsngo bar mi bya'i/de'i mngon sum du bsngo bar cham byas na ④nyes dmigs der mi 'gyur ro/ /gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /dge slong gzhan zhig gis dge slong zhig la chos gos dag bsngos te/ gang la bsngos pa 8de thab khrol 8can zhig ste/ rtag tu dge slong dag 6)dang lhan cig thab khrol 'byed pa las de gzhan ⑨ zhig dang thab ⑥mo byas nas 'gro bar chas pa dang / gang gis ⑥de la chos gos dag bsngos pa des de mi btang chabar brtsams te/ tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gro shig duces des de bzung ba dang / 'dug tu ma btub 'bo/ /des yang dang yang du bzlog pa 10—626

dang / de la dge slong zhig gis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa 'di ni thab khrol ①can zhig ste rtag tu dge slong rnams la mi bde bar byed pa yin gyis ②thong shig/des smras pa/ gzhan gyi phyir 'di mi gtong ba ma yin gyi/ nga nyid kyi chos gos dag 'di la bsngos pas 'di 'dzin to/ /skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/gal te yid brtan pa'i dge slong rgya mtsho'i pha rol na 'dug pa zhig yin na de la yang ②yid brtan te/ bsngo ba byas nas gzung rjobar byas te⑤/ 'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gal te yid brtan pa'i dge slong rgya mtsho'i pha rol na 'dug pa zhig yin na de la yang chos gos dag bsngo bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong gzhan zhig gis yidage slong yul shin tu thag ring po na 'dug pa zhig la chos gos bsngos te/ de dus las 'das par gyur pa dang / dge slong des dge slong de ji ltar dus las 'das par gyur pa'i ⑦ring zhig ⑧lon nas thos pa dang / dge slong de 'gyod pa skyes so/ /skabs de dge slong dag la smras pa dang / dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang gi tshe thos pa ⑨de'i tshe gzhan la bsngo bar ⑩bya ste/ 'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o// //sdom ni/ mtshams kyi phyi rol 'dug pa yis/ /dad pa mi dbul sbyin mi bya / /gcig la gcig ni mi bya dang / /gso sbyong dang ni dgag dbye'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /dge slong drug sde dag 18—627

mtshams kyi phyi rol na gnas kyang dad pa 'bul ba'i skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/mtshams kyi phyi rol na gnas pas dad pa dbul bar mi bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis mtshams kyi phyi rol na gnas pas dad pa dbul bar mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong gzhan dag cig mtshams kyi phyi rol du song ngo /de dag chas pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bya ba zhig byung nas drug sde rnams kyis de dag las dad pa blangs so/ /skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mtshams kyi phyi rol du song ba las dad pa blang bar mi bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis mtshams kyi phyi rol na gnas pas dad pa dbul bar mi bya/ mtshams kyi phyi rol du song ba las dad pa blang bar yang mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / drug sde rnams mtshams kyi phyi rol na ①gnas bzhin ②du gcig la gcig dad pa sbyin par byed de/ dga' bos ni nyes chadaga' la/ nye dga'as kyang dga' bo la/'dun pas ni 'char ka la/ 'char kus kyang 'dun pa la/ 'gro mgyogs ④kyis ni nab so la/ nab sos kyang 'gro mgyogs la dad pa byin pa dang /skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong gis gcig la gcig dad pa sbyin par mi bya ste/ byin na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro//gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis zla ba phyed phyed cing gso sbyong gi tshe ⑤so sor thar pa'i mdo gdon pa thon cig ces bka' stsal pa dang / drug sde dag mtshams kyi phyi rol na gnas shing gso sbyong la 'dun pa dang /10—628

yongs su dag pa 'bul lokya/ /skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mtshams kyi phyi rol na gnas pas gso sbyong la 'dun pa dang / yongs su dag pa dbul bar mi bya'o / /bcom ldan 'das kyis mtshams kyi phyi rol na gnas pas gso sbyong la 'dun pa dang / yongs su ②dag pa dbul bar mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang /dge slong gzhan dag gcig mtshams kyi phyi rol du song ngo / /de dag chas pa dang / dge 'dun gso sbyong bya bar bzhed nas 'dus pa dang / drug sde rnams kyis de dag las 'dun ③pa dang / yongs su dag pa blangs so/ /skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mtshams kyi phyi rol du song ba las 'dun pa dang /yongs su dag pa blang bar mi bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis mtshams kyi phyi rol na gnas pas dad pa dang / yongs su dag pa dbul bar mi bya/ mtshams kyi phyi rol du song ba las dad pa dang / yongs su dag pa blang bar yang mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / drug sde dag mtshams kyi phyi rol na gnas bzhin du gcig la gcig dad pa sbyin par byed de/ dga' ④ngos ni nye dga' la/ nye dga'as kyang dga' bo la/ 'dun pas ni 'char ka ⑤la/ 'char kus kyang 'dun pa la/ 'gro mgyogs kyis ni nab so la/ nab sos kyang 'gro mgyogs la dad pa byin pa'i skabs de dudage slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong ⑦gis gcig la gcig gso sbyong gi dad pa dang / yongs su dag pa sbyin par mi bya'o/ /dge slong gis gcig la gcig gso sbyong gi dad pa dang / yongs su dag pa sbyin na 10—629

'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro// gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dbyar gnas par khas blangs pa'i dge slong gis ①gnas gsum po mthong ba dang / thos pa dang /dogs pas dgag dbye bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang ②/ drug sde dag mtshams kyi phyi rol na gnas shing dgag dbye'i dad pa dang / yongs su dag pa 'bul ba rgyas par thams cad gso sbyong bzhin no// // sdom ni/ dge slong bgrang bar bya ba dang / /tshul shing dag dang gang 'dod dang / /stan gcig khyim na gnas pa dang / /dge tshul gsar bu mi 'dug pa'o / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /mnyan yod na bram ze zhig 'dug pa de bya ba cung zad cig la phyir byung nas rgyal byed kyi ③tshal du song ba dang / de re zhig 'di na dge slong du zhig gnas dri'o snyam pa'i 'dod pa skyes nas/ des dge slong rnams la dris pa/ 'phags pa dag 'di na dge slong du zhig gnas/ de dag gis smras pa/ bram ze ma shes so/ /bram zes smras pa/ yul ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi khrom gyi ru'i grangs kyang shes na khyed kyis dge slong dag mi shes pa lta/ de dag cang mi smra bar 'dug pa dang /bram ze de song ngo / /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag bgrang bar bya'o / /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag bgrang bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong dag gis gcig ces bya ba la sogs pas bgrangs ba dang /18—630

phyis brjid nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gcig ces bya ba la sogs pas bgrang bar ①mi bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis sor mos 'dzugs shing bgrangs ②na 'on kyang brjid nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/sor mos gzugs shing bgrang bar mi bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis sridage slong dag gis gcig ces 0bya ba la sogs pas bgrang bar mi bya/ sor mos btsugs ༷shing bgrang bar mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong dag gis ji ltar bgrang ba ma shes so/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshul shing brim par bya zhing brims nas bgrang bar bya/ bgrangs yinas dge 'dun la dge slong 'di snyed do zhes brjod par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis tshul shing brim par bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong dag gis nyi ma'am zla ba'am/lo gang la brim pa mi shes nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dbyar nye bar gtong ba'i tshe tshul shing brim par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag bgrang bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / mnyan yod na khyim bdag cig gnas pa de dus dus su rgyal byed kyi tshal du nye bar 'ongs te/ des de na dge slong dag bsam gtan dang / 'don pa dang / yid la byed pa'i rnal 'byor la brtson pa mthong nas/ de ⑦de dag gi ⑤spyod lam dang / spyod pa dang /sgrub pa des mngon par dad de/ des bsams pa/ re zhig 'di na dge slong ji snyed cig yod pa dris la phyis spyan drangs te bshos gsol lo snyam nas/des dge slong rnams la dris pa/ 'phags pa/ dge slong ji snyed cig bzhugs / ⑨ dge slong dag gis smras pa/ 'di snyed cig go/ /des rkang pa 10—631

la phyag 'tshal te song nas rang gi khyim du phyin ①te nang mi la smras pa/ song ②kho bos sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun bshos gsol gyis ③khyed kyis dge slong 'di snyed cig gi rjobashos sbyor 0cig /de dag gis smras pa/ rje'i sras legs te de bzhin du bgyi'o zhes de dag gis hwags dang / bu ram dang /sha ka ⑥ra la sogs pa sta gon bya bar brtsams so/ /khyim bdag de yang mdza' bo dang / nye du dang / phu nu rnams sbran nas bshams zin pa'i dus su de dag dang lhan cig rgyal byed kyi tshal du song ste/ rgan pa'i mtha' nas rkang pa la phyag byas nas/ dge skos ⑦la smras pa/ 'phags pa khyim bdag che ge mo zhig sang sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun sdum par gdugs tshod la spyan 'dren to/ /zhes de skad gsungs shig /dge skos ⑤kyis smras pa dang /dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis gnang nas de rkang pa la phyag 'tshal te song ngo / /dge slong gzhan dag cig kyang ljongs rgyu ba rgyu zhing mnyan yod du phyin to/ /de nas khyim bdag de de nyid kyi nub mo bza' ba dang bca' ba gtsang zhing bsod pa sta gon byas nas/ nang par sngar langs te gdan bshams chu ra ⑨bzhag nas/bcom ldan 'das la pho nya las tho)btsun pa gdugs tshod bshams lags na/bcom ldan 'das kyis da de'i dus la bab par dgongs su gsol zhes gdugs tshod gdas par gsol to/ /dge slong rnams snga dro sham thabs bgos lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te khyim bdag de'i khyim du dong ngo / /bcom ldan 'das ni gtsug lag khang na bzhugs shing gdugs tshod der drangs so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni rgyu lngas gtsug lag khang na bzhugs shing gdugs tshod 'dren te/ lnga gang zhe na/ nang du yang dag 'jog par bzhed pa yin/10—632

lha rnams la chos ston par bzhed pa yin/ gnas mal la gzigs par bzhed pa yin/ nad pa la gzigs par bzhed pa yin/ nyan thos rnams 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bzhed ①pa yin no/ /don 'di la ni bcom ldan 'das nyan thos rnams 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bzhed nas gtsug ②lag khang na bzhugs shing der gdugs tshod drangs so/ /khyim bdag des dge slong gi sridage 'dun gyi tshad bzhin stan bshams/ zan sta gon byas pa las ji tsam na dge slong rab tu mang bar mthong nas des smras pa/ 'phags pa bdag gis khyed kyis dge slong ji snyed yod pa bstan pa de snyed kyi dge slong gi gdan bshams/ bshos sta gon byas na dge slong mang du byon to/ /dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ khyim bdag dge slong glo bur pa dag ④lhags kyis ⑤rab tu dga' ba skyed cig /des smras pa/ 'phags pa kye ⑥ma khyed kyis medage slong gzhan dag kyang 'ongs so zhes bgyis ⑧dang / bdag gis bshos kyang mang du sta gon bgyis/ gdan yang mang du bshams pa zhig /dge slong dag spobs pa med nas cang mi ⑨smra bar 'dug go/ /de na kha cig tha ma ma sgyungs 0tsam du gyur te/ de dag la dge slong rnams gshe bzhin ⑩du kham zin 8tsam za bar gyur to/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge skos kyi tshudage slong glo bur ba 'di snyed cig lhags so zhes tsodage slong glo 'bur pa rnams shes par byas nas khyim bdag la sbran par bya'o/ /dge slong gzhan dag gcig zan gyi thad ka kho nar 'ongs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de dag kyang sbran par bya'o//dge slong gzhan dag gcig sngar bos pa las gud du song nas/ bcom ldan 10—633

'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de dag kyang sbran par bya'o/ /gzhan yang ngas dge 'dun gyi ①gnas brtan gyi dge slong gi kun tu spyad pa'i chos bca' bar bya ste / dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyis chadage slong gi dudage 'dun blta bar bya zhing / gal te dge slong ni mang zan ni nyung na/ sbyin bdag la bzhin bzangs zan ni nyung / dge slong ni mang gis ④stoms par rims 0shig ces brjod par bya'o/ /'on te zan ni mang dge slong ni nyung na des bzhin bzangs zan ni mang gis ༅ci 'byor pa bzhin rims ༅shig ces brjod par bya'o/ /dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyi dge slong gis kun tu spyad pa'i chos ji ltar bcas pa rnams yang dag par blangs te mi 'jug na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro//gleng ⑧gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka snga dro sham ⑨thabs bgos lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te mnyan yod du bsod snyoms kyi phyir zhugs tho)so/ /mnyan yod du bsod snyoms la brgyus thormenas/btsun mo phreng ldan ma ga la ba der song ste phyin nas btsun mo phreng ldan ma la chos bstan par brtsams so/ /des 8de la chos ston pa na ri dgas 'dzin gyi ma sa ga dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi na ba'i sman khyer nas glu dang rol mo'i sgra dang /rgyal byed kyi tshal du chas pa btsun mo phreng ldan mas thos nas des spre)smras pa/'phags pa glu dang rol mo'i sgra grags 8pa 'o ni su'i lags/ des smras pa/btsun mo ri dgas 'dzin gyi ma sa ga dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi na ba'i sman khyer nas 'gro ste/ sgra 'o ni 8de'i yin no/ /des smras pa/ 'phags pa gal te de lta na btsun mo phreng ldan gyis dge slong gi dge 'dun la na ba'i sman gyis bstabs so ⑩zhes bdag gi ming gis dge slong gi dge 'dun la brjod pa'i 10—634

rigs so/ /des smras pa/ btsun mo legs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang gang zhig nad pa la rim gro byed pa de ni nga la rim gro byed pa yin no zhes gsungs pas/khyod kyis ①ming gis dge slong gi dge 'dun la bstab ②par bya'o zhes smras nas/btsun mo phreng ldan ma la nad med par gyur cig ces byas te stan las langs nas song ngo / /de nas gtsug lag khang du song ste/ rgan pa'i mthar 'dug nas smras pa/ btsun mo phreng ldan mas dge slong gi dge 'dun la na ba'i sman gyis bstabs kyisal/ gang zhig sman gang 'dod pa de song la slongs ༷shig /dge skos ⑤kyis bsgo ba ⑥dang / dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑦rgyal po'i pho brang du 'gro ba la nyes dmigs bcu yod do zhes ma gsungs sam/ de ji ltar bdag cag gis sman gyi phyir bslab pa las 'da' bar bya/ de spobs pa med nas cang mi zer bar 'dug ste/dge slong 'ga' ⑧yang phreng ldan ma las sman mi slong ngo / /ji tsam na tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka yang btsun mo phreng ldan ma'i der song ba dang / des smras pa/'phags pa khyod kyis bdag gi ming gis dge slong gi dge 'dun la na ba'i sman gyis ma bstabs sam/ btsun mo ⑨bstabs so/ / 'phags pa gal te de lta na ci'i slad du dge slong dag mi byon/ btsun mo bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po'i pho brang du 'gro ba la nyes dmigs bcu yod do zhes ma gsungs sam/ dge slong dag 'dir ji ltar 'ong /⑩ 'phags pa gal te de lta na bdag gis 'di la ji ltar bsgrub par bgyi/ btsun mo tshong dus ⑩pa'i tshong pa'i lag tu kār ṣā pa ṇa dag gtad tson/ dge slong gang zhig gang 'dod pa de de las de tislong grang ⑫/des smras pa/ 'phags pa legs te de ltar bgyi'o zhes tsotshong 'dus pa'i tshong 10—635

pa'i lag tu kār ṣā pa ṇa dag gtad nas smras pa/ 'phags pa dag rgyal po'i pho brang du mi 'ong gis ①dge slong gang zhig gang 'dod pa de la de byin cig /tshong pas rgyal mo'i bkas kār ṣā pa ṇa dag blangs te bzhag pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis lha mo phreng ldan mas spos 'tshong che ge mo zhig la kār ṣā pa ṇa dag gtad de/ dge slong gang zhig gang 'dod pa de khyod kyis sbyin par bya'o zhes bsgo ba thos nas song la bslang ngo snyam mo/ /de na chadage slong kha cig ni song nas smras pa/ bzhin bzangs kho bo cag la khur skam dang / khur ba dang /sha khu dag byos la byin cig /kha cig gis smras pa/ kho bo cag la khur ba dang sha skam byin cig /kha cig gis smras pa/ kho bo cag la sha khu khrol bu dang /tshog pa byin cig /de de dag gis gtses pa dang / smras pa/ 'phags pa bdag ni khur mkhan yang ma lags sha g.yos mkhan yang ma lags pas/ dbyig 'di snoms te bzhud ③la gang zhig gang bzhed pa des de bgyid du stsol cig /de dag gis smras pa/ bzhin bzangs bcom ldan 'das kyis dbyig ma gnang ngo / /des smras pa/ 'phags pa bdag ni spos 'tshong ste tshong 'dus ④kyis 'tsho ba lags na/ de lta na bdag gi ⑤'tsho ba 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sbyin bdag la yid brtan te kār ṣā pa ṇa dag blangs nas ci 'dod par yongs su spyad par bya ste/ 'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o//gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /drug sde rnams khyim pa dag dang lhan cig stan gcig la 'dug pa bram ze dang / khyim bdag dad pa can dag gis mthong nas 'phya bar byed cing / 'phags pa khyed rab tu byung ba tshangs par 10—636

spyod pa yin na/ ji ltar 'dod pa'i longs spyod spyod pa 'di dag dang lhan cig stan gcig la 'dug ces byas pa ①dang / de dag cang mi zer bar 'dug pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag bram ze dang / khyim bdag dad pa can dag 'phya ba ni thog tu bab bo/ /de lta bas na dge slong dag ②gis khyim pa dag dang lhan cig stan gcig la 'dug par mi bya ste/ 'dug na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim pa dag dang lhan cig stan gcig la 'dug par mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge tshul dag dang lhan cig stan gcig la 'dug pa dge bsnyen dag gis mthong nas smras pa/'phags pa khyed ②ni bsnyen par rdzogs pa lags na/ ji ltar dge tshul dag dang lhan cig stan gcig la bzhugs ④de dag gis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag 'di dag ni khyim pa ma yin te/ 'di dag dge sbyong ⑤yin na 'di la 'gal ba ci zhig yod/ de dag cang mi smra bar 'dug pa'i skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/bsnyen par ma 0rdzogs pa dang lhan cig stan gcig ⑦la 'dug par mi bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bsnyen ⑧par ma rdzogs pa dang lhan cig stan gcig la 'dug par mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong rgan pa rgan pa dag gsar bu gsar bu dag dang lhan cig stan gcig la 'dug pas gsar bu rnams rgan pa rnams la ma gus par byed pa'i skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa⑨/ rgan pa dang gsar bu lhan cig stan gcig la 'dug par d+me bya'itshu/ 'on kyang bar na lo 10—637

gsum zhugs pa dang lhan cig stan gcig la ①'dug par bya ste/ lor ma lon pa dang / lo gsum lon pa yang ②lhan cig 'dug par bya zhing / lo gcig lon pa dang / lo bzhi lon pa nas ①de bzhin du lo dgu lon pa dang / lo bcu gnyis lon pa'i bar yang lhan cig 'dug par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bar na lo gsum zhugs pa dang lhan cig 'dug par bya ste/ lor ma lon pa dang /lo gsum lon pa ④yang lhan cig 'dug par bya zhing / lo gcig lon pa dang /lo bzhi lon pa nas de bzhin du lo dgu lon pa dang / lo bcu gnyis lon pa'i bar ⑤yang lhan cig 'dug par bya'o zhes bka' stsal te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bar na lo gsum zhugs pa dang 0lhan cig 'dug par bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong dag khyim gyi nang du yang bar na lo gsum zhugs pa dang lhan cig 'dug par mi ⑦byed pas des stan dag ma 'byor nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim gyi nang du ni slob dpon dang mkhan po dag dang yang ⑧lhan cig 'dug par bya ste 'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o// //sdom ni/ dge tshul khri'u ⑨g.yogs mi sbyin dang / /dge tshul kha drang mi bya dang / /mna' dang skugs 'dzugs ⑩mi bya dang / /stag gi god ma mi bza' ba'o / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis chos nyan pa'i stan bsham ⑩par bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge tshul dag kyang khri'u g.yogs ma can la 'dug nas chos nyan par byed de8/ de dag gnyid log nas de nyid du bshang gci shor 0te khri'u g.yogs ma can dag ma rung 10—638

bar gyur pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge tshul la khri'u g.yogs ma can sbyin par mi bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge tshul la khri'u g.yogs ma can sbyin par mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu'i dge tshul skul byed ces bya ba de chos nyan du song ba dang / de la dge slong dag gis khri'u rkyang pa zhig byin pa dang / des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag ci'i phyir bdag la khri'u rkyang ①pa sbyin/ de dag gis smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ②dge tshul rnams la khri'u g.yogs ma can bkag go/ /des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag ci kho bo yang nyes dmigs de byed dam/ skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge tshul gang dag dran pa nye bar 'jog pa de dag la/ khri'u g.yogs ma can sbyin par bya'i/ gzhan dag la ni ma yin no//gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /dge slong zhig la dge tshul zhig yod pa de la des nan tur ②byas pa dang / ri de rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi sgo na ngu zhing 'dug go//drug sde las gang yang rung ba zhig gis ④rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi sgo mi stong ⑤pa yin pas tshe dang ldan pa nye dga' sgo na 'dug pa des de mthong nas des smras pa/dge tshul ci'i phyir ngu / des smras pa/ btsun pa nye dga' bdag mkhan pos nan tur dubyas so/ /bu tshur ngas ⑦khyod kyi lhung bzed dang / chos gos dang /dra ba dang / phor ④bu dang / ska rags dang / khyod gang dang gang gis phongs ⑨pa de dang des mi phongs ⑩par bya'o zhes des yiganas khang du 'khrid do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis nan tur byas nas yal bar dor bar mi bya'o0/ /'on 18—639

kyang slar dgug par bya'o zhes bka' stsal pas/ dge slong des dge sbyong de la dge slong zhig mngags nas des de la smras ①pa dang / des smras pa/ kho bo la mkhan po ci dgos/ nye dga'as kho bo'i yo byad ②thams cad sbyar bas mi 'gro'o / /dge slong de ②'phya bar byed/ gzhogs phyas ⑤byed/ smod par byed de/ bdag gis rab tu phyung ba nye dga'as kha phyung ⑤ngo zhes zer ba'i rjoskabs de dge slong dag gis ⑦bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong gis gzhan gyis ⑧dge tshul kha drang bar mi bya ste kha 'dren na dbyen dang nye ba'i nyes pa sbom 0por 'gyur ro//gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /drug sde rnams gang dang gang du dgos par mna' 'dor bar byed de/ sangs rgyas la mna' 'dor/ chos dang dge 'dun la mna' 'dor/ slob dpon dang mkhan po la mna' 'dor ba dang /bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can rnams kyis smras pa0/ slob dpon dag bdag cag khyim pa lags kyang / ston pa la mna' 'dor bar mi bgyid na/khyed rab tu byung ba lags na ji ltar ston pa la mna' 'dor 'di ni 'tsham 0pa ma legs 8so zhes byas pa dang / de dag cang mi zer bar tso'adug pa'i 8skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can rnams 'phya ba ni thog 8tu bab po/ /rab tu byung ba ni bden pa'i bsam pa can yin te / de lta bas na dge slong gis mna' 'dor bar mi bya'o/ /dge slong mna' 'dor na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro//gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /drug sde dag gang dang gang du dgos par 18—640 ci

lhung bzed dang / chos gos dang / dra ba dang / phor ①bu dang / ska rags dang / gzhan yang dge sbyong gi yo byad gang yang rung ba dag skugs su 'dzugs ②par byed pa bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis mthong nas 'phya bar byed cing 'phags pa khyed ci khyim pa dag bzhin ③du lhung bzed la sogs pa yo byad skugs su 'dzugs sam/ de ni 'tsham ④pa ma yin no/ /de dag gis smras pa/ sgog skya zos sam/ chang 'thungs sam/ 'di la mi 'tsham pa ci zhig yod/ de dag cang mi zer bar 'dug pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams 'phya ba ni thog tu bab po/ /de lta bas na dge slong gis skugs gzugs par mi bya ste/ dge slong skugs 'dzugs ⑤na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro//gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ drug sde rnams kyi ⑥kun tu spyod pa ni nang par sngar langs nas khang thog tu 'dzegs te phyogs bzhir blta ④zhing de dag gang na du ba 'thul ba'am/ bya rgod lding ba snang ba der myur du gom ⑧pa bslang ste 'gro bar byed do0/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na nye dga' nang ⑩par sngar khang thog tu 'dzegs 7te blta bar brtsams tson/ des bya rgod lding ba mthong nas de rings 8pa rings par song ba dang / ji tsam na stag gis nags thibs po'i sa phyogs zhig 6tu god ma zhig sbas pa mthong nas de dga' ste/ de khyer nas rgyal byed kyi tshal du song ba dang / stag dri snom zhing phyi bzhin 'brangs nas rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi sgo na sgra 'byin par byed do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du rmed 8par mdzad pa yin pas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan 10—641

pa kun dga' bo la mas ①pa/ stag 'o ni ci ste skad 'byin/ des gsol pa/btsun pa des god ma sbas pa de btsun pa nye dga'as ②'tshal te mchis pa'i slad du'o / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo dge slong ③stag gi god ma za'am/ btsun pa 'tshal ④lags so/ /kun dga' bo ri dgas kyi rgyal po seng ge ni ri dgas bzang po bzang po dag bsad nas sha bzang po dag zos shing khrag bzang po dag 'thungs nas bor te 'gro'i/ stag ni ⑤god ma sbed par byed pas de lta bas na dge slong gis stag gi yigod ma bza' bar mi bya ste/ za na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag gzhan ༅yang ngas dge 'dun gyi ⑧gnas brtan gyi kun du spyad ⑨pa'i chos bca' bar bya ste/dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyi ⑩dge slong gis sha 'drim ⑩pa'i tshe 'di ci'i sha stag gi 8god ma ma yin nam zhes dri bar bya'o/ /ma dris par len na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro// //sdom ni/ tshul shing rnams ni brims pa na/ /spun gnyis dag ni gab pa dang / /la ba bsgyur bar bya ba dang / /de lta bu la sogs pa 'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /ri 'or 0zhig na gtsug lag khang zhig yod de(9/ ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na dga' bo dang /nye dga' ljongs rgyu zhing dong ba las ri 'or 8der phyin to/ /de dag der phyin pa na dge 'dun la yang rnyed pa zhig grub na de dag gnas ngan len kun tu spyod pa yin pas dge slong gang gis kyang ma bcar ba 0dang / nye dga' bos dga' 18—642

bo la smras pa/ slob dpon lhung bzed nag po can 'di dag khengs pa nga rgyal can dag cig pas gtses tshul spyon①/ gab ste bzhugs la 'di dag rnyed pa ji ltar 'ged ②pa gzigs so/ /des smras pa/ legs te de bzhin bya'o zhes de dag gab ste 'dug pa dang / dge 'dun gyis rnyed pa de bgos ②so/ /gang gi tshe rnyed pa dubagos ①zin pa de'i tshe de dag 'ongs nas smras pa tshe dang ldan pa dag dge 'dun gyi rnyed pa grub pa bgo'o/ /dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ khyed ga las da gzod ⑥'dir 'ongs kyi/ rnyed pa de 'drim ⑦pa'i tshe ma yin/ de dag gis smras pa/ ci khyed bgod rgyu zhig yin nam/ bgos par mi chud kyi bgo nyes te/ ci khyod kyis go bar byas nas bgos sam/ skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge 'dun la deng dge 'dun gyi rnyed pa 'drim ⑧na/ dge slong gang yang gang du yang ma 'gro shig ②ces go bar byas nas rnyed pa brim ⑩par bya'o//dge slong rnams kyis rnyed pa de slar bsdus so/ /bsdus nas dge 'dun la dge 'dun gyi rnyed pa 'drim yin/ dge slong gang yang gang du yang ma 'gro shig ⑫ces bsgo tsonas/ de dag gis bgo bar brtsams pa dang / dga' bo dang nye dga' de bzhin du gab ste bya'adug go// // 'dul ba phran tshegs kyi gzhi/tso bam po nyi shu tshugasum pa/ gang gi tshe dge 'dun gyis rnyed pa de bgos zin pa de'i tshe de dag yang 'ongs nas smras pa/tshe dang ldan pa dag tshur rnyed pa de bgo'o/ /dge slong dag gis smras pa/khyed yigang nas da gzod 'dir 'ongs kyi rnyed pa de dge 'dun la go bar byas nas 'drim 8pa'i tshe ni ma yin/ de dag gis smras pa/ gal te khyed ⑩kyis go 10—643

bar byas kyang bgos par mi chud ①kyi bgo ②nyes te/ ci khyod ②kyis go bar byas nas gaṇ+ḍi ④brdungs sam/ skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ go bar byas nas gaṇ+ḍi ⑤brdungs te dge 'dun la rnyed pa de brim par bya'o/ /dge slong rnams kyis yang rnyed pa de slar bsdus so/ /bsdus nas de bzhin du go bar byas te/gaṇ+ḍi ⑥brdungs nas bgo bar brtsams pa dang / de dag de kho na bzhin du gab ste 'dug ⑦gro/ /gang gi tshe rnyed pa de bgos zin pa de'i tshe yang 'ongs te de kho na bzhin du smras pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ dge 'dun la yang go bar byas/ gaṇ+ḍi ⑧yang brdungs nas ⑨khyed ga las da gzod ⑩'dir 'ongs/de dag gis smras pa/ khyod ⑩kyis go bar yang byas/ gaṇ+ḍi ④yang brdungs kyang ci ga khyed kyis 'tshul shing brims sam/ bgos par mi chud kyi tsobago nyes so zhes zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ go bar byas te gaṇ+ḍi brdungs nas tshul shing brim par bya'o/ /dge slong rnams kyis yang rnyed pa de bsdus so/ /bsdus nas go bar byas/ gaṇ+ḍi brdungasatso/ tshul shing brims te bgo bar brtsams pa dang / de dag de kho na bzhin du tsogab ste 'dug go/ /gang gi tshe rnyed pa ⑩de bgos zin pa de'i tshe de dag 'ongs nas de kho na bzhin du smras pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa khyed kyis dge 'dun la de ltar co dri'amatso / dge 'dun la go bar byas/ gaṇ+ḍi ⑩brdungs tshul shing brims na dukhyed ga las da gzod 0'dir phyina'/ de dag gis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag rnyed pa lta phar zhoga' /gal te de lta na kho bo cag gis dge 'dun ji ltar 10—644 ri

co dris pa smros shig /gal te khyod ①kyis dge 'dun la go bar byas/ gaṇ+ḍi ②brdungs / tshul shing brims na de ci khyed kyis kho bo cag gi bgo skal bstan tam/der zad/ rnyed pa med kyang bla ③'gro'o zhes zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge 'dun la go bar byas/ gaṇ+ḍi ④brdungs/ tshul shing brims nas gang zhig mi snang ba de'i bgo skal bstan nas bgo bar bya'o/ /bgos zin te 'ong ba gang yin pa de la ni rnyed pa sbyin par mi bya ste/ gal te de ltar bgos na legs par bgos pa yin pas 'di la 'gyod par mi bgyi'o⑤/ /dge slong gis ched du bsams te ⑥de ltar dge 'dun la co dri ⑦bar yang mi bya'o/ /dge slong ched du bsams te dudage 'dun la 0co 'dri bar byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro//gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /gang gi tshe khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis rgyal byed kyi tshal phyogs bzhi'i ⑩dge slong gi dge 'dun la phul nas tshon rtsi'i khyad par rnam pa sna tshogs kyis skephyi nang bcas te ri mo bris pa de'i tshe mnyan yod na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs kyis ji ltar khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis rgyal byed kyi tshal tshon rtsi'i khyad par rnam pa sna tshogs kyis phyi nang bcas te ri mo bris nas mchog tu phun sum tshogs par byas pa thos te/ de'i tshe srog ⑫chags brgya stong phrag du ma rgyal byed kyi tshal blta ba'i phyir nye bar song ngo / /yang de'i tshe mnyan yod na bram ze zhig gnas pa de la rgyal po dang / blon po dang / grong mi rnams bram ze 'di mdzes so zhes mngon par dad de des rgyal po'i pho brang nas chen po la 'os pa'i la ba zhig thob bo/ /des de bgos nas 10—645

rgyal byed kyi tshal du ltad mo ltar ①song ba dang / de mthong ma thag kho nar dad pa chen po skyes nas des la ba de phyogs bzhi'i dge slong gi dge 'dun la phul lol//bcom ldan 'das kyis gos kyi rnyed pa byung na tha na me mar gyi snying po'i rgyu tsam du yang mnyam par bgo'o zhes gsungs pas/ bge slong rnams kyis de tshal bu tshal bur byas nas mnyam par bgos so/ /bram ze des bsams pa la ba de chen po la 'os pa zhig pas bdag gis 'phags pa rnams la kār ṣā pa ṇa dag phul la slar blang ngo snyam ste de nang par sngar langs nas rgyal byed kyi tshal du song ba dang / rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi sgo na dge slong mang po dag ③cig 'dug go/ /des smras pa/ 'phags pa dag phyag 'tshal lo/ /bram ze chen po nad med cig/'phags pa ④la la ba phul ba de khyed kyis cir bgyis/ dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ bram ze chen po rjes su yi rang ⑤bar gyis shig /kho bo cag gis mnyam par bgos so/ /⑥gcig ⑦gis smras pa/ bdag gis ni bgo skal zhwa la glan rnal/ /gzhan zhig gis smras pa/ bdag gis ni lham 0yu thung la glan no0//gzhan zhig gis smras pa/ bdag gis ni stod kor la glan noyi/ /gzhan zhig gis smras pa/ bdag gis ni 4)lhung bzed phyi bar byas so/ des smras pa/'phags pa la ba de tsochen po la 'os pa zhig na kye ma khyed kyis de kār ṣā pa ṇa dag tu bsgyur la kār ṣā pa ṇa dag bgo 'dad ④cig ④ces zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag bram ze de zer ba bden te/ de lta bas na dge 'dun la gos kyi 0rnyed pa de lta bu grub pa gang yin pa de kār ṣā pa ṇa dag tu bsgyur la/ kār ṣā pa ṇa dag bgo bar bya'o// //18—646

sdom ni/ rung ba ma yin lnga dag gi/ /lham ni dgag pa mdzad pa dang / /dom lpags ①kyi ni lham dag dang / /de yi steng gi rim pa'o /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /drug sde rnams kyis smras pa/dga' bo nye dga' bo bdag cag gis mnyan yod du skye bo mang po thams cad la ma lus par bza' ba'i rim ②bslangs na/ rgyal po'i glang po che 'dul ba de dag gis bdag cag la cung zad kyang ma byin gyis ②tshur shog 'dong ④cung zad cig bslang ngo / /de na kha cig gis smras pa/ legs te de ltar bya mod ⑤kyi/ 'on kyang thabs shig bsham par bya'o/ /ci zhig byarjo/ seng ge'i pags pa las lham byas la de bgos te rdzi kur 'dug ⑦nas glang po che rnams bskyog ⑧par bya'o/ /gzhan dag gis smras pa/ re zhig de bzhin du bslangs la gal te ma ster na phyis de ltar bya'o zhes de rnams nang par sngar langs te de dag gi drung du song nas smras pa/ bzhin bzangs dag gtum po khyod 0kyis kho bo cag la zas kyi rin mi sbyin nam/ de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa khyed la kho bo cag ci rag lus na gang gi phyir kho bo cag gis zas kyi rin sbyin/ drug sde rnams kyis 'jal tsoto zhes byas nas song ngo / /de dag gis sngar gros byas pa bzhin seng ge'i pags ⑩pa las lham byas nas bgos te de dag glang po che rnams rgyu ba'i rdzi kur dong ⑩ste 'dug pa dang / glang po che rnams kyis seng ge'i dri tshor te bred nas gcin rtug stor 0te 'bros par brtsams so/ /glang po che 'dul ba rnams kyis lcags kyu dag gis zho sha yod med kyis bzung tson ma thub pa 10—647

dang / drug sde rnams kyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag ma gtang shig ma gtang shig /de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa mi ①thub na ji ltar mi gtang ②/drug sde rnams kyis smras pa/ kho bo cag gis glan nam/ 'phags pa de ltar gnang na sman ②che'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag gal te bza' ba'i rin ster bar dam 'cha' na glan no/ /'phags pa dbul lo/ /bden grang zhes byas nas de dag rdzi phyogs ma yin par dong ste 'dug pa dang / seng ge'i dri mi dumanam par ⑤glang po che rnams sdod do/ /glang po che 'dul ba rnams kyis smras pa/ 'phags pa ci khyod ⑥rig sngags mkhyen tam/ bzhin bzangs kho bo cag gis ③rig sngags mi shes so/ /'phags pa gal te de lta na khyed kyis ji ltar bzlog /de rnams kyis ji ltar gyur pa bsnyad pa dang / de dag gis smras pa/ khyed ⑤kyis gnod pa 'di lta bu yang byas pa lta/ gal te rgyal po'i glang po che dam pa yan lag mchog can 'di lta bu dag nags kyi nang du shor bar gyur na/ khyed kyis rgyal po la dgu ⑨byas par ma gyur tam/ de dag 'dzum dmul nas cang mi zer bar 'dug pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ nyes dmigs gang cung zad byung ba ni dge slong dag seng ge'i pags pa'i lham gyon pa las gyur gyisatshu/ de'i phyir dge slong gis seng ge'i pags pa'i lham bcang bar mi bya'o snyam du dgongs nas / dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na dge slong gis seng ge'i pags pa'i lham bcang bar mi bya ste/ dge slong seng ge'i pags pa'i lham 'chang na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gis seng ge'i pags pa'i lham bcang bar mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal 18—648

pa dang / drug sde rnams kyis stag lpags kyi lham bcang bar brtsams pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na sen mo dang / mche ba'i stobs can lnga po glang po cang shes dang / rta cang shes dang / seng ge dang / stag dang / gung gi pags ①pa'i lham bcang bar mi bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis sen mo dang mche ba'i stobs can lnga'i pags pa'i lham bcang bar mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa nye ba ②'khor gyis bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa btsun pa sen mo dang mche ba'i stobs can gzhan dag kyang mchis na/ci lags de dag gi pags pa'i lham yang bcang bar mi bgyi lags sam/ nye ba ②'khor de dag gi pags pa'i lham yang bcang bar mi bya ste/ 'chang na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro//gleng dugazhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /mnyan yod na dge slong zhig gzhang 'brum gyi nad kyis thebs pa de sman pa'i drung du song nas bzhin bzangs bdag gzhang 'brum gyis thebs na sman ston cig des smras pa/ 'phags pa dom lpags kyi lham mnobs ⑧shig dang khyod sos par 'gyur ro/ /des smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang ngo / /'phags pa khyod kyi ston pa ni thugs rje can yin pas gnang bar 'gyur ro skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de 0lta bas na gnang gis ⑦dge slong gzhang 'brum gyi nad kyis thebs ⑧pas dom lpags kyi lham bcang bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gzhang 'brum gyi nad kyis thebs pas dom lpags kyi lham bcang bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / rim pa 10—649

mang po ma rnyed nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gal te rim pa mang por ma rnyed ①na steng rim cig spun pag tu glanasapar bya'o// //'dul ba phran tshegs kyi gzhi las sgo lnga pa rdzogs sto // // cibasdus pa'i sdom ni/ rgyus pa rab snang drag po dang / /bran dang de bzhin btsod ka dang / /babs pa dang ni ④tshong dpon dang / /dge slong lhag ma mi ⑤dor ba'o/ /sdom ni/ de yi yirgyus pa 'breng bu dang / /de bzhin brang lhan rting lhan dang / /yu chad dang ni yu thung dang / /sgro ⑦ku can dag mi bya'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gis sen mo dang mche ⑧ba'i stobs can lnga'i pags pa'i lham bcang bar mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / drug sde rnams kyis de dag gi 0rgyus pas lham btsems te nyes dmigs de nyid du gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de dag gi 0rgyus pas lham btsem par mi bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de dag gi rgyus pas lham btsem par mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / drug sde rnams kyis de dag gi ⑩pags pa'i 'breng bus btsems te/ nyes dmigs de nyid du gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de dag gi ④pags pa'i 'breng bus lham btsem par mi bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de dag gi rgyus pa dang pags pa'i 'breng bus lham btsem par mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / drug sde rnams kyis de dag gi pags pa las brang lhan byas te nyes dmigs de nyid du gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de 18—650

dag gi pags pa las brang lhan mi bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de dag gi pags pa las brang lhan mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / drug sde rnams kyis de dag gi pags pa la ①snying lhan byas te/ nyes dmigs de nyid du gyur nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ②de dag gi pags pa las rting lhan mi bya'o / /bcom ldan 'das kyis de dag gi pags pa las brang lhan chadang /rting lhan mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / drug sde rnams kyis de dag gi pags pa las lham yu ⑤chad byas te nyes dmigs de nyid du gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de dag gi pags pa las lham yu chad mi bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de dag gi pags pa las brang lhan dang / rting lhan dang /lham yu chad mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / drug sde rnams kyis de dag gi pags pa las lham yu thung byas te/ nyes dmigs de nyid du gyur nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de dag gi pags pa las lham yu thung mi bya'o / /bcom ldan 'das kyis de dag gi pags pa las lham yu thung mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / drug sde rnams kyis de dag gi ⑤pags pa las lham sgro ⑥gu can byas te nyes dmigs de nyid du gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de dag gi pags pa las lham sgro ⑦ga can mi bya'o// // sdom ni/du rab snang 'dod pa thams cad dang / /dge 'dun bshos dang bzo 0sbyangs dang / /mgon med zas sbyin khre'u ⑩rnams dang / /gtsug lag khang dang bzang po 'o// //bar sdom ni/ bltam yidang rgyal po che dang bdag gi mthu/ /de bzhin mi 10—651

dkar rab byung ①rgyal tshab dang / /sangs rgyas rgyal srid nyid dang yan lag mchog /de bzhin rmi lam sa 'dzin skyes dang gnas/ /byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas na bzhugs pa na rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer na rgyal po pad ma chen po zhes ②bya ba rgyal srid byed du 'jug ste/ chos kyi rgyal po rgyal srid 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang lo legs pa dang / skye ③bo dang / mi mang pos gang ba 'thab pa dang / rtsod pa dang / 'khrug ④pa dang / 'khrug long rab tu zhi ba/ chom rkun ⑤dang / nad med pa/ sā rjolu dang / bu ram shing dang / ma he phun sum tshogs pa/ chos dang mthun pas byed du 'jug go/ /mnyan yod na ni rgyal po tshangs byin ring du 'phur/'phags ⑦rgyal na ⑧ni mu khyud mtha' yas/ kau shām bī ⑨na ni dmag brgya pa zhes ⑩bya ba rgyal srid byed du 'jug ste/ rgyal srid rgyas pa dang zhes bya ba nas/chos dang mthun par byed du 'jug go zhes bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin no/ /gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das dga' ldan gyi gnas na bzhugs pa na gzigs pa lnga po rigs la gzigs pa dang / dus la gzigs pa dang /yul la gzigs pa dang / rus la gzigs pa dang / bud med la gzigs pas ⑩'jig rten la gzigs te/ 'dod pa na spyod pa'i 8lha drug kyang lan gsum du sbyang ba mdzad nas glang po cher bstan pas yum gyi lhums su zhugs so/ /de'i tshe sa chen po yang shin tu tsogayos par gyur/ 'jig rten 'di ④thams cad kyang snang ba rgya chen pos sum bcu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi kha dog gi mthu yang zil gyis mnan nas khyab par gyur8/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten gyi bar gyi mun pa 0mun gnag thibs po smag tu gyur pa gang du nyi ma dang zla ba 'di ltar 18—652

rdzu 'phrul che ba/ 'di ltar mthu che ba 'di dag gi 'od kyis ①snang bar ma nus pa gang dag yin pa de dag kyang de'i tshe snang ba rgya chen pos khyab par gyur te/der sems can gang dag skyes pa de dag rang gi lag nas bzung yang mi mthong ba de dag kyang 'od des sems can phan tshun mthong nas shes ldan dag sems can gzhan dag kyang 'dir skyes pa lta/ shes ldan dag sems can gzhan dag kyang 'dir skyes pa lta zhes bya bar shes so/ /gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das bltam ②pa de'i tshe rgyal po chen po bzhi'i bu yang btsas ③te/ rgyal po'i khab tu ni rgyal po pad ma chen po'i bu btsas so/ /mnyan yod du ni tshangs byin gyi 'phags rgyal du ni mu khyud mtha' yas kyi/ kau shāsbyir ④ni rgyal po dmag brgya pa'i bu btsas so/ /byang chub sems dpa' bltam ⑤pa na sa chen po 'di gser zhun ⑥ma lta bur snang bar gyur pa dang / rgyal po so so nas bsams pa / bdag gi bu'i mthu'o bdag gi bu'i mthu'o snyam nas de dag so so nas ming 'dogs par byed de/ rgyal po pad ma chen pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag nga'i bu btsas pa na nyi ma'i gzugs bzhin du 'jig rten snang bar byas pas de'i phyir gzhon nu'i ming gzugs can snying po zhes gdags ⑦so/ /rgyal po tshangs byin ring du 'phur gyis smras pa/ nga'i bu btsas pa na gzhongs ⑧rnams gsal zhing gsal ba lta bur snang bas de'i phyir gzhon nu'i ming gsal rgyal zhes bya bar gdags so/ /rgyal po mu khyud mtha' yas kyis smras pa/ nga'i bu btsas pa na 'jig rten rab tu snang ba kho nas snang bar byas pas de'i phyir gzhon nu'i ming rab snang zhes bya bar gdags so/ /rgyal po dmag brgya pas smras pa/ nga'i bu btsas pa na 'jig rten nyi ma shar ba bzhin du snang bar byas pas de'i phyir gzhon 10—653

nu'i ming shar bar gdags so/ /de'i ①tshe ri ki skyin da rgyal drang srong mi dkar ba zhes bya ba 'jig rten 'di'i 'jig pa la mkhas pa/ 'chags pa la mkhas pa zhig gnas so/ /de'i tsha bo na la da zhes bya ba zhig yod pa ③de de'i drung du yang dang yang du nye bar 'gro'o/ /des ①nye bar 'ongs pa de la rtag tu 'jig pa dang 'chags pa'i gtam byas te/ de 'jig pa dang 'chags pa'i gtam thos nas skyo ste de'i thad du rab tu byung ngo / /des dus gzhan zhig na drang srong mi dkar ba'i phug snang ba rgya chen pos khyab pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang tshigs su bcad ⑤de smras pa/ nyi ma thams cad cig car ༷du/ /'dir ni shar bar gyur tam ci/ /'di ltar ri dang phug bcas par/ /'od zer dag gis 'bar ba bzhin/ /mi dkar ba yis de ⑦smras pa/ /nyi ma'i 'od tsha 'od 'di bsil/ /lus 'dir snang ba 'jug pas na/ /'di ni nges par thub pa'i 'od/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'od po che/ /gdon mi za bar lhums nas byung ⑧/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' de/ /byung ⑨ba'i 'od ni dri med pa/ /'jig rten gsum po dag kun ⑩ni/ /gser dang 'dra ba bkye ba yin/ /na la das smras pa/mkhan po gal te de lta na tshur spyon/ byang chub sems dpa' gzigs kyis ⑪bzhud do/ /des smras pa/ bu da ltar tsobyang chub sems dpa' lha dbang che bar grags pa/ dbang che bar grags pa rnams kyis bskor cing bzhugs te/de bdag cag 8gis mthong bar sla byab ma yin gyisaX/ gang gi tshe pho brang du gshegs nas mtshan btags te phyir byung ba de'i tshe ltar tso'adong ngo / /gang gi nyin par byang chub sems dpa' bltam ⑩pa de nyid kyi nyin mo 'dun pa la sogs pa rim gro pa lnga brgya dang / 'dun ma la sogs pa'i 8rim gro ma lnga brgya dang /10—654

glang po che ①mo lnga brgya dang / rta rgod ma lnga brgya yang btsas shing 'brangs/gter lnga brgya yang kha bye ste snang ngo / /blon po rnams kyis rgyal po zas gtsang la ②sbran pa/ lha zhal rjes dgyes ③pa mdzad du gsol/ gzhon nu bltam rjopa na don 'di snyed grub ste/ rim gro ba lnga brgya dang / rim gro ma lnga brgya yang btsas / glang po che ༷mo lnga brgya dang / rta rgod ma lnga brgya yang du'abrangs/gter lnga brgya yang kha bye ste bstan lags so/ /rgyal po zas gtsang ⑦gis thos nas yid bde ba skyes te smras pa/ shes ldan dag gzhon nu btsas pa ni nga'i don thams cad dang las kyi mtha' thams cad grub pas de'i phyir gzhon nu'i ming don thams cad grub pa ⑧zhes bya bar gdags so zhes ⑨byang chub sems dpa'i ⑩mtshan 'di lta ste don thams cad grub pa ⑩zhes bya bar ④der btags so/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin po che 0sna bzhi'i khyogs la bzhag ste sems can stong phrag du mas bskor nas lha dang mi'i bkur sti 8chen pos ser skya'i gzhi'i grong khyer du zhugs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' grong khyer du zhugs pa na shākya nga rgyal can mur bcor smra ba/ thug 0thub can rnams thub pa bzhin du cang mi smra bar 'dug pa dang / rgyal po zas gtsang gis smras pa/ shākya nga rgyal can mu cor smra ba thug byathub can 'di dag gzhon nu grong khyer du zhugs pa dang thub pa bzhin du cang mi smra bar 'dug pas 8de'i phyir gzhon nu'i yiming shākya thub par gdags so zhes de ni ⑥byang chub sems dpa'i mtshan gnyis pa 'di lta ste shākya thub pa zhes bya ba der btags so/ /shākya rnams la gnod sbyin gnyug mar ⑥gnas pa shākya spel ba zhes bya ba zhig yod de/ shākya su'i bu'am/ bu mo btsas kyang rung de dang por gnod sbyin shākya spel ba'i rkang pa rme phyag 'tshal du khrid nas ⑥rgyal po 10wa 655

zas gtsang gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag deng la gzhon nu gnod sbyin shākya spel ba'i rkang pa la phyag 'tshal du chug shig① /blon po rnams kyis de'i mdun du khrid pa dang / gnod sbyin shākya spel bas byang chub sems dpa' thag ring po kho na nas mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang de brtad de rings pa ②rings par gom pa bslang nas byang chub sems dpa' bsu ste larkang pa la phyag byas pa dang / rgyal po zas gtsang ④gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag gnod sbyin shākya spel ba yang gzhon nu'i rkang pa la phyag 'tshal te/ de lta bas na 'di ni lha'i yang lha yin pas de'i phyir gzhon nu'i ming lha'i yang lha zhes gdags so zhes des ⑤na byang chub sems dpa'i mtshan gsum pa 'di lta ste/ lha'i yang lha zhes bya ba der btags ⑥so/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis byang chub sems dpa' bram ze rnams dang / mtshan mkhan rnams dang / skar mkhan rnams la bstan nas/shes ldan dag gzhon nu cig phyogang dag dang ldan na skyes bu chen po'i 'gro ba gnyis su 'gyur gyi gzhan du ma yin te/ gal te khyim pa khyim na gnas pa ⑧'khor los sgyur ⑨ba'i rgyal po mtha' bzhir rnam par rgyal ba chos kyi rgyal po chos dang mthun pa rin po che sna bdun dang ldan par 'gyur zhing / de'i rin po che sna bdun ni 'di lta bu dag yin te⑩/ 'khor lo rin po che dang / glang po rin po che dang / rta rin po che dang / nor bu rin po che dang / bud med ⑪rin po che dang / khyim bdag rin po che dang / bdun ⑩pa blon po rin po che'o//gal te skra dang kha spu bregs nas gos ngur smrig 8dag bgos te dad pas ④yang dag par khyim nas khyim med par rab tu phyung (nyen 'jig rten na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes sgra rnam par 10—656

grags par 'gyur/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis dang ldan nam/de dag gis smras pa/ lha de lta lags te/ gzhon nu ni gang dag dang ldan na skyes bu chen po'i 'gro ba gnyis su 'gyur gyi gzhan du ma lags te zhes bya ba nas 'jig rten na sgra rnam par grags par 'gyur ba skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis dang ldan lags so/ /na la das ⑨smras pa/ mkhan po byang chub sems dpa' ser skya'i gzhi'i 'grong khyer du gshegs te/ de'i mtshan yang btags lags kyis ②tshur gshegs gzigs su bzhud do/ /des smras pa/ bu legs te/ de bzhin byas ④'dong ngo zhes de gnyis rdzu 'phrul gyis chas pa dang /byang chub sems dpa'i mthus de'i rdzu 'phrul nyams te rkang pa kho nas ser skya'i gzhi'i grong khyer du zhugs nas rgyal po zas gtsang gi pho brang ga la ba der song ste phyin nas rgyal po'i pho brang gi sgo na sdod do/ /de nas drang srong mi dkar bas mi zhig la smras pa/ kye skyes bu khyed ②tshur shog song la rgyal po zas gtsang la drang srong mi dkar ba lha lta ⑥bar 'dod de sgo na 'dug go zhes sgron cig /de ⑦song nas rgyal po zas gtsang la lha drang srong mi dkar ba lha lta ⑧bar 'tshal te chab sgo na mchis so zhes sbran pa dang / des smras pa/ shes ldan dag drang srong mi dkar ba las ⑨su 'gog nang du shog shig ⑩de nang du zhugs pa dang / rgyal po zas gtsang gis byon pa legs so zhes bya ba'i kun du spyod pas kun du spyad nas rkang pa la mchod yon phul te seng ge'i khri la 'dug tu bcug go/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis de'i rkang pa gnyis la gtugs nas smras pa/ drang srong chen po ci ⑩zhig gi slad du byon/ des tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ rgyal chen bdag ni khyod kyi sras/ /blta bar 'tshal nas mchis lags te/ /'jig rten 10—657

gtso bo rnam 'dren pa/ /thub pa de ni blta 'tshal lo/ /①rgyal po zas gtsang gis smras pa/ drang srong chen po gzhon nu gnyid log go/ /des smras pa/mnal bzhin blta bar bya'o②/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis smras pa/ drang srong chen po legs kyis ③de bzhin du mdzod la dugazigs shig /des song nas ⑤byang chub sems dpa' ①mig mi 'dzums ⑦par gzugs rnams la gzigs pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ rigs kyi larta po rnam ⑨dag ni/ /nam gyi gung la nyal ba ltar/ /dgos pa don du gnyer rnams kyil/ /mig la yun ring gnyid mi gnas/ /zhes smras nas smras pa/ lha ci ⑩gzhon nu bram ze rnams dang / mtshan mkhan rnams dang / skar mkhan rnams la bstan tam/ des smras pa/ drang srong chen po bstan to/ /lha de dag gis ci zhig tu lung bstan/ rgyal po zas gtsang gis lasmras pa/ 'khor los sgyur ⑩ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro zhes mchi'o/ /des byang chub sems dpa' la yan tsoman brtag par brtsams pa dang ⑫/ ji tsam na byang chub sems dpa' la sangs rgyas kyi mtshan rnams mthong nas/ dus ci ④tsam gyis bdud rtsi thob par 'gyur zhes bsams pa la zhugs nas des lo nyi shu rtsa dgu lon pa dang khyim nas byung ste lo drug tu dka' ba spyad nas bdud rtsi thob par 'gyur bar mthong ngo // de na tsobadag nyid kyi rgyud bsam pa la zhugs pa dang / bar skabs su 'chi bar mthong nas 'dod pa na spyod pa'i sred pa byung nas 8de mig mchi mas gang bzhin tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ sa bdag rtog ge rnams kyi blo gros 'khrul/ /dus kyi mthar ⑩ni 'khor los sgyur ⑩mi 'byung / /bsod nams mchog can 'di ni chos kyi mdzod/ /nyes pa rnams las rgyal te sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /mi yi 10—658 ci

dbang po mtshan gsal min rnams kyis/ /gling ①bzhi rnams kyi bdag po'i ②dbang phyug 'gyur/ /shin tu mtshan gsal thub dbang rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /mi mchog chos kyi 'khor lo skor ③bar 'gyur/ /de nas rgyal pos de mig mchi mas gang ba mthong nas bag tsha ste mi dga' nas slar tshigs su bcad de smras pa/skyes pa bud med dag ni gang phrad dunas/ /ngoms ⑤par mi 'gyur dga' ba thob 'gyur ba/ /lus bzangs dga' byed de ni 'dir gzigs nas/ /ci slad khyod ༷kyi zhal ni mchi mar bcas/ /bdag gi gzhon nu 'ga' las 'jigs pa 'am/ /tshe zad nye bar gnas par mi 'gyur ⑦grang ⑧/ /de slad dge ba 'di myur bdag la gsungs/ /khyod kyi bshums mo byung bas bdag 'dar rol/ /des kyang tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ gal te 'di yi steng du mkha' las ni/ /rdo rje'i char drag rab tu bab gyur kyang / /thub pa chen po'i sku yi ⑦spu nyag gcig /kun tu bskyod par nus pa ma yin no/ /tshan chen rlung gis rab tu bskyod pa yi/ /shin tu mi bzad yimatshon rnon rnam tsodag dang / /sbrul gdug rnams dang shin tu gdug pa'i dug /gzhon nu'i lus la bab kyang smas mi tsonas/ /mi dbang bdag ni chos mchog mdzod 8'di dang / /phrad tsonas don ma grub par 'chi 'gyur te/ /zhi ba mi 'thob rang gi nyes mthong nas / /de yi slad du bdag ni ngu bar bas/ /'jig rten dag ni gang rnams dus su ni/ /smra ba'i dam pa mtshungs med 'di yi chos/ /nyan cing thos nas rab zhi mchog 'gro ba/ /bde skyid bsod nams can de rims nad bral/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis byang chub sems dpas bdud rtsi 'thob par thos nas cang mi zer bar 'dug go/ /log pa'i lta bas nyams pa ni phal chen brdzun 0smra 10—659

ba dang g.yo kun du spyod pa la zhugs pa yin pas drang srong mi dkar bas smras pa/lha khyod ①kyi grong khyer na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs 'di snyam du kye ma ②drang srong mi dkar ba rkang gis ②ser skya'i gzhi'i ④grong khyer du 'ongs kyang ci ma rung snyam du yun ring po nas smon pas bdag skye bo la snying brtse ba'i phyir rkang kho nas ser skya'i gzhi'i grong khyer du 'ongs te rkang kho ⑤nas 'byung gis ༅grong khyer mdzes par bgyid du stsol cig /rgyal po zas gtsang ⑦gis blon po rnams la bsgo ⑧ba/shes ldan dag drang srong mi dkar ba rkang gis grong khyer nas 'byung gisal/grong khyer dang lam mdzes par byed du chug la dril sgrogs ⑨ te 'di skad du ser skya'i gzhi na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs dang yul sna tshogs nas lhags pa gzhan ⑩gyis kyang drang srong mi dkar ba grong khyer nas 'byung ba su zhig 8ces ④sgo ④shig/lha de ltar 'tshal lo zhes blon po rnams kyis ser skya'i gzhi'i grong khyer rdo dang /gsog ma dang / gyo mo med par byas/ tsan dan gyi chus chag chag btab dri zhim po'i ④pog phor bzhag⑩ /dar gyi lda ldi mang po bres/ rgyal rmetshan dang ba dan bsgreng / me tog sna tshogs bkram ༅lha rnams kyi skyed mos tshal tsodaga' ba'i tshal bas kyang lhag par dga' dga' ltar grong khyer mdzes pa dang / lam mdzes par byas nas dril bsgrags te/ 'di skad ces shes ldan yigrong khyer na gnas pa rnams dang / pho brang 'khor ba rnams dang / yul sna tshogs nas lhags pa'i skye bo'i tshogs nyon cig /lhas 'di skad ces drang srong mi dkar ba sang rkang gis ser skya'i gzhi'i grong khyer nas 'byung gis de'i phyir ⑥khyed thams cad kyis de su zhig ( 〉ces bka' stsal to(1/ /ji tsam nam nangs pa dang /drang srong mi dkar ba mi'i mchog stong phrag du mas bkur sti chen pos bskyal nas 10—660

rkang gis ser skya'i gzhi'i grong khyer nas byung ngo / /des ri ki zhin dar song nas yang bsam gtan dag kyang bskyed/ rdzu 'phrul yang bsgrubs ①so/ /de'i tshe rnam par smin pa'i las yongs su zad pas nad kyis thebs te/ rtsa ba dang /sdong bu dang / me tog dang / 'dab ②ma dang / 'bras bu'i sman rnams kyis rim gro byas kyang nad de ②nye bar zhi bar ma gyur to/ /na la das ④de'i lus kyi gnas skabs shes nas rkang pa la phyag 'tshal te smras pa/ mkhan po gang cung zad rab tu 'byung ⑤ba de thams cad ni bdud rtsi don du gnyer ba ⑥bdud rtsi tshol ba lags te⑦/ de'i slad du gal te khyod kyis bdud rtsi brnyes nani/bdag la yang bdud rtsi'i bgo bsha' mdzad du gsol/ des smras pa/ bu nga yang gang cung zad rab tu byung ba de thams cad bdud rtsi don du gnyer ba dang /bdud rtsi tshol ba yin na ngas ⑨bdud rtsi ma rnyed do/ /'on kyang khyod shākya rnams kyi nang du gzhon nu 'khrungs pa de'i spyan sngar rab tu byung tshul rigs rlom par skem byed/ rus rlom par ma byed/8 bram ze'i bu'i rlom pa ma byed par nga rgyal chog tshul tshangs par 8spyad pa spyod cig dang / des na khyod bdud rtsi thob par 'gyur ro zhes smras nas/ bsags pa kun gyi mtha' zad ④cing / /mthon po'i ⑩mtha' ni snyil ⑩bar 'gyur/ /phrad 8pa'i mtha' ni 'bral yib ste/ /gson pa'i mtha' ni shi du ba yin/ /zhes bya bas dus 0kyi chos dang ldan par gyur to/ /des de'i rus bu la rus bu'i mchod pa byas nas grong khyer bā rā ṇa sīr song ste drang srong gi nang na 'dug go/ /de na la da dang rus mthun pas de'i ming drang srong na la da zhes bya bar chags so/ /gzhon nu rab snang ma ma brgyad po pang na 'tsho ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / nu ma snun ⑤pa'i ma ma gnyis 10—661

dang / dri ma 'phyi ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / rtsen grogs ①kyi ma ma gnyis la gtad nas de ma ma brgyad kyis 'o ma dang / zho dang / mar sar sridang /mar dkar ③dang / mar gyi snying khu rjodang / gzhan yang yo byad kyi khyad par ⑤gtso bo dag gis bskyed bsrings pas mtshe'u dun 'dug pa'i pad ma bzhin du skyed drag ⑦par gyur to/ /de gang gi tshe chen por gyur pa de'i tshe yi ge dang /grangs dang / rtsis dang / lag rtsis dang / rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur bdu/ yul kyi dbang phyug la gnas pa'i mthu thob pa/ sa chen po'i dkyil 'khor rnal du phab ste gnas pa rnams kyi bzo'i gnas dang / las kyi gnas tha dad pa gang dag yin pa 'di lta ste/ glang po che'i gnyar zhon pa dang / rta la zhon pa dang / shing rta'i thabs dang / ral gri'i thabs dang /'phang ⑨dpyad dang / phyir bsnur ⑩ba dang / mdun du bsnur 7ba dang /lcags kyus bsgyur 'thabs dang / zhags pa tsogadab pa dang / mda' tsobo che 'phen pa dang / gcad pa dang / dral ba dang / 'dzin stangs dang /gom stabs byadang / thor tshugs ⑩dang / rgyang nas phog ⑩pa dang / sgra grag par 8rdzog pa dang / gnad du phog pa dang / mi 'chor ⑩bar phog pa dang /tshabs chen po de dag la mkhas par gyur te chaganas lnga la yang byang bar gyur to/ /gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das gzhon nu'i ⑥rol pa la rol pa'i 3tshe gzhon nu rab snang yang gzhon nu'i rtse ba la rtse'odu/ /gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur ba de'i tshe gzhon nu rab snang yang rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur to/ /gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' rgan po dang nad pa dang shi ba gzigs nas skyo ste sa 'tsho byam dang / ri dwags skyes dang /10—662
